        <script>
        // --- Projector Test Pattern Generator Tab Render ---
    function drawProjectorTestPattern(canvas, s, isPreview = true, circularOverride = null) {
            if (!canvas || !s) return;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            // Normalize numeric values
            const totalWidth = Math.max(1, parseInt(s.totalWidth, 10) || 1);
            const totalHeight = Math.max(1, parseInt(s.totalHeight, 10) || 1);
            const displayW = Math.max(1, parseInt(s.displayWidth, 10) || 1);
            const displayH = Math.max(1, parseInt(s.displayHeight, 10) || 1);
            const displaysX = Math.max(1, parseInt(s.displaysX, 10) || 1);
            const displaysY = Math.max(1, parseInt(s.displaysY, 10) || 1);
            // Use pixel overlaps from state (kept in sync with percent)
            let overlapX = s.overlap ? Math.max(0, Math.min(displayW - 1, parseInt(s.overlapX, 10) || 0)) : 0;
            let overlapY = s.overlap ? Math.max(0, Math.min(displayH - 1, parseInt(s.overlapY, 10) || 0)) : 0;

            // Clear and background in preview space
            const targetW = canvas.width;
            const targetH = canvas.height;
            ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, targetW, targetH);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, targetW, targetH);

            // Scale and center the logical pattern in the preview canvas
            const scale = Math.min(targetW / totalWidth, targetH / totalHeight) || 1;
            const offsetX = (targetW - totalWidth * scale) / 2;
            const offsetY = (targetH - totalHeight * scale) / 2;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(offsetX, offsetY);
            ctx.scale(scale, scale);

            // Optional circular (dome) mask
            let clippedForCircle = false;
            const useCircular = (typeof circularOverride === 'boolean') ? circularOverride : !!s.circular;
            if (useCircular) {
                clippedForCircle = true;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.beginPath();
                const r = Math.min(totalWidth, totalHeight) / 2;
                ctx.arc(totalWidth / 2, totalHeight / 2, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.clip();
            }

            // Draw display rectangles, per-projector overlay, circles, names, and center numbers
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor;
            ctx.font = '48px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            for (let y = 0; y < displaysY; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < displaysX; x++) {
                    const posX = x * (displayW - overlapX);
                    const posY = y * (displayH - overlapY);
                    const idx = y * displaysX + x;

                            // Color overlay: per-projector only
                            let overlayHex = (Array.isArray(s.projectors) && s.projectors[idx] && s.projectors[idx].color)
                                ? s.projectors[idx].color
                                : null;
                    if (overlayHex) {
                        const m = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(overlayHex);
                        if (m) {
                            const r = parseInt(m[1], 16), g = parseInt(m[2], 16), b = parseInt(m[3], 16);
                            ctx.save();
                            const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Number(s.overlayOpacity) ?? 40) / 100));
                            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`;
                            ctx.fillRect(posX, posY, displayW, displayH);
                            ctx.restore();
                        }
                    }

                    // Outline
                    ctx.strokeRect(posX, posY, displayW, displayH);
                    // Selection highlight (preview-only)
                    if (s.selectedProjectorIndex === idx && (typeof isPreview === 'undefined' || isPreview)) {
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, (Number(s.widthPxN) || 1) + 2);
                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.strokeRect(posX + 1, posY + 1, displayW - 2, displayH - 2);
                        ctx.restore();
                    }

                    // Projector label centered in tile and index below it (no shadow/outline)
                    ctx.save();
                                    try {
                                        if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush(`led parse summary: brand=${hint.brand} model=${hint.model} pitch=${hint.pitchMm} res=${hint.panelResW}x${hint.panelResH} cab=${hint.cabinetWmm}x${hint.cabinetHmm}x${hint.cabinetDmm} curve=${hint.curveType} usage=${hint.usage} viewDistM=${hint.viewDistanceM} nits=${hint.brightnessNits} refresh=${hint.refreshHz}`);
                                    } catch(_) {}
                    const hasName = Array.isArray(s.projectors) && s.projectors[idx] && s.projectors[idx].name;
                    const baseFont = Math.max(12, Math.round(Math.min(displayW, displayH) * 0.12));
                    const name = hasName ? String(s.projectors[idx].name) : `P${idx + 1}`;
                    ctx.font = `${baseFont}px Arial`;
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
                    const cx = posX + displayW / 2;
                    const cy = posY + displayH / 2 - Math.round(baseFont * 0.15);
                    ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                                        try {
                                            if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush(`projector parse summary: brand=${hint.brand} model=${hint.model} res=${hint.resolution} lumens=${hint.brightnessLumens} tech=${hint.technology} lens=${hint.lens} throw=${hint.throwRatio}`);
                                        } catch(_) {}
                    ctx.fillText(name, cx, cy);
                    // index small below
                    const idxFont = Math.max(10, Math.round(baseFont * 0.5));
                    ctx.font = `${idxFont}px Arial`;
                    ctx.fillText(String(idx + 1), cx, cy + Math.round(baseFont * 0.9));
                    ctx.restore();

                    // Per-projector circle centered in tile
                    if (s.circles) {
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Number(s.widthPxN) || 1);
                        const r = Math.min(displayW, displayH) / 2 - 10;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(posX + displayW / 2, posY + displayH / 2, Math.max(0, r), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                    
                }
            }

            // Overlap shading (different color)
            if (s.overlap && (overlapX > 0 || overlapY > 0)) {
                const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
                    const m = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex || '#ffffff');
                    return m ? { r: parseInt(m[1], 16), g: parseInt(m[2], 16), b: parseInt(m[3], 16) } : { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 };
                };
                const rgb = hexToRgb(s.overlapColor || '#ffffff');
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${rgb.r}, ${rgb.g}, ${rgb.b}, 0.18)`;

                // Vertical overlap bands between columns
                if (overlapX > 0 && displaysX > 1) {
                    for (let i = 1; i < displaysX; i++) {
                        const xStart = i * (displayW - overlapX);
                        ctx.fillRect(xStart, 0, overlapX, totalHeight);
                    }
                }
                // Horizontal overlap bands between rows
                if (overlapY > 0 && displaysY > 1) {
                    for (let j = 1; j < displaysY; j++) {
                        const yStart = j * (displayH - overlapY);
                        ctx.fillRect(0, yStart, totalWidth, overlapY);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Grid
            if (s.gridSize > 0) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Number(s.widthPxN) || 1);
                const gridSize = Math.max(1, Number(s.gridSize) || 1) * 20;
                for (let x = 0; x <= totalWidth; x += gridSize) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
                    ctx.lineTo(x, totalHeight);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
                for (let y = 0; y <= totalHeight; y += gridSize) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
                    ctx.lineTo(totalWidth, y);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }

                // Grid numbers (top and bottom)
                if (s.numbers) {
                    const centerX = totalWidth / 2;
                    const maxSteps = Math.floor(totalWidth / (2 * gridSize));
                    const fontSize = Math.min(48, Math.max(12, Math.round(gridSize * 0.5)));
                    ctx.font = `${fontSize}px Arial`;
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
                    const topY = fontSize + 6;
                    const bottomY = totalHeight - 8;
                    for (let i = -maxSteps; i <= maxSteps; i++) {
                        if (i === 0) continue; // skip zero to match common patterns
                        const x = centerX + i * gridSize;
                        if (x < 0 || x > totalWidth) continue;
                        const label = String(i);
                        ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(label, x, topY);
                        ctx.fillText(label, x, bottomY);
                    }

                    // Vertical grid numbers (left and right edges)
                    const centerY = totalHeight / 2;
                    const maxStepsY = Math.floor(totalHeight / (2 * gridSize));
                    const leftX = 16;
                    const rightX = totalWidth - 16;
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    // prevent overlaps near top/bottom corners
                    const vFontSize = fontSize;
                    ctx.font = `${vFontSize}px Arial`;
                    const avoidTop = vFontSize * 1.8; // room for top labels
                    const avoidBottom = totalHeight - vFontSize * 1.2;
                    for (let j = -maxStepsY; j <= maxStepsY; j++) {
                        if (j === 0) continue;
                        const y = centerY + j * gridSize;
                        if (y < 0 || y > totalHeight) continue;
                        if (y < avoidTop || y > avoidBottom) continue;
                        const vLabel = String(j);
                        // Left side (align left so text extends inward)
                        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
                        ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(vLabel, leftX, y);
                        // Right side (align right so text extends inward)
                        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
                        ctx.fillText(vLabel, rightX, y);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Global concentric circles (disabled by default)
            if (s.circlesGlobal) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Number(s.widthPxN) || 1);
                const centerX = totalWidth / 2;
                const centerY = totalHeight / 2;
                const maxRadius = Math.min(totalWidth, totalHeight) / 2;
                for (let r = maxRadius / 10; r < maxRadius; r += maxRadius / 10) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            }

            // Hatching overlay with styles
            if (s.hatching) {
                const density = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(s.hatchingDensity) || 1));
                const base = Math.max(10, (Number(s.gridSize) || 1) * 20);
                const spacing = Math.max(6, Math.round(base / density));
                const style = s.hatchingStyle || 'cross';
                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                if (style === 'forward' || style === 'cross') {
                    for (let d = -totalHeight; d < totalWidth; d += spacing) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(d, 0);
                        ctx.lineTo(d + totalHeight, totalHeight);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
                if (style === 'backward' || style === 'cross') {
                    for (let d = 0; d < totalWidth + totalHeight; d += spacing) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(d, 0);
                        ctx.lineTo(d - totalHeight, totalHeight);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
                ctx.restore();
            }

            // Image name label (centered, with offsets) and total size under it
            if (s.imageName) {
                const nameSize = Math.max(8, Number(s.nameFontSize) || 48);
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                const offx = Number(s.nameOffsetXPercent) || 0;
                const offy = Number(s.nameOffsetYPercent) || 0;
                const cx = Math.round(totalWidth / 2 + (totalWidth * offx / 100));
                const cy = Math.round(totalHeight / 2 + (totalHeight * offy / 100));
                // Image name
                ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
                ctx.font = `${nameSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                ctx.fillText(String(s.imageName), cx, cy);
                // Total size below
                const totalLabel = `${Math.round(totalWidth)} x ${Math.round(totalHeight)}`;
                const subSize = Math.max(18, Math.round(nameSize * 0.7));
                ctx.font = `${subSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
                const gap = Math.round(nameSize * 0.25);
                ctx.fillText(totalLabel, cx, cy + gap);
            }

            // Remove circular clip and draw border
            if (clippedForCircle) {
                ctx.restore();
                ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Number(s.widthPxN) || 1);
                ctx.beginPath();
                const r = Math.min(totalWidth, totalHeight) / 2 - ctx.lineWidth / 2;
                ctx.arc(totalWidth / 2, totalHeight / 2, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            // Logo (bottom-right) if enabled and loaded
            if (s.logo && s._logoImg && s._logoImg.complete) {
                try {
                    const img = s._logoImg;
                    const margin = 20;
                    const availW = totalWidth - margin * 2;
                    const availH = totalHeight - margin * 2;
                    const base = Math.min(availW, availH);
                    const pct = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.25, (Number(s.logoSize) || 5) / 10 * 0.2 + 0.05));
                    const target = base * pct;
                    const ar = img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight;
                    let drawW = target, drawH = target;
                    if (ar >= 1) { drawH = target / ar; } else { drawW = target * ar; }
                    const dx = totalWidth - margin - drawW;
                    const dy = totalHeight - margin - drawH;
                    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, drawW, drawH);
                } catch (_) {}
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }
        // Dedicated Dome renderer: uses explicit diameter/radius independent of rectangular totals
        function drawDomeTestPattern(canvas, s) {
            if (!canvas || !s) return;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const D = Math.max(1, Number(s.domeDiameterPx) || Math.min(Number(s.totalWidth) || 1, Number(s.totalHeight) || 1));
            const targetW = canvas.width;
            const targetH = canvas.height;
            ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, targetW, targetH);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, targetW, targetH);

            // Scale and center a D x D logical square into canvas
            const scale = Math.min(targetW / D, targetH / D) || 1;
            const offsetX = (targetW - D * scale) / 2;
            const offsetY = (targetH - D * scale) / 2;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(offsetX, offsetY);
            ctx.scale(scale, scale);

            // Circular clip using explicit diameter
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();
            const r = D / 2;
            ctx.arc(D / 2, D / 2, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.clip();

            // Grid inside circle (cartesian)
            if (s.gridSize > 0) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Number(s.widthPxN) || 1);
                const gridSize = Math.max(1, Number(s.gridSize) || 1) * 20;
                for (let x = 0; x <= D; x += gridSize) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
                    ctx.lineTo(x, D);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
                for (let y = 0; y <= D; y += gridSize) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
                    ctx.lineTo(D, y);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }

                if (s.numbers) {
                    const centerX = D / 2;
                    const maxSteps = Math.floor(D / (2 * gridSize));
                    const fontSize = Math.min(48, Math.max(12, Math.round(gridSize * 0.5)));
                    ctx.font = `${fontSize}px Arial`;
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
                    const topY = fontSize + 6;
                    const bottomY = D - 8;
                    for (let i = -maxSteps; i <= maxSteps; i++) {
                        if (i === 0) continue;
                        const x = centerX + i * gridSize;
                        if (x < 0 || x > D) continue;
                        const label = String(i);
                        ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(label, x, topY);
                        ctx.fillText(label, x, bottomY);
                    }

                    const centerY = D / 2;
                    const maxStepsY = Math.floor(D / (2 * gridSize));
                    const leftX = 16;
                    const rightX = D - 16;
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    const vFontSize = fontSize;
                    ctx.font = `${vFontSize}px Arial`;
                    const avoidTop = vFontSize * 1.8;
                    const avoidBottom = D - vFontSize * 1.2;
                    for (let j = -maxStepsY; j <= maxStepsY; j++) {
                        if (j === 0) continue;
                        const y = centerY + j * gridSize;
                        if (y < 0 || y > D) continue;
                        if (y < avoidTop || y > avoidBottom) continue;
                        const vLabel = String(j);
                        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
                        ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(vLabel, leftX, y);
                        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
                        ctx.fillText(vLabel, rightX, y);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Hatching inside circle
            if (s.hatching) {
                const density = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(s.hatchingDensity) || 1));
                const base = Math.max(10, (Number(s.gridSize) || 1) * 20);
                const spacing = Math.max(6, Math.round(base / density));
                const style = s.hatchingStyle || 'cross';
                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                if (style === 'forward' || style === 'cross') {
                    for (let d = -D; d < D; d += spacing) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(d, 0);
                        ctx.lineTo(d + D, D);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
                if (style === 'backward' || style === 'cross') {
                    for (let d = 0; d < D + D; d += spacing) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(d, 0);
                        ctx.lineTo(d - D, D);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
                ctx.restore();
            }

            // Name and diameter label
            if (s.imageName) {
                const nameSize = Math.max(8, Number(s.nameFontSize) || 48);
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                const offx = Number(s.nameOffsetXPercent) || 0;
                const offy = Number(s.nameOffsetYPercent) || 0;
                const cx = Math.round(D / 2 + (D * offx / 100));
                const cy = Math.round(D / 2 + (D * offy / 100));
                ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
                ctx.font = `${nameSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.fillStyle = s.textColor || '#ffffff';
                ctx.fillText(String(s.imageName), cx, cy);
                const totalLabel = `Ø ${Math.round(D)} px`;
                const subSize = Math.max(18, Math.round(nameSize * 0.7));
                ctx.font = `${subSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
                const gap = Math.round(nameSize * 0.25);
                ctx.fillText(totalLabel, cx, cy + gap);
            }

            // Logo bottom-right within circle bounds
            if (s.logo && s._logoImg && s._logoImg.complete) {
                try {
                    const img = s._logoImg;
                    const margin = 20;
                    const avail = D - margin * 2;
                    const target = avail * (Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.25, (Number(s.logoSize) || 5) / 10 * 0.2 + 0.05)));
                    const ar = img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight;
                    let drawW = target, drawH = target;
                    if (ar >= 1) { drawH = target / ar; } else { drawW = target * ar; }
                    const dx = D - margin - drawW;
                    const dy = D - margin - drawH;
                    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, drawW, drawH);
                } catch (_) {}
            }

            // Remove clip and draw circle border
            ctx.restore();
            ctx.strokeStyle = s.gridColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Number(s.widthPxN) || 1);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(D / 2, D / 2, D / 2 - ctx.lineWidth / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();
        }
    function renderProjectorTestPattern() {
            const container = document.getElementById('projector-test-pattern-content');
            if (!container) return;
            // Local state for the generator
            if (!window.projectorTestPatternState) {
                const storedRes = (() => {
                    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ptp-custom-resolutions') || '[]') || []; } catch(_) { return []; }
                })();
                window.projectorTestPatternState = {
                    imageName: 'Name your testpattern',
                    displayWidth: 1920,
                    displayHeight: 1080,
                    displaysX: 2,
                    displaysY: 1,
                    overlapX: 190,
                    overlapY: 0,
                    totalWidth: 3650,
                    totalHeight: 1080,
                    overlap: true,
                    logo: false,
                    gridSize: 5,
                    widthPxN: 5,
                    gridColor: '#ff0000',
                    textColor: '#ffffff',
                    circles: true,
                    hatching: false,
                    overlapUnit: 'px',
                    overlapXPercent: 0,
                    overlapYPercent: 0,
                    logoFile: null,
                    logoSize: 5,
                    circular: false,
                    nameFontSize: 48,
                    nameOffsetXPercent: 0,
                    nameOffsetYPercent: 0,
                    numbers: true,
                    overlapColor: '#ffffff',
                    projectors: [],
                    circlesGlobal: false,
                    customResList: Array.isArray(storedRes) ? storedRes : [],
                    overlayOpacity: 40,

                    hatchingDensity: 5,
                    selectedProjectorIndex: -1,
                    uiSubTab: 'calc-flat',
                    previewZoom: 1,
                    // Flat calculator defaults
                    calcFlat: {
                        screenWidthMeters: 10,
                        screenHeightMeters: 5.625,
                        calcMode: 'distanceToRatio', // 'distanceToRatio' | 'ratioToDistance'
                        throwLow: 8,
                        throwHigh: 8,
                        autoCalc: true,
                        numProjectorsHorizontal: 2,
                        overlapPercentHorizontal: 25,
                        numProjectorsVertical: 2,

            // Ensure current subtab is valid (screen tab removed)
            if (!['settings','calc-flat','calc-circ'].includes(s.uiSubTab)) {

            }
            // Ensure projector list length matches current layout
            const ensureProjectors = () => {
                const nx = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysX) || 1);
                const ny = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysY) || 1);
                const needed = nx * ny;
                const palette = ['#e6194b','#3cb44b','#ffe119','#0082c8','#f58231','#911eb4','#46f0f0','#f032e6','#d2f53c','#fabebe','#008080','#e6beff','#aa6e28','#fffac8','#800000','#aaffc3','#808000','#ffd8b1','#000080','#808080'];
                if (!Array.isArray(s.projectors)) s.projectors = [];
                let changed = false;
                while (s.projectors.length < needed) {
                    const i = s.projectors.length;
                    s.projectors.push({ name: `Projector ${i + 1}`, color: palette[i % palette.length] });
                    changed = true;
                }
                while (s.projectors.length > needed) { s.projectors.pop(); changed = true; }
                return changed;
            };
            ensureProjectors();
            // Helpers for dome unit conversions
            const unitToMeters = (v, unit) => unit === 'ft' ? (v * 0.3048) : v;
            const metersToUnit = (m, unit) => unit === 'ft' ? (m / 0.3048) : m;
            const fmtDomeVal = (n, unit) => {
                const dp = (unit === 'ft') ? 2 : 3;
                const val = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
                return String(val.toFixed(dp));
            };
            // Initialize dome diameter once or when lock is enabled
            if (s.domeDiameterPx == null || s.domeDiameterLock) {
                const tw0 = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalWidth) || 1);
                const th0 = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalHeight) || 1);
                s.domeDiameterPx = Math.min(tw0, th0);
            }
            if (s.domeDiameterValue == null) {
                const meters = (Math.max(1, Number(s.domePixelsPerMeter) || 1) > 0) ? s.domeDiameterPx / Math.max(1, Number(s.domePixelsPerMeter) || 1) : 0;
                s.domeDiameterValue = metersToUnit(meters, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
            }
            const defaultResolutions = [
                { w: 800, h: 600, label: '800×600 (4:3)' },
                { w: 1024, h: 768, label: '1024×768 (4:3)' },
                { w: 1152, h: 864, label: '1152×864 (4:3)' },
                { w: 1280, h: 960, label: '1280×960 (4:3)' },
                { w: 1400, h: 1050, label: '1400×1050 (4:3)' },
                { w: 1600, h: 1200, label: '1600×1200 (4:3)' },
                { w: 2048, h: 1536, label: '2048×1536 (4:3)' },
                { w: 1280, h: 1024, label: '1280×1024 (5:4)' },
                { w: 2560, h: 2048, label: '2560×2048 (5:4)' },
                { w: 1280, h: 720, label: '1280×720 (16:9)' },
                { w: 1366, h: 768, label: '1366×768 (16:9)' },
                { w: 1600, h: 900, label: '1600×900 (16:9)' },
                { w: 1920, h: 1080, label: '1920×1080 (16:9)' },
                { w: 2048, h: 1152, label: '2048×1152 (16:9)' },
                { w: 3840, h: 2160, label: '3840×2160 (16:9)' },
                { w: 1280, h: 800, label: '1280×800 (16:10)' },
                { w: 1440, h: 900, label: '1440×900 (16:10)' },
                { w: 1680, h: 1050, label: '1680×1050 (16:10)' },
                { w: 1920, h: 1200, label: '1920×1200 (16:10)' },
                { w: 2560, h: 1600, label: '2560×1600 (16:10)' },
                { w: 2048, h: 1080, label: '2048×1080 (17:9)' },
                { w: 4096, h: 2160, label: '4096×2160 (17:9)' },
                { w: 800, h: 480, label: '800×480 (5:3)' },
                { w: 1280, h: 768, label: '1280×768 (5:3)' },
                { w: 1080, h: 1920, label: '1080×1920 (9:16)' },
                { w: 1200, h: 1920, label: '1200×1920 (10:16)' },
                { w: 2160, h: 3840, label: '2160×3840 (9:16)' },
                { w: 2160, h: 4096, label: '2160×4096 (10:17)' }
            ];
            const customRes = Array.isArray(s.customResList) ? s.customResList : [];
            const allRes = [...defaultResolutions, ...customRes.map(({w,h}) => ({ w, h, label: `Custom (${w}×${h})` }))];
            const buildOptions = (selW, selH) => {
                const matchIdx = allRes.findIndex(r => r.w === Number(selW) && r.h === Number(selH));
                const isCustomSelection = matchIdx === -1;
                const optionsHtml = allRes.map((r, idx) => {
                    const selected = (!isCustomSelection && idx === matchIdx) ? 'selected' : '';
                    return `<option value="${r.w}x${r.h}" ${selected}>${r.label}</option>`;
                }).join('') + `<option value="__custom__" ${isCustomSelection ? 'selected' : ''}>Custom…</option>`;
                return { optionsHtml, isCustomSelection };
            };
            const settingsOptions = buildOptions(s.displayWidth, s.displayHeight);
            const flatOptions = buildOptions(s.calcFlat?.projectorWidthPx, s.calcFlat?.projectorHeightPx);
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="p-6 ptp-theme-amber">
                    <!-- Sub-tabs -->
                    <nav class="rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4">

                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Projectors (V)</div>
                                            <input id="fc-nv" type="number" min="1" step="1" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcFlat.numProjectorsVertical}">
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <label class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Vertical Blend (<span id="fc-ovv-val">${s.calcFlat.overlapPercentVertical.toFixed ? s.calcFlat.overlapPercentVertical.toFixed(1) : s.calcFlat.overlapPercentVertical}</span>%)</label>
                                            <input id="fc-ovv" type="range" min="0" max="90" step="0.1" class="w-full h-2 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer" value="${s.calcFlat.overlapPercentVertical}">
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="col-span-2 flex items-center gap-3 mt-1">
                                            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-200"><input id="fc-auto" type="checkbox" class="accent-amber-500 w-4 h-4" ${s.calcFlat.autoCalc ? 'checked' : ''}> Auto-calc projectors</label>
                                            <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">Uses screen size, blends, and projector aspect to choose a minimal grid</span>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    
                                </div>
                                <div class="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-gray-200">
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Total Resolution</span><span id="fc-res" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span id="fc-throw-label">${s.calcFlat.calcMode==='ratioToDistance'?'Calculated Throw Distance':'Calculated Throw Ratio'}</span><span id="fc-throw" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Single Image Width</span><span id="fc-single-w" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Single Image Height</span><span id="fc-single-h" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Required Overlap (H)</span><span id="fc-overlap-req" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Fit-Height Canvas</span><span id="fc-fit-canvas" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Pixel Width</span><span id="fc-pxwmm" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Pixel Height</span><span id="fc-pxhmm" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Horizontal Overlap</span><span id="fc-ovh-out" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Vertical Overlap</span><span id="fc-ovv-out" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Blend Zone (px)</span><span id="fc-blend-px" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Projector Spacing</span><span id="fc-proj-spacing" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-black rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 p-3 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[550px] shadow-2xl">
                                <svg id="fc-svg" viewBox="-50 -50 1100 700" class="w-full h-full"></svg>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Circular / Semi-circular Calculator Panel -->
                    <div id="ptp-panel-calc-circular" class="${s.uiSubTab==='calc-circ' ? '' : 'hidden'}">
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 items-start">
                            <div class="bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 p-5 shadow-2xl">
                                <div class="text-xl font-semibold text-amber-400 mb-4">Circular / Semi-circular Calculator</div>
                                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Shape</div>
                                            <select id="cc-shape" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500">
                                                <option value="circle" ${s.calcCirc.shape==='circle'?'selected':''}>Circle (360°)</option>
                                                <option value="semi" ${s.calcCirc.shape==='semi'?'selected':''}>Semi-circle (180°)</option>
                                            </select>
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Diameter (m)</div>
                                            <input id="cc-d" type="number" step="0.001" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.diameter}">
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Calculation Mode</div>
                                        <select id="cc-mode" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500">
                                            <option value="distanceToRatio" ${s.calcCirc.calcMode==='distanceToRatio'?'selected':''}>Calculate Ratio (from Distance)</option>
                                            <option value="ratioToDistance" ${s.calcCirc.calcMode==='ratioToDistance'?'selected':''}>Calculate Distance (from Ratio)</option>
                                        </select>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <div id="cc-throw-low-label" class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">${s.calcCirc.calcMode==='ratioToDistance'?'Throw Distance (m)':'Lens Throw Ratio (Low)'} </div>
                                        <input id="cc-throw-low" type="number" step="0.01" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.throwLow}">
                                    </div>
                                    <div id="cc-throw-high-wrap" class="${s.calcCirc.calcMode==='ratioToDistance'?'hidden':''}">
                                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Lens Throw Ratio (High)</div>
                                        <input id="cc-throw-high" type="number" step="0.01" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.throwHigh}">
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Along Arc (Projectors)</div>
                                            <input id="cc-nh" type="number" min="1" step="1" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.numProjectorsHorizontal}">
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <label class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Arc Blend (<span id="cc-ovh-val">${s.calcCirc.overlapPercentHorizontal.toFixed ? s.calcCirc.overlapPercentHorizontal.toFixed(1) : s.calcCirc.overlapPercentHorizontal}</span>%)</label>
                                            <input id="cc-ovh" type="range" min="0" max="90" step="0.1" class="w-full h-2 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer" value="${s.calcCirc.overlapPercentHorizontal}">
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Projectors (V)</div>
                                            <input id="cc-nv" type="number" min="1" step="1" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.numProjectorsVertical}">
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <label class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Vertical Blend (<span id="cc-ovv-val">${s.calcCirc.overlapPercentVertical.toFixed ? s.calcCirc.overlapPercentVertical.toFixed(1) : s.calcCirc.overlapPercentVertical}</span>%)</label>
                                            <input id="cc-ovv" type="range" min="0" max="90" step="0.1" class="w-full h-2 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer" value="${s.calcCirc.overlapPercentVertical}">
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Projector Width (px)</div>
                                            <input id="cc-pxw" type="number" step="1" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.projectorWidthPx}">
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium mb-1">Projector Height (px)</div>
                                            <input id="cc-pxh" type="number" step="1" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500" value="${s.calcCirc.projectorHeightPx}">
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-gray-200">
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Total Resolution</span><span id="cc-res" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Pixel Pitch (avg)</span><span id="cc-pitch" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span id="cc-throw-label">${s.calcCirc.calcMode==='ratioToDistance'?'Calculated Throw Ratio':'Calculated Throw Distance'}</span><span id="cc-throw" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Pixel Width</span><span id="cc-pxwmm" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Pixel Height</span><span id="cc-pxhmm" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                    <div class="bg-slate-800/70 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between"><span>Arc Length</span><span id="cc-arc" class="font-bold text-amber-400">-</span></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-black rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 p-3 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[550px] shadow-2xl">
                                <svg id="cc-svg" viewBox="0 0 700 520" class="w-full h-full"></svg>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            // Bind sub-tab clicks
            try {
                const subtabButtons = container.querySelectorAll('.ptp-subtab');
                subtabButtons.forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const k = btn.getAttribute('data-subtab');
                        if (!k) return;
                        s.uiSubTab = k;
                        renderProjectorTestPattern();
                    });
                });
            } catch(_) {}
            // Bind all controls to state and redraw preview on change
            const canvas = document.getElementById('testpattern-preview-canvas');
            const domeCanvas = document.getElementById('testpattern-dome-canvas');
            const fcSvg = document.getElementById('fc-svg');
            const ccSvg = document.getElementById('cc-svg');
            const previewStage = document.getElementById('ptp-preview-stage');
            const previewZoomWrap = document.getElementById('ptp-preview-zoom');
            const zoomLabel = document.getElementById('ptp-zoom-label');

            // Helper: draw both previews (main rectangular, dome circular)
            const drawBothPreviews = () => {
                if (canvas) drawProjectorTestPattern(canvas, s, true, false);
                if (domeCanvas) drawDomeTestPattern(domeCanvas, s);
            };

            const setPreviewZoom = (z) => {
                const next = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(3, Number(z) || 1));
                s.previewZoom = next;
                if (previewZoomWrap) previewZoomWrap.style.transform = `scale(${next})`;
                if (zoomLabel) zoomLabel.textContent = `${Math.round(next * 100)}%`;
            };
            const fitPreviewZoom = () => {
                if (!previewStage || !canvas) return;
                const w = Math.max(1, previewStage.clientWidth);
                const h = Math.max(1, previewStage.clientHeight);
                const scale = Math.min(w / canvas.width, h / canvas.height);
                setPreviewZoom(scale);
            };
            // Keep flat calculator projector resolution in sync with Native Resolution
            const syncFlatProjResFromNative = () => {
                try {
                    const w = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayWidth) || 1);
                    const h = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayHeight) || 1);
                    s.calcFlat.projectorWidthPx = w;
                    s.calcFlat.projectorHeightPx = h;
                    const wEl = document.getElementById('fc-pxw');
                    const hEl = document.getElementById('fc-pxh');
                    if (wEl) wEl.value = String(w);
                    if (hEl) hEl.value = String(h);
                } catch(_) {}
            };
            // Helper: toggle dome card visibility
            const syncDomeVisibility = () => {
                const card = document.getElementById('dome-visualizer-card');
                if (!card) return;
                if (s.circular) card.classList.remove('hidden'); else card.classList.add('hidden');
            };
            // --- Flat Calculator: visualization helper ---
            // Auto-calc projectors (flat): find minimal nV and nH to cover HxW using blends and projector aspect
            const autoCalcFlatProjectors = () => {
                const autoEl = document.getElementById('fc-auto');
                if (!autoEl || !autoEl.checked) return false;
                const Wm = Math.max(0, Number(document.getElementById('fc-screen-w')?.value) || 0);
                const Hm = Math.max(0, Number(document.getElementById('fc-screen-h')?.value) || 0);
                const fH = Math.max(0, Math.min(0.9, (Number(document.getElementById('fc-ovh')?.value) || 0)/100));
                const fV = Math.max(0, Math.min(0.9, (Number(document.getElementById('fc-ovv')?.value) || 0)/100));
                const pxW = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-pxw')?.value) || 1);
                const pxH = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-pxh')?.value) || 1);
                const ar = pxW / pxH;
                let best = { nH: null, nV: null, total: Infinity };
                for (let nV = 1; nV <= 10; nV++) {
                    const effV = nV - (nV - 1) * fV; // coverage factor
                    const Hp = effV > 0 ? (Hm / effV) : Infinity; // per-projector image height required
                    if (!isFinite(Hp) || Hp <= 0) continue;
                    const Wp = Hp * ar; // per-projector image width by aspect
                    // find minimal nH that covers width using overlap
                    let nH = 1;
                    for (; nH <= 16; nH++) {
                        const effH = nH - (nH - 1) * fH;
                        const coverW = Wp * effH;
                        if (coverW + 1e-6 >= Wm) break;
                    }
                    if (nH > 16) continue;
                    const total = nH * nV;
                    if (total < best.total || (total === best.total && (best.nV == null || nH < best.nH))) {
                        best = { nH, nV, total };
                    }
                }
                if (best.nH && best.nV) {
                    const nhEl = document.getElementById('fc-nh');
                    const nvEl = document.getElementById('fc-nv');
                    if (nhEl) nhEl.value = String(best.nH);
                    if (nvEl) nvEl.value = String(best.nV);
                    s.calcFlat.numProjectorsHorizontal = best.nH;
                    s.calcFlat.numProjectorsVertical = best.nV;
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            };

            const drawFlatCalc = () => {
                if (!document.getElementById('ptp-panel-calc-flat') || !fcSvg) return;
                // read values
                const Wm = Math.max(0, Number(document.getElementById('fc-screen-w')?.value) || 0);
                const Hm = Math.max(0, Number(document.getElementById('fc-screen-h')?.value) || 0);
                const mode = (document.getElementById('fc-mode')?.value) || 'distanceToRatio';
                const tLow = Number(document.getElementById('fc-throw-low')?.value) || 0;
                const tHighRaw = Number(document.getElementById('fc-throw-high')?.value);
                const nH = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-nh')?.value) || 1);
                const nV = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-nv')?.value) || 1);
                let ovH = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('fc-ovh')?.value) || 0));
                let ovV = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('fc-ovv')?.value) || 0));
                const pxW = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-pxw')?.value) || 1);
                const pxH = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-pxh')?.value) || 1);

                // If auto-calc is enabled, compute nH/nV before calculations
                autoCalcFlatProjectors();
                // Re-read nH/nV in case they were adjusted
                let nH2 = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-nh')?.value) || nH);
                let nV2 = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-nv')?.value) || nV);

                // Universal grid solver
                const SAFE_OVERLAP = 0.20;
                const projAspect = pxH > 0 ? (pxW / pxH) : 0;
                const screenAspect = (Wm > 0 && Hm > 0) ? (Wm / Hm) : 0;
                let bestRows = 1;
                let bestCols = 1;
                if (screenAspect > 0 && projAspect > 0) {
                    if (screenAspect > projAspect) {
                        bestRows = 1;
                        bestCols = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((screenAspect / projAspect) / (1 - SAFE_OVERLAP)));
                    } else {
                        bestCols = 1;
                        bestRows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(((projAspect / screenAspect)) / (1 - SAFE_OVERLAP)));
                    }
                }

                const imgHFit = (bestRows > 0) ? (Hm / bestRows) : 0;
                const imgWFit = imgHFit * projAspect;
                const totalWidthA = (bestCols * imgWFit) - ((bestCols - 1) * (imgWFit * SAFE_OVERLAP));
                let imgWFinal = imgWFit;
                let imgHFinal = imgHFit;
                if (totalWidthA < Wm && bestCols > 0) {
                    const denom = bestCols - ((bestCols - 1) * SAFE_OVERLAP);
                    imgWFinal = denom > 0 ? (Wm / denom) : imgWFit;
                    imgHFinal = projAspect > 0 ? (imgWFinal / projAspect) : imgHFit;
                }

                let overlapWM = 0, overlapHM = 0, overlapWPct = 0, overlapHPct = 0;
                if (bestCols > 1 && imgWFinal > 0) {
                    const totalRawW = bestCols * imgWFinal;
                    overlapWM = Math.max(0, (totalRawW - Wm) / (bestCols - 1));
                    overlapWPct = overlapWM / imgWFinal;
                }
                if (bestRows > 1 && imgHFinal > 0) {
                    const totalRawH = bestRows * imgHFinal;
                    overlapHM = Math.max(0, (totalRawH - Hm) / (bestRows - 1));
                    overlapHPct = overlapHM / imgHFinal;
                }

                const ppm = imgWFinal > 0 ? (pxW / imgWFinal) : 0;
                let totalResX = Math.round(Wm * ppm);
                let totalResY = Math.round(Hm * ppm);
                const overlapWPx = Math.round(overlapWPct * pxW);
                const overlapHPx = Math.round(overlapHPct * pxH);

                const autoEl = document.getElementById('fc-auto');
                if (autoEl && autoEl.checked) {
                    nH2 = bestCols;
                    nV2 = bestRows;
                    ovH = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, overlapWPct * 100));
                    ovV = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, overlapHPct * 100));
                    const nhEl = document.getElementById('fc-nh');
                    const nvEl = document.getElementById('fc-nv');
                    const ovhEl = document.getElementById('fc-ovh');
                    const ovvEl = document.getElementById('fc-ovv');
                    const ovhValEl = document.getElementById('fc-ovh-val');
                    const ovvValEl = document.getElementById('fc-ovv-val');
                    if (nhEl) nhEl.value = String(nH2);
                    if (nvEl) nvEl.value = String(nV2);
                    if (ovhEl) ovhEl.value = String(ovH);
                    if (ovvEl) ovvEl.value = String(ovV);
                    if (ovhValEl) ovhValEl.textContent = ovH.toFixed(1);
                    if (ovvValEl) ovvValEl.textContent = ovV.toFixed(1);
                    s.calcFlat.numProjectorsHorizontal = nH2;
                    s.calcFlat.numProjectorsVertical = nV2;
                    s.calcFlat.overlapPercentHorizontal = ovH;
                    s.calcFlat.overlapPercentVertical = ovV;
                }

                const ovHDec = ovH/100, ovVDec = ovV/100;
                const totWpx = (nH2===1)? pxW : (nH2*pxW - (nH2-1)*(pxW*ovHDec));
                const totHpx = (nV2===1)? pxH : (nV2*pxH - (nV2-1)*(pxH*ovVDec));
                const Wmm = Wm*1000, Hmm = Hm*1000;
                const pwmm = totWpx>0 ? (Wmm / totWpx) : 0;
                const phmm = totHpx>0 ? (Hmm / totHpx) : 0;
                const avgPitch = (pwmm + phmm)/2;
                const singleWm = imgWFinal || (pxW * pwmm)/1000;
                const singleHm = imgHFinal || (pxH * phmm)/1000;
                const pixelOverlap = overlapWPx || Math.round(pxW * ovHDec);
                const projectorSpacing = singleWm * (1 - (overlapWPct || ovHDec));
                totalResX = Math.round(Wm * (singleWm > 0 ? (pxW / singleWm) : 0));
                totalResY = Math.round(Hm * (singleWm > 0 ? (pxW / singleWm) : 0));

                // Throw
                let throwOut = '-', throwMeters = 0;
                const throwLabel = document.getElementById('fc-throw-label');
                if (throwLabel) throwLabel.textContent = (mode==='ratioToDistance')? 'Calculated Throw Distance' : 'Calculated Throw Ratio';
                if (mode === 'distanceToRatio') {
                    const ratio = singleWm>0 ? (tLow / singleWm) : 0;
                    throwOut = `${ratio.toFixed(2)} : 1`;
                    throwMeters = tLow;
                } else {
                    const tHigh = (isFinite(tHighRaw) && tHighRaw >= tLow) ? tHighRaw : tLow;
                    const dLow = tLow * singleWm;
                    const dHigh = tHigh * singleWm;
                    throwOut = (Math.abs(dHigh-dLow)<1e-6) ? `${dLow.toFixed(2)} m` : `${dLow.toFixed(2)} - ${dHigh.toFixed(2)} m`;
                    throwMeters = dLow;
                }

                // Results
                const ovHPx = pxW * ovHDec; const ovVPx = pxH * ovVDec;
                const ovHM = (ovHPx * pwmm)/1000; const ovVM = (ovVPx * phmm)/1000;
                const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
                const setTxt = (id, v) => { const el = byId(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
                setTxt('fc-res', `${Math.round(totWpx)} x ${Math.round(totHpx)} px`);
                setTxt('fc-throw', throwOut);
                setTxt('fc-single-w', `${singleWm.toFixed(2)} m`);
                setTxt('fc-single-h', `${singleHm.toFixed(2)} m`);
                setTxt('fc-overlap-req', `${overlapWM.toFixed(2)} m (${(overlapWPct * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
                setTxt('fc-fit-canvas', `${totalResX} x ${totalResY} px`);
                setTxt('fc-pxwmm', `${pwmm.toFixed(2)} mm`);
                setTxt('fc-pxhmm', `${phmm.toFixed(2)} mm`);
                setTxt('fc-ovh-out', `${overlapWM.toFixed(2)} m (${overlapWPx} px)`);
                setTxt('fc-ovv-out', `${overlapHM.toFixed(2)} m (${overlapHPx} px)`);
                setTxt('fc-blend-px', `${pixelOverlap} px`);
                setTxt('fc-proj-spacing', `${projectorSpacing.toFixed(2)} m`);

                // Persist flat calc summary for PDF
                s.calcFlat.lastSummary = {
                    screen: `${Wm.toFixed(2)}m x ${Hm.toFixed(2)}m`,
                    projectorRes: `${pxW} x ${pxH}`,
                    grid: `${nV2} x ${nH2}`,
                    singleImage: `${singleWm.toFixed(2)}m x ${singleHm.toFixed(2)}m`,
                    overlapH: `${overlapWM.toFixed(2)}m (${overlapWPx} px, ${(overlapWPct*100).toFixed(1)}%)`,
                    overlapV: `${overlapHM.toFixed(2)}m (${overlapHPx} px, ${(overlapHPct*100).toFixed(1)}%)`,
                    canvas: `${totalResX} x ${totalResY} px`,
                    spacing: `${projectorSpacing.toFixed(2)} m`
                };

                // Sync to Projector Test Pattern state and render preview
                try {
                    const ptp = window.projectorTestPatternState || (window.projectorTestPatternState = {});
                    ptp.displayWidth = pxW;
                    ptp.displayHeight = pxH;
                    ptp.displaysX = nH2;
                    ptp.displaysY = nV2;
                    ptp.overlap = (overlapWPx > 0 || overlapHPx > 0);
                    ptp.overlapX = Math.max(0, overlapWPx);
                    ptp.overlapY = Math.max(0, overlapHPx);
                    ptp.overlapXPercent = pxW > 0 ? Math.round((ptp.overlapX / pxW) * 100) : 0;
                    ptp.overlapYPercent = pxH > 0 ? Math.round((ptp.overlapY / pxH) * 100) : 0;
                    ptp.totalWidth = totalResX;
                    ptp.totalHeight = totalResY;
                    ptp.imageName = `Flat_${Wm.toFixed(2)}x${Hm.toFixed(2)}m`;
                    const needed = Math.max(1, nH2 * nV2);
                    if (!Array.isArray(ptp.projectors)) ptp.projectors = [];
                    while (ptp.projectors.length < needed) {
                        const idx = ptp.projectors.length + 1;
                        ptp.projectors.push({ name: `Projector ${idx}`, color: '#ffffff' });
                    }
                    if (ptp.projectors.length > needed) ptp.projectors = ptp.projectors.slice(0, needed);
                    if (typeof drawProjectorTestPattern === 'function') {
                        const previewCanvas = document.getElementById('testpattern-preview-canvas');
                        if (previewCanvas) drawProjectorTestPattern(previewCanvas, ptp, true, false);
                    }
                } catch (_) {}
                const ovhVal = byId('fc-ovh-val'); if (ovhVal) ovhVal.textContent = ovH.toFixed(1);
                const ovvVal = byId('fc-ovv-val'); if (ovvVal) ovvVal.textContent = ovV.toFixed(1);

                // Visualization
                fcSvg.innerHTML = '';
                const svgW = 1000;
                const svgH = (Wm>0) ? (svgW / Wm) * Hm : 600;
                const m = 50;
                const m2px = (Wm>0) ? (svgW / Wm) : 0;
                const projGap = Math.max(60, Math.min(svgH * 1.2, (throwMeters || 0) * m2px));
                fcSvg.setAttribute('viewBox', `${-m} ${-m} ${svgW + m*2} ${svgH + projGap + m*2}`);

                const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
                // Arrowhead marker for dimension lines
                const defs = document.createElementNS(NS,'defs');
                const marker = document.createElementNS(NS,'marker');
                marker.setAttribute('id','fc-arrow');
                marker.setAttribute('markerWidth','8');
                marker.setAttribute('markerHeight','8');
                marker.setAttribute('refX','4');
                marker.setAttribute('refY','4');
                marker.setAttribute('orient','auto');
                const mpath = document.createElementNS(NS,'path');
                mpath.setAttribute('d','M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z');
                mpath.setAttribute('fill','#6B7280');
                marker.appendChild(mpath);
                defs.appendChild(marker);
                fcSvg.appendChild(defs);
                const rect = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
                rect.setAttribute('x','0'); rect.setAttribute('y','0'); rect.setAttribute('width', String(svgW)); rect.setAttribute('height', String(svgH));
                rect.setAttribute('fill','none'); rect.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF'); rect.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');
                fcSvg.appendChild(rect);

                const projW = (singleWm / Wm) * svgW;
                const projH = (singleHm / Hm) * svgH;
                const stepX = (nH2>1) ? (svgW - projW) / (nH2 - 1) : 0;
                const stepY = (nV2>1) ? (svgH - projH) / (nV2 - 1) : 0;
                // coverage
                for (let y=0;y<nV2;y++){
                    for (let x=0;x<nH2;x++){
                        const r = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
                        r.setAttribute('x', String(x*stepX));
                        r.setAttribute('y', String(y*stepY));
                        r.setAttribute('width', String(projW));
                        r.setAttribute('height', String(projH));
                        r.setAttribute('fill','rgba(37,99,235,0.18)');
                        r.setAttribute('stroke','rgba(37,99,235,0.5)');
                        r.setAttribute('stroke-width','1');
                        fcSvg.appendChild(r);
                    }
                }
                // overlap bands
                const ovWpx = projW * ovHDec; const ovHpx = projH * ovVDec;
                if (nH2>1 && ovWpx>0){
                    for (let i=1;i<nH2;i++){
                        const b = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
                        b.setAttribute('x', String(i*stepX)); b.setAttribute('y','0');
                        b.setAttribute('width', String(ovWpx)); b.setAttribute('height', String(svgH));
                        b.setAttribute('fill','rgba(37,99,235,0.35)');
                        fcSvg.appendChild(b);
                    }
                }
                if (nV2>1 && ovHpx>0){
                    for (let j=1;j<nV2;j++){
                        const b = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
                        b.setAttribute('x','0'); b.setAttribute('y', String(j*stepY));
                        b.setAttribute('width', String(svgW)); b.setAttribute('height', String(ovHpx));
                        b.setAttribute('fill','rgba(37,99,235,0.35)');
                        fcSvg.appendChild(b);
                    }
                }
                // Dimension arrows for width and height
                const dimColor = '#6B7280';
                // Width arrow (top)
                const wLine = document.createElementNS(NS,'line');
                wLine.setAttribute('x1','0'); wLine.setAttribute('y1', String(-20));
                wLine.setAttribute('x2', String(svgW)); wLine.setAttribute('y2', String(-20));
                wLine.setAttribute('stroke', dimColor); wLine.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.5');
                wLine.setAttribute('marker-start','url(#fc-arrow)');
                wLine.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#fc-arrow)');
                fcSvg.appendChild(wLine);
                const wText = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
                wText.setAttribute('x', String(svgW/2)); wText.setAttribute('y', String(-30));
                wText.setAttribute('fill','#9CA3AF'); wText.setAttribute('font-size','12'); wText.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
                wText.textContent = `${(isFinite(Wm)?Wm:0).toFixed(2)} m`;
                fcSvg.appendChild(wText);
                // Height arrow (left)
                const hLine = document.createElementNS(NS,'line');
                hLine.setAttribute('x1', String(-20)); hLine.setAttribute('y1','0');
                hLine.setAttribute('x2', String(-20)); hLine.setAttribute('y2', String(svgH));
                hLine.setAttribute('stroke', dimColor); hLine.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.5');
                hLine.setAttribute('marker-start','url(#fc-arrow)');
                hLine.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#fc-arrow)');
                fcSvg.appendChild(hLine);
                const hText = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
                hText.setAttribute('x', String(-30)); hText.setAttribute('y', String(svgH/2));
                hText.setAttribute('fill','#9CA3AF'); hText.setAttribute('font-size','12'); hText.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
                hText.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(-90 ${-30} ${svgH/2})`);
                hText.textContent = `${(isFinite(Hm)?Hm:0).toFixed(2)} m`;
                fcSvg.appendChild(hText);
                // projector icons and throw lines
                const projY = svgH + projGap; const projSize = 18;
                for (let x=0;x<nH2;x++){
                    const cx = x*stepX + projW/2;
                    const pr = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
                    pr.setAttribute('x', String(cx - projSize/2));
                    pr.setAttribute('y', String(projY - projSize/2));
                    pr.setAttribute('width', String(projSize)); pr.setAttribute('height', String(projSize));
                    pr.setAttribute('fill','#ffffff'); pr.setAttribute('stroke','#111827'); pr.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.5');
                    fcSvg.appendChild(pr);
                    const l1 = document.createElementNS(NS,'line'); l1.setAttribute('x1', String(cx)); l1.setAttribute('y1', String(projY)); l1.setAttribute('x2', String(x*stepX)); l1.setAttribute('y2', String(svgH)); l1.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF'); l1.setAttribute('stroke-width','1'); fcSvg.appendChild(l1);
                    const l2 = document.createElementNS(NS,'line'); l2.setAttribute('x1', String(cx)); l2.setAttribute('y1', String(projY)); l2.setAttribute('x2', String(x*stepX + projW)); l2.setAttribute('y2', String(svgH)); l2.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF'); l2.setAttribute('stroke-width','1'); fcSvg.appendChild(l2);
                    // Center throw dimension line and label (annotation)
                    const dLine = document.createElementNS(NS,'line');
                    dLine.setAttribute('x1', String(cx)); dLine.setAttribute('y1', String(projY));
                    dLine.setAttribute('x2', String(cx)); dLine.setAttribute('y2', String(svgH));
                    dLine.setAttribute('stroke', dimColor); dLine.setAttribute('stroke-width','1'); dLine.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','4,4');
                    fcSvg.appendChild(dLine);
                    const midY = (projY + svgH)/2 - 6;
                    const dText = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
                    dText.setAttribute('x', String(cx)); dText.setAttribute('y', String(midY));
                    dText.setAttribute('fill','#9CA3AF'); dText.setAttribute('font-size','10'); dText.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
                    dText.textContent = `${(isFinite(throwMeters)?throwMeters:0).toFixed(2)} m`;
                    fcSvg.appendChild(dText);
                    if (x < nH-1){
                        const nx = (x+1)*stepX + projW/2; const mid = (cx+nx)/2; const yL = projY + 16;
                        const dash = document.createElementNS(NS,'line'); dash.setAttribute('x1', String(cx)); dash.setAttribute('y1', String(yL)); dash.setAttribute('x2', String(nx)); dash.setAttribute('y2', String(yL)); dash.setAttribute('stroke','#6B7280'); dash.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','4,4'); fcSvg.appendChild(dash);
                        const label = document.createElementNS(NS,'text'); label.setAttribute('x', String(mid)); label.setAttribute('y', String(yL - 4)); label.setAttribute('fill','#9CA3AF'); label.setAttribute('font-size','10'); label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle'); label.textContent = `${(singleWm*(1-ovHDec)).toFixed(2)} m`; fcSvg.appendChild(label);
                    }
                }
            };

            // --- Circular Calculator: visualization helper ---
            const drawCircCalc = () => {
                if (!document.getElementById('ptp-panel-calc-circular') || !ccSvg) return;
                const shape = (document.getElementById('cc-shape')?.value === 'semi') ? 'semi' : 'circle';
                const D = Math.max(0, Number(document.getElementById('cc-d')?.value) || 0);
                const totalAngle = shape==='circle'? 360 : 180;
                const arcLen = Math.PI * D * (shape==='circle'? 1 : 0.5);
                const Hm = shape==='circle'? D : (D/2);
                const mode = (document.getElementById('cc-mode')?.value) || 'distanceToRatio';
                const tLow = Number(document.getElementById('cc-throw-low')?.value) || 0;
                const tHighRaw = Number(document.getElementById('cc-throw-high')?.value);
                const nH = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-nh')?.value) || 1);
                const nV = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-nv')?.value) || 1);
                const ovH = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('cc-ovh')?.value) || 0));
                const ovV = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('cc-ovv')?.value) || 0));
                const pxW = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-pxw')?.value) || 1);
                const pxH = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-pxh')?.value) || 1);

                const ovHDec = ovH/100, ovVDec = ovV/100;
                const totWpx = (nH===1)? pxW : (nH*pxW - (nH-1)*(pxW*ovHDec));
                const totHpx = (nV===1)? pxH : (nV*pxH - (nV-1)*(pxH*ovVDec));
                const Wmm = arcLen*1000, Hmm = Hm*1000;
                const pwmm = totWpx>0 ? (Wmm / totWpx) : 0;
                const phmm = totHpx>0 ? (Hmm / totHpx) : 0;
                const singleWm = (pxW * pwmm)/1000;
                // throw
                let throwOut = '-', throwMeters = 0;
                const label = document.getElementById('cc-throw-label'); if (label) label.textContent = (mode==='ratioToDistance')? 'Calculated Throw Ratio' : 'Calculated Throw Distance';
                if (mode === 'distanceToRatio') { const ratio = singleWm>0 ? (tLow / singleWm) : 0; throwOut = `${ratio.toFixed(2)} : 1`; throwMeters = tLow; }
                else { const tHigh = (isFinite(tHighRaw) && tHighRaw >= tLow) ? tHighRaw : tLow; const dLow = tLow * singleWm; const dHigh = tHigh * singleWm; throwOut = (Math.abs(dHigh-dLow)<1e-6)? `${dLow.toFixed(2)} m` : `${dLow.toFixed(2)} - ${dHigh.toFixed(2)} m`; throwMeters = dLow; }

                const setTxt = (id,v)=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent=v; };
                setTxt('cc-res', `${Math.round(totWpx)} x ${Math.round(totHpx)} px`);
                setTxt('cc-pitch', `${((pwmm+phmm)/2).toFixed(2)} mm`);
                setTxt('cc-throw', throwOut);
                setTxt('cc-pxwmm', `${pwmm.toFixed(2)} mm`);
                setTxt('cc-pxhmm', `${phmm.toFixed(2)} mm`);
                setTxt('cc-arc', `${arcLen.toFixed(2)} m`);
                const ovhVal = document.getElementById('cc-ovh-val'); if (ovhVal) ovhVal.textContent = ovH.toFixed(1);
                const ovvVal = document.getElementById('cc-ovv-val'); if (ovvVal) ovvVal.textContent = ovV.toFixed(1);

                // Visualization (arc with segments)
                ccSvg.innerHTML = '';
                const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
                const svgW=700, svgH=520; const cx=svgW/2, cy=svgH/2 + (shape==='semi'? 60:0);
                const R = Math.min(svgW, svgH) * (shape==='semi'? 0.42 : 0.4);
                const band = Math.max(6, R*0.09);
                const start = shape==='circle'? 0 : 180; const end = 360;
                const rad = a => (a*Math.PI)/180; const ap=(r,a)=>({x:cx + r*Math.cos(rad(a)), y: cy + r*Math.sin(rad(a))});
                const p0=ap(R,start); const p1=ap(R,end); const large=((end-start)>180)?1:0;
                const outline = document.createElementNS(NS,'path');
                outline.setAttribute('d', `M ${p0.x} ${p0.y} A ${R} ${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${p1.x} ${p1.y}${shape==='circle'? ' A '+R+' '+R+' 0 '+large+' 1 '+p0.x+' '+p0.y:''}`);
                outline.setAttribute('fill','none'); outline.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF'); outline.setAttribute('stroke-width','2');
                ccSvg.appendChild(outline);

                const thetaImg = (singleWm / (arcLen||1)) * (shape==='circle'?360:180);
                const step = thetaImg * (1 - ovHDec);
                const coverage = (nH-1)*step + thetaImg;
                const base = shape==='circle'? 0 : 180;
                const offset = Math.max(0, ((shape==='circle'?360:180) - coverage)/2);
                for (let i=0;i<nH;i++){
                    const a0=base+offset+i*step; const a1=a0+thetaImg; const largeArc = (a1-a0)>180?1:0;
                    const outer0=ap(R,a0), outer1=ap(R,a1), inner0=ap(R-band,a0), inner1=ap(R-band,a1);
                    const seg = document.createElementNS(NS,'path');
                    const d=[`M ${inner0.x} ${inner0.y}`,`L ${outer0.x} ${outer0.y}`,`A ${R} ${R} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outer1.x} ${outer1.y}`,`L ${inner1.x} ${inner1.y}`,`A ${R-band} ${R-band} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${inner0.x} ${inner0.y}`,'Z'].join(' ');
                    seg.setAttribute('d', d); seg.setAttribute('fill','rgba(37,99,235,0.25)'); seg.setAttribute('stroke','rgba(37,99,235,0.45)'); seg.setAttribute('stroke-width','1'); ccSvg.appendChild(seg);
                    // projector icon and throw lines
                    const aMid=(a0+a1)/2; const m2px=(2*R)/(D||1); const rOff=Math.max(40, Math.min(R*1.2, (throwMeters||0)*m2px));
                    const pProj = ap(R+rOff, aMid);
                    const pr=document.createElementNS(NS,'rect'); pr.setAttribute('x', String(pProj.x-9)); pr.setAttribute('y', String(pProj.y-9)); pr.setAttribute('width','18'); pr.setAttribute('height','18'); pr.setAttribute('fill','#ffffff'); pr.setAttribute('stroke','#111827'); pr.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.5'); ccSvg.appendChild(pr);
                    const ray1=document.createElementNS(NS,'line'); ray1.setAttribute('x1', String(pProj.x)); ray1.setAttribute('y1', String(pProj.y)); ray1.setAttribute('x2', String(outer0.x)); ray1.setAttribute('y2', String(outer0.y)); ray1.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF'); ray1.setAttribute('stroke-width','1'); ccSvg.appendChild(ray1);
                    const ray2=document.createElementNS(NS,'line'); ray2.setAttribute('x1', String(pProj.x)); ray2.setAttribute('y1', String(pProj.y)); ray2.setAttribute('x2', String(outer1.x)); ray2.setAttribute('y2', String(outer1.y)); ray2.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF'); ray2.setAttribute('stroke-width','1'); ccSvg.appendChild(ray2);
                }
                const t = document.createElementNS(NS,'text'); t.setAttribute('x', String(cx)); t.setAttribute('y', String(cy + (shape==='circle'? 0 : R*0.1))); t.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle'); t.setAttribute('font-size','12'); t.setAttribute('fill','#9CA3AF'); t.textContent = `${shape==='circle'?'Circle':'Semi-circle'} • D=${D.toFixed(2)} m • Arc=${arcLen.toFixed(2)} m`; ccSvg.appendChild(t);
            };
            // Helper: recompute total size based on display and overlap
            const recalcAndSyncTotals = () => {
                const dispW = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayWidth) || 1);
                const dispH = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayHeight) || 1);
                const nx = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysX) || 1);
                const ny = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysY) || 1);
                // Clamp px overlaps and sync percents
                let ovx = Math.max(0, Number(s.overlapX) || 0);
                let ovy = Math.max(0, Number(s.overlapY) || 0);
                ovx = Math.min(dispW - 1, ovx);
                ovy = Math.min(dispH - 1, ovy);
                s.overlapX = ovx;
                s.overlapY = ovy;
                s.overlapXPercent = Math.max(0, Math.round(ovx / dispW * 100));
                s.overlapYPercent = Math.max(0, Math.round(ovy / dispH * 100));
                const totalW = Math.max(1, nx * dispW - (nx - 1) * ovx);
                const totalH = Math.max(1, ny * dispH - (ny - 1) * ovy);
                s.totalWidth = totalW;
                s.totalHeight = totalH;
                // Sync dome diameter if locked
                if (s.domeDiameterLock) {
                    s.domeDiameterPx = Math.min(totalW, totalH);
                    const ppm = Math.max(1, Number(s.domePixelsPerMeter) || 1);
                    const meters = s.domeDiameterPx / ppm;
                    s.domeDiameterValue = metersToUnit(meters, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
