                    const valEl = document.getElementById('ptp-dome-dia-value');
                    if (valEl) valEl.value = fmtDomeVal(s.domeDiameterValue, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
                }
                const tw = document.getElementById('ptp-total-width');
                const th = document.getElementById('ptp-total-height');
                if (tw) tw.value = String(totalW);
                if (th) th.value = String(totalH);
                // push synced values to inputs if present
                const oxpx = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-x-px');
                const oxpct = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-x-pct');
                const oypx = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-y-px');
                const oypct = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-y-pct');
                if (oxpx) oxpx.value = String(s.overlapX);
                if (oxpct) oxpct.value = String(s.overlapXPercent);
                if (oypx) oypx.value = String(s.overlapY);
                if (oypct) oypct.value = String(s.overlapYPercent);
                drawBothPreviews();
            };
            // Helper: compute projector counts from target totals (blend-aware)
            const computeCountsFromTotals = (targetW, targetH) => {
                const dispW = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayWidth) || 1);
                const dispH = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayHeight) || 1);
                const ovx = s.overlap ? Math.max(0, Math.min(dispW - 1, Number(s.overlapX) || 0)) : 0;
                const ovy = s.overlap ? Math.max(0, Math.min(dispH - 1, Number(s.overlapY) || 0)) : 0;
                const effW = Math.max(1, dispW - ovx);
                const effH = Math.max(1, dispH - ovy);
                const tx = Math.max(1, Number(targetW) || 1);
                const ty = Math.max(1, Number(targetH) || 1);
                // When multiple projectors, first tile uses full width, subsequent add effW
                // Solve n such that n*dispW - (n-1)*ovx >= tx -> n >= (tx - ovx) / (dispW - ovx)
                const nx = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((tx - ovx) / effW));
                const ny = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((ty - ovy) / effH));
                s.displaysX = nx;
                s.displaysY = ny;
                const dx = document.getElementById('ptp-displays-x'); if (dx) dx.value = String(nx);
                const dy = document.getElementById('ptp-displays-y'); if (dy) dy.value = String(ny);
                return { nx, ny };
            };
            // Screen tab: convert physical size to pixels, then compute counts
            const toMeters = (val, unit) => {
                const v = Math.max(0, Number(val) || 0);
                if (unit === 'ft') return v * 0.3048;
                if (unit === 'mm') return v / 1000;
                return v; // meters
            };
            // Screen inputs removed: no recalcFromScreen needed
            const bind = (id, prop, type = 'value') => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!el) return;
                if (el.type === 'checkbox') {
                    el.addEventListener('change', e => { s[prop] = el.checked; if (prop === 'circular') syncDomeVisibility(); drawBothPreviews(); });
                } else if (el.type === 'file') {
                    el.addEventListener('change', e => { s[prop] = el.files[0] || null; });
                } else {
                    el.addEventListener('input', e => {
                        const isNumeric = el.type === 'number' || el.type === 'range';
                        s[prop] = isNumeric ? Number(el.value) : el.value;
                        drawBothPreviews();
                    });
                }
            };
            bind('ptp-image-name', 'imageName');
            bind('ptp-display-width', 'displayWidth');
            bind('ptp-display-height', 'displayHeight');
            // Also sync flat calculator on native display width/height edits
            const dispWEl = document.getElementById('ptp-display-width');
            const dispHEl = document.getElementById('ptp-display-height');
            if (dispWEl) dispWEl.addEventListener('input', () => { syncFlatProjResFromNative(); try { if (typeof drawFlatCalc === 'function') drawFlatCalc(); } catch(_) {} });
            if (dispHEl) dispHEl.addEventListener('input', () => { syncFlatProjResFromNative(); try { if (typeof drawFlatCalc === 'function') drawFlatCalc(); } catch(_) {} });
            bind('ptp-displays-x', 'displaysX');
            bind('ptp-displays-y', 'displaysY');
            // Overlap inputs — twin px/% kept in sync
            const ovxPxEl = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-x-px');
            const ovyPxEl = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-y-px');
            const ovxPctEl = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-x-pct');
            const ovyPctEl = document.getElementById('ptp-overlap-y-pct');
            const onPxChange = () => {
                const dispW = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayWidth) || 1);
                const dispH = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayHeight) || 1);
                s.overlapX = Math.max(0, Math.min(dispW - 1, Number(ovxPxEl?.value) || 0));
                s.overlapY = Math.max(0, Math.min(dispH - 1, Number(ovyPxEl?.value) || 0));
                s.overlapXPercent = Math.max(0, Math.round(s.overlapX / dispW * 100));
                s.overlapYPercent = Math.max(0, Math.round(s.overlapY / dispH * 100));
                if (ovxPctEl) ovxPctEl.value = String(s.overlapXPercent);
                if (ovyPctEl) ovyPctEl.value = String(s.overlapYPercent);
                recalcAndSyncTotals();
            };
            const onPctChange = () => {
                const dispW = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayWidth) || 1);
                const dispH = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayHeight) || 1);
                s.overlapXPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(ovxPctEl?.value) || 0));
                s.overlapYPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(ovyPctEl?.value) || 0));
                s.overlapX = Math.max(0, Math.min(dispW - 1, Math.round(dispW * s.overlapXPercent / 100)));
                s.overlapY = Math.max(0, Math.min(dispH - 1, Math.round(dispH * s.overlapYPercent / 100)));
                if (ovxPxEl) ovxPxEl.value = String(s.overlapX);
                if (ovyPxEl) ovyPxEl.value = String(s.overlapY);
                recalcAndSyncTotals();
            };
            if (ovxPxEl) ovxPxEl.addEventListener('input', onPxChange);
            if (ovyPxEl) ovyPxEl.addEventListener('input', onPxChange);
            if (ovxPctEl) ovxPctEl.addEventListener('input', onPctChange);
            if (ovyPctEl) ovyPctEl.addEventListener('input', onPctChange);
            bind('ptp-total-width', 'totalWidth');
            bind('ptp-total-height', 'totalHeight');
            bind('ptp-overlap', 'overlap');
            bind('ptp-logo', 'logo');
            bind('ptp-circular', 'circular');
            bind('ptp-gridsize', 'gridSize');
            bind('ptp-widthpxn', 'widthPxN');
            bind('ptp-gridcolor', 'gridColor');
            bind('ptp-textcolor', 'textColor');
            bind('ptp-overlapcolor', 'overlapColor');
            bind('ptp-circles', 'circles');
            bind('ptp-hatching', 'hatching');
            bind('ptp-numbers', 'numbers');
            bind('ptp-logo-file', 'logoFile');
            bind('ptp-logo-size', 'logoSize');
            bind('ptp-name-fontsize', 'nameFontSize');
            // Visual styles removed from Projector tab
            // Dome controls
            const domeLockEl = document.getElementById('ptp-dome-lock');
            if (domeLockEl) {
                domeLockEl.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    s.domeDiameterLock = !!domeLockEl.checked;
                    if (s.domeDiameterLock) {
                        // Snap to current totals and update displayed value
                        const tw0 = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalWidth) || 1);
                        const th0 = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalHeight) || 1);
                        s.domeDiameterPx = Math.min(tw0, th0);
                        const ppm = Math.max(1, Number(s.domePixelsPerMeter) || 1);
                        const meters = s.domeDiameterPx / ppm;
                        s.domeDiameterValue = metersToUnit(meters, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
                        const valEl = document.getElementById('ptp-dome-dia-value');
                        if (valEl) valEl.value = fmtDomeVal(s.domeDiameterValue, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
                    }
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }
            const domeDiaValueEl = document.getElementById('ptp-dome-dia-value');
            const domeDiaUnitEl = document.getElementById('ptp-dome-dia-unit');
            const domePPMEl = document.getElementById('ptp-dome-ppm');
            if (domeDiaValueEl) {
                domeDiaValueEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    const unit = (domeDiaUnitEl && domeDiaUnitEl.value === 'ft') ? 'ft' : 'm';
                    const raw = Number(domeDiaValueEl.value);
                    const val = Math.max(0.001, Number.isFinite(raw) ? raw : 0);
                    s.domeDiameterValue = val;
                    const meters = unitToMeters(val, unit);
                    const ppm = Math.max(1, Number(s.domePixelsPerMeter) || 1);
                    s.domeDiameterPx = Math.round(meters * ppm);
                    // Auto-unlock on manual change
                    s.domeDiameterLock = false;
                    if (domeLockEl) domeLockEl.checked = false;
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }
            if (domeDiaUnitEl) {
                domeDiaUnitEl.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    s.domeDiameterUnit = (domeDiaUnitEl.value === 'ft') ? 'ft' : 'm';
                    // Keep physical size constant: recompute displayed value from px & ppm
                    const ppm = Math.max(1, Number(s.domePixelsPerMeter) || 1);
                    const meters = Math.max(0, Number(s.domeDiameterPx) || 0) / ppm;
                    s.domeDiameterValue = metersToUnit(meters, s.domeDiameterUnit);
                    if (domeDiaValueEl) domeDiaValueEl.value = fmtDomeVal(s.domeDiameterValue, s.domeDiameterUnit);
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }
            if (domePPMEl) {
                domePPMEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    const ppm = Math.max(1, Number(domePPMEl.value) || 1);
                    s.domePixelsPerMeter = ppm;
                    if (s.domeDiameterLock) {
                        // px tied to totals; update displayed physical value
                        const meters = Math.max(0, Number(s.domeDiameterPx) || 0) / ppm;
                        s.domeDiameterValue = metersToUnit(meters, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
                        if (domeDiaValueEl) domeDiaValueEl.value = fmtDomeVal(s.domeDiameterValue, s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
                    } else {
                        // keep physical value constant; update px
                        const meters = unitToMeters(Math.max(0.001, Number(s.domeDiameterValue) || 0), s.domeDiameterUnit || 'm');
                        s.domeDiameterPx = Math.round(meters * ppm);
                    }
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }
            // Name offsets bindings with label updates
            const offx = document.getElementById('ptp-name-offx');
            const offy = document.getElementById('ptp-name-offy');
            const offxLbl = document.getElementById('ptp-name-offx-label');
            const offyLbl = document.getElementById('ptp-name-offy-label');
            if (offx) {
                offx.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    s.nameOffsetXPercent = Number(offx.value) || 0;
                    if (offxLbl) offxLbl.textContent = String(s.nameOffsetXPercent);
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }
            if (offy) {
                offy.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    s.nameOffsetYPercent = Number(offy.value) || 0;
                    if (offyLbl) offyLbl.textContent = String(s.nameOffsetYPercent);
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }

            // No unit selector; twins are kept in sync both ways

            // Overlay opacity slider
            const overlayOpacity = document.getElementById('ptp-overlay-opacity');
            const overlayOpacityLabel = document.getElementById('ptp-overlay-opacity-label');
            if (overlayOpacity) {
                overlayOpacity.addEventListener('input', e => {
                    const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(overlayOpacity.value) || 0));
                    s.overlayOpacity = v;
                    if (overlayOpacityLabel) overlayOpacityLabel.textContent = String(v);
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }

            // Hatching controls
            const hatchStyle = document.getElementById('ptp-hatching-style');
            if (hatchStyle) {
                hatchStyle.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    const val = hatchStyle.value;
                    s.hatchingStyle = (val === 'forward' || val === 'backward' || val === 'cross') ? val : 'cross';
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }
            const hatchDensity = document.getElementById('ptp-hatching-density');
            const hatchDensityLabel = document.getElementById('ptp-hatching-density-label');
            if (hatchDensity) {
                hatchDensity.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    const v = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(hatchDensity.value) || 1));
                    s.hatchingDensity = v;
                    if (hatchDensityLabel) hatchDensityLabel.textContent = String(v);
                    drawBothPreviews();
                });
            }

            // Enable/disable hatching sub-controls when toggled
            const hatchToggle = document.getElementById('ptp-hatching');
            const hatchControls = document.getElementById('ptp-hatching-controls');
            if (hatchToggle && hatchControls) {
                const syncHatchControls = () => {
                    if (hatchToggle.checked) {
                        hatchControls.classList.remove('opacity-50','pointer-events-none');
                    } else {
                        hatchControls.classList.add('opacity-50','pointer-events-none');
                    }
                };
                hatchToggle.addEventListener('change', syncHatchControls);
                syncHatchControls();
            }

            // Logo file loader
            const logoFileInput = document.getElementById('ptp-logo-file');
            if (logoFileInput) {
                logoFileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    const file = logoFileInput.files && logoFileInput.files[0];
                    if (!file) { s._logoImg = null; drawBothPreviews(); return; }
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = () => {
                        const img = new Image();
                        img.onload = () => { s._logoImg = img; drawBothPreviews(); };
                        img.src = String(reader.result);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
            }

            // Auto-recalc totals when overlap, display size, or display count changes
            ['ptp-display-width','ptp-display-height','ptp-displays-x','ptp-displays-y','ptp-overlap-x','ptp-overlap-y','ptp-overlap'].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!el) return;
                const evt = el.type === 'checkbox' ? 'change' : 'input';
                el.addEventListener(evt, () => {
                    const before = Array.isArray(s.projectors) ? s.projectors.length : 0;
                    recalcAndSyncTotals();
                    const changed = ensureProjectors();
                    const nx = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysX) || 1);
                    const ny = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysY) || 1);
                    const needed = nx * ny;
                    if (changed || before !== needed) {
                        renderProjectorTestPattern();
                    }
                });
            });

            // Native resolution dropdown behavior
            const nativeSel = document.getElementById('ptp-native-res');
            if (nativeSel) {
                nativeSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    const val = nativeSel.value;
                    // Toggle visibility of custom resolution controls under Native Resolution
                    const customCtrls = document.getElementById('ptp-custom-res-controls');
                    if (customCtrls) customCtrls.classList.toggle('hidden', val !== '__custom__');
                    if (val === '__custom__') { recalcAndSyncTotals(); return; }
                    const [wStr, hStr] = val.split('x');
                    const w = Number(wStr);
                    const h = Number(hStr);
                    if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                        s.displayWidth = w;
                        s.displayHeight = h;
                        const dw = document.getElementById('ptp-display-width');
                        const dh = document.getElementById('ptp-display-height');
                        if (dw) dw.value = String(w);
                        if (dh) dh.value = String(h);
                        recalcAndSyncTotals();
                        // Also sync Flat Calculator projector resolution and recalc
                        syncFlatProjResFromNative();
                        // Recompute Flat Calculator layout if available
                        try { if (typeof drawFlatCalc === 'function') drawFlatCalc(); } catch(_) {}
                    }
                });
            }

            const flatNativeSel = document.getElementById('fc-native-res');
            if (flatNativeSel) {
                flatNativeSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    const val = flatNativeSel.value;
                    const customCtrls = document.getElementById('fc-custom-res-controls');
                    if (customCtrls) customCtrls.classList.toggle('hidden', val !== '__custom__');
                    if (val === '__custom__') { drawFlatCalc(); return; }
                    const [wStr, hStr] = val.split('x');
                    const w = Number(wStr);
                    const h = Number(hStr);
                    if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
                        s.calcFlat.projectorWidthPx = w;
                        s.calcFlat.projectorHeightPx = h;
                        const wEl = document.getElementById('fc-pxw');
                        const hEl = document.getElementById('fc-pxh');
                        if (wEl) wEl.value = String(w);
                        if (hEl) hEl.value = String(h);
                        drawFlatCalc();
                    }
                });
            }

            // Add custom resolution
            const addBtn = document.getElementById('ptp-add-custom-res');
            if (addBtn) {
                addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const cw = Number((document.getElementById('ptp-custom-w') || {}).value);
                    const ch = Number((document.getElementById('ptp-custom-h') || {}).value);
                    if (!cw || !ch) return;
                    s.customResList = Array.isArray(s.customResList) ? s.customResList : [];
                    const exists = s.customResList.some(r => r.w === cw && r.h === ch);
                    if (!exists) s.customResList.push({ w: cw, h: ch });
                    try { localStorage.setItem('ptp-custom-resolutions', JSON.stringify(s.customResList)); } catch(_) {}
                    // Set as active selection and re-render to refresh dropdown
                    s.displayWidth = cw;
                    s.displayHeight = ch;
                    // Keep Flat Calculator in sync with this new native resolution
                    s.calcFlat.projectorWidthPx = cw;
                    s.calcFlat.projectorHeightPx = ch;
                    renderProjectorTestPattern();
                });
            }
            const addFlatBtn = document.getElementById('fc-add-custom-res');
            if (addFlatBtn) {
                addFlatBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const cw = Number((document.getElementById('fc-custom-w') || {}).value);
                    const ch = Number((document.getElementById('fc-custom-h') || {}).value);
                    if (!cw || !ch) return;
                    s.customResList = Array.isArray(s.customResList) ? s.customResList : [];
                    const exists = s.customResList.some(r => r.w === cw && r.h === ch);
                    if (!exists) s.customResList.push({ w: cw, h: ch });
                    try { localStorage.setItem('ptp-custom-resolutions', JSON.stringify(s.customResList)); } catch(_) {}
                    s.calcFlat.projectorWidthPx = cw;
                    s.calcFlat.projectorHeightPx = ch;
                    const wEl = document.getElementById('fc-pxw');
                    const hEl = document.getElementById('fc-pxh');
                    if (wEl) wEl.value = String(cw);
                    if (hEl) hEl.value = String(ch);
                    renderProjectorTestPattern();
                });
            }
            // Initial draw
            drawBothPreviews();
            syncDomeVisibility();
            setPreviewZoom(s.previewZoom || 1);

            // --- Bind Flat Calculator inputs ---
            try {
                const bindFlat = (id, onInput) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.addEventListener('input', onInput); };
                const syncFlatLabels = () => {
                    const modeEl = document.getElementById('fc-mode');
                    const lowLbl = document.getElementById('fc-throw-low-label');
                    const hiWrap = document.getElementById('fc-throw-high-wrap');
                    const throwLbl = document.getElementById('fc-throw-label');
                    const mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'distanceToRatio';
                    if (lowLbl) lowLbl.textContent = mode==='ratioToDistance' ? 'Lens Throw Ratio (Low)' : 'Throw Distance (m)';
                    if (hiWrap) hiWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', mode!=='ratioToDistance');
                    if (throwLbl) throwLbl.textContent = mode==='ratioToDistance' ? 'Calculated Throw Distance' : 'Calculated Throw Ratio';
                };
                bindFlat('fc-mode', () => { s.calcFlat.calcMode = String(document.getElementById('fc-mode')?.value || 'distanceToRatio'); syncFlatLabels(); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-screen-w', () => { s.calcFlat.screenWidthMeters = Number(document.getElementById('fc-screen-w')?.value)||0; drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-screen-h', () => { s.calcFlat.screenHeightMeters = Number(document.getElementById('fc-screen-h')?.value)||0; drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-throw-low', () => { s.calcFlat.throwLow = Number(document.getElementById('fc-throw-low')?.value)||0; drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-throw-high', () => { s.calcFlat.throwHigh = Number(document.getElementById('fc-throw-high')?.value)||0; drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-nh', () => { s.calcFlat.numProjectorsHorizontal = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-nh')?.value)||1); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-nv', () => { s.calcFlat.numProjectorsVertical = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-nv')?.value)||1); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-ovh', () => { s.calcFlat.overlapPercentHorizontal = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('fc-ovh')?.value)||0)); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-ovv', () => { s.calcFlat.overlapPercentVertical = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('fc-ovv')?.value)||0)); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-pxw', () => { s.calcFlat.projectorWidthPx = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-pxw')?.value)||1); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-pxh', () => { s.calcFlat.projectorHeightPx = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('fc-pxh')?.value)||1); drawFlatCalc(); });
                bindFlat('fc-auto', () => { s.calcFlat.autoCalc = !!document.getElementById('fc-auto')?.checked; drawFlatCalc(); });
                const pdfBtn = document.getElementById('fc-generate-pdf');
                const pdfStatus = document.getElementById('fc-pdf-status');
                const generateFlatCalcPdf = async () => {
                    try {
                        if (!window.jspdf || !window.jspdf.jsPDF) {
                            if (pdfStatus) pdfStatus.textContent = 'PDF library not available';
                            return;
                        }
                        if (typeof window.html2canvas !== 'function') {
                            if (pdfStatus) pdfStatus.textContent = 'Capture library not available';
                            return;
                        }
                        const jsPDF = window.jspdf.jsPDF;
                        const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: 'landscape', unit: 'pt', format: 'a4' });
                        const summary = (s.calcFlat && s.calcFlat.lastSummary) ? s.calcFlat.lastSummary : {};

                        const pageW = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                        const pageH = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
                        doc.setFontSize(18);
                        doc.text('Flat Screen Calculation', 40, 40);
                        doc.setFontSize(11);
                        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');

                        const rows = [
                            ['Screen Size', summary.screen || '-'],
                            ['Projector Resolution', summary.projectorRes || '-'],
                            ['Grid Setup', summary.grid || '-'],
                            ['Single Image Size', summary.singleImage || '-'],
                            ['Overlap (H)', summary.overlapH || '-'],
                            ['Overlap (V)', summary.overlapV || '-'],
                            ['Canvas Resolution', summary.canvas || '-'],
                            ['Projector Spacing', summary.spacing || '-'],
                        ];
                        let y = 70;
                        rows.forEach(([label, val]) => {
                            doc.setTextColor(120);
                            doc.text(String(label), 40, y);
                            doc.setTextColor(10);
                            doc.text(String(val), 220, y);
                            y += 18;
                        });

                        // Capture Flat Screen Calculator panel as-is
                        const flatPanel = document.getElementById('ptp-panel-calc-flat');
                        if (flatPanel) {
                            try {
                                const panelCanvas = await window.html2canvas(flatPanel, {
                                    backgroundColor: '#0b1020',
                                    scale: 2,
                                    useCORS: true
                                });
                                const panelImg = panelCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                                const panelMaxW = pageW - 80;
                                const panelMaxH = Math.max(200, pageH - y - 40);
                                const panelRatio = panelCanvas.width / panelCanvas.height;
                                let panelW = panelMaxW;
                                let panelH = panelW / panelRatio;
                                if (panelH > panelMaxH) { panelH = panelMaxH; panelW = panelH * panelRatio; }
                                doc.setDrawColor(180);
                                doc.rect(40 - 6, y - 6, panelW + 12, panelH + 12);
                                doc.addImage(panelImg, 'PNG', 40, y, panelW, panelH);
                            } catch (panelErr) {
                                console.warn('Flat panel capture failed', panelErr);
                            }
                        }

                        // Render full-resolution test pattern for PDF
                        const ptp = window.projectorTestPatternState || {};
                        const buildTestPatternImage = () => {
                            try {
                                const srcW = Math.max(1, Number(ptp.totalWidth) || 1);
                                const srcH = Math.max(1, Number(ptp.totalHeight) || 1);
                                const maxW = 2000;
                                const scale = Math.min(1, maxW / srcW);
                                const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(srcW * scale));
                                const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(srcH * scale));
                                const off = document.createElement('canvas');
                                off.width = w;
                                off.height = h;
                                const ctx = off.getContext('2d');
                                if (ctx && scale !== 1) ctx.scale(scale, scale);
                                drawProjectorTestPattern(off, ptp, false);
                                return off.toDataURL('image/png');
                            } catch (_) { return null; }
                        };
                        try {
                            const patternImg = buildTestPatternImage();
                            if (patternImg) {
                                doc.addPage('a4', 'landscape');
                                doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
                                doc.setFontSize(16);
                                doc.text('Projector Test Pattern', 40, 40);
                                const imgX = 40;
                                const imgY = 70;
                                const maxW = 760;
                                const maxH = 480;
                                const props = doc.getImageProperties(patternImg);
                                const ratio = props.width && props.height ? (props.width / props.height) : (maxW / maxH);
                                let imgW = maxW;
                                let imgH = imgW / ratio;
                                if (imgH > maxH) { imgH = maxH; imgW = imgH * ratio; }
                                doc.setDrawColor(180);
                                doc.rect(imgX - 6, imgY - 6, imgW + 12, imgH + 12);
                                doc.addImage(patternImg, 'PNG', imgX, imgY, imgW, imgH);
                            }
                        } catch (patternErr) {
                            console.warn('Pattern render failed', patternErr);
                        }

                        doc.save(`projector_testpattern_${Date.now()}.pdf`);
                        if (pdfStatus) pdfStatus.textContent = 'PDF saved';
                        setTimeout(() => { if (pdfStatus) pdfStatus.textContent = ''; }, 2000);
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.warn('Flat calc PDF failed', err);
                        if (pdfStatus) pdfStatus.textContent = err && err.message ? `PDF failed: ${err.message}` : 'PDF failed';
                    }
                };
                if (pdfBtn) pdfBtn.addEventListener('click', generateFlatCalcPdf);

                // On first reveal, draw once
                if (s.uiSubTab === 'calc-flat') { syncFlatLabels(); drawFlatCalc(); }
            } catch(_) {}

            // --- Bind Circular Calculator inputs ---
            try {
                const bindCirc = (id, onInput) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.addEventListener('input', onInput); };
                const syncCircLabels = () => {
                    const modeEl = document.getElementById('cc-mode');
                    const lowLbl = document.getElementById('cc-throw-low-label');
                    const hiWrap = document.getElementById('cc-throw-high-wrap');
                    const throwLbl = document.getElementById('cc-throw-label');
                    const mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'distanceToRatio';
                    if (lowLbl) lowLbl.textContent = mode==='ratioToDistance' ? 'Lens Throw Ratio (Low)' : 'Throw Distance (m)';
                    if (hiWrap) hiWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', mode!=='ratioToDistance');
                    if (throwLbl) throwLbl.textContent = mode==='ratioToDistance' ? 'Calculated Throw Distance' : 'Calculated Throw Ratio';
                };
                bindCirc('cc-mode', () => { s.calcCirc.calcMode = String(document.getElementById('cc-mode')?.value || 'distanceToRatio'); syncCircLabels(); drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-shape', () => { s.calcCirc.shape = (document.getElementById('cc-shape')?.value === 'semi') ? 'semi' : 'circle'; drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-d', () => { s.calcCirc.diameter = Number(document.getElementById('cc-d')?.value)||0; drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-throw-low', () => { s.calcCirc.throwLow = Number(document.getElementById('cc-throw-low')?.value)||0; drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-throw-high', () => { s.calcCirc.throwHigh = Number(document.getElementById('cc-throw-high')?.value)||0; drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-nh', () => { s.calcCirc.numProjectorsHorizontal = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-nh')?.value)||1); drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-nv', () => { s.calcCirc.numProjectorsVertical = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-nv')?.value)||1); drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-ovh', () => { s.calcCirc.overlapPercentHorizontal = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('cc-ovh')?.value)||0)); drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-ovv', () => { s.calcCirc.overlapPercentVertical = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, Number(document.getElementById('cc-ovv')?.value)||0)); drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-pxw', () => { s.calcCirc.projectorWidthPx = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-pxw')?.value)||1); drawCircCalc(); });
                bindCirc('cc-pxh', () => { s.calcCirc.projectorHeightPx = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('cc-pxh')?.value)||1); drawCircCalc(); });
                if (s.uiSubTab === 'calc-circ') { syncCircLabels(); drawCircCalc(); }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Screen size tab/section removed; no bindings needed

            // Make projector tiles selectable via preview click
            if (canvas && !canvas.dataset.ptpClickBound) {
                canvas.dataset.ptpClickBound = '1';
                canvas.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                    try {
                        const totalW = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalWidth) || 1);
                        const totalH = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalHeight) || 1);
                        const prevW = canvas.width, prevH = canvas.height;
                        const scale = Math.min(prevW / totalW, prevH / totalH);
                        const targetW = totalW * scale, targetH = totalH * scale;
                        const offsetX = (prevW - targetW) / 2;
                        const offsetY = (prevH - targetH) / 2;
                        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const px = (ev.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
                        const py = (ev.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);
                        const lx = (px - offsetX) / scale;
                        const ly = (py - offsetY) / scale;
                        if (lx < 0 || ly < 0 || lx > totalW || ly > totalH) return;
                        const dispW = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayWidth) || 1);
                        const dispH = Math.max(1, Number(s.displayHeight) || 1);
                        const ovx = s.overlap ? Math.max(0, Number(s.overlapX) || 0) : 0;
                        const ovy = s.overlap ? Math.max(0, Number(s.overlapY) || 0) : 0;
                        const nx = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysX) || 1);
                        const ny = Math.max(1, Number(s.displaysY) || 1);
                        let bestIdx = -1; let bestD = Infinity;
                        for (let y = 0; y < ny; y++) {
                            for (let x = 0; x < nx; x++) {
                                const posX = x * (dispW - ovx);
                                const posY = y * (dispH - ovy);
                                if (lx >= posX && lx <= posX + dispW && ly >= posY && ly <= posY + dispH) {
                                    const cx = posX + dispW / 2, cy = posY + dispH / 2;
                                    const d = (lx - cx) * (lx - cx) + (ly - cy) * (ly - cy);
                                    const idx = y * nx + x;
                                    if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; bestIdx = idx; }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (bestIdx >= 0) {
                            // remove previous highlight
                            if (s.selectedProjectorIndex >= 0) {
                                const prevRow = document.getElementById(`ptp-proj-name-${s.selectedProjectorIndex}`)?.parentElement;
                                if (prevRow) prevRow.classList.remove('ring-2','ring-accent','rounded-md');
                            }
                            s.selectedProjectorIndex = bestIdx;
                            drawBothPreviews();
                            const row = document.getElementById(`ptp-proj-name-${bestIdx}`)?.parentElement;
                            if (row) {
                                row.classList.add('ring-2','ring-accent','rounded-md');
                                try { row.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); } catch(_) {}
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (_) {}
                });
            }

            // Calculate UI removed; no handler needed

            // Save Image
            const saveBtn = document.getElementById('ptp-save-image');
            if (saveBtn && canvas) {
                saveBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                    try {
                        const name = (s.imageName || 'testpattern').toString().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9-_]+/gi, '_') || 'testpattern';
                        const totalW = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalWidth) || 1);
                        const totalH = Math.max(1, Number(s.totalHeight) || 1);

                        // Draw at actual resolution to an offscreen canvas
                        const off = document.createElement('canvas');
                        off.width = totalW;
                        off.height = totalH;
                        drawProjectorTestPattern(off, s, false);

                        const link = document.createElement('a');
                        link.download = `${name}_${totalW}x${totalH}.png`;
                        link.href = off.toDataURL('image/png');
                        link.click();
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error('Save Image failed', e);
                        // Fallback to preview canvas if something goes wrong
                        const link = document.createElement('a');
                        link.download = 'testpattern.png';
                        link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                        link.click();
                    }
                });
            }
            const toolbarSaveBtn = document.getElementById('ptp-save-png');
            if (toolbarSaveBtn && saveBtn) {
                toolbarSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => saveBtn.click());
            }
            const saveAllBtn = document.getElementById('ptp-save-all-pngs');
            if (saveAllBtn) {
                saveAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    try {
                        const base = (s.imageName || 'testpattern').toString().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9-_]+/gi, '_') || 'testpattern';
                        const downloadCanvas = (srcCanvas, suffix) => {
                            if (!srcCanvas) return;
                            const link = document.createElement('a');
                            link.download = `${base}_${suffix}.png`;
                            link.href = srcCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                            link.click();
                        };
                        if (canvas) downloadCanvas(canvas, 'main');
                        if (domeCanvas && s.circular) downloadCanvas(domeCanvas, 'dome');
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.warn('Save all PNGs failed', err);
                    }
                });
            }
            const zoomButtons = container.querySelectorAll('[data-ptp-zoom]');
            zoomButtons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const mode = btn.getAttribute('data-ptp-zoom');
                    if (mode === 'in') setPreviewZoom((s.previewZoom || 1) + 0.1);
                    else if (mode === 'out') setPreviewZoom((s.previewZoom || 1) - 0.1);
                    else if (mode === 'fit') fitPreviewZoom();
                    else setPreviewZoom(1);
                });
            });
            // Bind dynamic projector fields
            if (Array.isArray(s.projectors)) {
                s.projectors.forEach((p, i) => {
                    const n = document.getElementById(`ptp-proj-name-${i}`);
                    const c = document.getElementById(`ptp-proj-color-${i}`);
                    if (n) n.addEventListener('input', () => { s.projectors[i].name = n.value; drawBothPreviews(); });
                    if (c) c.addEventListener('input', () => { s.projectors[i].color = c.value; drawBothPreviews(); });
                });
            }
        }
        // Tab switch logic (add this tab to the switchTab function if not already present)
        const origSwitchTab = window.switchTab;
        window.switchTab = function(tab) {
            if (tab === 'projector-test-pattern') renderProjectorTestPattern();
            if (origSwitchTab) origSwitchTab.apply(this, arguments);
        };
        </script>
            <!-- LED Patching content removed per request -->
        </main>
    </div>

                // simple dragging

                const onMove = (e) => {

                    const x = (e.clientX || 0) - startX + baseLeft;
                    const y = (e.clientY || 0) - startY + baseTop;
                    wrap.style.left = x + 'px';
                    wrap.style.top = y + 'px';
                };
                const onUp = () => {
                    if (!dragging) return;
                    dragging = false;
                    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);

                window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => push(`unhandled: ${e.reason && e.reason.message ? e.reason.message : e.reason}`));
                push('debug overlay ready');

        // Configure pdf.js worker (used by Devices tab import from PDF)
        try {
            if (window.pdfjsLib && pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions) {
                // Use local vendored worker for offline reliability
                pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = 'vendor/pdf.worker.min.js';
            }
        } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

        const AUTHOR_INSTAGRAM = 'https://www.instagram.com/dhirajkalra82';
        const AUTHOR_LINKEDIN = 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhirajkalra82';
        const DEFAULT_INFO_FONT_OPTIONS = [
            'Inter',
            'Arial',
            'Segoe UI',
            'Roboto',
            'Open Sans',
            'Montserrat',
            'Poppins',
            'Lato',
            'Georgia',

            'Courier New'
        ];
        const FONT_CACHE_KEY = 'pixellogic-system-fonts';

        const sanitizeFontName = (fontName = '') => fontName.replace(/["']/g, '').trim();

        const PANEL_DIMENSION_UNITS = ['mm','cm','m','ft','in'];
        const PANEL_UNIT_FACTORS = {
            mm: 1,
            cm: 10,
            m: 1000,
            ft: 304.8,
            in: 25.4
        };
        const convertPanelUnitValueToMm = (value, unit = 'mm') => {
            const numeric = parseFloat(value);
            if (!isFinite(numeric)) return 0;
            const factor = PANEL_UNIT_FACTORS[unit] || 1;
            return numeric * factor;
        };
        const convertMmToPanelUnitValue = (mm, unit = 'mm') => {
            const numeric = parseFloat(mm);
            if (!isFinite(numeric)) return 0;
            const factor = PANEL_UNIT_FACTORS[unit] || 1;
            return numeric / factor;
        };
        const formatPanelUnitValueForInput = (mm, unit = 'mm') => {
            if (typeof mm !== 'number' || !isFinite(mm)) return '';
            const converted = convertMmToPanelUnitValue(mm, unit);
            const rounded = Math.round(converted * 1000) / 1000;
            return Number.isFinite(rounded) ? String(rounded) : '';
        };

        const escapeHtml = (str = '') => String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (ch) => {
            switch (ch) {
                case '&': return '&amp;';
                case '<': return '&lt;';
                case '>': return '&gt;';
                case '"': return '&quot;';
                case "'": return '&#39;';
                default: return ch;
            }
        });

        const loadStoredFontOptions = () => {
            try {
                const cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FONT_CACHE_KEY) || '[]');
                if (Array.isArray(cached) && cached.length) {
                    return cached.map(sanitizeFontName).filter(Boolean);
                }
            } catch (_) {}
            return [...DEFAULT_INFO_FONT_OPTIONS];
        };

        let availableFontOptions = loadStoredFontOptions();

        const getFontOptions = () => (Array.isArray(availableFontOptions) && availableFontOptions.length ? availableFontOptions : DEFAULT_INFO_FONT_OPTIONS);

        const persistFontOptions = (fonts) => {
            try { localStorage.setItem(FONT_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(fonts)); } catch (_) {}
        };

        const mergeFontOptions = (incomingFonts) => {
            if (!Array.isArray(incomingFonts) || !incomingFonts.length) return null;
            const sanitized = incomingFonts.map(sanitizeFontName).filter(Boolean);
            if (!sanitized.length) return null;
            const base = getFontOptions().slice();
            const additions = sanitized.filter((name) => !base.includes(name)).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
            if (!additions.length) return null;
            return base.concat(additions).slice(0, 400);
        };

        async function hydrateSystemFonts() {
            if (!window.systemFonts || typeof window.systemFonts.getFonts !== 'function') return;
            try {
                const fonts = await window.systemFonts.getFonts();
                const merged = mergeFontOptions(fonts);
                if (merged) {
                    availableFontOptions = merged;
                    persistFontOptions(availableFontOptions);
                    if (state.activeTab === 'effects') {
                        renderEffectsDetails();
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('System font detection failed', error);
            }
        }

        // Legacy alias used in some handlers; forwards to persistProjects
        const saveState = () => {

        };

        const loadProjectsFromStorage = () => {
            try {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-projects');
                if (!raw) return false;
                const data = JSON.parse(raw);
                if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.projects)) return false;
                state.projects = data.projects || [];
                // Normalize: force all maps to use 'checker' visual style on load
                try {
                    (state.projects || []).forEach(p => {
                        if (Array.isArray(p.pixelMaps)) {
                            p.pixelMaps.forEach(m => {
                                m.visualStyle = 'checker';
                                if (!Array.isArray(m.checkerColors) || m.checkerColors.length < 2) {
                                    m.checkerColors = ['#4b5563', '#1f2937'];
                                }
                                // Migration: remove any baked-in personal contact from info overlay
                                try {
                                    const info = m.details && m.details.info ? m.details.info : null;
                                    if (info) {
                                        if (typeof info.name === 'string' && /dhiraj\s+kalra/i.test(info.name)) {
                                            info.name = '';
                                        }
                                        try { delete info.name; delete info.autoName; } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
                                    }
                                } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                    // Persist normalization so subsequent loads are consistent
                    persistProjects();
                } catch (_) { /* best effort */ }
                state.activeProjectId = data.activeProjectId || (state.projects[0]?.id ?? null);
                return state.projects.length > 0;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Failed to load projects from storage', e);
                return false;
            }
        };

        // --- Persistence Helpers (Devices v2) ---
        const DEVICES_STORAGE_KEY = 'pixi-logic-devices-v2';
        const persistDevices = () => {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(DEVICES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state.devicesV2 || { version: 2, ledWalls: [], projectors: [] }));
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Failed to persist devices', e);
                showNotification('Could not save devices to local storage');
            }
        };
        const loadDevicesFromStorage = () => {
            try {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem(DEVICES_STORAGE_KEY);
                if (!raw) return false;
                const data = JSON.parse(raw);
                if (!data || data.version !== 2) return false; // only load v2 to avoid cross-version impact
                state.devicesV2 = {
                    version: 2,
                    ledWalls: Array.isArray(data.ledWalls) ? data.ledWalls : [],
                    projectors: Array.isArray(data.projectors) ? data.projectors : []
                };
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Failed to load devices from storage', e);
                return false;
            }
        };

        // --- Project Backup & Restore ---
        const downloadJson = (obj, filename) => {
            try {
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url; a.download = filename;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Failed to download JSON', e);
                showNotification('Failed to export JSON');
            }
        };

        const timestamp = () => {
            const d = new Date();
            const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
            return `${d.getFullYear()}${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}${pad(d.getDate())}-${pad(d.getHours())}${pad(d.getMinutes())}${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
        };

        const exportProjects = (mode = 'all') => {
            const ts = timestamp();
            if (mode === 'all') {
                const payload = { version: 1, projects: state.projects || [], activeProjectId: state.activeProjectId || null };
                downloadJson(payload, `pixi-logic-projects-${ts}.json`);
            } else if (mode === 'current') {
                const current = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
                if (!current) { showNotification('No active project to export'); return; }
                const payload = { version: 1, projects: [current], activeProjectId: current.id };
                const safeName = (current.name || 'project').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/ig, '_');
                downloadJson(payload, `${safeName}-${ts}.json`);
            }
            showNotification('Export started');
        };

        const importProjectsFromObject = (data, mode = 'merge') => {
            try {
                let incoming = [];
                let incomingActiveId = null;
                if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                    incoming = data;
                } else if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
                    if (Array.isArray(data.projects)) incoming = data.projects;
                    if (data.activeProjectId !== undefined) incomingActiveId = data.activeProjectId;
                }
                if (!Array.isArray(incoming)) throw new Error('Invalid JSON format');

                // Basic validation
                incoming = incoming.filter(p => p && typeof p === 'object' && p.id != null && p.name);
                if (incoming.length === 0) { showNotification('No valid projects found in file'); return; }

                if (mode === 'replace') {
                    state.projects = incoming;
                    state.activeProjectId = incomingActiveId && incoming.some(p => p.id === incomingActiveId) ? incomingActiveId : (incoming[0]?.id ?? null);
                } else { // merge
                    const byId = new Map((state.projects || []).map(p => [p.id, p]));
                    incoming.forEach(p => { byId.set(p.id, p); });
                    state.projects = Array.from(byId.values());
                    if (incomingActiveId && state.projects.some(p => p.id === incomingActiveId)) {
                        state.activeProjectId = incomingActiveId;
                    } else if (!state.activeProjectId) {
                        state.activeProjectId = state.projects[0]?.id ?? null;
                    }
                }
                // Normalize imported projects: force 'checker' style
                try {
                    (state.projects || []).forEach(p => {
                        if (Array.isArray(p.pixelMaps)) {
                            p.pixelMaps.forEach(m => {
                                m.visualStyle = 'checker';
                                if (!Array.isArray(m.checkerColors) || m.checkerColors.length < 2) {
                                    m.checkerColors = ['#4b5563', '#1f2937'];
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                } catch (_) { /* best effort */ }
                state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId = state.activeProjectId || (state.projects[0]?.id ?? null);
                persistProjects();
                showNotification(`Imported ${incoming.length} project(s) (${mode})`);
                // Refresh current tab to reflect changes
                try { switchTab(state.activeTab); } catch (e) { /* best-effort */ }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Import failed', e);
                showNotification('Failed to import projects');
            }
        };

        // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---
        const mainContent = {
            designer: document.getElementById('designer-content'),
            visualizer: document.getElementById('visualizer-content'),
            effects: document.getElementById('effects-content'),
            canvas: document.getElementById('canvas-content'),
            'led-patching': document.getElementById('led-patching-content'),
            pdf: document.getElementById('pdf-export-content'),
            shows: document.getElementById('shows-content'),
            saved: document.getElementById('saved-content'),
            'circular-led': document.getElementById('circular-led-content'),
            'projector-test-pattern': document.getElementById('projector-test-pattern-content'),
            devices: document.getElementById('devices-content'),
            help: document.getElementById('help-content'),
            // LED Patching removed
        };
    const navTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab[data-tab]');
    const modeToggle = document.getElementById('app-mode-toggle');
    const modeSwitch = document.getElementById('app-mode-switch');
    const modeLabelEl = document.getElementById('app-mode-label');
    const appTitleEl = document.getElementById('app-title');
    const appSubtitleEl = document.getElementById('app-subtitle');

    const APP_MODES = {
        pixel: 'pixel',
        projection: 'projection'
    };
    const MODE_LABELS = {
        pixel: { title: 'Pixel Logic', subtitle: 'LED & Projector Patterns Generator' },
        projection: { title: 'Projection Logic', subtitle: 'Projector Tools & Alignment Patterns' }
    };

    const getAllowedTabsForMode = (mode) => {
        if (mode === APP_MODES.projection) return ['projector-test-pattern', 'help'];
        return ['designer', 'effects', 'visualizer', 'canvas', 'pdf', 'shows', 'saved', 'circular-led', 'help'];
    };

    const applyAppMode = (mode, { persist = true } = {}) => {
        const resolvedMode = (mode === APP_MODES.projection) ? APP_MODES.projection : APP_MODES.pixel;
        if (persist) {
            try { localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-app-mode', resolvedMode); } catch (_) {}
        }

        const labels = MODE_LABELS[resolvedMode] || MODE_LABELS.pixel;
        if (appTitleEl) appTitleEl.textContent = labels.title;
        if (appSubtitleEl) appSubtitleEl.textContent = labels.subtitle;

        const allowed = new Set(getAllowedTabsForMode(resolvedMode));
        navTabs.forEach(tab => {
            const modes = (tab.dataset.modes || 'pixel').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
            const visible = modes.includes(resolvedMode);
            tab.classList.toggle('hidden', !visible);
            tab.setAttribute('aria-hidden', visible ? 'false' : 'true');
            if (!visible) {
                tab.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
            } else {
                tab.removeAttribute('tabindex');
            }
        });

        if (modeSwitch) modeSwitch.checked = resolvedMode === APP_MODES.projection;
        if (modeLabelEl) modeLabelEl.textContent = resolvedMode === APP_MODES.projection ? 'Projection Logic' : 'Pixel Logic';

        const current = state.activeTab;
        if (!allowed.has(current)) {
            const fallback = resolvedMode === APP_MODES.projection ? 'projector-test-pattern' : 'designer';
            switchTab(fallback);
        } else {
            switchTab(current);
        }
    };

    const initAppMode = () => {
        let saved = null;
        try { saved = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-app-mode'); } catch (_) {}
        applyAppMode(saved || APP_MODES.pixel, { persist: false });
    };
    // Global handler for Learn more links
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const go = e.target.closest('[data-goto-tab]');
        if (!go) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const tab = go.getAttribute('data-goto-tab');
        const key = go.getAttribute('data-highlight');
        if (tab) {
            if (key) pendingHighlight = { tab, key };
            switchTab(tab);
        }
    });
    // Global handler for Performance Mode (delegated)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const lite = e.target.closest('#help-performance-lite, #header-performance-lite');
        const full = e.target.closest('#help-performance-full, #header-performance-full');
        if (lite) {
            try { localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-preview-cap-mp', '1'); localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-performance-mode', 'lite'); } catch(_) {}
            const badge = document.getElementById('header-performance-status');
            if (badge) { badge.textContent = 'Lite'; badge.classList.remove('hidden'); }
            if (typeof showNotification === 'function') showNotification('Performance: Lite mode enabled');
            if (typeof redrawAffectedVisuals === 'function') redrawAffectedVisuals(); else { try { renderVisualizer(); renderPixelMapDesigner(); renderEffectsDetails(); } catch(_) {} }
        } else if (full) {
            try { localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-preview-cap-mp', '4'); localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-performance-mode', 'full'); } catch(_) {}
            const badge = document.getElementById('header-performance-status');
            if (badge) { badge.classList.add('hidden'); }
            if (typeof showNotification === 'function') showNotification('Performance: Full mode enabled');
            if (typeof redrawAffectedVisuals === 'function') redrawAffectedVisuals(); else { try { renderVisualizer(); renderPixelMapDesigner(); renderEffectsDetails(); } catch(_) {} }
        }
    });

    // Global handler for Help: Video Tutorial (delegated)
    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest('#help-open-tutorial-video');
        if (!btn) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        try {
            if (!window.tutorialVideo || typeof window.tutorialVideo.open !== 'function') {
                if (typeof showNotification === 'function') showNotification('Tutorial video is only available in the installed app');
                return;
            }
            const res = await window.tutorialVideo.open();
            if (!res || res.ok !== true) {
                if (typeof showNotification === 'function') showNotification('Could not open tutorial video');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('Tutorial video open failed', err);
            if (typeof showNotification === 'function') showNotification('Could not open tutorial video');
        }
    });
    // Set app version badge (attempt to read from Electron app; fallback to inline constant)
    (async function(){
        const badge = document.getElementById('app-version-badge');
        try {
            if (window.appInfo && typeof window.appInfo.getVersion === 'function') {
                const v = await window.appInfo.getVersion();
                if (v) APP_VERSION = v;
            }
        } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        if (badge) {
            badge.textContent = `v${APP_VERSION}`;
            badge.title = `Build: ${APP_BUILD_DATE}`;
        }
    })();
        const notificationEl = document.getElementById('notification');

        // Simple confirm dialog (non-blocking) to avoid OS-level confirm focus issues
        const showConfirm = (message, confirmText = 'Confirm', cancelText = 'Cancel') => {
            return new Promise((resolve) => {
                try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush('showConfirm()'); } catch(_) {}
                const overlay = document.createElement('div');
                overlay.className = 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center';
                overlay.style.background = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
                overlay.style.backdropFilter = 'blur(1px)';
                const box = document.createElement('div');
                box.className = 'bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-5 w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl';
                box.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="text-gray-200 text-sm">${message}</div>
                    <div class="mt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
                        <button id="cf-cancel" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">${cancelText}</button>
                        <button id="cf-ok" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 text-white text-sm">${confirmText}</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                overlay.appendChild(box);
                document.body.appendChild(overlay);

                const cleanup = (val) => {
                    try { document.body.removeChild(overlay); } catch(_) {}
                    try {
                        if (typeof unlockShowsUi === 'function') {
                            unlockShowsUi(); setTimeout(unlockShowsUi, 50);
                        }
                    } catch(_) {}
                    resolve(val);
                };

                overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const dialog = box;
                    if (dialog && !dialog.contains(e.target)) cleanup(false);
                });
                const ok = box.querySelector('#cf-ok');
                const cancel = box.querySelector('#cf-cancel');
                if (ok) ok.addEventListener('click', () => cleanup(true), { once: true });
                if (cancel) cancel.addEventListener('click', () => cleanup(false), { once: true });
            });
        };

        // --- RENDER FUNCTIONS ---
        
        const renderPixelMapDesigner = () => {
            // Event delegation in the dashboard handles this now.
            // document.querySelectorAll('.rename-project-btn').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            //     e.stopPropagation();
            //     const projectId = parseInt(e.currentTarget.dataset.id);
            //     const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === projectId);
            //     if (project) {
            //         showInputModal('Rename Project', project.name, (newName) => {
            //             if (newName && newName.trim() !== '') {
            //                 project.name = newName.trim();
            //                 (dashboard removed)
            //             }
            //         });
            //     }
            // }));

            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) {
                return;
            }

            const activeMap = project.pixelMaps.find(m => m.id === project.activePixelMapId);
             if (!activeMap) {
                if (project.pixelMaps.length > 0) {
                    project.activePixelMapId = project.pixelMaps[0].id;
                    renderPixelMapDesigner();
                } else {
                    mainContent.designer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center p-8 bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
                        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-400">No Pixel Maps in this Project</h2>
                        <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Click "Add Map" to start designing.</p>
                         <button id="add-pixel-map-btn" class="mt-4 btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-accent hover:bg-accent-dark mx-auto">Add Map</button>
                    </div>`;
                     document.getElementById('add-pixel-map-btn').addEventListener('click', addPixelMap);

            const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap);

                <button data-map-id="${map.id}" title="Click to select" class="pixel-map-tab px-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-t-lg ${map.id === project.activePixelMapId ? 'bg-gray-800 text-white' : 'bg-gray-700 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-600'}">
                    ${map.name}
                </button>
            `).join('');

            const getSavedGradientPalettes = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-gradient-palettes')) || []; } catch(_) { return []; } };
            const getSavedCheckerPalettes  = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-checker-palettes')) || []; } catch(_) { return []; } };

                { name: 'Sunrise', colors: ['#ff9a9e', '#fad0c4'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Ocean', colors: ['#a1c4fd', '#c2e9fb'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Passion', colors: ['#fa709a', '#fee140'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Forest', colors: ['#43e97b', '#38f9d7'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Amethyst', colors: ['#9d50bb', '#6e48aa'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },

            const gradientPalettes = [ { name: 'Custom', colors: activeMap.gradient.colors, type: activeMap.gradient.type, angle: activeMap.gradient.angle }, ...builtInGrad, ...getSavedGradientPalettes() ];
            const paletteOptions = gradientPalettes.map(p => `<option value="${p.name}" ${activeMap.gradient.palette === p.name ? 'selected' : ''}>${p.name}</option>`).join('');

                { name: 'Classic', colors: ['#4b5563', '#1f2937'] },
                { name: 'Monochrome', colors: ['#ffffff', '#000000'] },
                { name: 'Earth', colors: ['#a16207', '#422006'] },
                { name: 'Oceanic', colors: ['#0c4a6e', '#082f49'] },
            ];
            const checkerPalettes = [ { name: 'Custom', colors: activeMap.checkerColors }, ...builtInChecker, ...getSavedCheckerPalettes() ];
            const checkerPaletteOptions = checkerPalettes.map(p => `<option value="${p.name}" ${activeMap.checkerPalette === p.name ? 'selected' : ''}>${p.name}</option>`).join('');
            const panelUnit = activeMap.panelDimensionsUnit || 'mm';
            const panelWidthDisplayValue = (typeof activeMap.panelWidthMm === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(activeMap.panelWidthMm)) ? formatPanelUnitValueForInput(activeMap.panelWidthMm, panelUnit) : '';
            const panelHeightDisplayValue = (typeof activeMap.panelHeightMm === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(activeMap.panelHeightMm)) ? formatPanelUnitValueForInput(activeMap.panelHeightMm, panelUnit) : '';

                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">

                                      <div>

                                          <input type="text" id="map-name-input" value="${activeMap.name || ''}" placeholder="Enter pixel map name" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-accent">

                                        ${(state.designerPresets||[]).length ? state.designerPresets.map(p=>`<div class='flex items-center gap-2 bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-2'>
                                                <span class='text-xs text-gray-300 truncate max-w-[140px]' title='${p.name}'>${p.name}</span>

                        <div class="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
                             <div id="info-cards-container" class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                                <!-- Info cards will be populated by JS -->
                             </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/50 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg pl-sticky-preview">
                                <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center mb-4 gap-2">
                                    <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-accent">Live Preview: <span id="live-demo-map-name" class="text-white">${activeMap.name}</span></h3>
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <button id="designer-zoom-out-btn" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="w-5 h-5"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line><line x1="8" y1="11" x2="14" y2="11"></line></svg></button>
                                        <button id="designer-zoom-in-btn" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="w-5 h-5"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line><line x1="11" y1="8" x2="11" y2="14"></line><line x1="8" y1="11" x2="14" y2="11"></line></svg></button>
                                        <button id="designer-fit-btn" title="Fit to Screen" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 8V4h4M20 8V4h-4M4 16v4h4M20 16v4h-4"></path></svg></button>
                                        <button id="designer-actual-btn" class="btn-glow px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700">Actual</button>
                                        <button id="designer-zoom-100-btn" class="btn-glow px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700">100%</button>
                                        <button id="send-to-canvas-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700">Send to Output</button>
                                        <button id="save-png-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700">Save PNG</button>
                                        <button id="save-all-pngs-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700">Save All PNGs</button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div id="designer-preview-viewport" class="relative w-full h-[20.8rem] bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-4 overflow-auto">
                                    <div id="designer-preview-wrapper" style="transform-origin: top left;">
                                        <canvas id="designer-preview-canvas" class="block" style="image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>
