                        </div>
                    </div>
                 </div>
            `;
            
            // Bind critical controls first (so they work even if rendering below fails)
            document.querySelectorAll('.pixel-map-tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const dataId = e.currentTarget.dataset.mapId;
                    const match = project.pixelMaps.find(m => String(m.id) === String(dataId));
                    if (match) { project.activePixelMapId = match.id; }
                    renderPixelMapDesigner();
                });
            });
            const addBtn = document.getElementById('add-pixel-map-btn'); if (addBtn) addBtn.addEventListener('click', addPixelMap);
            // Rename Map removed; inline Map Name field is used instead
            const delBtn = document.getElementById('delete-pixel-map-btn'); if (delBtn) delBtn.addEventListener('click', deletePixelMap);
            const dupBtn = document.getElementById('duplicate-pixel-map-btn'); if (dupBtn) dupBtn.addEventListener('click', duplicatePixelMap);

            // Re-populate info cards and draw canvas
            try { updateCalculationCards(calcs); } catch (e) { console.warn('updateCalculationCards failed', e); }
            const previewCanvas = document.getElementById('designer-preview-canvas');
            if (previewCanvas) {
                try { drawVisualizerCanvas(previewCanvas, activeMap); } catch (e) { console.warn('drawVisualizerCanvas failed', e); }
                // Ensure CSS size reflects current zoom; scrollbars handle navigation
                if (previewCanvas.width && previewCanvas.height) {
                    const z = activeMap.zoom || 1;
                    previewCanvas.style.width = `${Math.round(previewCanvas.width * z)}px`;
                    previewCanvas.style.height = `${Math.round(previewCanvas.height * z)}px`;
                }
                if (state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview) try { fitDesignerPreviewToScreen(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
            }
            // Map name input handlers
            const mapNameInput = document.getElementById('map-name-input');
            if (mapNameInput) {
                const commitName = () => {
                    const newName = (mapNameInput.value || '').trim();
                    if (!newName) { showNotification('Map name cannot be empty.'); mapNameInput.value = activeMap.name || ''; return; }
                    if (newName !== activeMap.name) {
                        activeMap.name = newName;
                        try {
                            const effectsContainer = document.getElementById('effects-content');
                            if (effectsContainer && effectsContainer.children.length) {
                                renderEffectsDetails();
                            }
                        } catch(_) {}
                        renderPixelMapDesigner();
                    }
                };
                mapNameInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); commitName(); } });
                mapNameInput.addEventListener('blur', commitName);
                mapNameInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    const live = document.getElementById('live-demo-map-name'); if (live) live.textContent = mapNameInput.value;
                    const activeTabBtn = document.querySelector('.pixel-map-tab.bg-gray-800.text-white'); if (activeTabBtn) activeTabBtn.textContent = mapNameInput.value || activeMap.name || '';
                });
            }

            document.querySelectorAll('.design-input, .unit-select').forEach(input => {
                input.addEventListener('input', handleInputChange);
                input.addEventListener('change', handleInputChange);
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.visual-style-input').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', handleVisualStyleChange));
            document.querySelectorAll('.style-input').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', handleStyleChange));
            const gradPal = document.getElementById('gradient-palette'); if (gradPal) gradPal.addEventListener('change', handlePaletteChange);
            const panelPreset = document.getElementById('panel-res-preset'); if (panelPreset) panelPreset.addEventListener('change', handlePanelResPresetChange);
            const saveCustom = document.getElementById('save-custom-res-btn'); if (saveCustom) saveCustom.addEventListener('click', saveCustomPanelResolution);
            const checkerPal = document.getElementById('checker-palette'); if (checkerPal) checkerPal.addEventListener('change', handleCheckerPaletteChange);
            // Panel dimension preset controls (width/height/res snapshots)
            try {
                if (!Array.isArray(state.panelDimensionPresets)) {
                    state.panelDimensionPresets = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixellogic-panel-dimension-presets') || '[]') || [];
                }
                const persistPanelDimensionPresets = () => {
                    try { localStorage.setItem('pixellogic-panel-dimension-presets', JSON.stringify(state.panelDimensionPresets)); } catch(_) {}
                };
                const panelPresetNameInput = document.getElementById('panel-dimension-preset-name');
                const panelPresetSaveBtn = document.getElementById('panel-dimension-preset-save');
                const panelPresetList = document.getElementById('panel-dimension-presets-list');
                if (panelPresetSaveBtn) {
                    panelPresetSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const snapshot = {
                            panelWidthMm: Number(activeMap.panelWidthMm) || 0,
                            panelHeightMm: Number(activeMap.panelHeightMm) || 0,
                            panelResWidth: Number(activeMap.panelResWidth) || 0,
                            panelResHeight: Number(activeMap.panelResHeight) || 0,
                            panelDimensionsUnit: activeMap.panelDimensionsUnit || 'mm'
                        };
                        if (!(snapshot.panelWidthMm > 0 && snapshot.panelHeightMm > 0)) {
                            showNotification('Enter valid panel dimensions first.');
                            return;
                        }
                        const nm = (panelPresetNameInput?.value || '').trim() || `Panel ${((state.panelDimensionPresets || []).length + 1)}`;
                        const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
                        state.panelDimensionPresets.push({ id, name: nm, data: snapshot });
                        persistPanelDimensionPresets();
                        if (panelPresetNameInput) panelPresetNameInput.value = '';
                        showNotification('Panel preset saved.');
                        renderPixelMapDesigner();
                    });
                }
                if (panelPresetList) {
                    panelPresetList.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
                        const applyId = evt.target?.getAttribute && evt.target.getAttribute('data-apply-panel-preset');
                        const delId = evt.target?.getAttribute && evt.target.getAttribute('data-delete-panel-preset');
                        if (applyId) {
                            const preset = (state.panelDimensionPresets || []).find(p => String(p.id) === String(applyId));
                            if (preset && preset.data) {
                                ['panelWidthMm','panelHeightMm','panelResWidth','panelResHeight'].forEach(key => {
                                    if (typeof preset.data[key] !== 'undefined') activeMap[key] = preset.data[key];
                                });
                                if (preset.data.panelDimensionsUnit) {
                                    activeMap.panelDimensionsUnit = preset.data.panelDimensionsUnit;
                                }
                                saveState();
                                renderPixelMapDesigner();
                                try { redrawAffectedVisuals(); } catch(_) {}
                                showNotification(`Applied panel preset "${preset.name}".`);
                            }
                        } else if (delId) {
                            const before = (state.panelDimensionPresets || []).length;
                            state.panelDimensionPresets = (state.panelDimensionPresets || []).filter(p => String(p.id) !== String(delId));
                            if ((state.panelDimensionPresets || []).length !== before) {
                                persistPanelDimensionPresets();
                                renderPixelMapDesigner();
                                showNotification('Panel preset deleted.');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Pixel Map Designer presets (whole tab) - save/apply/delete
            try {
                if (!Array.isArray(state.designerPresets)) {
                    try { state.designerPresets = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixellogic-designer-presets')||'[]') || []; } catch(_) { state.designerPresets = []; }
                }
                const nameInput = document.getElementById('designer-preset-name');
                const saveBtn = document.getElementById('designer-preset-save');
                const listEl = document.getElementById('designer-presets-list');
                const persist = () => { try { localStorage.setItem('pixellogic-designer-presets', JSON.stringify(state.designerPresets)); } catch(_) {} };
                // Only capture styling fields so presets never overwrite screen or panel dimensions.
                const DESIGNER_PRESET_FIELDS = Object.freeze([
                    'visualStyle',
                    'gradient',
                    'checkerColors',
                    'checkerPalette',
                    'numbering',
                    'border'
                ]);
                const snapshotDesigner = () => {
                    const sMap = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeMap));
                    const payload = {};
                    DESIGNER_PRESET_FIELDS.forEach((field) => {
                        if (typeof sMap[field] !== 'undefined') {
                            payload[field] = sMap[field];
                        }
                    });
                    return payload;
                };
                if (saveBtn) {
                    saveBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
                        const nm = (nameInput?.value||'').trim() || `Preset ${((state.designerPresets||[]).length+1)}`;
                        const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
                        state.designerPresets.push({ id, name: nm, data: snapshotDesigner() });
                        persist();
                        renderPixelMapDesigner();
                        showNotification('Designer preset saved.');
                    });
                }
                if (listEl) {
                    listEl.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
                        const applyId = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-apply-designer-preset');
                        const delId = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-delete-designer-preset');
                        const applyToMap = (presetObj, mapObj) => {
                            if (!presetObj || !mapObj) return;
                            const d = presetObj.data || {};
                            DESIGNER_PRESET_FIELDS.forEach((field) => {
                                if (typeof d[field] !== 'undefined') {
                                    mapObj[field] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d[field]));
                                }
                            });
                        };
                        if (applyId) {
                            const p = (state.designerPresets||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(applyId));
                            if (p) {
                                applyToMap(p, activeMap);
                                saveState();
                                renderPixelMapDesigner();
                                try { redrawAffectedVisuals(); } catch(_) {}
                                showNotification(`Applied designer preset "${p.name}" to active map.`);
                            }
                        } else if (delId) {
                            const before = (state.designerPresets||[]).length;
                            state.designerPresets = (state.designerPresets||[]).filter(x=>String(x.id)!==String(delId));
                            if ((state.designerPresets||[]).length !== before) {
                                persist();
                                renderPixelMapDesigner();
                                showNotification('Designer preset deleted.');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            const sendToCanvasBtn = document.getElementById('send-to-canvas-btn'); if(sendToCanvasBtn) sendToCanvasBtn.addEventListener('click', sendVisualizerToCanvas);
            const savePngBtn = document.getElementById('save-png-btn'); if(savePngBtn) savePngBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportVisualizer('png', 'designer-preview-canvas', activeMap.name));
            const saveAllPngsBtn = document.getElementById('save-all-pngs-btn'); if (saveAllPngsBtn) saveAllPngsBtn.addEventListener('click', exportAllPixelMapsAsPNGs);

            const zoomIn = document.getElementById('designer-zoom-in-btn'); if (zoomIn) zoomIn.addEventListener('click', () => handleDesignerZoom(1.25));
            const zoomOut = document.getElementById('designer-zoom-out-btn'); if (zoomOut) zoomOut.addEventListener('click', () => handleDesignerZoom(0.8));
            const fitBtn = document.getElementById('designer-fit-btn'); if (fitBtn) fitBtn.addEventListener('click', () => fitDesignerPreviewToScreen(false, true)); // Keep forceRecalc=true for fit button
            const zoom100 = document.getElementById('designer-zoom-100-btn'); if (zoom100) zoom100.addEventListener('click', () => handleDesignerZoom(null, 1.0));
            const actualBtn = document.getElementById('designer-actual-btn'); if (actualBtn) actualBtn.addEventListener('click', () => fitDesignerPreviewToScreen(true, true));

            // Populate and set the panel resolution preset dropdown
            try { populatePanelResPresets(); } catch (e) { console.warn('populatePanelResPresets failed', e); }

            // Mixed Panel Grid removed
        };

        const renderVisualizer = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
             if (!activeMap) {
                 mainContent.visualizer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center p-8 bg-gray-800 rounded-lg"><p class="text-gray-500">Please select a Pixel Map in the Pixel Maps tab to view it here.</p></div>`;
                 return;
             }
             
             const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap);
             let visualizerContent;
             if (calcs.totalResWidth > 0 && calcs.totalResHeight > 0) {
                 visualizerContent = `<canvas id="visualizer-canvas" class="block" style="image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>`;
             } else {
                 visualizerContent = `<p class="text-gray-500">The selected Pixel Map has no valid dimensions.</p>`;
             }

             const projectForViz = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
             const thumbsHtml = (projectForViz?.pixelMaps || []).map(pm => `
                 <button data-thumb-id="${pm.id}" class="relative cursor-pointer min-w-[190px] max-w-[190px] p-2 rounded-lg border ${String(pm.id)===String(projectForViz.activePixelMapId)?'border-accent ring-1 ring-accent/40':'border-gray-700'} bg-gray-900 hover:border-accent transition-colors">
                    ${String(pm.id)===String(projectForViz.activePixelMapId) ? '<span class="absolute top-1 left-1 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-600/90 text-white">Active</span>' : ''}
                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-300 mb-2 truncate" title="${pm.name}">${pm.name}</div>
                    <div class="w-[174px] h-[108px] rounded bg-black/40 flex items-start justify-center overflow-hidden mx-auto">
                        <canvas id="thumb-canvas-${pm.id}" class="block" style="image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>
                    </div>
                 </button>
             `).join('');

             mainContent.visualizer.innerHTML = `
                 <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg">
                       <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center mb-4 gap-4">
                           <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold">Visualizer: <span class="text-accent">${activeMap.name}</span></h2>
                      <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-center items-center gap-2">
                          <button id="visualizer-save-png-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700">Save PNG</button>
                          <button id="visualizer-save-jpg-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700">Save JPG</button>
                          <button id="visualizer-save-all-pngs-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700">Save All PNGs</button>
                          <button id="visualizer-send-to-canvas-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700">Send to Output</button>
                          <button id="visualizer-fit-btn" title="Fit to Screen" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 8V4h4M20 8V4h-4M4 16v4h4M20 16v4h-4"></path></svg></button>
                          <button id="visualizer-actual-btn" class="btn-glow px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700">Actual</button>
                                <button id="visualizer-zoom-100-btn" class="btn-glow px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700">100%</button>
                                <button id="visualizer-zoom-out-btn" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="w-5 h-5"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line><line x1="8" y1="11" x2="14" y2="11"></line></svg></button>
                                <button id="visualizer-zoom-in-btn" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="w-5 h-5"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line><line x1="11" y1="8" x2="11" y2="14"></line><line x1="8" y1="11" x2="14" y2="11"></line></svg></button>
                           </div>
                       </div>
                       <div id="visualizer-scroll-container" class="relative w-full h-[49.6vh] bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-4 overflow-auto">
                            <!-- Rulers overlay -->
                            <canvas id="viz-ruler-top" class="absolute top-0 left-0 z-10 pointer-events-none"></canvas>
                            <canvas id="viz-ruler-left" class="absolute top-0 left-0 z-10 pointer-events-none"></canvas>
                            <div id="visualizer-wrapper">
                               ${visualizerContent}
                           </div>
                       </div>
                       <div class="mt-4">
                           <div class="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-2">All Pixel Maps in this Project</div>
                           <div id="visualizer-thumbs" class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                               ${thumbsHtml || '<div class="text-xs text-gray-500">No other pixel maps yet.</div>'}
                           </div>
                       </div>
                 </div>`;
            
            // Draw the canvas content after the DOM is updated
            if (calcs.totalResWidth > 0) {
                const canvas = document.getElementById('visualizer-canvas');
                if (canvas) {
                    drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, activeMap);
                    canvas.addEventListener('click', onVisualizerCanvasClick);
                    // Ensure CSS size reflects underlying pixel buffer at current zoom
                    if (canvas.width && canvas.height) {
                        const z = state.visualizerState.zoom || 1;
                        canvas.style.width = `${Math.round(canvas.width * z)}px`;
                        canvas.style.height = `${Math.round(canvas.height * z)}px`;
                    }
                    if (state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview) fitVisualizerToScreen();
                }
            }

            document.getElementById('visualizer-zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleVisualizerZoom(1.1));
            document.getElementById('visualizer-zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleVisualizerZoom(0.9));
            document.getElementById('visualizer-fit-btn').addEventListener('click', () => fitVisualizerToScreen(true));
            document.getElementById('visualizer-zoom-100-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleVisualizerZoom(null, 1));
            const vizActual = document.getElementById('visualizer-actual-btn'); if (vizActual) vizActual.addEventListener('click', () => handleVisualizerZoom(null, 1));
            document.getElementById('visualizer-save-png-btn').addEventListener('click', () => exportVisualizer('png', 'visualizer-canvas', activeMap.name));
            document.getElementById('visualizer-save-jpg-btn').addEventListener('click', () => exportVisualizer('jpeg', 'visualizer-canvas', activeMap.name));

            const sendBtn = document.getElementById('visualizer-send-to-canvas-btn');
            if (sendBtn) sendBtn.addEventListener('click', sendVisualizerToCanvas);

            // Visualizer rulers and scrollbars: draw rulers on scroll/resize/zoom
            try {
                const container = document.getElementById('visualizer-scroll-container');
                const drawVizRulers = () => {
                    const top = document.getElementById('viz-ruler-top');
                    const left = document.getElementById('viz-ruler-left');
                    const canvasEl = document.getElementById('visualizer-canvas');
                    if (!container || !top || !left) return;
                    const cs = getComputedStyle(container);
                    const padL = parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0;
                    const padT = parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) || 0;
                    // top ruler
                    top.width = container.clientWidth;
                    top.height = 24;
                    left.width = 24;
                    left.height = container.clientHeight;
                    const ctxTop = top.getContext('2d');
                    const ctxLeft = left.getContext('2d');
                    ctxTop.clearRect(0,0,top.width,top.height);
                    ctxLeft.clearRect(0,0,left.width,left.height);
                    ctxTop.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; ctxTop.fillRect(0,0,top.width,top.height);
                    ctxLeft.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; ctxLeft.fillRect(0,0,left.width,left.height);
                    ctxTop.fillStyle = '#9ca3af'; ctxTop.font = '10px Inter';
                    ctxLeft.fillStyle = '#9ca3af'; ctxLeft.font = '10px Inter';
                    const z = state.visualizerState.zoom || 1;
                    const startWX = Math.max(0, Math.floor((container.scrollLeft - padL) / z));
                    const endWX = Math.ceil((container.scrollLeft - padL + container.clientWidth) / z);
                    const startWY = Math.max(0, Math.floor((container.scrollTop - padT) / z));
                    const endWY = Math.ceil((container.scrollTop - padT + container.clientHeight) / z);
                    const interval = (z < 0.25 ? 500 : (z < 0.5 ? 200 : 100));
                    for (let wx = startWX - (startWX % (interval/10)); wx <= endWX; wx += interval/10) {
                        const sx = padL + wx * z - container.scrollLeft;
                        const mark = (wx % interval === 0) ? 10 : (wx % (interval/2) === 0 ? 6 : 3);
                        ctxTop.strokeStyle = (wx === 0) ? 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7)' : '#9ca3af';
                        ctxTop.beginPath(); ctxTop.moveTo(sx, 24 - mark); ctxTop.lineTo(sx, 24); ctxTop.stroke();
                        if (wx % interval === 0) ctxTop.fillText(wx, sx + 2, 12);
                    }
                    for (let wy = startWY - (startWY % (interval/10)); wy <= endWY; wy += interval/10) {
                        const sy = padT + wy * z - container.scrollTop;
                        const mark = (wy % interval === 0) ? 10 : (wy % (interval/2) === 0 ? 6 : 3);
                        ctxLeft.strokeStyle = (wy === 0) ? 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7)' : '#9ca3af';
                        ctxLeft.beginPath(); ctxLeft.moveTo(24 - mark, sy); ctxLeft.lineTo(24, sy); ctxLeft.stroke();
                        if (wy % interval === 0) {
                            ctxLeft.save(); ctxLeft.translate(12, sy + 8); ctxLeft.rotate(-Math.PI/2); ctxLeft.fillText(wy, 0, 0); ctxLeft.restore();
                        }
                    }
                };
                container.addEventListener('scroll', drawVizRulers);
                window.addEventListener('resize', drawVizRulers);
                drawVizRulers();
            } catch(_) {}

            // Keyboard navigation: Left/Right arrow to cycle pixel maps
            try {
                const container = document.getElementById('visualizer-content');
                const proj = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
                if (container && proj && proj.pixelMaps && proj.pixelMaps.length > 1) {
                    const keyHandler = (ev) => {
                        if (ev.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && ev.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
                        const idx = proj.pixelMaps.findIndex(m => String(m.id) === String(proj.activePixelMapId));
                        if (idx === -1) return;
                        let nextIdx = idx + (ev.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1);
                        if (nextIdx < 0) nextIdx = proj.pixelMaps.length - 1;
                        if (nextIdx >= proj.pixelMaps.length) nextIdx = 0;
                        proj.activePixelMapId = proj.pixelMaps[nextIdx].id;
                        saveState();
                        renderVisualizer();
                    };
                    // Attach on the document while Visualizer is active; remove on re-render by scoping to once
                    document.addEventListener('keydown', keyHandler, { once: true });
                    // Re-attach on next render automatically
                }
            } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }

            // Thumbnails: draw and wire up click to activate
            try {
                const proj = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
                if (proj && Array.isArray(proj.pixelMaps)) {
                    proj.pixelMaps.forEach(pm => {
                        const c = document.getElementById(`thumb-canvas-${pm.id}`);
                        if (c) {
                            // Ensure parent has fixed size; draw scaled inside
                            try { drawVisualizerCanvas(c, pm); } catch (_) {}
                        }
                    });
                    // Event delegation: make any thumb click activate
                    const strip = document.getElementById('visualizer-thumbs');
                    if (strip) {
                        strip.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                            const el = ev.target.closest('[data-thumb-id]');
                            if (!el) return;
                            const id = el.getAttribute('data-thumb-id');
                            const match = proj.pixelMaps.find(pm => String(pm.id) === String(id));
                            if (!match) return;
                            proj.activePixelMapId = match.id; // preserve original type (number)
                            saveState();
                            renderVisualizer();
                        }, { once: false });
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('thumbs render error', e); }
        };

        const renderEffectsDetails = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) {
                mainContent.effects.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-gray-500">Please select or create a project.</div>`;
                return;
            }
            const activeMap = project.pixelMaps.find(m => m.id === project.activePixelMapId);
            if (!activeMap) {
                 mainContent.effects.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-gray-500">Please select a Pixel Map in Pixel Maps to edit its effects.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            const { details } = activeMap;
            // Migrate legacy centerBadge fields into info.* on the fly for UI coherence
            try {
                if (details && details.centerBadge) {
                    const cb = details.centerBadge;
                    if (!details.info) details.info = {};
                    if (typeof details.info.badgeEnabled === 'undefined') details.info.badgeEnabled = !!cb.enabled;
                    if (typeof details.info.badgeSize === 'undefined' && typeof cb.size !== 'undefined') details.info.badgeSize = cb.size;
                    if (typeof details.info.badgeOpacity === 'undefined' && typeof cb.opacity !== 'undefined') details.info.badgeOpacity = cb.opacity;
                    if (typeof details.info.badgeShadow === 'undefined' && typeof cb.shadow !== 'undefined') details.info.badgeShadow = cb.shadow;
                    if (typeof details.info.badgeStroke === 'undefined' && typeof cb.stroke !== 'undefined') details.info.badgeStroke = cb.stroke;
                    if (typeof details.info.badgeStrokeWidth === 'undefined' && typeof cb.strokeWidth !== 'undefined') details.info.badgeStrokeWidth = cb.strokeWidth;
                }
            } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }

            if (!details.info.fontFamily) details.info.fontFamily = 'Inter';
            const fontsForSelect = (() => {
                const base = getFontOptions();
                const set = new Set(base);
                if (details.info.fontFamily) set.add(details.info.fontFamily);
                return Array.from(set);
            })();
            const infoFontOptionsHtml = fontsForSelect.map((fontName) => {
                const isSelected = (details.info.fontFamily || 'Inter') === fontName;
                const safe = escapeHtml(fontName);
                return `<option value="${safe}" ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}>${safe}</option>`;
            }).join('');
            const lockedInfoName = escapeHtml(activeMap.name || 'Untitled Pixel Map');

            // Build thumbnails similar to Visualizer
            const thumbsHtml = (project.pixelMaps || []).map(pm => `
                <button data-thumb-id="${pm.id}" class="relative cursor-pointer min-w-[190px] max-w-[190px] p-2 rounded-lg border ${String(pm.id)===String(project.activePixelMapId)?'border-accent ring-1 ring-accent/40':'border-gray-700'} bg-gray-900 hover:border-accent transition-colors">
                    ${String(pm.id)===String(project.activePixelMapId) ? '<span class="absolute top-1 left-1 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-600/90 text-white">Active</span>' : ''}
                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-300 mb-2 truncate" title="${pm.name}">${pm.name}</div>
                    <div class="w-[174px] h-[108px] rounded bg-black/40 flex items-start justify-center overflow-hidden mx-auto">
                        <canvas id="effects-thumb-canvas-${pm.id}" class="block" style="image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>
                    </div>
                </button>
            `).join('');

            mainContent.effects.innerHTML = `
                <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
                    <!-- Full-width Live Preview at top -->
                    <div class="border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-4 pl-sticky-preview z-10 bg-gray-800/60 backdrop-blur">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                            <h3 class="font-semibold text-accent">Live Preview</h3>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-300">
                                <button id="effects-zoom-out" class="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 border border-gray-600">-</button>
                                <button id="effects-zoom-in" class="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 border border-gray-600">+</button>
                                <span class="mx-2 text-gray-400">|</span>
                                <button id="effects-zoom-actual" class="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 border border-gray-600" title="Show at 1:1 pixel size">Actual Pixels</button>
                                <button id="effects-zoom-fit" class="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 border border-gray-600" title="Fit the preview to the viewport">Fit</button>
                                <button id="effects-zoom-100" class="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 border border-gray-600" title="Set zoom to 100%">100%</button>
                                <span class="mx-2 text-gray-400">|</span>
                                <span id="effects-zoom-label" class="min-w-[60px] inline-block text-right">100%</span>
                                <span class="mx-2 text-gray-400">|</span>
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-1" title="Preview quality scale (low = faster preview, export always full)">
                                    <label for="effects-preview-quality" class="text-gray-400">Quality</label>
                                    <input id="effects-preview-quality" type="range" min="5" max="100" value="100" class="w-24" />
                                    <span id="effects-preview-quality-label" class="text-gray-400">100%</span>
                                </div>
                                <span class="mx-2 text-gray-400">|</span>
                                <button id="effects-send-to-canvas-btn" class="btn-glow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700">Send to Canvas</button>
                            </div>

                    <div class="border border-gray-700 rounded-lg p-4">
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-2">All Pixel Maps in this Project</div>
                        <div id="effects-thumbs" class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                            ${thumbsHtml || '<div class="text-xs text-gray-500">No pixel maps yet.</div>'}

                            <div class="space-y-4 ${details.info.enabled ? '' : 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none'}">
                                <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                                    <div class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">Pixel Map Name</div>
                                    <div class="font-semibold text-gray-100">${lockedInfoName}</div>
                                    <div class="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">Rename the Pixel Map from the Pixel Maps tab to update this overlay text.</div>
                                </div>
                                <select data-details-field="info.position" class="details-input w-full bg-gray-900 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-gray-600">
                                    <option value="top-left" ${details.info.position === 'top-left' ? 'selected' : ''}>Top Left</option>
                                    <option value="top-right" ${details.info.position === 'top-right' ? 'selected' : ''}>Top Right</option>
                                    <option value="bottom-left" ${details.info.position === 'bottom-left' ? 'selected' : ''}>Bottom Left</option>
                                    <option value="bottom-right" ${details.info.position === 'bottom-right' ? 'selected' : ''}>Bottom Right</option>
                                    <option value="center" ${details.info.position === 'center' ? 'selected' : ''}>Center</option>
                                </select>
                                <div>
                                    <label class="text-sm">Font Family</label>
                                    <select data-details-field="info.fontFamily" class="details-input w-full bg-gray-900 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-gray-600 mt-1">
                                        ${infoFontOptionsHtml}
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <label id="info-font-size-label" class="text-sm">Font Size (${details.info.fontSize}%)</label>
                                    <input type="range" data-details-field="info.fontSize" min="0" max="300" value="${details.info.fontSize}" class="details-input w-full">

                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <label class="text-sm">Display As</label>
                                    <select data-details-field="info.displayMode" class="details-input w-full bg-gray-900 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-gray-600 mt-1">
                                        <option value="box" ${(!details.info.displayMode || details.info.displayMode === 'box') ? 'selected' : ''}>Information Box</option>
                                        <option value="badge" ${(details.info.displayMode === 'badge') ? 'selected' : ''}>Center Badge</option>
                                    </select>
                                </div>

            document.querySelectorAll('.details-input, .toggle-switch input').forEach(input => {
                const eventType = input.type === 'checkbox' || input.type === 'file' ? 'change' : 'input';
                input.addEventListener(eventType, handleDetailsChange);
            });
            // (Panel grid editor moved to Designer)

            // Wire Effects Presets controls
            try {
                if (!Array.isArray(state.effectsPresets)) {
                    try { state.effectsPresets = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixellogic-effects-presets')||'[]') || []; } catch(_) { state.effectsPresets=[]; }
                }
                const nameInput = document.getElementById('effects-preset-name');
                const saveBtn = document.getElementById('effects-preset-save');
                const listEl = document.getElementById('effects-presets-list');
                const activeSelect = document.getElementById('effects-active-preset-select');
                const persist = () => { try { localStorage.setItem('pixellogic-effects-presets', JSON.stringify(state.effectsPresets)); } catch(_) {} };
                const snapshot = () => {
                    // Save only effect-related fields to keep presets portable
                    const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeMap));
                    return { details: s.details, visualStyle: s.visualStyle, gradient: s.gradient, checkerColors: s.checkerColors, checkerPalette: s.checkerPalette, numbering: s.numbering, border: s.border };
                };
                if (saveBtn) {
                    saveBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
                        const nm = (nameInput?.value||'').trim() || `Preset ${((state.effectsPresets||[]).length+1)}`;
                        const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
                        state.effectsPresets.push({ id, name: nm, data: snapshot() });
                        persist();
                        renderEffectsDetails();
                        showNotification('Preset saved.');
                    });
                }
                if (activeSelect) {
                    activeSelect.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        state.ui = state.ui || {};
                        state.ui.activeEffectsPresetId = val || '';
                        // Persist selection globally (non-destructive)
                        try { localStorage.setItem('pixellogic-active-effects-preset', state.ui.activeEffectsPresetId); } catch(_) {}
                        // Redraw preview & thumbs only; do not modify map data
                        try {
                            const canvas = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                            if (canvas) drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, activeMap);
                            (project.pixelMaps||[]).forEach(pm => { const c=document.getElementById(`effects-thumb-canvas-${pm.id}`); if(c) drawVisualizerCanvas(c, pm); });
                        } catch(_) {}
                    });
                }
                if (listEl) {
                    listEl.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
                        const applyId = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-apply-preset');
                        const applyTargetId = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-apply-preset-target');
                        const applyAllId = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-apply-preset-all');
                        const delId = e.target?.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-delete-preset');
                        const applyToMap = (presetObj, mapObj) => {
                            if (!presetObj || !mapObj) return;
                            const d = presetObj.data || {};
                            ['visualStyle','gradient','checkerColors','checkerPalette','numbering','border','details'].forEach(k=>{
                                if (typeof d[k] !== 'undefined') mapObj[k] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d[k]));
                            });
                        };
                        if (applyId) {
                            const p = (state.effectsPresets||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(applyId));
                            if (p) {
                                applyToMap(p, activeMap);
                                saveState(); renderEffectsDetails(); showNotification(`Applied preset "${p.name}" to active map.`);
                            }
                        } else if (applyTargetId) {
                            const p = (state.effectsPresets||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(applyTargetId));
                            if (p) {
                                const selectEl = listEl.querySelector(`select[data-preset-target-select='${p.id}']`);
                                const targetMapId = selectEl ? selectEl.value : null;
                                const project = state.projects.find(pr=>pr.id===state.activeProjectId);
                                const targetMap = project?.pixelMaps?.find(m=>String(m.id)===String(targetMapId));
                                if (targetMap) {
                                    applyToMap(p, targetMap);
                                    saveState(); renderEffectsDetails(); showNotification(`Applied preset "${p.name}" to ${targetMap.name}.`);
                                } else showNotification('Target map not found.');
                            }
                        } else if (applyAllId) {
                            const p = (state.effectsPresets||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(applyAllId));
                            if (p) {
                                const project = state.projects.find(pr=>pr.id===state.activeProjectId);
                                (project?.pixelMaps||[]).forEach(m=> applyToMap(p, m));
                                saveState(); renderEffectsDetails(); showNotification(`Applied preset "${p.name}" to all pixel maps.`);
                            }
                        } else if (delId) {
                            const before = (state.effectsPresets||[]).length;
                            state.effectsPresets = (state.effectsPresets||[]).filter(x=>String(x.id)!==String(delId));
                            if ((state.effectsPresets||[]).length !== before) { persist(); renderEffectsDetails(); showNotification('Preset deleted.'); }
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch(_) {}
            // Initialize and apply zoom state + initial draw of the live preview
            try {
                // Ensure UI state bucket
                if (!state.ui) state.ui = {};

                const applyZoom = (scale, center = true) => {
                    const wrapper = document.getElementById('effects-preview-wrapper');
                    const label = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-label');
                    const s = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(8, scale));
                    state.ui.effectsPreviewScale = s;
                    const canvasEl = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                    if (canvasEl) {
                        const baseW = canvasEl.width || 1;
                        const baseH = canvasEl.height || 1;
                        canvasEl.style.width = `${Math.round(baseW * s)}px`;
                        canvasEl.style.height = `${Math.round(baseH * s)}px`;
                    }
                    if (label) label.textContent = `${Math.round(s * 100)}%`;
                    saveState();
                };

                const hookZoomControls = () => {
                    const btnIn = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-in');
                    const btnOut = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-out');
                    const btnActual = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-actual');
                    const btnFit = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-fit');
                    const btn100 = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-100');
                    const btnSend = document.getElementById('effects-send-to-canvas-btn');
                    const viewport = document.getElementById('effects-preview-viewport');
                    // Recalculate fit on window resize so the top preview uses full space
                    if (viewport) {
                        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                            try {
                                const canvasEl = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                                if (!canvasEl) return;
                                const vw = viewport.clientWidth;
                                const vh = viewport.clientHeight;
                                const cw = canvasEl.clientWidth || canvasEl.width || 1;
                                const ch = canvasEl.clientHeight || canvasEl.height || 1;
                                const fitScale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(8, Math.min(vw / cw, vh / ch)));
                                if (!Number.isFinite(state.ui.effectsPreviewScale) || state.ui.effectsPreviewScale > fitScale * 1.1) {
                                    applyZoom(fitScale);
                                }
                            } catch(_) {}
                        });
                    }
                    if (btnIn) btnIn.addEventListener('click', () => applyZoom((state.ui.effectsPreviewScale || 1) * 1.25));
                    if (btnOut) btnOut.addEventListener('click', () => applyZoom((state.ui.effectsPreviewScale || 1) / 1.25));
                    if (btnActual) btnActual.addEventListener('click', () => applyZoom(1));
                    if (btnFit) btnFit.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const viewport = document.getElementById('effects-preview-viewport');
                        const canvasEl = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                        if (!viewport || !canvasEl) return;
                        const vw = viewport.clientWidth;
                        const vh = viewport.clientHeight;
                        const cw = canvasEl.clientWidth || canvasEl.width || 1;
                        const ch = canvasEl.clientHeight || canvasEl.height || 1;
                        const fitScale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(8, Math.min(vw / cw, vh / ch)));
                        applyZoom(fitScale);
                    });
                    if (btn100) btn100.addEventListener('click', () => applyZoom(1));
                    if (btnSend) btnSend.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        try { sendVisualizerToCanvas(); } catch (e) { console.warn('send to canvas from effects failed', e); }
                    });
                };

                // Draw preview first time
                const canvas = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                if (canvas) {
                    drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, activeMap);
                    // Ensure CSS size reflects the underlying pixel buffer for accurate 1:1
                    if (canvas.width && canvas.height) {
                        canvas.style.width = `${canvas.width}px`;
                        canvas.style.height = `${canvas.height}px`;
                    }
                    // Clicking on preview toggles tiles like Visualizer
                    try { canvas.addEventListener('click', onVisualizerCanvasClick); } catch(_) {}
                }
                // Hook preview quality slider
                try {
                    const slider = document.getElementById('effects-preview-quality');
                    const label = document.getElementById('effects-preview-quality-label');
                    if (slider) {
                        const init = Math.round((state.visualizerState?.previewScale || 1) * 100);
                        slider.value = String(init);
                        if (label) label.textContent = `${init}%`;
                        slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
                            const pct = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, parseInt(slider.value, 10) || 100));
                            state.visualizerState.previewScale = pct / 100;
                            try { localStorage.setItem('pixellogic-preview-scale', String(state.visualizerState.previewScale)); } catch(_) {}
                            if (label) label.textContent = `${pct}%`;
                            // Redraw preview and thumbnails at new scale
                            try { if (canvas) drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, activeMap); } catch(_) {}
                            try { (project.pixelMaps||[]).forEach(pm => { const c=document.getElementById(`effects-thumb-canvas-${pm.id}`); if(c) drawVisualizerCanvas(c, pm); }); } catch(_) {}
                        });
                    }
                } catch(_) {}
                // Apply initial zoom: default to Fit if no persisted value
                let initialScale = state.ui.effectsPreviewScale;
                if (!(typeof initialScale === 'number' && isFinite(initialScale))) {
                    const viewport = document.getElementById('effects-preview-viewport');
                    const canvasEl = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                    if (viewport && canvasEl) {
                        const vw = viewport.clientWidth;
                        const vh = viewport.clientHeight;
                        const cw = canvasEl.clientWidth || canvasEl.width || 1;
                        const ch = canvasEl.clientHeight || canvasEl.height || 1;
                        initialScale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(8, Math.min(vw / cw, vh / ch)));
                    } else {
                        initialScale = 1;
                    }
                }
                applyZoom(initialScale);
                hookZoomControls();

                // Scrolling is handled by the viewport's overflow; no hand-tool panning here by design

                // Removed Logo/Markers tab system; markers now integrated under Coordinates Overlay.
            } catch(e) { console.warn('effects preview init failed', e); }

            // Thumbnails: draw and wire up click to activate
            try {
                if (project && Array.isArray(project.pixelMaps)) {
                    project.pixelMaps.forEach(pm => {
                        const c = document.getElementById(`effects-thumb-canvas-${pm.id}`);
                        if (c) {
                            try { drawVisualizerCanvas(c, pm); } catch (_) {}
                        }
                    });
                    const strip = document.getElementById('effects-thumbs');
                    if (strip) {
                        strip.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                            const el = ev.target.closest('[data-thumb-id]');
                            if (!el) return;
                            const id = el.getAttribute('data-thumb-id');
                            const match = project.pixelMaps.find(pm => String(pm.id) === String(id));
                            if (!match) return;
                            project.activePixelMapId = match.id;
                            saveState();
                            renderEffectsDetails();
                        }, { once: false });
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('effects thumbs render error', e); }
        };


        const renderCanvas = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) {
                mainContent.canvas.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-gray-500">Please select or create a project.</div>`;

            }

            }

            }

                    ${canvas.name}
                </button>
            `).join('');

            mainContent.canvas.innerHTML = `

                            <input id="canvas-name-input" type="text" value="${activeCanvas.name}" class="w-56 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-accent focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent/40" title="Rename the active Output Canvas (updates the tab name)" />

                            <button id="canvas-fit-btn" class="btn-glow p-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-700" title="Fit to screen"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 8V4h4M20 8V4h-4M4 16v4h4M20 16v4h-4"></path></svg></button>

                                const top = (sel?.cropTop ?? 0);

                                const lPanels = Math.floor(left / pW);
                                const rPanels = Math.floor(right / pW);
                                const tPanels = Math.floor(top / pH);
                                const bPanels = Math.floor(bottom / pH);
                                return `<div class=\"flex items-center gap-2\" title=\"Enter px or expressions like 64*3, 1920/4\">

                                    <label class=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">Right</label>
                                    <input type=\"text\" id=\"crop-right-input\" class=\"w-20 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm\" ${sel?`value=\"${right}\"`:'value=\"0\" disabled'}>
                                    <label class=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">Top</label>

                                    <input type=\"text\" id=\"crop-bottom-input\" class=\"w-20 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm\" ${sel?`value=\"${bottom}\"`:'value=\"0\" disabled'}>

                                    <label class=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">Right</label>

                                    <label class=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">Top</label>
                                    <input type=\"text\" id=\"crop-panels-top-input\" class=\"w-16 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm\" ${sel?`value=\"${tPanels}\"`:'value=\"0\" disabled'}>
                                    <label class=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">Bottom</label>
                                    <input type=\"text\" id=\"crop-panels-bottom-input\" class=\"w-16 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm\" ${sel?`value=\"${bPanels}\"`:'value=\"0\" disabled'}>
                                </div>`;
                            })()}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Manual Drawing Tools -->

                                    <input id="draw-snap-enabled" type="checkbox" class="form-checkbox bg-gray-700" ${state.canvasState.drawing?.snapEnabled ? 'checked' : ''} />
                                    Snap while drawing
                                </label>

                    </div>
                    <div id="main-canvas-wrapper" class="w-full h-[49vh] bg-gray-900 rounded-lg overflow-hidden relative">

                            <canvas id="main-canvas"></canvas>
                            <canvas id="draw-overlay" class="absolute top-0 left-0"></canvas>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            // Hook preview quality slider for Output Canvas
            try {
                const slider = document.getElementById('canvas-preview-quality');
                const label = document.getElementById('canvas-preview-quality-label');
                if (slider) {
                    const init = Math.round((state.visualizerState?.previewScale || 1) * 100);
                    slider.value = String(init);
                    if (label) label.textContent = `${init}%`;

                        state.visualizerState = state.visualizerState || {};

            } catch(_) {}
            // Canvas name input -> updates active canvas and tab label
            const canvasNameInput = document.getElementById('canvas-name-input');
            if (canvasNameInput) {
                const commitCanvasRename = () => {
                    const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    if (!project || !ac) return;

                canvasNameInput.addEventListener('blur', commitCanvasRename);

            // Selected map name input: initialize and bind save on Enter/blur
            const mapNameInput = document.getElementById('selected-map-name-input');
            if (mapNameInput) {
                const ac0 = getActiveCanvas();
                const sel0 = ac0?.maps?.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                if (sel0) {
                    mapNameInput.disabled = false;
                    mapNameInput.value = sel0.name || '';
                } else {
                    mapNameInput.disabled = true;

            const cropLeftEl = document.getElementById('crop-left-input');
            const cropRightEl = document.getElementById('crop-right-input');
            const cropTopEl = document.getElementById('crop-top-input');
            const cropBottomEl = document.getElementById('crop-bottom-input');
            const cropPanelsLeftEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-left-input');
            const cropPanelsRightEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-right-input');
            const cropPanelsTopEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-top-input');
            const cropPanelsBottomEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-bottom-input');
            const evalExpr = (txt) => {
                if (typeof txt !== 'string') return NaN;
                // Normalize common symbols: x, × for multiply; ÷ for divide
                let s = txt.trim()
                    .replace(/[x×]/gi, '*')
                    .replace(/÷/g, '/');
                if (s === '') return NaN;
                // Allow only digits, operators, decimal point, spaces and parentheses
                if (!/^[0-9+\-*/().\s]+$/.test(s)) return NaN;
                try { return Math.floor(Function(`"use strict";return (${s})`)()); } catch(_) { return NaN; }
            };
            const handleCropChange = (commit = false) => {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas(); if(!ac) return;
                const sel = ac.maps?.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                if (!sel) return;
                // Determine source pixel size to clamp accurately
                let sourceW = sel.width || 0;
                let sourceH = sel.height || 0;
                try {
                    const temp = document.createElement('canvas');
                    drawVisualizerCanvas(temp, sel);
                    if (temp && temp.width) sourceW = temp.width;
                    if (temp && temp.height) sourceH = temp.height;
                } catch(_){}
                const maxW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(sourceW));
                const maxH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(sourceH));
                const leftEval = evalExpr(cropLeftEl?.value ?? '');
                const rightEval = evalExpr(cropRightEl?.value ?? '');
                const topEval = evalExpr(cropTopEl?.value ?? '');
                const bottomEval = evalExpr(cropBottomEl?.value ?? '');
                // If editing (input) and expression is incomplete/invalid, don't coerce to 0 or overwrite UI/state
                if (!commit && (![leftEval, rightEval, topEval, bottomEval].every(v => isFinite(v)))) {
                    return;
                }
                // On commit, if invalid, also keep previous values (no update)
                if (commit && (![leftEval, rightEval, topEval, bottomEval].every(v => isFinite(v)))) {
                    return;
                }
                let left = leftEval; if (!isFinite(left)) left = 0;
                let right = rightEval; if (!isFinite(right)) right = 0;
                let top = topEval; if (!isFinite(top)) top = 0;
                let bottom = bottomEval; if (!isFinite(bottom)) bottom = 0;
                left = Math.max(0, left); right = Math.max(0, right); top = Math.max(0, top); bottom = Math.max(0, bottom);
                // Do not clamp inputs; allow large values (10+ digits). Rendering/export will clamp to source size safely.
                sel.cropLeft = left; sel.cropRight = right; sel.cropTop = top; sel.cropBottom = bottom;
                // Back-compat fields
                sel.sliceLeft = left; sel.sliceRight = right;
                if (cropLeftEl) cropLeftEl.value = left;
                if (cropRightEl) cropRightEl.value = right;
                if (cropTopEl) cropTopEl.value = top;
                if (cropBottomEl) cropBottomEl.value = bottom;
                // Keep panels fields in sync based on panel resolution
                const pW = Math.max(1, sel.panelResWidth || 128);
                const pH = Math.max(1, sel.panelResHeight || 128);
                if (cropPanelsLeftEl) cropPanelsLeftEl.value = Math.floor(left / pW);
                if (cropPanelsRightEl) cropPanelsRightEl.value = Math.floor(right / pW);
                if (cropPanelsTopEl) cropPanelsTopEl.value = Math.floor(top / pH);
                if (cropPanelsBottomEl) cropPanelsBottomEl.value = Math.floor(bottom / pH);
                drawMainCanvas();
            };
            const handlePanelCropChange = (commit = false) => {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas(); if(!ac) return;
                const sel = ac.maps?.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                if (!sel) return;
                const pW = Math.max(1, sel.panelResWidth || 128);
                const pH = Math.max(1, sel.panelResHeight || 128);
                const lEval = evalExpr(cropPanelsLeftEl?.value ?? '');
                const rEval = evalExpr(cropPanelsRightEl?.value ?? '');
                const tEval = evalExpr(cropPanelsTopEl?.value ?? '');
                const bEval = evalExpr(cropPanelsBottomEl?.value ?? '');
                if (!commit && (![lEval, rEval, tEval, bEval].every(v => isFinite(v)))) return;
                if (commit && (![lEval, rEval, tEval, bEval].every(v => isFinite(v)))) return;
                let l = Math.max(0, isFinite(lEval) ? lEval : 0);
                let r = Math.max(0, isFinite(rEval) ? rEval : 0);
                let t = Math.max(0, isFinite(tEval) ? tEval : 0);
                let b = Math.max(0, isFinite(bEval) ? bEval : 0);
                const pxLeft = Math.floor(l * pW);
                const pxRight = Math.floor(r * pW);
                const pxTop = Math.floor(t * pH);
                const pxBottom = Math.floor(b * pH);
                sel.cropLeft = pxLeft; sel.cropRight = pxRight; sel.cropTop = pxTop; sel.cropBottom = pxBottom;
                sel.sliceLeft = pxLeft; sel.sliceRight = pxRight;
                if (cropLeftEl) cropLeftEl.value = pxLeft;
                if (cropRightEl) cropRightEl.value = pxRight;
                if (cropTopEl) cropTopEl.value = pxTop;
                if (cropBottomEl) cropBottomEl.value = pxBottom;
                if (cropPanelsLeftEl) cropPanelsLeftEl.value = l;
                if (cropPanelsRightEl) cropPanelsRightEl.value = r;
                if (cropPanelsTopEl) cropPanelsTopEl.value = t;
                if (cropPanelsBottomEl) cropPanelsBottomEl.value = b;
                drawMainCanvas();
            };
            [cropLeftEl, cropRightEl, cropTopEl, cropBottomEl].forEach(el => {
                if (!el) return;
                el.addEventListener('input', () => handleCropChange(false));
                el.addEventListener('blur', () => handleCropChange(true));
                el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleCropChange(true); });
            });
            [cropPanelsLeftEl, cropPanelsRightEl, cropPanelsTopEl, cropPanelsBottomEl].forEach(el => {
                if (!el) return;
                el.addEventListener('input', () => handlePanelCropChange(false));
                el.addEventListener('blur', () => handlePanelCropChange(true));
                el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handlePanelCropChange(true); });
            });
             document.getElementById('canvas-grid-toggle').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                state.canvasState.grid = e.target.checked;
