            // Manual drawing tools wiring
            try {
                const drawCfg = state.canvasState.drawing || {};
                // Coordinate font controls
                const coordFontEl = document.getElementById('coord-font-size');
                const coordFontVal = document.getElementById('coord-font-size-val');
                if (coordFontEl) {
                    coordFontEl.value = state.canvasState.coordFontSize || 12;
                    coordFontEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                        const v = Math.max(8, Math.min(36, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 12));
                        state.canvasState.coordFontSize = v;
                        if (coordFontVal) coordFontVal.textContent = `${v}px`;
                        drawMainCanvas();
                    });
                }
                const btnToggle = document.getElementById('draw-mode-toggle');
                const colorEl = document.getElementById('draw-color');
                const multiColorEl = document.getElementById('draw-multicolor');
                const widthEl = document.getElementById('draw-width');
                const aStartEl = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-start');
                const aEndEl = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-end');
                const showLinesEl = document.getElementById('draw-show-lines');
                const snapWhileDrawingEl = document.getElementById('draw-snap-enabled');
                const snapDistEl = document.getElementById('draw-snap-threshold');
                const snapDistVal = document.getElementById('draw-snap-threshold-val');
                const undoBtn = document.getElementById('draw-undo');
                const redoBtn = document.getElementById('draw-redo');
                const clearBtn = document.getElementById('draw-clear');
                const selectToggleBtn = document.getElementById('select-mode-toggle');
                const deleteSelBtn = document.getElementById('draw-delete-selected');
                const updateUndoRedoButtons = () => {
                    try {
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        if (undoBtn) undoBtn.disabled = !(ac && Array.isArray(ac.drawings) && ac.drawings.length > 0);
                        if (redoBtn) redoBtn.disabled = !(ac && Array.isArray(ac.drawingsRedo) && ac.drawingsRedo.length > 0);
                    } catch(_) {}
                };
                const syncToggle = () => {
                    if (!btnToggle) return;
                    btnToggle.textContent = drawCfg.enabled ? 'On' : 'Off';
                    btnToggle.classList.toggle('bg-yellow-600', drawCfg.enabled);
                    btnToggle.classList.toggle('hover:bg-yellow-700', drawCfg.enabled);
                    btnToggle.classList.toggle('bg-gray-700', !drawCfg.enabled);
                    btnToggle.classList.toggle('hover:bg-gray-600', !drawCfg.enabled);
                };
                const syncSelectToggle = () => {
                    if (!selectToggleBtn) return;
                    const on = !!(state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled);
                    selectToggleBtn.textContent = on ? 'On' : 'Off';
                    selectToggleBtn.classList.toggle('bg-yellow-600', on);
                    selectToggleBtn.classList.toggle('hover:bg-yellow-700', on);
                    selectToggleBtn.classList.toggle('bg-gray-700', !on);
                    selectToggleBtn.classList.toggle('hover:bg-gray-600', !on);
                };
                if (btnToggle) btnToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    const hasMaps = !!(ac && Array.isArray(ac.maps) && ac.maps.length > 0);
                    if (!hasMaps) {
                        // Block enabling draw mode until there's a map
                        showNotification('Add a map to the Output Canvas to enable Draw Mode.');
                        return;
                    }
                    drawCfg.enabled = !drawCfg.enabled;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.enabled = drawCfg.enabled;
                    if (drawCfg.enabled) {
                        // Turning on draw mode turns off select mode
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled = false;
                        syncSelectToggle();
                    }
                    syncToggle();
                });
                if (selectToggleBtn) selectToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    const hasMaps = !!(ac && Array.isArray(ac.maps) && ac.maps.length > 0);
                    if (!hasMaps) return;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled = !state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled;
                    if (state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled) {
                        // Turning on select turns off draw mode
                        drawCfg.enabled = false;
                        state.canvasState.drawing.enabled = false;
                        syncToggle();
                    }
                    syncSelectToggle();
                    // Clear preview when toggling select
                    state.canvasState.drawing.preview = null;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath = null;
                    // reset marquee when toggling
                    state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting = false;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect = null;
                    renderDrawOverlay();
                });
                if (deleteSelBtn) deleteSelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                    const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices.slice() : [];
                    if (!ac || !Array.isArray(ac.drawings)) return;
                    if (Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0) {
                        // Delete multiple: sort descending to keep indices stable
                        selMany.sort((a,b) => b - a).forEach(i => {
                            if (i >= 0 && i < ac.drawings.length) ac.drawings.splice(i, 1);
                        });
                    } else if (typeof selIdx === 'number' && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length) {
                        ac.drawings.splice(selIdx, 1);
                    } else {
                        return;
                    }
                    state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndex = null;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices = [];
                    syncSelectionUIFromStroke();
                    renderDrawOverlay();
                    updateUndoRedoButtons();
                });
                if (colorEl) { colorEl.value = drawCfg.color || '#ff0000'; colorEl.addEventListener('input', e => {
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                        const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                        if (ac && typeof selIdx === 'number' && ac.drawings && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length) {
                            ac.drawings[selIdx].color = e.target.value;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else if (ac && Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0) {
                            selMany.forEach(i => { if (i >= 0 && i < ac.drawings.length) ac.drawings[i].color = e.target.value; });
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else {
                            state.canvasState.drawing.color = e.target.value;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        }
                    }); }
                if (widthEl) { widthEl.value = drawCfg.width || 5; widthEl.addEventListener('input', e => {
                        const v = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1));
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                        const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                        if (ac && Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0) {
                            selMany.forEach(i => { if (i >= 0 && i < ac.drawings.length) ac.drawings[i].width = v; });
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else if (ac && typeof selIdx === 'number' && ac.drawings && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length) {
                            ac.drawings[selIdx].width = v;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else {
                            state.canvasState.drawing.width = v;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        }
                    }); }
                // Line style
                const styleEl = document.getElementById('draw-style');
                if (styleEl) {
                    styleEl.value = drawCfg.lineStyle || 'solid';
                    styleEl.addEventListener('change', e => {
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                        const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                        if (ac && Array.isArray(ac.drawings)) {
                            // Build list of indices to update: multi-select if any, else single selection
                            const indices = (selMany && selMany.length > 0)
                                ? selMany.slice()
                                : (typeof selIdx === 'number' ? [selIdx] : []);
                            if (indices.length > 0) {
                                let anyChanged = false;
                                indices.forEach(i => {
                                    const s = ac.drawings[i];
                                    if (!s) return;
                                    if (val === 'pencil') {
                                        // Only apply to true pencil strokes
                                        if (Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 1) {
                                            s.lineStyle = 'pencil';
                                            anyChanged = true;
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        // Only apply to straight lines; pencil strokes stay as pencil rendering
                                        if (!(Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 1)) {
                                            s.lineStyle = val;
                                            anyChanged = true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                });
                                if (!anyChanged) {
                                    // If nothing updated (e.g., selected only pencil strokes and chose dashed), keep control value but no change
                                    // No-op render still safe
                                }
                                renderDrawOverlay();
                            } else {
                                // No selection: update default draw style only
                                state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle = val;
                            }
                        } else {
                            state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle = val;
                        }
                    });
                }
                // Multicolor toggle
                if (multiColorEl) {
                    multiColorEl.checked = !!drawCfg.multiColor;
                    multiColorEl.addEventListener('change', e => {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.multiColor = !!e.target.checked;
                        renderDrawOverlay();
                    });
                }
                // Show/hide lines toggle
                if (showLinesEl) {
                    showLinesEl.checked = drawCfg.showLines !== false;
                    showLinesEl.addEventListener('change', e => {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.showLines = !!e.target.checked;
                        renderDrawOverlay();
                    });
                }
                // Snap while drawing toggle
                if (snapWhileDrawingEl) {
                    snapWhileDrawingEl.checked = !!drawCfg.snapEnabled;
                    snapWhileDrawingEl.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.snapEnabled = !!e.target.checked;
                    });
                }
                // Snap distance slider (in screen pixels)
                if (snapDistEl) {
                    const initial = state.canvasState.drawSnapThreshold || 50;
                    snapDistEl.value = initial;
                    if (snapDistVal) snapDistVal.textContent = `${initial}px`;
                    snapDistEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                        const v = Math.max(1, Math.min(400, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 50));
                        state.canvasState.drawSnapThreshold = v;
                        if (snapDistVal) snapDistVal.textContent = `${v}px`;
                        // Update preview snapping immediately
                        renderDrawOverlay();
                    });
                }
                // Zigzag controls removed for pencil mode
                if (aStartEl) {
                    aStartEl.checked = !!drawCfg.arrowStart;
                    aStartEl.addEventListener('change', e => {
                        const checked = !!e.target.checked;
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                        const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices)
                            ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices.slice()
                            : [];
                        if (ac && Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0 && Array.isArray(ac.drawings)) {
                            selMany.forEach(i => { if (i >= 0 && i < ac.drawings.length) ac.drawings[i].arrowStart = checked; });
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else if (ac && typeof selIdx === 'number' && ac.drawings && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length) {
                            ac.drawings[selIdx].arrowStart = checked;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else {
                            state.canvasState.drawing.arrowStart = checked;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        }
                    });
                }
                if (aEndEl) {
                    aEndEl.checked = !!drawCfg.arrowEnd;
                    aEndEl.addEventListener('change', e => {
                        const checked = !!e.target.checked;
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                        const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices)
                            ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices.slice()
                            : [];
                        if (ac && Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0 && Array.isArray(ac.drawings)) {
                            selMany.forEach(i => { if (i >= 0 && i < ac.drawings.length) ac.drawings[i].arrowEnd = checked; });
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else if (ac && typeof selIdx === 'number' && ac.drawings && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length) {
                            ac.drawings[selIdx].arrowEnd = checked;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else {
                            state.canvasState.drawing.arrowEnd = checked;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        }
                    });
                }
                // Arrow size
                const arrowSizeEl = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-size');
                const arrowSizeVal = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-size-val');
                if (arrowSizeEl) {
                    arrowSizeEl.value = drawCfg.arrowSize || 1.2;
                    arrowSizeEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                        const v = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(3, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 1));
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                        const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                        if (ac && Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0) {
                            selMany.forEach(i => { if (i >= 0 && i < ac.drawings.length) ac.drawings[i].arrowSize = v; });
                            if (arrowSizeVal) arrowSizeVal.textContent = `x${v}`;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else if (ac && typeof selIdx === 'number' && ac.drawings && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length) {
                            ac.drawings[selIdx].arrowSize = v;
                            if (arrowSizeVal) arrowSizeVal.textContent = `x${v}`;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        } else {
                            state.canvasState.drawing.arrowSize = v;
                            if (arrowSizeVal) arrowSizeVal.textContent = `x${v}`;
                            renderDrawOverlay();
                        }
                    });
                }
                if (undoBtn) undoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    if (!ac || !Array.isArray(ac.drawings) || ac.drawings.length === 0) return;
                    const popped = ac.drawings.pop();
                    ac.drawingsRedo = ac.drawingsRedo || [];
                    ac.drawingsRedo.push(popped);
                    renderDrawOverlay();
                    updateUndoRedoButtons();
                });
                if (redoBtn) redoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    if (!ac || !Array.isArray(ac.drawingsRedo) || ac.drawingsRedo.length === 0) return;
                    const stroke = ac.drawingsRedo.pop();
                    ac.drawings = ac.drawings || [];
                    ac.drawings.push(stroke);
                    renderDrawOverlay();
                    updateUndoRedoButtons();
                });
                if (clearBtn) clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { const ac = getActiveCanvas(); if (!ac) return; ac.drawings = []; ac.drawingsRedo = []; renderDrawOverlay(); updateUndoRedoButtons(); });
                // Disable drawing controls when no maps present
                const updateDrawingToolsAvailability = () => {
                    try {
                        const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                        const hasMaps = !!(ac && Array.isArray(ac.maps) && ac.maps.length > 0);
                        const tools = document.getElementById('drawing-tools');
                        if (tools) {
                            tools.classList.toggle('opacity-50', !hasMaps);
                            tools.classList.toggle('pointer-events-none', !hasMaps);
                        }
                        if (btnToggle) btnToggle.disabled = !hasMaps;
                        if (selectToggleBtn) selectToggleBtn.disabled = !hasMaps;
                        if (!hasMaps) {
                            // Ensure draw mode cannot remain on if maps were removed
                            drawCfg.enabled = false;
                            if (state.canvasState.drawing) state.canvasState.drawing.enabled = false;
                            syncToggle();
                            if (state.canvasState.drawing) state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled = false;
                            syncSelectToggle();
                            state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndex = null;
                            state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices = [];
                            state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting = false;
                            state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect = null;
                            syncSelectionUIFromStroke();
                        }
                    } catch(_) {}
                };
                syncToggle();
                syncSelectToggle();
                syncSelectionUIFromStroke();
                updateDrawingToolsAvailability();
                updateUndoRedoButtons();
            } catch(_) {}
            
            // Set initial values
            const presetEl = document.getElementById('canvas-preset-select');
            const customW = document.getElementById('canvas-custom-width');
            const customH = document.getElementById('canvas-custom-height');
            const currentRes = `${activeCanvas.width}x${activeCanvas.height}`;
            if ([...presetEl.options].some(o => o.value === currentRes)) {
                presetEl.value = currentRes;
            } else {
                presetEl.value = 'custom';
            }
            customW.value = activeCanvas.width;
            customH.value = activeCanvas.height;
            handleCanvasPresetChange({target: presetEl}); // To show/hide custom inputs

            // Attach canvas interaction listeners
            const canvasWrapper = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            canvasWrapper.addEventListener('mousedown', handleCanvasMouseDown);
            canvasWrapper.addEventListener('mousemove', handleCanvasMouseMove);
            canvasWrapper.addEventListener('mouseup', handleCanvasMouseUp);
            canvasWrapper.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleCanvasMouseUp);
            canvasWrapper.addEventListener('wheel', handleCanvasWheel, { passive: false });


            drawMainCanvas();
            try { updateMapUndoRedoButtons(); } catch(_) {}
        };

        const renderPdfExport = () => {
            const projectOptions = state.projects.map(p => `<option value="${p.id}" ${state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId == p.id ? 'selected' : ''}>${p.name}</option>`).join('');
            
            let mapNameInputs = '';
            const selectedProjectForPdf = state.projects.find(p => p.id == state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId);

            if (typeof state.pdfExport.previewPanelOpen !== 'boolean') state.pdfExport.previewPanelOpen = false;
            state.pdfExport.previewDirty = !!state.pdfExport.previewDirty;

            // PDF optimization persistence removed

                if (!ds.mediaServer) {
                    Object.assign(ds, {

                        codecsCustom: '',

                        codecsLink2: '',

                        pixelAspectRatio: 'Square Pixels (1:1)',
                        fps: '25',
                        embeddedAudio: true,
                        embeddedAudioDetails: 'Stereo, Uncompressed, 16 Bit',
                        sampleRate: '48000 Hz',
                        unembeddedAudioFormat: 'Wav',
                        stillFrameFormat: 'PNG',
                        namingStructure: '"Bank Number"_"delivery"_"screen Name"_"resolution"_"version".Mov',
                        example: '001_intro-video_center-screen_1920x1080_v001.Mov',
                        comments: 'Media Servers Rely On File Names To Understand And Manage Updates On The Content. Please Make Sure The File Name Is Consistent And Use The Version Tag At The End Of The File.'
                    });

                                        <input type="text" id="tb-projectName" value="${state.pdfExport.titleBlock.projectName || selectedProjectForPdf?.name || ''}" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">

            // Interactive drag/resize for template areas (stable percent-based deltas)
            const setupTemplateAreaEditor = () => {
                const container = document.getElementById('template-preview-container');
                const imgEl = document.getElementById('template-preview');
                if (!container || !imgEl) return;

                const setAreasDirty = (dirty) => {
                    state.pdfExport._areasDirty = !!dirty;
                    const d = document.getElementById('areas-dirty-status');
                    if (d) d.classList.toggle('hidden', !dirty);
                };

                const getImageRect = () => {
                    const containerW = container.clientWidth;
                    const containerH = container.clientHeight;
                    const nW = imgEl.naturalWidth || containerW;
                    const nH = imgEl.naturalHeight || containerH;
                    const scale = Math.min(containerW / nW, containerH / nH);
                    const dispW = nW * scale;
                    const dispH = nH * scale;
                    const offsetX = (containerW - dispW) / 2;
                    const offsetY = (containerH - dispH) / 2;
                    return { dispW, dispH, offsetX, offsetY };
                };

                const MIN_PCT = 1; // 1% min to avoid disappearing
                const round1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
                const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));

                const areas = [
                    { key: 'templateArea', elId: 'pdf-map-area-outline', storage: 'pdfTemplateArea' },
                    { key: 'titleArea', elId: 'pdf-title-area-preview', storage: 'pdfTitleArea' },
                    { key: 'detailsArea', elId: 'pdf-details-area-preview', storage: 'pdfDetailsArea' },
                    { key: 'titleBlockArea', elId: 'pdf-title-block-area-preview', storage: 'pdfTitleBlockArea' },
                    { key: 'refImageArea', elId: 'pdf-ref-area-preview', storage: 'pdfRefImageArea' },
                ];

                const ensureHandles = (box) => {
                    if (!box || box.querySelector('.ta-handle')) return;
                    const mk = (dir, extra) => {
                        const h = document.createElement('div');
                        h.className = `ta-handle absolute w-2 h-2 bg-white border border-gray-700 rounded-full ${extra}`;
                        h.dataset.dir = dir;
                        h.style.zIndex = '20';
                        h.style.userSelect = 'none';
                        box.appendChild(h);
                    };
                    mk('nw','top-0 left-0 -translate-x-1 -translate-y-1 cursor-nwse-resize');
                    mk('ne','top-0 right-0 translate-x-1 -translate-y-1 cursor-nesw-resize');
                    mk('sw','bottom-0 left-0 -translate-x-1 translate-y-1 cursor-nesw-resize');
                    mk('se','bottom-0 right-0 translate-x-1 translate-y-1 cursor-nwse-resize');
                };

                const attach = ({ key, elId, storage }) => {
                    const box = document.getElementById(elId);
                    if (!box) return;
                    ensureHandles(box);

                    let dragging = false;
                    let resizing = false;
                    let dir = null;
                    let startMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
                    let startPct = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 };
                    let imgRect = null;

                    const toPctDelta = (dx, dy) => ({
                        dxp: (dx / imgRect.dispW) * 100,
                        dyp: (dy / imgRect.dispH) * 100,
                    });

                    const applyState = (nx, ny, nw, nh) => {
                        const area = state.pdfExport[key];
                        area.x = round1(clamp(nx, 0, 100 - nw));
                        area.y = round1(clamp(ny, 0, 100 - nh));
                        area.width = round1(clamp(nw, MIN_PCT, 100 - area.x));
                        area.height = round1(clamp(nh, MIN_PCT, 100 - area.y));
                        updatePdfPreviewOverlay();
                        schedulePdfLivePreview();
                    };

                    const onMove = (e) => {
                        if (!dragging && !resizing) return;
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const dx = e.clientX - startMouse.x;
                        const dy = e.clientY - startMouse.y;
                        const { dxp, dyp } = toPctDelta(dx, dy);
                        if (dragging) {
                            let nx = startPct.x + dxp;
                            let ny = startPct.y + dyp;
                            applyState(nx, ny, startPct.w, startPct.h);
                        } else if (resizing) {
                            let nx = startPct.x;
                            let ny = startPct.y;
                            let nw = startPct.w;
                            let nh = startPct.h;
                            if (dir.includes('e')) nw = startPct.w + dxp;
                            if (dir.includes('s')) nh = startPct.h + dyp;
                            if (dir.includes('w')) { nw = startPct.w - dxp; nx = startPct.x + dxp; }
                            if (dir.includes('n')) { nh = startPct.h - dyp; ny = startPct.y + dyp; }
                            const keepAspect = e.shiftKey && startPct.w > 0 && startPct.h > 0;
                            if (keepAspect) {
                                const aspect = startPct.w / startPct.h;
                                if (dir === 'ne' || dir === 'se') nh = nw / aspect;
                                if (dir === 'nw' || dir === 'sw') nh = nw / aspect;
                            }
                            // Clamp min sizes
                            nw = Math.max(MIN_PCT, nw);
                            nh = Math.max(MIN_PCT, nh);
                            applyState(nx, ny, nw, nh);
                        }
                    };

                    const onUp = () => {
                        dragging = false; resizing = false; dir = null;
                        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                        // mark as unsaved until user clicks Save
                        setAreasDirty(true);
                    };

                    box.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                        if (e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('ta-handle')) return; // handle has its own flow
                        e.preventDefault();
                        imgRect = getImageRect();
                        const a = state.pdfExport[key];
                        startPct = { x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.width, h: a.height };
                        startMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
                        dragging = true; resizing = false; dir = null;
                        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                        document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                    });

                    box.querySelectorAll('.ta-handle').forEach(h => {
                        h.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            e.preventDefault();
                            imgRect = getImageRect();
                            const a = state.pdfExport[key];
                            startPct = { x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.width, h: a.height };
                            startMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
                            dragging = false; resizing = true; dir = h.dataset.dir || 'se';
                            document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                            document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                        });
                    });
                };

                areas.forEach(attach);
            };
            // Initialize interactions after preview is laid out
            setupTemplateAreaEditor();

            // Preset buttons
            const setPreset = (key, val) => { Object.assign(state.pdfExport[key], val); renderPdfExport(); const d = document.getElementById('areas-dirty-status'); if (d) d.classList.remove('hidden'); state.pdfExport._areasDirty = true; };
            const pMap = document.getElementById('preset-map-left'); if (pMap) pMap.addEventListener('click', () => setPreset('templateArea', { x: 6, y: 14, width: 70, height: 58 }));
            const pTitle = document.getElementById('preset-title-top'); if (pTitle) pTitle.addEventListener('click', () => setPreset('titleArea', { x: 20, y: 5, width: 50, height: 8 }));
            const pDet = document.getElementById('preset-details-bottom'); if (pDet) pDet.addEventListener('click', () => setPreset('detailsArea', { x: 4, y: 80, width: 52, height: 16 }));
            const pTB = document.getElementById('preset-title-block-right'); if (pTB) pTB.addEventListener('click', () => setPreset('titleBlockArea', { x: 79, y: 18, width: 18, height: 76 }));
            const pSS = document.getElementById('preset-screenshot-defaults'); if (pSS) pSS.addEventListener('click', () => {
                setPreset('templateArea', { x: 3.8, y: 16, width: 81, height: 58 });
                setPreset('titleArea', { x: 21, y: 3.3, width: 50, height: 8 });
                setPreset('detailsArea', { x: 2, y: 81, width: 38, height: 16 });
                setPreset('titleBlockArea', { x: 87, y: 74, width: 11.2, height: 23 });
                setPreset('refImageArea', { x: 44, y: 81, width: 30, height: 16 });
            });
            // Save/Clear area definitions
            const showSaved = () => {
                const s = document.getElementById('save-areas-status');

            const btnSaveAreas = document.getElementById('save-areas');

                    localStorage.setItem('pdfTitleArea', JSON.stringify(state.pdfExport.titleArea));

                    localStorage.setItem('pdfTitleBlockArea', JSON.stringify(state.pdfExport.titleBlockArea));

                    if (container && imgEl && imgEl.naturalWidth && imgEl.naturalHeight) {

                state.pdfExport._areasDirty = false;

            });

            if (btnClearAreas) btnClearAreas.addEventListener('click', () => {

                        // on save, collect values from form inputs to state
                        const collect = (id, key, isCheckbox=false) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return; state.pdfExport.deliverySpec[key] = isCheckbox ? el.checked : el.value; };
                        collect('delivery-media-server', 'mediaServer');

                        collect('delivery-par', 'pixelAspectRatio');

                        'delivery-codecs-link':'codecsLink','delivery-codecs-link-2':'codecsLink2','delivery-quality':'quality','delivery-par':'pixelAspectRatio','delivery-fps':'fps','delivery-sample-rate':'sampleRate','delivery-unembedded-format':'unembeddedAudioFormat','delivery-still-format':'stillFrameFormat','delivery-naming':'namingStructure'
                    };
                    const key = keyMap[id]; if (key) state.pdfExport.deliverySpec[key] = el.value;
                    refreshDeliverySummary();
                    try { schedulePdfLivePreview(); } catch(_){}
                });

            // bind content validation email
            bindDeliveryInput('delivery-content-validation-email', 'contentValidationEmail');

            const includeValChk = document.getElementById('delivery-include-validation-note');

            // bind show panel background flag
            const showPanelBgChk = document.getElementById('delivery-show-panel-bg');

            // Title Block bindings

            // PDF optimization bindings removed
        };

        // --- LOGIC & EVENT HANDLERS ---
        const activeTabColors = {
            designer: {bg: 'bg-accent', glow: 'active-pixelmaps'},
            visualizer: {bg: 'bg-teal-600', glow: 'active-visualizer'},
            effects: {bg: 'bg-pink-600', glow: 'active-effects'},
            canvas: {bg: 'bg-yellow-600', glow: 'active-canvas'},
            'led-patching': {bg: 'bg-orange-600', glow: 'active-canvas'},
            pdf: {bg: 'bg-red-600', glow: 'active-pdf'},
            shows: {bg: 'bg-indigo-600', glow: 'active-shows'},
            saved: {bg: 'bg-emerald-600', glow: 'active-saved'},
            'circular-led': {bg: 'bg-green-600', glow: 'active-pixelmaps'},
            'projector-test-pattern': {bg: 'bg-amber-600', glow: 'active-pixelmaps'},
            devices: {bg: 'bg-sky-600', glow: 'active-visualizer'},
            help: {bg: 'bg-violet-600', glow: 'active-effects'},

        // Learn more jump targets and highlight system
        const HIGHLIGHT_TARGETS = {
            'designer': {
                'duplicate-map': '#duplicate-pixel-map-btn'
            },
            'effects': {
                'info-toggle': 'input[data-details-field="info.enabled"]',
                'info-font': 'input[data-details-field="info.fontSize"]',
                'coords-toggle': 'input[data-details-field="coords.enabled"]',
                'coords-font': 'input[data-details-field="coords.fontSize"]'
            },
            'canvas': {
                'duplicate-canvas': '#duplicate-canvas-btn'

            'circular-led': {

                'save-png': '#visualizer-save-png-btn'
            }
        };
        let pendingHighlight = null; // { tab, key }

        const applyPendingHighlight = (tabName) => {
            if (!pendingHighlight || pendingHighlight.tab !== tabName) return;
            const key = pendingHighlight.key;
            pendingHighlight = null; // consume
            try {
                const sel = (HIGHLIGHT_TARGETS[tabName] || {})[key];
                if (!sel) return;
                const root = mainContent[tabName];
                const el = root ? root.querySelector(sel) : null;
                if (!el) return;
                el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                try { el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch(_){}
                el.classList.add('auto-highlight');
                setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('auto-highlight'), 2400);
            } catch(_) { /* best effort */ }
        };

        const switchTab = (tabName) => {
            // Devices tab disabled in this version; redirect to Designer
            if (tabName === 'devices') {
                try { showNotification('Devices tab is disabled in this version'); } catch(_) {}
                tabName = 'designer';
            }
            state.activeTab = tabName;
            
            navTabs.forEach(tab => {
                const currentTabName = tab.dataset.tab;
                tab.classList.remove(...Object.values(activeTabColors).map(c => c.bg));
                tab.classList.remove(...Object.values(activeTabColors).map(c => c.glow));
                tab.classList.remove('text-white');
                tab.classList.add('text-gray-300');

                if (currentTabName !== 'designer') {
                    tab.style.backgroundColor = '';
                }

                if (currentTabName === tabName) {
                    const activeColor = activeTabColors[currentTabName];
                    if (currentTabName !== 'designer' && activeColor && activeColor.bg) {
                       tab.classList.add(activeColor.bg);
                    }
                    if (activeColor && activeColor.glow) {
                        tab.classList.add(activeColor.glow);
                    }
                    tab.classList.add('text-white');
                    tab.classList.remove('text-gray-300');
                }
            });

            Object.values(mainContent).forEach(contentEl => contentEl.classList.remove('active'));
            if (mainContent[tabName]) mainContent[tabName].classList.add('active');

                case 'designer': renderPixelMapDesigner(); break;
                case 'visualizer': renderVisualizer(); break;

                case 'pdf': renderPdfExport(); break;
                case 'shows': renderShows(); break;
                case 'saved': renderSaved(); break;
                case 'circular-led': renderCircularLed(); break;
                case 'devices': renderDevicesTab(); break;
                case 'help': renderHelpTab(); break;
                case 'projector-test-pattern':
                    if (typeof renderProjectorTestPattern === 'function') renderProjectorTestPattern();
                    break;
            }

            // Apply any pending highlight after render
            setTimeout(() => applyPendingHighlight(tabName), 0);
        };

                    <section class="space-y-4">

Control font size (info 0–300; badge 0–100), spacing (default 50%), and badge fill color/opacity. Live preview fits to screen by default with Fit/+/−/100% zoom.</p>

                    </section>

                    <section class="space-y-3">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-accent">Typical workflow</h3>

                            <li>Export PNGs or a PDF spec via PDF Export; update version as you iterate.</li>
                        </ol>
                    </section>

                    <section class="space-y-3">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-accent">Tips</h3>
                        <ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-gray-200 space-y-1">
                            <li>Use duplicate buttons to try variations without losing your base layout.</li>
                            <li>Coordinates overlay can help when aligning maps on the Output Canvas.</li>
                            <li>Color bars can be positioned near the info overlay for reference.</li>
                        </ul>
                    </section>
                </div>
            `;
        };

                // Devices Database (v2) — LED Walls & Projectors with PDF import
                const ensureDevicesUiState = () => {
                        if (!state.ui) state.ui = {};
                        if (!state.ui.devices) state.ui.devices = { subTab: 'led', editingId: null, filter: '' };
                        if (!state.devicesV2 || state.devicesV2.version !== 2) state.devicesV2 = { version: 2, ledWalls: [], projectors: [] };
                };

                // Ensure pdf.js is available and the worker is configured
                const ensurePdfJs = async () => {
                    try {
                        const hasLib = !!(window.pdfjsLib && typeof pdfjsLib.getDocument === 'function');
                        const isElectron = !!(window.process && process.versions && process.versions.electron);
                        const setWorker = (src) => { try { if (window.pdfjsLib && pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions) { pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = src; } } catch(_) {} };

                        if (hasLib) {
                            // Prefer local worker path; fall back to CDN for reliability
                            if (isElectron) setWorker('installed-resources/vendor/pdf.worker.min.js');
                            else setWorker('vendor/pdf.worker.min.js');
                            // Always set a CDN fallback to avoid local path issues in packaged builds
                            setTimeout(() => setWorker('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/2.11.338/pdf.worker.min.js'), 0);
                            return true;
                        }

                        // Attempt to dynamically load the library from local paths, then CDN
                        const candidates = [
                            isElectron ? 'installed-resources/vendor/pdf.min.js' : null,
                            'vendor/pdf.min.js',
                            'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/2.11.338/pdf.min.js',
                        ].filter(Boolean);
                        for (const src of candidates) {
                            const ok = await new Promise(resolve => {
                                try {
                                    const s = document.createElement('script');
                                    s.src = src;
                                    s.onload = () => resolve(true);
                                    s.onerror = () => resolve(false);
                                    document.head.appendChild(s);
                                } catch(_) { resolve(false); }
                            });
                            if (ok && window.pdfjsLib && typeof pdfjsLib.getDocument === 'function') {
                                setWorker('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/2.11.338/pdf.worker.min.js');
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                        return false;
                    } catch (_) { return false; }
                };

                // Parse helper utilities
                const _num = (str, def = null) => {
                        if (typeof str === 'number' && isFinite(str)) return str;
                        if (!str) return def;
                        const s = String(str).replace(/[,\s]/g,'').replace(/[^0-9.\-xX]/g,'');
                        const m = s.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
                        return m ? parseFloat(m[1]) : def;
                };
                const parseResolution = (txt) => {
                        if (!txt) return { w: null, h: null };
                        const m = txt.match(/(\d{3,5})\s*[x×]\s*(\d{3,5})/i);
                        if (m) return { w: parseInt(m[1],10), h: parseInt(m[2],10) };
                        return { w: null, h: null };
                };
                const parseThrowRatio = (txt) => {
                        if (!txt) return null;
                        const m = txt.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[:\/\-]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
                        if (m) {
                                const a = parseFloat(m[1]); const b = parseFloat(m[2]);
                                if (isFinite(a) && isFinite(b) && b !== 0) return a / b;
                        }
                        const m2 = txt.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
                        return m2 ? parseFloat(m2[1]) : null;
                };

        // PDF: extract plain text from all pages
        const extractPdfText = async (file) => {
            try {
                const ready = await ensurePdfJs();
                if (!ready) {
                    showNotification('PDF engine not available. Please check network or vendor files.');
                    return '';
                }
                const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
                const pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument({ data: arrayBuffer }).promise;
                let out = '';
                for (let i = 1; i <= pdf.numPages; i++) {
                    const page = await pdf.getPage(i);
                    // normalizeWhitespace helps pdf.js split words correctly
                    const content = await page.getTextContent({ normalizeWhitespace: true, disableCombineTextItems: false });
                    const strings = content.items.map(it => it.str).filter(Boolean);
                    out += strings.join('\n') + '\n';
                }
                return out;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('PDF parse failed', e);
                try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush('PDF parse failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e)); } catch(_) {}
                return '';
            }
        };

                // Heuristic parsers
                const parseLedWallFromText = (text) => {
                    const tRaw = (text || '').replace(/\r/g,' ').replace(/\n/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                    const t = tRaw;
                    // Panel/cabinet resolution in pixels — prefer explicit (module/panel) labels, fallback to any AxB
                    let res = { w: null, h: null };
                    const resLabeled = t.match(/(?:panel|module|cabinet)[^0-9]{0,20}(?:resolution|pixels?|pixel\s*matrix)[^0-9]{0,10}(\d{2,5})\s*[x×]\s*(\d{2,5})/i);
                    if (resLabeled) {
                        res = { w: parseInt(resLabeled[1],10), h: parseInt(resLabeled[2],10) };
                    } else {
                        res = parseResolution(t);
                    }
                    // Pixel pitch (mm)
                    let pitch = (() => {
                        // Common patterns: "Pixel pitch 2.6 mm", "P2.6", "2.6mm"
                        let m = t.match(/(pixel\s*pitch|pitch)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*mm/i);
                        if (m) return parseFloat(m[2]);
                        m = t.match(/\bP\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*mm)?\b/i);
                        if (m) return parseFloat(m[1]);
                        // Fallback: pick the smallest plausible mm value (0.2–20 mm) present in the text
                        const mmMatches = [...t.matchAll(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*mm\b/gi)].map(x => parseFloat(x[1])).filter(v => isFinite(v) && v >= 0.2 && v <= 20);
                        if (mmMatches.length) return Math.min(...mmMatches);
                        return null;
                    })();
                    // Cabinet dimensions — support combined "500x500mm" and separate width/height
                    let cabW = null, cabH = null, cabD = null;
                    const triple = t.match(/(?:cabinet|panel)?[^\d]{0,20}(?:size|dimension)s?[^\d]{0,10}(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[x×]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[x×]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[^\d]{0,10}(?:mm|millimeter)/i);
                    if (triple) { cabW = parseFloat(triple[1]); cabH = parseFloat(triple[2]); cabD = parseFloat(triple[3]); }
                    const comb = t.match(/(cabinet|panel)[^\d]{0,20}(?:size|dimension)s?[^\d]{0,10}(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[x×]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[^\d]{0,10}(?:mm|millimeter)/i);
                    if (comb) { cabW = parseFloat(comb[2]); cabH = parseFloat(comb[3]); }
                    if (cabW == null) { const m = t.match(/(cabinet|panel)[^\d]*(?:size|width)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*mm|\s*cm|\s*in)?/i); if (m) cabW = parseFloat(m[2]); }
                    if (cabH == null) { const m = t.match(/(cabinet|panel)[^\d]*height[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*mm|\s*cm|\s*in)?/i); if (m) cabH = parseFloat(m[2]); }
                    if (cabD == null) {
                        const md = t.match(/(depth|thickness)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*mm|\s*cm|\s*in)?/i);
                        if (md) cabD = parseFloat(md[2]);
                    }
                    // Brightness (nits) — accept nits or cd/m²
                    const bright = (() => {
                        let m = t.match(/(brightness)[^\d]*(\d{3,6})\s*(nits?)/i);
                        if (m) return parseInt(m[2],10);
                        m = t.match(/(brightness|luminance)[^\d]*(\d{3,6})\s*(?:cd\s*\/\s*m(?:2|²))/i);
                        return m ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : null;
                    })();
                    // Refresh rate (Hz)
                    const refresh = (() => { const m = t.match(/(refresh(?:\s*rate)?)[^\d]*(\d{2,5})\s*hz/i); return m ? parseInt(m[2],10) : null; })();
                    // Frame frequency (Hz) — often 50/60 Hz; choose the max
                    const frameHz = (() => {
                        const m = t.match(/(frame\s*frequency)[^\d]*(\d{2,3})(?:\s*\/\s*(\d{2,3}))?\s*hz/i);
                        if (m) { const a = parseInt(m[2],10); const b = m[3] ? parseInt(m[3],10) : null; return b ? Math.max(a,b) : a; }
                        const m2 = t.match(/(frame\s*rate)[^\d]*(\d{2,3})\s*hz/i); if (m2) return parseInt(m2[2],10);
                        const m3 = t.match(/(\d{2,3})\s*(fps|frames\s*per\s*second)/i); if (m3) return parseInt(m3[1],10);
                        return null;
                    })();
                    // Input voltage (text like "AC 100–240V")
                    const inputVoltage = (() => {
                        let m = t.match(/(input\s*voltage)[\s:\-]*([^;\.\n\r]+)/i);
                        if (m) return m[2].trim();
                        // Fallback: capture patterns like "AC 100-240V"
                        m = t.match(/\b(?:AC|DC)?\s*\d{2,4}\s*[\-–~\/]\s*\d{2,4}\s*V\b/i);
                        return m ? m[0].trim() : '';
                    })();
                    // Input power (text)
                    const inputPower = (() => { const m = t.match(/(input\s*power)[\s:\-]*([^;\.\n\r]+)/i); return m ? m[2].trim() : ''; })();
                    // Input power frequency
                    const inputPowerFrequency = (() => {
                        // Prefer explicit power frequency mentions, else pick a small Hz value (45-70 Hz) to avoid refresh matches
                        let m = t.match(/(?:input\s*power\s*frequency|power\s*frequency|mains\s*frequency)[\s:\-]*([\d\s\/\-]+)\s*hz/i);
                        if (m) return (m[1].replace(/\s+/g,'').trim() + ' Hz');
                        const hzs = [...t.matchAll(/\b(\d{2,3})\s*hz\b/gi)].map(x => parseInt(x[1],10)).filter(v => v >= 45 && v <= 70);
                        if (hzs.length) {
                            const uniq = [...new Set(hzs)].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
                            return uniq.join('/') + ' Hz';
                        }
                        return '';
                    })();
                    // Cabinet weight — prefer kg, convert from lbs when needed
                    const weight = (() => {
                        const mk = t.match(/(cabinet\s*weight|module\s*weight|weight)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(kg|kgs?|kilograms?)/i);
                        if (mk) return parseFloat(mk[2]);
                        const ml = t.match(/(cabinet\s*weight|module\s*weight|weight)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(lb|lbs|pounds?)/i);
                        if (ml) return Math.round(parseFloat(ml[2]) * 0.45359237 * 100) / 100; // lbs -> kg
                        return null;
                    })();
                    // Curvature
                    const curveType = (() => {
                        const hasConcave = /concave/i.test(t);
                        const hasConvex = /convex/i.test(t);
                        if (hasConcave && hasConvex) return 'both';
                        if (hasConcave) return 'concave';
                        if (hasConvex) return 'convex';
                        return 'flat';
                    })();
                    // Usage (indoor/outdoor)
                    const usage = (() => {
                        const ind = /indoor/i.test(t);
                        const outd = /outdoor/i.test(t);
                        if (ind && outd) return 'both';
                        if (outd) return 'outdoor';
                        if (ind) return 'indoor';
                        return '';
                    })();
                    // Recommended viewing distance (meters)
                    const viewDistanceM = (() => {
                        const m = t.match(/(recommended|minimum)?\s*viewing\s*distance[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(mm|cm|m|meter|metre|ft|feet|in|inch|inches)/i);
                        if (!m) return null;
                        const val = parseFloat(m[2]); const unit = m[3].toLowerCase();
                        if (unit === 'm' || unit.startsWith('meter') || unit.startsWith('metre')) return val;
                        if (unit === 'cm') return val / 100;
                        if (unit === 'mm') return val / 1000;
                        if (unit === 'ft' || unit === 'feet') return val * 0.3048;
                        if (unit === 'in' || unit.startsWith('inch')) return val * 0.0254;
                        return val;
                    })();
                    // Aspect ratio: parse explicit or compute from resolution
                    const aspectRatio = (() => {
                        const m = t.match(/aspect\s*ratio\s*[:\-]?\s*(\d+)\s*[:x]\s*(\d+)/i);
                        if (m) return `${m[1]}:${m[2]}`;
                        if (res.w && res.h) {
                            const gcd = (a,b)=>b?gcd(b,a%b):a; const g = gcd(res.w, res.h);
                            return `${Math.round(res.w/g)}:${Math.round(res.h/g)}`;
                        }
                        return '';
                    })();
                    // Avg/Max power consumption — try cabinet-level W; if only W/m², still capture value
                    const avgPowerW = (() => {
                        const m = t.match(/(?:avg|average)[^\n]*?(?:power\s*consumption)?[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*w(?!\/)/i);
                        if (m) return parseFloat(m[1]);
                        const m2 = t.match(/power\s*consumption[^\n]*?(?:avg|average)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*w(?!\/)/i);
                        return m2 ? parseFloat(m2[1]) : null;
                    })();
                    const maxPowerW = (() => {
                        const m = t.match(/(?:max|maximum|peak)[^\n]*?(?:power\s*consumption)?[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*w(?!\/)/i);
                        if (m) return parseFloat(m[1]);
                        const m2 = t.match(/power\s*consumption[^\n]*?(?:max|maximum|peak)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*w(?!\/)/i);
                        return m2 ? parseFloat(m2[1]) : null;
                    })();
                    // Brand/Model
                    const brandModel = (() => {
                        const m = t.match(/(?:brand|manufacturer)\s*[:\-]\s*([\w\- ]{2,64})/i);
                        const n = t.match(/(?:model)\s*[:\-]\s*([\w\- ]{1,64})/i);
                        // Fallback: sometimes the "Model" appears near product name like "Absen PL2.5 Pro"
                        let brand = m ? m[1].trim() : '';
                        let model = n ? n[1].trim() : '';
                        if (!brand || !model) {
                            const header = tRaw.slice(0, 120).trim();
                            const mm = header.match(/([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-. ]{1,40})/);
                            if (mm) {
                                if (!brand) brand = mm[1];
                                if (!model) model = mm[2].trim();
                            }
                        }
                        return { brand, model };
                    })();
                    // If pitch is still missing but we have cabinet size and panel resolution, estimate pitch (mm per pixel)
                    if ((pitch == null || !isFinite(pitch)) && res.w && (cabW || cabH)) {
                        const cand = [];
                        if (cabW && res.w) cand.push(cabW / res.w);
                        if (cabH && res.h) cand.push(cabH / res.h);
                        if (cand.length) pitch = Math.round((cand.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / cand.length) * 100) / 100;
                    }

                    return {
                        name: '',
                        brand: brandModel.brand || '',
                        model: brandModel.model || '',
                        pitchMm: pitch,
                        panelResW: res.w,
                        panelResH: res.h,
                        cabinetWmm: cabW,
                        cabinetHmm: cabH,
                        cabinetDmm: cabD,
                        cabinetWeightKg: weight,
                        curveType: curveType,
                        usage: usage,
                        viewDistanceM: viewDistanceM,
                        aspectRatio: aspectRatio,
                        avgPowerW: avgPowerW,
                        maxPowerW: maxPowerW,
                        inputPower: inputPower,
                        inputVoltage: inputVoltage,
                        inputPowerFrequency: inputPowerFrequency,
                        frameFrequencyHz: frameHz,
                        brightnessNits: bright,
                        refreshHz: refresh,
                    };
                };
                const parseProjectorFromText = (text) => {
                        const t = (text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
                        const res = parseResolution(t);
                        const lum = (() => { const m = t.match(/(brightness|lumens|light output)[^\d]*(\d{3,6})\s*(lm|lumens?)/i); return m ? parseInt(m[2],10) : null; })();
                        const tech = (() => { const m = t.match(/(technology)\s*[:\-]\s*([A-Za-z0-9\- ]{2,40})/i); return m ? m[2].trim() : ''; })();
                        const lens = (() => { const m = t.match(/(lens)\s*[:\-]\s*([A-Za-z0-9\- ]{2,60})/i); return m ? m[2].trim() : ''; })();
                        const throwR = (() => { const m = t.match(/(throw\s*ratio)[^\d]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*[:\/\-]\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/i); return m ? parseThrowRatio(m[2]) : null; })();
                        const brandModel = (() => { const m = t.match(/(?:brand|manufacturer)\s*[:\-]\s*([\w\- ]+)/i); const n = t.match(/(?:model)\s*[:\-]\s*([\w\- ]+)/i); return { brand: m ? m[1].trim() : '', model: n ? n[1].trim() : ''}; })();
                        return {
                                name: '',
                                brand: brandModel.brand || '',
                                model: brandModel.model || '',
                                resolution: res.w && res.h ? `${res.w}x${res.h}` : '',
                                brightnessLumens: lum,
                                technology: tech,
                                lens: lens,
                                throwRatio: throwR,
                        };
                };

                const renderDevicesTab = () => {
                        ensureDevicesUiState();
                        const ui = state.ui.devices;
                        const db = state.devicesV2 || { version: 2, ledWalls: [], projectors: [] };
                        const active = ui.subTab === 'proj' ? 'proj' : 'led';

                        const list = active === 'led' ? (db.ledWalls || []) : (db.projectors || []);
                        const filter = (ui.filter || '').toLowerCase();
                        const filtered = filter ? list.filter(item => JSON.stringify(item).toLowerCase().includes(filter)) : list.slice();

                        const rows = filtered.map(item => `
                                <tr class="border-b border-gray-700">
                                    <td class="px-2 py-1 text-sm">${item.name || ''}</td>
                                    <td class="px-2 py-1 text-sm">${item.brand || ''}</td>
                                    <td class="px-2 py-1 text-sm">${item.model || ''}</td>
                                    <td class="px-2 py-1 text-sm">${active==='led' ? (item.pitchMm!=null? item.pitchMm+' mm':'' ) : (item.resolution || '')}</td>
                                    <td class="px-2 py-1 text-sm text-right">
                                        <button data-id="${item.id}" class="dev-edit px-2 py-1 bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 rounded text-xs">Edit</button>
                                        <button data-id="${item.id}" class="dev-del px-2 py-1 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 rounded text-xs text-white">Delete</button>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                        `).join('') || `<tr><td class="px-2 py-3 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm" colspan="5">No entries yet</td></tr>`;

                        const c = mainContent.devices;
                        if (!c) return;
                        c.innerHTML = `
                                <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
                                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold">Devices Database <span class="text-xs align-middle text-gray-300 bg-gray-700/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">v2</span></h2>
                                        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                            <button id="dev-export" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-sm">Export JSON</button>
                                            <input id="dev-import-file" type="file" accept="application/json,.json" class="hidden" />
                                            <button id="dev-import" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Import JSON</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <button data-sub="led" class="subtab ${active==='led'?'bg-sky-600 text-white':'bg-gray-700 text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-600'} px-3 py-1 rounded">LED Walls</button>
                                        <button data-sub="proj" class="subtab ${active==='proj'?'bg-sky-600 text-white':'bg-gray-700 text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-600'} px-3 py-1 rounded">Projectors</button>
                                        <div class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
                                            <input id="dev-filter" value="${ui.filter || ''}" placeholder="Search..." class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                                        <div class="lg:col-span-2 bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-700 rounded-xl">
                                            <table class="w-full text-left">
                                                <thead><tr class="text-gray-300 text-sm border-b border-gray-700">
                                                    <th class="px-2 py-2">Name</th>
                                                    <th class="px-2 py-2">Brand</th>
                                                    <th class="px-2 py-2">Model</th>
                                                    <th class="px-2 py-2">${active==='led'?'Pixel Pitch / Res':'Resolution / Lumens'}</th>
                                                    <th class="px-2 py-2 text-right">Actions</th>
                                                </tr></thead>
                                                <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                                            </table>
                                        </div>

                                        <div class="bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-3 space-y-3">
                                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-accent text-lg">${ui.editingId ? 'Edit' : 'Add'} ${active==='led'?'LED Wall':'Projector'}</h3>
                                                ${ui.editingId ? '<button id="dev-cancel" class="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600">Cancel</button>' : ''}
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="space-y-2">
                                                <input id="dev-name" placeholder="Name" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                    <input id="dev-brand" placeholder="Brand" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    <input id="dev-model" placeholder="Model" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                </div>
                                                                        ${active==='led' ? `
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-pitch" placeholder="Pixel Pitch (mm)" type="number" step="0.01" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <input id="dev-refresh" placeholder="Refresh (Hz)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-resw" placeholder="Panel Res W" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <input id="dev-resh" placeholder="Panel Res H" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-cabw" placeholder="Cabinet W (mm)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <input id="dev-cabh" placeholder="Cabinet H (mm)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-cabd" placeholder="Cabinet D (mm)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <select id="dev-curve" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm">
                                                            <option value="flat" selected>Flat</option>
                                                            <option value="concave">Curved (Concave)</option>
                                                            <option value="convex">Curved (Convex)</option>
                                                            <option value="both">Curved (Concave & Convex)</option>
                                                        </select>
                                                    </div>
                                                                            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                                                <input id="dev-weight-kg" placeholder="Cabinet Weight (kg)" type="number" step="0.01" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                                                <input id="dev-nits" placeholder="Brightness (nits)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                                            </div>
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-aspect-ratio" placeholder="Aspect Ratio (e.g., 16:9)" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <input id="dev-view-distance" placeholder="Recommended Viewing Distance (m)" type="number" step="0.01" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <select id="dev-usage" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm">
                                                            <option value="">Usage</option>
                                                            <option value="indoor">Indoor</option>
                                                            <option value="outdoor">Outdoor</option>
                                                            <option value="both">Indoor/Outdoor</option>
                                                        </select>
                                                        <input id="dev-power-frequency" placeholder="Input Power Frequency (e.g., 50/60 Hz)" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    </div>
                                                                            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-avg-power" placeholder="AVG Power (W)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <input id="dev-max-power" placeholder="MAX Power (W)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-framefreq" placeholder="Video Frame Rate (Hz)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                                                <input id="dev-input-voltage" placeholder="Input Voltage (e.g., AC 100–240V)" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <input id="dev-input-power" placeholder="Input Power (text)" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                ` : `
                                                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                                        <input id="dev-resolution" placeholder="Resolution (e.g., 1920x1200)" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                        <input id="dev-lumens" placeholder="Brightness (lumens)" type="number" step="1" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <input id="dev-technology" placeholder="Technology (e.g., 3LCD, DLP)" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    <input id="dev-lens" placeholder="Lens" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                    <input id="dev-throw" placeholder="Throw Ratio (e.g., 1.2-2.1:1)" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
                                                `}
                                                <textarea id="dev-notes" placeholder="Notes" rows="3" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"></textarea>
                                                <button id="dev-save" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded ${active==='led'?'bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700':'bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700'} text-white">${ui.editingId ? 'Update' : 'Add'} ${active==='led'?'LED Wall':'Projector'}</button>
                                            </div>

                                            <div class="pt-3 border-t border-gray-700 space-y-2">
                                                <div class="text-sm text-gray-300 font-semibold">Import from PDF</div>
                                                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
                                                    <input id="dev-pdf-file" type="file" accept="application/pdf" class="w-full text-sm" />
                                                    <button id="dev-pdf-parse" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-sm">Parse and Prefill</button>
                                                    <div id="dev-pdf-summary" class="text-xs text-gray-300 bg-gray-900/70 border border-gray-700 rounded p-2 hidden"></div>
                                                    <details class="text-xs text-gray-400">
                                                        <summary class="cursor-pointer">Show last extracted text</summary>
                                                        <pre id="dev-pdf-text" class="whitespace-pre-wrap p-2 bg-gray-950 rounded border border-gray-800 max-h-40 overflow-auto"></pre>
                                                    </details>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                        `;

                        // Wire subtabs
                        c.querySelectorAll('.subtab').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { state.ui.devices.subTab = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-sub'); state.ui.devices.editingId = null; renderDevicesTab(); }));
                        // Filter
                        const filterEl = document.getElementById('dev-filter'); if (filterEl) filterEl.addEventListener('input', (ev) => { state.ui.devices.filter = ev.target.value; renderDevicesTab(); });

                        // Export/Import JSON
                        const expBtn = document.getElementById('dev-export'); if (expBtn) expBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                                downloadJson({ version: 2, ledWalls: db.ledWalls || [], projectors: db.projectors || [] }, `devices_v2_${timestamp()}.json`);
                        });
                        const impBtn = document.getElementById('dev-import'); const impFile = document.getElementById('dev-import-file');
                        if (impBtn && impFile) {
                                impBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=> impFile.click());
                                impFile.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                                        const f = e.target.files && e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
