                                        const reader = new FileReader();
                                        reader.onload = (ev) => {
                                                try {
                                                        const json = JSON.parse(String(ev.target.result||'{}'));
                                                        if (!json || json.version !== 2) { showNotification('Invalid devices JSON (expect version 2)'); return; }
                                                        state.devicesV2 = { version: 2, ledWalls: Array.isArray(json.ledWalls)?json.ledWalls:[], projectors: Array.isArray(json.projectors)?json.projectors:[] };
                                                        persistDevices();
                                                        renderDevicesTab();
                                                        showNotification('Devices imported');
                                                } catch (err) { console.warn('Devices import failed', err); showNotification('Import failed'); }
                                                e.target.value = '';
                                        };
                                        reader.readAsText(f);
                                });
                        }

                        // Edit/Delete
                        c.querySelectorAll('.dev-edit').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                                const id = ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id');
                                state.ui.devices.editingId = id;
                                renderDevicesTab();
                        }));
                        c.querySelectorAll('.dev-del').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                                const id = ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id');
                                if (!id) return;
                                if (!confirm('Delete this entry?')) return;
                                if (active==='led') state.devicesV2.ledWalls = (state.devicesV2.ledWalls||[]).filter(x => String(x.id) !== String(id));
                                else state.devicesV2.projectors = (state.devicesV2.projectors||[]).filter(x => String(x.id) !== String(id));
                                persistDevices();
                                renderDevicesTab();
                        }));

                        // Prefill form if editing
                        const setVal = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = (v ?? '') }; 
                        if (ui.editingId) {
                                const src = (active==='led' ? (db.ledWalls||[]) : (db.projectors||[])).find(x => String(x.id)===String(ui.editingId));
                                if (src) {
                                        setVal('dev-name', src.name);
                                        setVal('dev-brand', src.brand);
                                        setVal('dev-model', src.model);
                                        if (active==='led') {
                                                setVal('dev-pitch', src.pitchMm);
                                                setVal('dev-refresh', src.refreshHz);
                                                setVal('dev-resw', src.panelResW);
                                                setVal('dev-resh', src.panelResH);
                                                setVal('dev-cabw', src.cabinetWmm);
                                                setVal('dev-cabh', src.cabinetHmm);
                        setVal('dev-cabd', src.cabinetDmm);
                        const curveSel = document.getElementById('dev-curve'); if (curveSel) curveSel.value = src.curveType || 'flat';
                                                setVal('dev-nits', src.brightnessNits);
                                    setVal('dev-weight-kg', src.cabinetWeightKg);
                    setVal('dev-aspect-ratio', src.aspectRatio);
                    setVal('dev-view-distance', src.viewDistanceM);
                    const usageSel = document.getElementById('dev-usage'); if (usageSel) usageSel.value = src.usage || '';
                    setVal('dev-power-frequency', src.inputPowerFrequency);
                                    setVal('dev-avg-power', src.avgPowerW);
                                    setVal('dev-max-power', src.maxPowerW);
                                    setVal('dev-input-power', src.inputPower);
                                    setVal('dev-input-voltage', src.inputVoltage);
                                    setVal('dev-framefreq', src.frameFrequencyHz);
                                        } else {
                                                setVal('dev-resolution', src.resolution);
                                                setVal('dev-lumens', src.brightnessLumens);
                                                setVal('dev-technology', src.technology);
                                                setVal('dev-lens', src.lens);
                                                setVal('dev-throw', src.throwRatio);
                                        }
                                        setVal('dev-notes', src.notes);
                                        const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('dev-cancel'); if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { state.ui.devices.editingId = null; renderDevicesTab(); });
                                }
                        }

                        // Save/Add handler
                        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('dev-save');
                        if (saveBtn) saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                                const id = ui.editingId || (Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7));
                                if (active==='led') {
                                        const rec = {
                                                id,
                                                name: (document.getElementById('dev-name')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                brand: (document.getElementById('dev-brand')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                model: (document.getElementById('dev-model')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                pitchMm: _num(document.getElementById('dev-pitch')?.value),
                                                panelResW: _num(document.getElementById('dev-resw')?.value),
                                                panelResH: _num(document.getElementById('dev-resh')?.value),
                                                cabinetWmm: _num(document.getElementById('dev-cabw')?.value),
                                                cabinetHmm: _num(document.getElementById('dev-cabh')?.value),
                        cabinetDmm: _num(document.getElementById('dev-cabd')?.value),
                                                brightnessNits: _num(document.getElementById('dev-nits')?.value),
                                                refreshHz: _num(document.getElementById('dev-refresh')?.value),
                    curveType: (document.getElementById('dev-curve')?.value||'').trim(),
                                        cabinetWeightKg: _num(document.getElementById('dev-weight-kg')?.value),
                    aspectRatio: (document.getElementById('dev-aspect-ratio')?.value||'').trim(),
                    viewDistanceM: _num(document.getElementById('dev-view-distance')?.value),
                    usage: (document.getElementById('dev-usage')?.value||'').trim(),
                    inputPowerFrequency: (document.getElementById('dev-power-frequency')?.value||'').trim(),
                                        avgPowerW: _num(document.getElementById('dev-avg-power')?.value),
                                        maxPowerW: _num(document.getElementById('dev-max-power')?.value),
                                        inputPower: (document.getElementById('dev-input-power')?.value||'').trim(),
                                        inputVoltage: (document.getElementById('dev-input-voltage')?.value||'').trim(),
                                        frameFrequencyHz: _num(document.getElementById('dev-framefreq')?.value),
                                                notes: (document.getElementById('dev-notes')?.value||'').trim(),
                                        };
                                        const arr = state.devicesV2.ledWalls || (state.devicesV2.ledWalls = []);
                                        const idx = arr.findIndex(x => String(x.id)===String(id));
                                        if (idx>=0) arr[idx] = rec; else arr.push(rec);
                                } else {
                                        const rec = {
                                                id,
                                                name: (document.getElementById('dev-name')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                brand: (document.getElementById('dev-brand')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                model: (document.getElementById('dev-model')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                resolution: (document.getElementById('dev-resolution')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                brightnessLumens: _num(document.getElementById('dev-lumens')?.value),
                                                technology: (document.getElementById('dev-technology')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                lens: (document.getElementById('dev-lens')?.value||'').trim(),
                                                throwRatio: _num(document.getElementById('dev-throw')?.value),
                                                notes: (document.getElementById('dev-notes')?.value||'').trim(),
                                        };
                                        const arr = state.devicesV2.projectors || (state.devicesV2.projectors = []);
                                        const idx = arr.findIndex(x => String(x.id)===String(id));
                                        if (idx>=0) arr[idx] = rec; else arr.push(rec);
                                }
                                persistDevices();
                                state.ui.devices.editingId = null;
                                renderDevicesTab();
                                showNotification('Saved');
                        });

                        // PDF parse wiring
                        const pdfBtn = document.getElementById('dev-pdf-parse');
                        if (pdfBtn) pdfBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                                const fileInput = document.getElementById('dev-pdf-file');
                                if (!fileInput || !fileInput.files || !fileInput.files[0]) { showNotification('Choose a PDF first'); return; }
                                const file = fileInput.files[0];
                                const text = await extractPdfText(file);
                                const pre = document.getElementById('dev-pdf-text'); if (pre) pre.textContent = text.slice(0, 20000);
                                try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush(`devices: pdf text length ${text ? text.length : 0}`); } catch(_) {}
                                if (!text) { showNotification('Could not read PDF'); return; }
                                if (text.replace(/\s+/g,'').length < 24) { showNotification('The PDF seems to have no selectable text (likely a scanned/image PDF).'); }
                                if (active==='led') {
                                    const hint = parseLedWallFromText(text);
                                    const set = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && (v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='')) el.value = String(v); };
                                    if (hint.brand || hint.model) {
                                        set('dev-brand', hint.brand); set('dev-model', hint.model);
                                    }
                                    set('dev-pitch', hint.pitchMm);
                                    set('dev-resw', hint.panelResW);
                                    set('dev-resh', hint.panelResH);
                                    set('dev-cabw', hint.cabinetWmm);
                                    set('dev-cabh', hint.cabinetHmm);
                                    set('dev-cabd', hint.cabinetDmm);
                                    set('dev-weight-kg', hint.cabinetWeightKg);
                                    const curveSel = document.getElementById('dev-curve'); if (curveSel && hint.curveType) curveSel.value = hint.curveType;
                                    set('dev-aspect-ratio', hint.aspectRatio);
                                    set('dev-view-distance', hint.viewDistanceM);
                                    const usageSel = document.getElementById('dev-usage'); if (usageSel && (hint.usage||'')!=='') usageSel.value = hint.usage;
                                    set('dev-power-frequency', hint.inputPowerFrequency);
                                    set('dev-avg-power', hint.avgPowerW);
                                    set('dev-max-power', hint.maxPowerW);
                                    set('dev-input-power', hint.inputPower);
                                    set('dev-input-voltage', hint.inputVoltage);
                                    set('dev-framefreq', hint.frameFrequencyHz);
                                    set('dev-nits', hint.brightnessNits);
                                    set('dev-refresh', hint.refreshHz);
                                    // Show summary in UI and highlight affected inputs
                                    const summary = [];
                                    if (hint.brand) summary.push(`Brand: ${hint.brand}`);
                                    if (hint.model) summary.push(`Model: ${hint.model}`);
                                    if (hint.pitchMm!=null) summary.push(`Pitch: ${hint.pitchMm} mm`);
                                    if (hint.panelResW && hint.panelResH) summary.push(`Panel Res: ${hint.panelResW}×${hint.panelResH}`);
                                    if (hint.cabinetWmm || hint.cabinetHmm || hint.cabinetDmm) summary.push(`Cabinet: ${hint.cabinetWmm||'?'}×${hint.cabinetHmm||'?'}×${hint.cabinetDmm||'?'} mm`);
                                    if (hint.cabinetWeightKg!=null) summary.push(`Weight: ${hint.cabinetWeightKg} kg`);
                                    if (hint.brightnessNits!=null) summary.push(`Brightness: ${hint.brightnessNits} nits`);
                                    if (hint.refreshHz!=null) summary.push(`Refresh: ${hint.refreshHz} Hz`);
                                    if (hint.frameFrequencyHz!=null) summary.push(`Video Frame: ${hint.frameFrequencyHz} Hz`);
                                    if (hint.aspectRatio) summary.push(`Aspect Ratio: ${hint.aspectRatio}`);
                                    if (hint.viewDistanceM!=null) summary.push(`View Distance: ${hint.viewDistanceM} m`);
                                    if (hint.usage) summary.push(`Usage: ${hint.usage}`);
                                    if (hint.inputVoltage) summary.push(`Voltage: ${hint.inputVoltage}`);
                                    if (hint.inputPower) summary.push(`Input Power: ${hint.inputPower}`);
                                    if (hint.inputPowerFrequency) summary.push(`Power Freq: ${hint.inputPowerFrequency}`);
                                    const sumEl = document.getElementById('dev-pdf-summary');
                                    if (sumEl) {
                                        sumEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                                        sumEl.innerHTML = summary.length ? ('Detected: ' + summary.join(' • ')) : 'No recognizable fields found. Try “Show last extracted text” to confirm contents.';
                                    }
                                    const idsToHighlight = ['dev-brand','dev-model','dev-pitch','dev-resw','dev-resh','dev-cabw','dev-cabh','dev-cabd','dev-weight-kg','dev-nits','dev-refresh','dev-framefreq','dev-aspect-ratio','dev-view-distance','dev-usage','dev-input-voltage','dev-input-power','dev-power-frequency'];
                                    idsToHighlight.forEach(id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) { el.classList.add('auto-highlight'); setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('auto-highlight'), 1200); }});
                                } else {
                                        const hint = parseProjectorFromText(text);
                                        const set = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && (v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='')) el.value = String(v); };
                                        if (hint.brand || hint.model) { set('dev-brand', hint.brand); set('dev-model', hint.model); }
                                        set('dev-resolution', hint.resolution);
                                        set('dev-lumens', hint.brightnessLumens);
                                        set('dev-technology', hint.technology);
                                        set('dev-lens', hint.lens);
                                        set('dev-throw', hint.throwRatio);
                                        const sumEl = document.getElementById('dev-pdf-summary');
                                        if (sumEl) {
                                            const summary = [];
                                            if (hint.brand) summary.push(`Brand: ${hint.brand}`);
                                            if (hint.model) summary.push(`Model: ${hint.model}`);
                                            if (hint.resolution) summary.push(`Res: ${hint.resolution}`);
                                            if (hint.brightnessLumens!=null) summary.push(`Lumens: ${hint.brightnessLumens}`);
                                            if (hint.technology) summary.push(`Tech: ${hint.technology}`);
                                            if (hint.lens) summary.push(`Lens: ${hint.lens}`);
                                            if (hint.throwRatio!=null) summary.push(`Throw: ${hint.throwRatio}:1`);
                                            sumEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                                            sumEl.innerHTML = summary.length ? ('Detected: ' + summary.join(' • ')) : 'No recognizable fields found. Try “Show last extracted text” to confirm contents.';
                                        }
                                        const idsToHighlight = ['dev-brand','dev-model','dev-resolution','dev-lumens','dev-technology','dev-lens','dev-throw'];
                                        idsToHighlight.forEach(id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) { el.classList.add('auto-highlight'); setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('auto-highlight'), 1200); }});
                                }
                                showNotification('PDF parsed — fields prefilled');
                        });
                };

    // Render the dedicated LED Patching tab: same patching controls, no Canvas Settings, no Draw Mode.
    const renderLedPatchingTab = () => {
            const c = mainContent['led-patching'];
            if (!c) return;
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) {
                c.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-gray-500">Please select or create a project.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            // Prefer maps on the active Output Canvas; fallback to active Designer map
            const ac = getActiveCanvas();
            const acMaps = (ac && Array.isArray(ac.maps)) ? ac.maps : [];
            if (!state.lpState) state.lpState = { selectedMapId: null };
            let currentMap = null;
            if (acMaps.length > 0) {
                const selId = state.lpState.selectedMapId;
                currentMap = acMaps.find(m => String(m.id) === String(selId)) || acMaps[0];
                state.lpState.selectedMapId = currentMap ? currentMap.id : null;
            } else {
                currentMap = getActivePixelMap();
                state.lpState.selectedMapId = currentMap ? currentMap.id : null;
            }
            const vizCanvasHtml = currentMap ? `<canvas id="lp-visualizer-canvas" class="max-w-full max-h-full" style="image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>` : `<div class="text-gray-500">Send a map to Output Canvas or select a Pixel Map in Pixel Maps to preview it here.</div>`;

            c.innerHTML = `
                <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg">
                    <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center mb-4 gap-4">
                        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">LED Patching</h2>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400">Separate from Draw Mode. Overlay thickness/color live here.</div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Minimal viewer: show current Pixel Map with tabs for Output Canvas maps -->
                    <div class="mb-6">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                            <div id="lp-preview-title" class="text-sm text-gray-300">Pixel Map Preview ${currentMap ? `— <span class='text-accent'>${currentMap.name}</span>` : ''}</div>
                            <div id="lp-map-tabs" class="flex gap-2 overflow-auto"></div>
                        </div>
                        <div id="lp-visualizer-container" class="relative w-full h-[42vh] bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-4 flex items-start justify-center overflow-hidden">
                            <div id="lp-visualizer-wrapper">${vizCanvasHtml}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- LED Patching controls (IDs prefixed with lp-) -->
                    <div class="mt-2 mb-4 p-4 rounded-lg bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-700">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-accent">LED Patching</h3>
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400">NovaStar only</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 items-end">
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Brand</label>
                                <select id="lp-led-brand" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2" disabled>
                                    <option value="novastar" selected>NovaStar</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Model</label>
                                <select id="lp-led-model" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                    <option value="mctrl4k" selected>MCTRL 4K</option>
                                    <option value="mctrl700">MCTRL 700</option>
                                    <option value="mctrl660">MCTRL 660</option>
                                    <option value="mctrl660-pro">MCTRL 660 PRO</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Units</label>
                                <input id="lp-led-units" type="number" min="1" value="1" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Ports per Unit</label>
                                <input id="lp-led-ports" type="number" min="1" value="16" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2" />
                            </div>
                            <div class="md:col-span-2">
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Capacity per Port (pixels)</label>
                                <input id="lp-led-capacity" type="number" min="1000" step="1000" value="650000" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2" />
                                <div class="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">Hidden on screen; used internally/PDF.</div>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Max panels per Port (optional)</label>
                                <input id="lp-led-max-panels-port" type="number" min="0" step="1" placeholder="e.g., 8" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Refresh Rate</label>
                                <select id="lp-led-refresh" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                    <option value="60" selected>60 Hz (40 panels/port)</option>
                                    <option value="50">50 Hz (48 panels/port)</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex gap-2 items-end">
                                <button id="lp-led-generate" class="btn-glow flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-sm font-semibold">Generate Patching</button>
                                <button id="lp-led-export" class="btn-glow flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-sm font-semibold" disabled>Export CSV</button>
                                <button id="lp-led-save-png" class="btn-glow flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-sm font-semibold">Save PNG</button>
                                <label class="ml-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-300"><input id="lp-led-show-overlay" type="checkbox" class="form-checkbox bg-gray-700" checked> Show overlay on Output Canvas</label>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <!-- Overlay Styling (separate from Draw Mode) -->
                        <div class="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 items-end">
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Overlay Color</label>
                                <input id="lp-led-overlay-color" type="color" value="#ff0000" class="w-10 h-10 p-0 bg-transparent border-none rounded" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Overlay Thickness</label>
                                <input id="lp-led-overlay-width" type="range" min="1" max="16" step="1" value="5" class="w-full" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Overlay Style</label>
                                <select id="lp-led-overlay-style" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                    <option value="solid">Solid</option>
                                    <option value="dashed">Dashed</option>
                                    <option value="dotted">Dotted</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-sm text-gray-300 mb-1">Wiring Pattern</label>
                                <div id="lp-led-wiring-grid" class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 select-none"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;

            // Build wiring grid (clone if source exists, otherwise create a minimal grid here)
            try {
                const src = document.getElementById('led-wiring-grid');
                const dest = document.getElementById('lp-led-wiring-grid');
                if (dest) {
                    if (src) {
                        dest.innerHTML = src.innerHTML.replaceAll('name="led-wiring"', 'name="lp-led-wiring"');
                    } else {
                        const patterns = [
                            {code:'H-TL', label:'H TL'}, {code:'H-TR', label:'H TR'}, {code:'H-BL', label:'H BL'}, {code:'H-BR', label:'H BR'},
                            {code:'V-TL', label:'V TL'}, {code:'V-TR', label:'V TR'}, {code:'V-BL', label:'V BL'}, {code:'V-BR', label:'V BR'}
                        ];
                        dest.innerHTML = patterns.map(p => `
                            <label data-pattern="${p.code}" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs cursor-pointer select-none">
                                <input type="radio" name="lp-led-wiring" value="${p.code}" class="sr-only">
                                <span class="text-gray-200">${p.label}</span>
                            </label>
                        `).join('');
                    }
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Build tabs for maps on the active Output Canvas (if any)
            try {
                const tabsEl = document.getElementById('lp-map-tabs');
                if (tabsEl) {
                    if (acMaps.length > 0) {
                        tabsEl.innerHTML = acMaps.map(m => `
                            <button data-map-id="${m.id}" class="px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-gray-700 ${String(m.id)===String(state.lpState.selectedMapId)?'bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-600':'text-gray-300 hover:text-white hover:border-gray-500'}">${m.name || 'Map'}</button>
                        `).join('');
                        // Wire clicks to switch current map
                        tabsEl.querySelectorAll('button[data-map-id]').forEach(btn => {
                            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                const id = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-map-id');
                                const found = acMaps.find(mm => String(mm.id) === String(id));
                                if (found && lpCanvas) {
                                    state.lpState.selectedMapId = found.id;
                                    currentMap = found;
                                    try { drawVisualizerCanvas(lpCanvas, currentMap); } catch(_) {}
                                    try { fitLpCanvas(); } catch(_) {}
                                    // Update tab highlight
                                    tabsEl.querySelectorAll('button[data-map-id]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('bg-emerald-600/20','text-emerald-300','border-emerald-600'));
                                    e.currentTarget.classList.add('bg-emerald-600/20','text-emerald-300','border-emerald-600');
                                    // Update preview title
                                    try {
                                        const titleEl = document.getElementById('lp-preview-title');
                                        if (titleEl) titleEl.innerHTML = `Pixel Map Preview — <span class='text-accent'>${currentMap.name || 'Map'}</span>`;
                                    } catch(_) {}
                                    // Redraw overlay for new map
                                    try { drawLpSerpentineOverlay(); } catch(_) {}
                                }
                            });
                        });
                    } else {
                        tabsEl.innerHTML = `<span class="text-xs text-gray-500">No Output Canvas maps yet</span>`;
                    }
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Helper to fit LP canvas to the preview container (contain)
            const fitLpCanvas = () => {
                try {
                    const container = document.getElementById('lp-visualizer-container');
                    if (!lpCanvas || !container) return;
                    if (lpCanvas.width <= 0 || lpCanvas.height <= 0) return;
                    const cw = container.clientWidth || container.offsetWidth;
                    const ch = container.clientHeight || container.offsetHeight;
                    if (!cw || !ch) return;
                    const scale = Math.min(cw / lpCanvas.width, ch / lpCanvas.height);
                    lpCanvas.style.width = Math.round(lpCanvas.width * scale) + 'px';
                    lpCanvas.style.height = Math.round(lpCanvas.height * scale) + 'px';
                } catch(_) {}
            };

            // Draw the pixel map preview if available
            const lpCanvas = document.getElementById('lp-visualizer-canvas');
            try {
                if (currentMap && lpCanvas) {
                    drawVisualizerCanvas(lpCanvas, currentMap);
                    fitLpCanvas();
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Helper: draw serpentine overlay on the LP preview (independent of Output Canvas)
            const drawLpSerpentineOverlay = () => {
                if (!lpCanvas || !currentMap) return;
                const ctx = lpCanvas.getContext('2d');
                if (!ctx) return;
                // Re-draw base to avoid trail, then overlay
                try { drawVisualizerCanvas(lpCanvas, currentMap); } catch(_) {}
                try { fitLpCanvas(); } catch(_) {}
                const calcs = (typeof calculateLayout === 'function') ? calculateLayout(currentMap) : null;
                if (!calcs || !calcs.totalResWidth || !calcs.totalResHeight || !calcs.panelResWidth || !calcs.panelResHeight) return;
                const cols = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelsHorizontally || (calcs.totalResWidth / calcs.panelResWidth)));
                const rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelsVertically || (calcs.totalResHeight / calcs.panelResHeight)));
                const pW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelResWidth));
                const pH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelResHeight));
                const totalW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.totalResWidth));
                const totalH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.totalResHeight));

                // Style from LP controls
                const color = (document.getElementById('lp-led-overlay-color')?.value) || '#ff0000';
                const width = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('lp-led-overlay-width')?.value || '5', 10) || 5);
                const style = (document.getElementById('lp-led-overlay-style')?.value) || 'solid';
                const pattern = (typeof getSelectedWiringPatternLP === 'function' ? getSelectedWiringPatternLP() : 'H-TL') || 'H-TL';

                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                ctx.lineWidth = width;
                ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                if (style === 'dashed') ctx.setLineDash([Math.max(8, width*2), Math.max(6, width*1.5)]);
                else if (style === 'dotted') ctx.setLineDash([width, Math.max(6, width*2)]);

                const drawArrowHead = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => {
                    const headLen = Math.max(6, Math.round(width * 2));
                    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
                    ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
                    ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
                    ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
                    ctx.stroke();
                };

                const isHoriz = pattern.startsWith('H-');
                const startCorner = pattern.slice(2); // TL | TR | BL | BR

                if (isHoriz) {
                    const topFirst = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'TR');
                    const leftStart = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'BL');
                    // Determine row traversal order
                    const rowOrder = [...Array(rows).keys()];
                    if (!topFirst) rowOrder.reverse();
                    rowOrder.forEach((rowAbsIdx, relIdx) => {
                        const y = rowAbsIdx * pH + pH/2;
                        const ltr = (relIdx % 2 === 0) ? leftStart : !leftStart;
                        const xStart = ltr ? (pW/2) : (totalW - pW/2);
                        const xEnd = ltr ? (totalW - pW/2) : (pW/2);
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(xStart, y);
                        ctx.lineTo(xEnd, y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        drawArrowHead(xStart, y, xEnd, y);
                        // Connector to next row
                        const nextRowAbs = rowOrder[relIdx + 1];
                        if (nextRowAbs != null) {
                            const y2 = nextRowAbs * pH + pH/2;
                            const xConn = xEnd; // continue from end of this row
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(xConn, y);
                            ctx.lineTo(xConn, y2);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }

                        // Per-panel tiny arrows along this row
                        try {
                            const dir = ltr ? 0 : Math.PI; // 0 rad = right, PI = left
                            const arrowLen = Math.max(6, Math.round(Math.min(pW, pH) * 0.35));
                            const midY = y;
                            const lw = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * 0.6));
                            const prev = ctx.lineWidth;
                            ctx.lineWidth = lw;
                            for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                                const cx = c * pW + pW/2;
                                // draw a short arrow centered in the tile
                                const x1 = cx - Math.cos(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                const y1 = midY - Math.sin(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                const x2 = cx + Math.cos(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                const y2 = midY + Math.sin(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                ctx.beginPath();
                                ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
                                ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
                                ctx.stroke();
                                drawArrowHead(x1, y1, x2, y2);
                            }
                            ctx.lineWidth = prev;
                        } catch(_) {}
                    });
                } else {
                    // Vertical serpentine
                    const leftFirst = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'BL');
                    const topStart = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'TR');
                    const colOrder = [...Array(cols).keys()];
                    if (!leftFirst) colOrder.reverse();
                    colOrder.forEach((colAbsIdx, relIdx) => {
                        const x = colAbsIdx * pW + pW/2;
                        const ttb = (relIdx % 2 === 0) ? topStart : !topStart;
                        const yStart = ttb ? (pH/2) : (totalH - pH/2);
                        const yEnd = ttb ? (totalH - pH/2) : (pH/2);
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(x, yStart);
                        ctx.lineTo(x, yEnd);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        drawArrowHead(x, yStart, x, yEnd);
                        const nextColAbs = colOrder[relIdx + 1];
                        if (nextColAbs != null) {
                            const x2 = nextColAbs * pW + pW/2;
                            const yConn = yEnd;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(x, yConn);
                            ctx.lineTo(x2, yConn);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }

                        // Per-panel tiny arrows along this column
                        try {
                            const dir = ttb ? Math.PI/2 : -Math.PI/2; // up or down
                            const arrowLen = Math.max(6, Math.round(Math.min(pW, pH) * 0.35));
                            const midX = x;
                            const lw = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * 0.6));
                            const prev = ctx.lineWidth;
                            ctx.lineWidth = lw;
                            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
                                const cy = r * pH + pH/2;
                                const x1 = midX - Math.cos(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                const y1 = cy - Math.sin(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                const x2 = midX + Math.cos(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                const y2 = cy + Math.sin(dir) * (arrowLen * 0.35);
                                ctx.beginPath();
                                ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
                                ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
                                ctx.stroke();
                                drawArrowHead(x1, y1, x2, y2);
                            }
                            ctx.lineWidth = prev;
                        } catch(_) {}
                    });
                }

                // Per-port labels for current map if patch exists
                try {
                    const assignments = (ac && ac.processorPatch && Array.isArray(ac.processorPatch.assignments)) ? ac.processorPatch.assignments : [];
                    const mine = assignments.filter(a => String(a.mapId) === String(currentMap.id));
                    if (mine.length) {
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.setLineDash([]);
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                        const fs = Math.max(8, Math.round(Math.min(pW, pH) * 0.25));
                        ctx.font = `${fs}px Inter`;
                        mine.forEach(a => {
                            const text = `U${a.unit}-P${a.port}`;
                            const bx = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalW, Math.round(a.relX)));
                            const by = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalH, Math.round(a.relY)));
                            const bw = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalW - bx, Math.round(a.w)));
                            const bh = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalH - by, Math.round(a.h)));
                            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
                            ctx.strokeRect(bx + 0.5, by + 0.5, Math.max(0, bw - 1), Math.max(0, bh - 1));
                            const pad = 2;
                            const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + pad * 2;
                            const th = fs + pad * 2;
                            const cx = bx + bw / 2 - tw / 2;
                            const cy = by + bh / 2 - th / 2;
                            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
                            ctx.fillRect(cx, cy, tw, th);
                            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                            ctx.fillText(text, cx + pad, cy + th - pad - 2);
                        });
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                } catch(_) {}

                ctx.restore();
            };

            // Wire up LED patching controls for this tab (uses same logic, different element IDs)
            const NOVASTAR_MODELS = { 'mctrl4k': { portsPerUnit: 16, capacityPerPort: 650000 }, 'mctrl700': { portsPerUnit: 6, capacityPerPort: 650000 }, 'mctrl660': { portsPerUnit: 6, capacityPerPort: 650000 }, 'mctrl660-pro': { portsPerUnit: 6, capacityPerPort: 650000 } };

            const byId = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
            const modelEl = byId('lp-led-model');
            const unitsEl = byId('lp-led-units');
            const portsEl = byId('lp-led-ports');
            const capacityEl = byId('lp-led-capacity');
            const maxPanelsEl = byId('lp-led-max-panels-port');
            const refreshEl = byId('lp-led-refresh');
            const genBtn = byId('lp-led-generate');
            const exportBtn = byId('lp-led-export');
            const savePngBtn = byId('lp-led-save-png');
            const showOverlayEl = byId('lp-led-show-overlay');
            const colorEl = byId('lp-led-overlay-color');
            const widthEl = byId('lp-led-overlay-width');
            const styleEl = byId('lp-led-overlay-style');
            const wiringGridEl = byId('lp-led-wiring-grid');

            const setSelectedWiringPatternLP = (val) => {
                if (!wiringGridEl) return;
                wiringGridEl.querySelectorAll('input[name="lp-led-wiring"]').forEach(r => r.checked = (r.value === val));
                wiringGridEl.querySelectorAll('label[data-pattern]').forEach(lb => lb.classList.remove('ring-2','ring-emerald-500','border-emerald-500'));
                const sel = wiringGridEl.querySelector(`label[data-pattern="${val}"]`);
                if (sel) sel.classList.add('ring-2','ring-emerald-500','border-emerald-500');
            };
            const getSelectedWiringPatternLP = () => {
                const r = wiringGridEl?.querySelector('input[name="lp-led-wiring"]:checked');
                return r ? r.value : 'H-TL';
            };
            if (wiringGridEl) wiringGridEl.querySelectorAll('input[name="lp-led-wiring"]').forEach(r => r.addEventListener('change', () => setSelectedWiringPatternLP(getSelectedWiringPatternLP())));

            const applyDefaults = () => {
                const preset = NOVASTAR_MODELS[modelEl?.value || 'mctrl4k'];
                if (preset) {
                    if (portsEl) { portsEl.value = String(preset.portsPerUnit); portsEl.disabled = true; }
                    if (capacityEl && (!capacityEl.value || +capacityEl.value <= 0)) capacityEl.value = String(preset.capacityPerPort);
                } else { if (portsEl) portsEl.disabled = false; }
            };
            if (modelEl) modelEl.addEventListener('change', () => { applyDefaults(); drawLpSerpentineOverlay(); });
            applyDefaults();

            const generateLP = () => {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                if (!ac) { showNotification('Add at least one Output Canvas and send your map to it first.'); return; }
                const maps = Array.isArray(ac.maps) ? ac.maps : [];
                if (maps.length === 0) { showNotification('No maps on Output Canvas. Use Visualizer → Send to Output.'); return; }

                const units = Math.max(1, parseInt(unitsEl.value||'1', 10) || 1);
                const preset = NOVASTAR_MODELS[modelEl?.value || 'mctrl4k'];
                const portsPerUnit = preset ? preset.portsPerUnit : Math.max(1, parseInt(portsEl.value||'16', 10) || 16);
                if (portsEl) { portsEl.value = String(portsPerUnit); portsEl.disabled = !!preset; }
                const capacityPerPort = Math.max(1000, parseInt(capacityEl.value||'650000', 10) || (preset?.capacityPerPort || 650000));
                const maxPanelsPerPortRaw = parseInt(maxPanelsEl?.value || '0', 10);
                const maxPanelsPerPort = isNaN(maxPanelsPerPortRaw) ? 0 : Math.max(0, maxPanelsPerPortRaw);
                const hz = refreshEl ? parseInt(refreshEl.value, 10) : 60;
                const hzPanelsLimit = (hz === 50) ? 48 : 40;

                const totalPorts = units * portsPerUnit;
                const assignments = [];
                let globalPortIdx = 1;
                const takePort = () => { const idx = globalPortIdx++; return { unit: Math.floor((idx - 1) / portsPerUnit) + 1, port: ((idx - 1) % portsPerUnit) + 1 }; };
                const getCalcs = (map) => { try { return (typeof calculateLayout === 'function') ? calculateLayout(map) : null; } catch(_) { return null; } };
                const portsExhausted = () => globalPortIdx > totalPorts;

                maps.forEach(m => {
                    if (portsExhausted()) return;
                    const calcs = getCalcs(m) || {};
                    const pW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m.panelResWidth || calcs.panelResWidth || 128));
                    const pH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m.panelResHeight || calcs.panelResHeight || 128));
                    const panelsX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(calcs.panelsHorizontally || 0));
                    const panelsY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(calcs.panelsVertically || 0));
                    const panelPixels = pW * pH;
                    const pixelBasedLimit = Math.floor(capacityPerPort / panelPixels);
                    if (pixelBasedLimit <= 0) { showNotification('A panel exceeds per-port pixel capacity.'); return; }
                    const effectivePanelsPerPort = Math.max(1, Math.min(pixelBasedLimit, hzPanelsLimit, (maxPanelsPerPort > 0 ? maxPanelsPerPort : Infinity)));
                    const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropLeft ?? m.sliceLeft ?? 0));
                    const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropRight ?? m.sliceRight ?? 0));
                    const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropTop ?? 0));
                    const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropBottom ?? 0));
                    const offColsLeft = Math.min(panelsX, Math.ceil(sL / pW));
                    const offColsRight = Math.min(panelsX - offColsLeft, Math.ceil(sR / pW));
                    const offRowsTop = Math.min(panelsY, Math.ceil(sT / pH));
                    const offRowsBottom = Math.min(panelsY - offRowsTop, Math.ceil(sB / pH));
                    const availCols = Math.max(0, panelsX - offColsLeft - offColsRight);
                    const availRows = Math.max(0, panelsY - offRowsTop - offRowsBottom);
                    if (availCols === 0 || availRows === 0) return;
                    const baseRelX = offColsLeft * pW - sL;
                    const baseRelY = offRowsTop * pH - sT;
                    for (let row = 0; row < availRows && !portsExhausted(); row++) {
                        let col = 0;
                        while (col < availCols && !portsExhausted()) {
                            const groupPanels = Math.min(effectivePanelsPerPort, availCols - col);
                            const p = takePort();
                            const relX = baseRelX + col * pW;
                            const relY = baseRelY + row * pH;
                            const w = groupPanels * pW;
                            const h = pH;
                            assignments.push({ unit: p.unit, port: p.port, mapId: m.id, mapName: m.name || 'Map', relX, relY, w, h });
                            col += groupPanels;
                        }
                    }
                });

                const cfg = { brand: 'novastar', model: modelEl?.value || 'mctrl4k', units, portsPerUnit, capacityPerPort, maxPanelsPerPort, refreshHz: hz };
                const ac2 = getActiveCanvas();
                ac2.processorConfig = cfg;
                const overlayStyle = { color: colorEl?.value || '#ff0000', width: parseInt(widthEl?.value || '5', 10) || 5, lineStyle: styleEl?.value || 'solid', wiringPattern: getSelectedWiringPatternLP() || 'H-TL', arrowStart: false, arrowEnd: true, arrowSize: 1.2 };
                ac2.processorPatch = { assignments, showOverlay: !!showOverlayEl?.checked, overlayStyle };
                persistProjects();
                if (exportBtn) exportBtn.disabled = assignments.length === 0;
                showNotification(assignments.length ? 'Patching generated. View overlay on Output Canvas.' : 'No ports assigned.');
            };
            if (genBtn) genBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { 
                // Ensure Output Canvas overlay is enabled by default when generating
                try { if (showOverlayEl) showOverlayEl.checked = true; } catch(_) {}
                generateLP(); 
                drawLpSerpentineOverlay(); 
                // Re-render main canvas so overlay appears immediately
                try { renderCanvas(); } catch(_) {}
            });
            if (exportBtn) exportBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                try {
                    const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                    const rows = ac?.processorPatch?.assignments || [];
                    if (!rows.length) { showNotification('Nothing to export yet.'); return; }
                    const absRows = rows.map(r => {
                        const m = ac?.maps?.find(mm => mm.id === r.mapId);
                        const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m?.cropLeft ?? m?.sliceLeft ?? 0));
                        const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m?.cropTop ?? 0));
                        const absX = (m ? Math.floor((m.x||0) + sL + (r.relX||0)) : (r.x||0));
                        const absY = (m ? Math.floor((m.y||0) + sT + (r.relY||0)) : (r.y||0));
                        return { unit: r.unit, port: r.port, mapName: r.mapName, x: absX, y: absY, w: r.w, h: r.h };
                    });
                    const header = ['Unit','Port','Map','X','Y','W','H'];
                    const csv = [header.join(',')].concat(absRows.map(r => [r.unit, r.port, JSON.stringify(r.mapName), r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h].join(','))).join('\n');
                    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = `patching_${(getActiveCanvas().processorConfig?.model || 'novastar')}_${Date.now()}.csv`; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                } catch (e) { console.warn('CSV export failed', e); }
            });
        if (showOverlayEl) showOverlayEl.addEventListener('change', (e) => { const ac = getActiveCanvas(); if (!ac) return; ac.processorPatch = ac.processorPatch || {}; ac.processorPatch.showOverlay = !!e.target.checked; persistProjects(); });

        // Live overlay redraw on LP controls
        if (colorEl) colorEl.addEventListener('input', drawLpSerpentineOverlay);
        if (widthEl) widthEl.addEventListener('input', drawLpSerpentineOverlay);
        if (styleEl) styleEl.addEventListener('change', drawLpSerpentineOverlay);
        if (wiringGridEl) wiringGridEl.addEventListener('change', drawLpSerpentineOverlay);
        // Refit on resize to keep image fitting the preview box
        try {
            if (state.lpState && !state.lpState.resizeBound) {
                window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                    try { fitLpCanvas(); } catch(_) {}
                    try { drawLpSerpentineOverlay(); } catch(_) {}
                });
                state.lpState.resizeBound = true;
            }
        } catch(_) {}

        // Save PNG of the current LP preview (base + overlay)
        if (savePngBtn) savePngBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            try {
                if (!lpCanvas || !currentMap) { showNotification('Nothing to save yet.'); return; }
                // Ensure latest overlay is drawn
                try { drawLpSerpentineOverlay(); } catch(_) {}
                lpCanvas.toBlob((blob) => {
                    if (!blob) { showNotification('PNG export failed.'); return; }
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    a.href = url;
                    const safeName = (currentMap.name || 'map').toString().replace(/[^a-z0-9_\-]+/gi, '_');
                    a.download = `led_patching_${safeName}_${Date.now()}.png`;
                    document.body.appendChild(a);
                    a.click();
                    document.body.removeChild(a);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                }, 'image/png');
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Save PNG failed', e);
                showNotification('Save PNG failed');
            }
        });

        // Initial overlay draw
        drawLpSerpentineOverlay();
    };


        // Ensure Shows UI is interactive (closes overlays, enables pointer events, focuses input)
        const unlockShowsUi = () => {
            try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush('unlockShowsUi()'); } catch(_) {}
            try { if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur) document.activeElement.blur(); } catch(_) {}
            try { if (typeof closeAboutModal === 'function') closeAboutModal(); } catch(_) {}
            try { if (typeof closeHelpModal === 'function') closeHelpModal(); } catch(_) {}
            try { const rm = document.getElementById('rename-project-modal'); if (rm) rm.style.display = 'none'; } catch(_) {}
            try { const im = document.getElementById('input-modal'); if (im) im.style.display = 'none'; } catch(_) {}
            try { const pd = document.getElementById('processors-db-modal'); if (pd) pd.remove(); } catch(_) {}
            try { if (mainContent && mainContent.shows) mainContent.shows.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; } catch(_) {}
            try { document.body.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; } catch(_) {}
            try { const sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection(); if (sel && sel.removeAllRanges) sel.removeAllRanges(); } catch(_) {}
            try { const ni = document.getElementById('shows-new-project-name'); if (ni) { ni.disabled = false; ni.readOnly = false; ni.focus(); } } catch(_) {}
        };

        // Force a repaint/reflow on the Shows container to clear any transient overlay capture
        const forceRepaintShows = () => {
            try {
                const el = mainContent && mainContent.shows;
                if (!el) return;
                const prev = el.style.display;
                el.style.display = 'none';
                // force reflow
                void el.offsetHeight; // eslint-disable-line no-unused-expressions
                el.style.display = prev || '';
            } catch(_) {}
        };

        const renderShows = () => {
            try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush('renderShows()'); } catch(_) {}
            // Ensure status defaults exist
            (state.projects || []).forEach(p => { if (!p.status) p.status = 'draft'; });
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const projectName = project ? project.name : '—';
            const draftProjects = (state.projects || []).filter(p => p.status !== 'saved');
            const total = draftProjects.length;
            // Proactively close any lingering modals/backdrops that might trap focus or block clicks
            unlockShowsUi();
            mainContent.shows.innerHTML = `
                <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">Shows</h2>
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-400">Active Project: <span class="text-white">${projectName}</span> • Total: ${total}</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="space-y-2">
                        <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-200">Create New Project</h3>
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
                            <input id="shows-new-project-name" type="text" placeholder="Enter project name" class="flex-1 min-w-[200px] bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
                            <button id="shows-create-project" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Create</button>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Creates a new project with a default pixel map and output canvas.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="space-y-3">
                        <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-200">Projects</h3>
                        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-700">
                            ${draftProjects.map(p => `
                                <div class="project-row p-3 bg-gray-900" data-id="${p.id}">
                                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="font-semibold">${p.name}</div>
                                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400">ID: ${p.id} ${p.savedAt ? '• Saved: ' + new Date(p.savedAt).toLocaleString() : ''}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="shows-rename px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">Rename</button>
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="shows-delete px-2 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-sm text-white">Delete</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div class="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm">
                                        <div class="md:col-span-2">
                                            <label class="block text-gray-400 mb-1">Project Name</label>
                                            <input type="text" data-field="name" value="${p.name || ''}" placeholder="e.g., Main Event" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1" />
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                            <div>
                                                <label class="block text-gray-400 mb-1">Date</label>
                                                <input type="date" data-field="eventDate" value="${p.eventDate || ''}" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1" />
                                            </div>
                                            <div>
                                                <label class="block text-gray-400 mb-1">Time</label>
                                                <input type="time" data-field="eventTime" value="${p.eventTime || ''}" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1" />
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
                                            <div>
                                                <label class="block text-gray-400 mb-1">Location</label>
                                                <input type="text" data-field="location" value="${p.location || ''}" placeholder="e.g., New York, NY" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1" />
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <label class="block text-gray-400 mb-1">Salesperson</label>
                                            <input type="text" data-field="salesperson" value="${p.salesperson || ''}" placeholder="e.g., Jane Doe" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1" />
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <label class="block text-gray-400 mb-1">Venue</label>
                                            <input type="text" data-field="venue" value="${p.venue || ''}" placeholder="e.g., Madison Square Garden" class="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1" />
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="md:col-span-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-end">
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="shows-save-details px-3 py-1 rounded bg-accent text-black">Save Details</button>
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="shows-mark-saved px-3 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white">Mark as Saved</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                        ${total === 0 ? '<div class="text-sm text-gray-400 p-3">No draft shows here. Create a new project or reopen one from the Saved tab.</div>' : ''}
                    </div>

                    <div class="space-y-2">
                        <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-200">Backup & Restore</h3>
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                            <button id="export-projects-all" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-sm">Export All Projects</button>
                            <button id="export-project-current" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-sm">Export Current Project</button>
                            <input id="import-projects-file" type="file" accept="application/json,.json" class="hidden" />
                            <button id="import-projects-merge" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Import (Merge)</button>
                            <button id="import-projects-replace" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-sm">Import (Replace All)</button>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Export a JSON backup of your projects and import later. Replace All will overwrite your current projects.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            // Ensure the container can receive pointer events and the input is focused
            unlockShowsUi();
            // double RAF to allow layout settle then unlock once more
            requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { unlockShowsUi(); }));

            // Create New Project wiring
            const nameInput = document.getElementById('shows-new-project-name');
            const createBtn = document.getElementById('shows-create-project');
            const doCreate = () => {
                try {
                    const name = (nameInput?.value || '').trim();
                    if (!name) { showNotification('Please enter a project name'); return; }
                    createNewProjectByName(name);
                    // Reset input for quick entry of another project
                    if (nameInput) nameInput.value = '';
                    renderShows();
                    showNotification(`Project "${name}" created`);
                } catch (err) {
                    console.warn('Create project failed', err);
                    showNotification('Could not create project');
                }
            };
            if (createBtn) {
                // Ensure button is enabled after any prior modal/actions
                try { createBtn.disabled = false; } catch(_) {}
                createBtn.addEventListener('click', doCreate);
            }
            if (nameInput) {
                try { nameInput.disabled = false; nameInput.readOnly = false; } catch(_) {}
                nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); doCreate(); } });
                // Focus input to keep the flow after re-render
                setTimeout(() => { try { nameInput.focus(); if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush('focused shows-new-project-name'); } catch(_) {} }, 0);
            }

            // Wire backup buttons
            const exportAllBtn = document.getElementById('export-projects-all');
            const exportCurrentBtn = document.getElementById('export-project-current');
            const importFileInput = document.getElementById('import-projects-file');
            const importMergeBtn = document.getElementById('import-projects-merge');
            const importReplaceBtn = document.getElementById('import-projects-replace');

            if (exportAllBtn) exportAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportProjects('all'));
            if (exportCurrentBtn) exportCurrentBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportProjects('current'));
            const openFileDialog = () => { if (importFileInput) importFileInput.click(); };
            if (importMergeBtn) importMergeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { importMergeBtn.dataset.mode = 'merge'; openFileDialog(); });
            if (importReplaceBtn) importReplaceBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                importReplaceBtn.dataset.mode = 'replace';
                const proceed = window.confirm('This will replace ALL existing projects with those from the file. Continue?');
                if (!proceed) return;
                openFileDialog();
            });
            if (importFileInput) importFileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
                if (!file) return;
                const mode = (importReplaceBtn && importReplaceBtn.dataset.mode === 'replace') ? 'replace' : 'merge';
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = (ev) => {
                    try {
                        const json = JSON.parse(String(ev.target.result || '{}'));
                        importProjectsFromObject(json, mode);
                        renderShows();
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.warn('Invalid JSON selected for import', err);
                        showNotification('Invalid JSON file');
                    } finally {
                        e.target.value = '';
                        if (importReplaceBtn) delete importReplaceBtn.dataset.mode;
                    }
                };
                reader.readAsText(file);
            });

            // Project list handlers (Activate/Export removed as requested)
            mainContent.shows.querySelectorAll('.shows-rename').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                const id = parseInt(ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id'));
                const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                if (!proj) return;
                openRenameProjectModal(proj);
            }));
            mainContent.shows.querySelectorAll('.shows-delete').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', async (ev) => {
                try {
                    const id = parseInt(ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id'));
                    if (Number.isNaN(id)) return;
                    const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                    const ok = await showConfirm(`Delete project "${proj?.name || 'this project'}"? This cannot be undone.`, 'Delete', 'Cancel');
                    if (!ok) return;
                    if (deleteProjectById(id)) {
                        // Defer re-render to next tick to avoid any transient locks
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            forceRepaintShows();
                            renderShows();
                            unlockShowsUi();
                            setTimeout(unlockShowsUi, 50);
                            setTimeout(unlockShowsUi, 250);
                        }, 0);
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    console.warn('Delete project failed', err);
                    showNotification('Could not delete project');
                }
            }));

            // Helper to read and apply details from a project row
            const applyDetailsFromRow = (rowEl, proj) => {
                if (!rowEl || !proj) return;
                const read = (selector) => rowEl.querySelector(selector)?.value || '';
                const nameVal = (rowEl.querySelector('input[data-field="name"]')?.value || '').trim();
                if (nameVal) proj.name = nameVal; // keep previous name if emptied
                proj.eventDate = read('input[data-field="eventDate"]');
                proj.eventTime = read('input[data-field="eventTime"]');
                proj.location = read('input[data-field="location"]');
                proj.salesperson = read('input[data-field="salesperson"]');
                proj.venue = read('input[data-field="venue"]');
            };

            // Save Project Details handlers
            mainContent.shows.querySelectorAll('.shows-save-details').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                const id = parseInt(ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id'));
                const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                if (!proj) return;
                const row = mainContent.shows.querySelector(`.project-row[data-id="${id}"]`);
                if (!row) return;
                applyDetailsFromRow(row, proj);
                proj.savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
                proj.status = 'saved';
                persistProjects();
                showNotification('Project saved and moved to Saved');
                switchTab('saved');
            }));

            // Mark as Saved handlers (also capture current field values before saving)
            mainContent.shows.querySelectorAll('.shows-mark-saved').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                const id = parseInt(ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id'));
                const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                if (!proj) return;
                const row = mainContent.shows.querySelector(`.project-row[data-id="${id}"]`);
                if (row) applyDetailsFromRow(row, proj);
                proj.status = 'saved';
                proj.savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
                persistProjects();
                showNotification(`"${proj.name}" moved to Saved`);
                switchTab('saved');
            }));

            // Auto-persist changes to details on change/blur so values aren't lost
            const handleFieldPersist = (e) => {
                const input = e.target;
                if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
                if (!input.matches('input[data-field]')) return;
                const row = input.closest('.project-row');
                const id = parseInt(row?.getAttribute('data-id'));
                const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                if (!proj) return;
                const field = input.getAttribute('data-field');
                if (!field) return;
                if (field === 'name') {
                    const v = (input.value || '').trim();
                    if (!v) {
                        // prevent empty project name; revert input to current value
                        input.value = proj.name || '';
                        showNotification('Project name cannot be empty');
                        return;
                    }
                    proj.name = v;
                    // also update the header text in this row immediately
                    const header = row.querySelector('.font-semibold');
                    if (header) header.textContent = v;
                } else {
                    proj[field] = input.value || '';
                }
                persistProjects();
            };
            // Delegate to container to handle all rows' inputs; bind once to avoid stacking listeners
            state.ui = state.ui || {};
            if (!state.ui.showsHandlersBound) {
                mainContent.shows.addEventListener('change', handleFieldPersist);
                mainContent.shows.addEventListener('blur', handleFieldPersist, true);
                state.ui.showsHandlersBound = true;
            }
        };
        

        // Render Saved tab (projects marked as saved)
        const renderSaved = () => {
            // Ensure status defaults exist
            (state.projects || []).forEach(p => { if (!p.status) p.status = 'draft'; });
            const savedProjects = (state.projects || []).filter(p => p.status === 'saved');
            const active = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const projectName = active ? active.name : '—';
            mainContent.saved.innerHTML = `
                <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-6">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-400">Saved Shows</h2>
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-400">Active Project: <span class="text-white">${projectName}</span> • Total: ${savedProjects.length}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="space-y-3">
                        <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-200">Projects</h3>
                        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-700">
                            ${savedProjects.map(p => `
                                <div class="project-row p-3 bg-gray-900" data-id="${p.id}">
                                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="font-semibold">${p.name}</div>
                                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400">ID: ${p.id} ${p.savedAt ? '• Saved: ' + new Date(p.savedAt).toLocaleString() : ''}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="saved-reopen px-2 py-1 rounded bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-sm">Reopen</button>
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="saved-delete px-2 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-sm text-white">Delete</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-300 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                        <div><span class="text-gray-400">Date/Time:</span> ${p.eventDate || '—'}${p.eventTime ? ' ' + p.eventTime : ''}</div>
                                        <div><span class="text-gray-400">Location:</span> ${p.location || '—'}</div>
