                                        <div><span class="text-gray-400">Salesperson:</span> ${p.salesperson || '—'}</div>
                                        <div><span class="text-gray-400">Venue:</span> ${p.venue || '—'}</div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                        ${savedProjects.length === 0 ? '<div class="text-sm text-gray-400 p-3">No saved shows yet. Mark a project as saved from the Shows tab.</div>' : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            // Wire actions (Activate/Export removed as requested)
            mainContent.saved.querySelectorAll('.saved-reopen').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                const id = parseInt(ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id'));
                const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                if (!proj) return;
                proj.status = 'draft';
                state.activeProjectId = proj.id;
                state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId = proj.id;
                persistProjects();
                showNotification(`Reopened "${proj.name}"`);
                switchTab('designer');
            }));
            mainContent.saved.querySelectorAll('.saved-delete').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', async (ev) => {
                const id = parseInt(ev.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id'));
                if (Number.isNaN(id)) return;
                const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                const ok = await showConfirm(`Delete project "${proj?.name || 'this project'}"? This cannot be undone.`, 'Delete', 'Cancel');
                if (!ok) return;
                if (deleteProjectById(id)) {
                    setTimeout(() => { renderSaved(); }, 0);
                }
            }));
        };

        // Circular LED calculator with visual ring preview
        const renderCircularLed = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const projectName = project ? project.name : '—';
            const host = mainContent['circular-led'];
            if (!host) return;

            host.innerHTML = `
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                    <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-4">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">Circular LED Calculator</h2>
                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-400">Project: ${projectName}</div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Outer diameter D
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                                    <input id="cl-D" type="number" step="0.001" value="2.0" class="flex-1 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                                    <select id="cl-D-unit" class="w-20 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm">
                                        <option value="m" selected>m</option>
                                        <option value="mm">mm</option>
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                            </label>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Inner diameter d (optional)
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                                    <input id="cl-d" type="number" step="0.001" value="0" class="flex-1 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                                    <select id="cl-d-unit" class="w-20 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm">
                                        <option value="m" selected>m</option>
                                        <option value="mm">mm</option>
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                            </label>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Pixel pitch p (mm)
                                <input id="cl-pitch" type="number" step="0.01" value="2.5" class="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                            </label>
                            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Panel width Wp (mm)
                                    <input id="cl-mod-w" type="number" step="1" value="500" class="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                                </label>
                                <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Panel height Hp (mm)
                                    <input id="cl-mod-h" type="number" step="1" value="500" class="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                                </label>
                            </div>
                            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Panel pixels Px (W)
                                    <input id="cl-mod-px-w" type="number" step="1" value="128" class="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                                </label>
                                <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Panel pixels Py (H)
                                    <input id="cl-mod-px-h" type="number" step="1" value="128" class="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                                </label>
                            </div>
                            <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">Power density Pd (W/m²)
                                <input id="cl-power-density" type="number" step="1" value="450" class="mt-1 w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm"/>
                            </label>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-gray-300 pt-2 flex-wrap">
                                <label class="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><input id="cl-show-modules" type="checkbox" class="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-600 bg-gray-800"/> Show panel divisions</label>
                                <label class="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><input id="cl-show-measure" type="checkbox" class="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-600 bg-gray-800" checked/> Show circle measurements</label>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Radius R</div>
                                <div id="cl-radius" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Diameter D</div>
                                <div id="cl-diameter" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Circumference C</div>
                                <div id="cl-circ" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Inner circumference</div>
                                <div id="cl-inner-circ" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Inner radius</div>
                                <div id="cl-inner-radius" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Inner diameter</div>
                                <div id="cl-inner-diameter" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Pixels around N0 (ceil)</div>
                                <div id="cl-Nh" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Pixels vertical (full D) N9 (ceil)</div>
                                <div id="cl-Nv" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Radial pixels if ring (D-d)/p</div>
                                <div id="cl-Nv-ring" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2 md:col-span-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Total pixels (using ring if d>0)</div>
                                <div id="cl-total-px" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Panels around (phys)</div>
                                <div id="cl-mods-h-phys" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Angle between panels (phys)</div>
                                <div id="cl-angle-per" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Panels vertical (phys)</div>
                                <div id="cl-mods-v-phys" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Panels around (by pixels)</div>
                                <div id="cl-mods-h-px" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Panels vertical (by pixels)</div>
                                <div id="cl-mods-v-px" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2 md:col-span-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Total panels</div>
                                <div id="cl-total-mods" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Area (outer/ring)</div>
                                <div id="cl-area" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Power estimate</div>
                                <div id="cl-power" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded px-3 py-2 md:col-span-2">
                                <div class="text-gray-400">Recommended closest viewing distance</div>
                                <div id="cl-viewing" class="text-gray-100 mt-1">—</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg">
                        <canvas id="cl-preview" class="w-full h-[520px] bg-gray-900 rounded" style="display:block; image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const g = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
            const out = (id, v) => { const el = g(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };

            // compute + draw
            const update = () => {
                // inputs
                let D = Number(g('cl-D')?.value) || 0; const Du = g('cl-D-unit')?.value || 'm';
                let d = Number(g('cl-d')?.value) || 0; const du = g('cl-d-unit')?.value || 'm';
                if (Du === 'mm') D /= 1000; // convert to meters
                if (du === 'mm') d /= 1000;
                d = Math.min(d, D); if (d < 0) d = 0;
                const pitch_mm = Math.max(0.1, Number(g('cl-pitch')?.value) || 1);
                const Wm_mm = Math.max(1, Number(g('cl-mod-w')?.value) || 320);
                const Hm_mm = Math.max(1, Number(g('cl-mod-h')?.value) || 160);
                const Px = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(g('cl-mod-px-w')?.value) || 0));
                const Py = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(g('cl-mod-px-h')?.value) || 0));
                const Pd = Math.max(1, Number(g('cl-power-density')?.value) || 450);
                const showModules = !!g('cl-show-modules')?.checked;

                // geometry
                const R = Math.max(0, D/2);
                const C_m = Math.PI * D; // meters
                const C_mm = C_m * 1000;
                const innerC_m = d > 0 ? Math.PI * d : 0;

                // pixel counts
                const D_mm = D * 1000;
                const d_mm = d * 1000;
                const Nh = Math.ceil(C_mm / pitch_mm);
                const Nv_full = Math.ceil(D_mm / pitch_mm);
                const Nv_ring = d > 0 ? Math.ceil(Math.max(0, (D_mm - d_mm)) / pitch_mm) : 0;
                const N_vertical = d > 0 ? Nv_ring : Nv_full;
                const N_total = Nh * N_vertical;

                // modules (physical)
                const mods_h_phys = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(C_mm / Wm_mm));
                const modSpan_mm = d > 0 ? (D_mm - d_mm) : D_mm;
                const mods_v_phys = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(modSpan_mm / Hm_mm));

                // modules (by pixels)
                const mods_h_px = Px > 0 ? Math.ceil(Nh / Px) : 0;
                const mods_v_px = Py > 0 ? Math.ceil(N_vertical / Py) : 0;

                // choose a total modules to display (prefer pixel-based if set)
                const totalModsPhys = mods_h_phys && mods_v_phys ? mods_h_phys * mods_v_phys : 0;
                const totalModsPx = mods_h_px && mods_v_px ? mods_h_px * mods_v_px : 0;
                const totalModsOut = totalModsPx || totalModsPhys;

                // area and power
                const outerArea = Math.PI * Math.pow(D/2, 2);
                const ringArea = d > 0 ? Math.PI * (Math.pow(D/2,2) - Math.pow(d/2,2)) : outerArea;
                const powerW = ringArea * Pd;

                // outputs
                out('cl-radius', `${R.toFixed(3)} m`);
                out('cl-diameter', `${D.toFixed(3)} m (${(D*1000).toFixed(0)} mm)`);
                out('cl-circ', `${C_m.toFixed(3)} m (${C_mm.toFixed(0)} mm)`);
                out('cl-inner-circ', d>0 ? `${innerC_m.toFixed(3)} m` : '—');
                out('cl-inner-radius', d>0 ? `${(d/2).toFixed(3)} m` : '—');
                out('cl-inner-diameter', d>0 ? `${d.toFixed(3)} m (${(d*1000).toFixed(0)} mm)` : '—');
                out('cl-Nh', `${Nh.toLocaleString()} px`);
                out('cl-Nv', `${Nv_full.toLocaleString()} px`);
                out('cl-Nv-ring', d>0 ? `${Nv_ring.toLocaleString()} px` : '—');
                out('cl-total-px', `${N_total.toLocaleString()} px`);
                out('cl-mods-h-phys', mods_h_phys ? `${mods_h_phys.toLocaleString()}` : '—');
                // Angle per panel from physical width around the outer circle: theta = 2*asin((Wm/1000)/(2*R)) in radians
                let anglePerDeg = '—';
                if (R > 0 && Wm_mm > 0 && (Wm_mm/1000) < 2*R) {
                    const theta = 2 * Math.asin((Wm_mm/1000) / (2*R));
                    anglePerDeg = (theta * 180/Math.PI).toFixed(2) + '°';
                }
                out('cl-angle-per', anglePerDeg);
                out('cl-mods-v-phys', mods_v_phys ? `${mods_v_phys.toLocaleString()}` : '—');
                out('cl-mods-h-px', mods_h_px ? `${mods_h_px.toLocaleString()}` : '—');
                out('cl-mods-v-px', mods_v_px ? `${mods_v_px.toLocaleString()}` : '—');
                out('cl-total-mods', totalModsOut ? `${totalModsOut.toLocaleString()} (phys: ${totalModsPhys.toLocaleString()} | px: ${totalModsPx.toLocaleString()})` : '—');
                out('cl-area', d>0 ? `${ringArea.toFixed(3)} m² (outer ${outerArea.toFixed(3)} m²)` : `${outerArea.toFixed(3)} m²`);
                const minView = 0.3 * (pitch_mm / 1.0) / 1000; // meters
                out('cl-power', `${powerW.toFixed(0)} W @ ${Pd} W/m²`);
                out('cl-viewing', `≈ ${minView.toFixed(2)} m (rule: 0.3 × pitch_mm)`);

                // draw
                const canvas = g('cl-preview');
                if (!canvas) return;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                const w = Math.max(320, Math.floor(rect.width));
                const h = Math.max(320, Math.floor(rect.height));
                if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) { canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; }
                ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);

                const pad = 30;
                // scale to fit outer diameter
                const outerRadiusPx = Math.min((w - pad*2), (h - pad*2)) / 2;
                const scale = D > 0 ? outerRadiusPx / (D/2) : 1; // px per meter
                const innerRadiusPx = d > 0 ? (d/2) * scale : 0;

                const cx = w/2, cy = h/2;
                // background ring
                ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1220';
                ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

                // outer circle
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#60a5fa';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerRadiusPx, 0, Math.PI*2);
                ctx.stroke();

                // inner circle (if ring)
                if (d > 0) {
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, innerRadiusPx, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    // fill ring lightly
                    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,innerRadiusPx, cx,cy,outerRadiusPx);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(59,130,246,0.10)');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(59,130,246,0.25)');
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerRadiusPx, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, innerRadiusPx, 0, Math.PI*2, true);
                    ctx.closePath();
                    ctx.fill();
                } else {
                    // filled disc
                    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,outerRadiusPx*0.1, cx,cy,outerRadiusPx);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(59,130,246,0.20)');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(59,130,246,0.35)');
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerRadiusPx, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }

                if (showModules) {
                    // radial divisions (modules around based on physical size)
                    const around = Math.max(0, mods_h_phys);
                    if (around > 1) {
                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#93c5fd';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                        for (let k=0;k<around;k++) {
                            const a = (k/around) * Math.PI*2;
                            const x1 = cx + (innerRadiusPx>0?innerRadiusPx:0) * Math.cos(a);
                            const y1 = cy + (innerRadiusPx>0?innerRadiusPx:0) * Math.sin(a);
                            const x2 = cx + outerRadiusPx * Math.cos(a);
                            const y2 = cy + outerRadiusPx * Math.sin(a);
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);
                            ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                        // visualize angle between two adjacent panels on the outer edge
                        if (around >= 3) {
                            const a1 = 0;
                            const a2 = (1/around) * Math.PI*2;
                            const rArc = innerRadiusPx>0 ? innerRadiusPx + (outerRadiusPx-innerRadiusPx)*0.9 : outerRadiusPx*0.9;
                            ctx.strokeStyle = '#22c55e';
                            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(cx, cy, rArc, a1, a2);
                            ctx.stroke();
                            // label at arc midpoint
                            const amid = (a1+a2)/2;
                            const tx = cx + (rArc+12) * Math.cos(amid);
                            const ty = cy + (rArc+12) * Math.sin(amid);
                            ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
                            ctx.font = '12px monospace';
                            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                            // compute same angle as above for label (deg)
                            let anglePer = 0;
                            if (R > 0 && Wm_mm > 0 && (Wm_mm/1000) < 2*R) {
                                anglePer = 2 * Math.asin((Wm_mm/1000) / (2*R)) * 180/Math.PI;
                            } else {
                                anglePer = 360/around;
                            }
                            ctx.fillText(`${anglePer.toFixed(2)}°`, tx, ty);
                        }
                        // numeric labels for each panel (limit to avoid clutter)
                        if (around <= 96) {
                            const rLabel = innerRadiusPx>0 ? (innerRadiusPx + (outerRadiusPx-innerRadiusPx)*0.55) : (outerRadiusPx*0.82);
                            ctx.fillStyle = '#e5e7eb';
                            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
                            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                            ctx.font = '11px monospace';
                            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                            for (let k=0;k<around;k++) {
                                const aMid = ((k+0.5)/around) * Math.PI*2;
                                const tx = cx + rLabel * Math.cos(aMid);
                                const ty = cy + rLabel * Math.sin(aMid) + 3; // slight vertical offset
                                // outline for contrast
                                ctx.save();
                                ctx.miterLimit = 2;
                                ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
                                ctx.strokeText(String(k+1), tx, ty);
                                ctx.fillText(String(k+1), tx, ty);
                                ctx.restore();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // concentric rings (vertical modules by physical height)
                    const bands = Math.max(0, mods_v_phys);
                    if (bands > 1) {
                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                        const bandThicknessPx = (Hm_mm/1000) * scale;
                        for (let i=1;i<bands;i++) {
                            const r = outerRadiusPx - i*bandThicknessPx;
                            if (r <= innerRadiusPx + 1) break;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                        // summary label for counts
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#cbd5e1';
                        ctx.font = '12px monospace';
                        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                        ctx.fillText(`${around} around × ${bands} vertical (by ${Math.round(Wm_mm)}×${Math.round(Hm_mm)} mm)`, cx, h - 8);
                    }
                }

                // measurement overlays (C, D, R) similar to the reference — for outer and inner when present
                const showMeasure = !!g('cl-show-measure')?.checked;
                if (showMeasure) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#22c55e';
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.setLineDash([4,3]);
                    // dotted circles: outer and inner (if any)
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, outerRadiusPx*0.96, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    if (d > 0) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(cx, cy, Math.max(2, innerRadiusPx*0.96), 0, Math.PI*2);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    ctx.setLineDash([]);

                    // diameter lines (horizontal), offset slightly to avoid overlap
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(cx - outerRadiusPx*0.95, cy);
                    ctx.lineTo(cx + outerRadiusPx*0.95, cy);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.fillText(`D: ${D.toFixed(2)} m`, cx, cy - 6);
                    if (d > 0) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(cx - innerRadiusPx*0.95, cy + 14);
                        ctx.lineTo(cx + innerRadiusPx*0.95, cy + 14);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.fillText(`d: ${d.toFixed(2)} m`, cx, cy + 10);
                    }

                    // radius lines (to the right), offset for inner
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
                    ctx.lineTo(cx + outerRadiusPx*0.95, cy);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.fillText(`R: ${(D/2).toFixed(2)} m`, cx + outerRadiusPx*0.5, cy - 8);
                    if (d > 0) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + 14);
                        ctx.lineTo(cx + innerRadiusPx*0.95, cy + 14);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.fillText(`r: ${(d/2).toFixed(2)} m`, cx + innerRadiusPx*0.5, cy + 6);
                    }

                    // circumference labels near top for both
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.fillText(`C: ${(Math.PI*D).toFixed(2)} m`, cx, cy - outerRadiusPx + 16);
                    if (d > 0) ctx.fillText(`c: ${(Math.PI*d).toFixed(2)} m`, cx, cy - innerRadiusPx + 16);
                    ctx.restore();
                }
                // labels
                ctx.fillStyle = '#d1d5db';
                ctx.font = '12px monospace';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText(`${(D).toFixed(2)} m outer D`, cx, pad + 12);
                if (d > 0) ctx.fillText(`${(d).toFixed(2)} m inner d`, cx, h - pad + 12);
            };

            // wire inputs
            ['cl-D','cl-D-unit','cl-d','cl-d-unit','cl-pitch','cl-mod-w','cl-mod-h','cl-mod-px-w','cl-mod-px-h','cl-power-density','cl-show-modules','cl-show-measure']
                .forEach(id => { const el = g(id); if (!el) return; el.addEventListener('input', update); el.addEventListener('change', update); });

            // initial
            setTimeout(update, 0);
        };

    const renderLedPatching = () => {
            // Restored manual arrow patching UI with processor management and capacity warnings
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();

            mainContent.ledPatching.innerHTML = `
                <div class="bg-gray-800 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                    <div class="col-span-1">
                        <div class="flex flex-col h-full gap-4">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">LED Patching</h2>
                                <div class="text-sm text-gray-400">Project: ${state.projects.find(p=>p.id===state.activeProjectId)?.name || '—'}</div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-4 space-y-4">
                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-accent">Processors</h3>
                                <div class="flex gap-2">
                                    <select id="novastar-processor-select" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm w-full">
                                        <option value="">-- Select a model to add --</option>
                                        ${Object.keys(novastarCatalog).map(cat => `
                                            <optgroup label="${cat}">
                                                ${novastarCatalog[cat].map(m => `<option value="${m}">${m}</option>`).join('')}
                                            </optgroup>
                                        `).join('')}
                                    </select>
                                    <button id="add-novastar-processor" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Add</button>
                                </div>

                                <div id="processors-list" class="space-y-2 text-sm"></div>

                                <div id="processors-summary" class="text-sm text-gray-300"></div>

                                <div class="flex gap-2">
                                    <button id="review-processors-db" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">Review DB</button>
                                    <button id="auto-calc-processors" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Auto-calc</button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-4 space-y-3">
                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-accent">Allocation & Exports</h3>
                                <div id="capacity-warnings" class="text-sm text-yellow-300"></div>
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <label class="text-sm text-gray-400">Pixels per CAT6:</label>
                                    <input id="pixels-per-cable" type="number" value="${state.pdfExport && state.pdfExport.pixelsPerCable ? state.pdfExport.pixelsPerCable : 65536}" class="w-32 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm text-gray-200" />
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex gap-2">
                                    <button id="export-alloc-csv" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">Export Alloc CSV</button>
                                    <button id="export-alloc-pdf" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Export Alloc PDF</button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="col-span-2">
                        <div class="bg-gray-900 rounded-lg p-4 h-full flex flex-col gap-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-accent">Preview</h3>
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <button id="toggle-arrow-mode" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Add Arrow</button>
                                    <button id="clear-patches" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">Clear</button>
                                    <button id="auto-patch-arrows" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Auto Patch</button>
                                    <button id="export-overlay-png" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Overlay PNG</button>
                                    <button id="export-summary-png" class="px-3 py-2 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">Summary PNG</button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="flex-1 bg-black rounded overflow-hidden relative">
                                <canvas id="led-patching-canvas" style="display:block; width:100%; height:80vh; image-rendering: pixelated;"></canvas>
                                <div id="led-patch-overlay" class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-auto"></div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-400">Tip: Use Auto Patch to generate arrows, or Add Arrow to draw manually.</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            // ensure patches storage
            if (!state.pdfExport.ledPatching) state.pdfExport.ledPatching = { patches: [] };
            if (!Array.isArray(state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches)) state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches = [];

            const selectEl = document.getElementById('novastar-processor-select');
            const addBtn = document.getElementById('add-novastar-processor');
            const reviewBtn = document.getElementById('review-processors-db');
            const processorsList = document.getElementById('processors-list');
            const summaryEl = document.getElementById('processors-summary');
            const previewCanvas = document.getElementById('led-patching-canvas');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('led-patch-overlay');
            const toggleArrowBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-arrow-mode');
            const clearBtn = document.getElementById('clear-patches');
            const warningsEl = document.getElementById('capacity-warnings');

            // draw active map into the preview canvas
            if (previewCanvas && activeMap) {
                try { drawVisualizerCanvas(previewCanvas, activeMap); } catch (e) { console.warn('drawVisualizerCanvas error', e); }
            }

            const renderProcessorsList = () => {
                processorsList.innerHTML = '';
                const procs = state.hardware && state.hardware.processors ? state.hardware.processors : [];
                procs.forEach(p => {
                    const info = processorsDB[p.model] || {};
                    const total = p.pixels || info.totalPixels || null;
                    const perPort = info.perPortEstimate || null;
                    const el = document.createElement('div');
                    el.className = 'bg-gray-800 p-2 rounded flex items-center justify-between';
                    el.innerHTML = `<div class="text-sm text-gray-200">${p.model} <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">${total ? ` — ${total.toLocaleString()} px` : ''}${perPort ? ` | per-port: ${perPort.toLocaleString()}` : ''}</span>
                                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1" data-breakdown-id="${p.id}"></div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                                            <button data-id="${p.id}" class="remove-proc px-2 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 text-xs">Remove</button>
                                        </div>`;
                    processorsList.appendChild(el);
                });
                // summary
                const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap) || {};
                const mapPixels = calcs.totalPixels || 0;
                const totalCapacity = (state.hardware.processors || []).reduce((s, pr) => s + (pr.pixels || (processorsDB[pr.model] && processorsDB[pr.model].totalPixels) || 0), 0);
                summaryEl.innerHTML = `Total map pixels: <strong>${mapPixels ? mapPixels.toLocaleString() : 'N/A'}</strong><br/>Total processors capacity: <strong>${totalCapacity ? totalCapacity.toLocaleString() : 'N/A'}</strong>`;

                // capacity warnings
                warningsEl.innerHTML = '';
                if (mapPixels && totalCapacity && totalCapacity < mapPixels) {
                    warningsEl.innerHTML = `<div class="text-sm text-red-400">Warning: total processor capacity is less than map pixels. You will not be able to drive the full map. (${totalCapacity.toLocaleString()} < ${mapPixels.toLocaleString()})</div>`;
                }

                // per-port allocation simulation and per-processor breakdown
                const sim = simulatePerPortAllocation(state.hardware.processors || [], mapPixels || 0);
                (sim || []).forEach(procSim => {
                    const el = processorsList.querySelector(`[data-breakdown-id="${procSim.id}"]`);
                    if (!el) return;
                    // build small inline bars (text based)
                    const portInfo = procSim.ports.map((v, idx) => {
                        const warn = procSim.perPortLimit && v > procSim.perPortLimit ? '⚠️' : '';
                        return `Port ${idx+1}: ${v.toLocaleString()} ${warn}`;
                    }).join(' | ');
                    el.textContent = portInfo;
                });

                // wire remove buttons
                const removeBtns = processorsList.querySelectorAll('.remove-proc');
                removeBtns.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                    const id = b.getAttribute('data-id');
                    const idx = state.hardware.processors.findIndex(pp => pp.id === id);
                    if (idx > -1) state.hardware.processors.splice(idx, 1);
                    renderLedPatching();
                }));
            };

        // Block-based per-port allocation: distribute in blocks of size `blockSize` for faster, representative mapping
        // Returns array [{ id, model, perPortLimit, ports: [usage,...] }]
        const simulatePerPortAllocation = (processors, totalPixels, blockSize = 1024) => {
            if (!processors || processors.length === 0) return [];
            // Build pool of ports
            const portPool = [];
            processors.forEach(p => {
                const info = processorsDB[p.model] || {};
                const perPortLimit = info.perPortEstimate || Math.floor((p.pixels || info.totalPixels || 65536) / (info.ethernetPorts || 1));
                const ethernetPorts = info.ethernetPorts || Math.max(1, Math.floor((p.pixels || info.totalPixels || 65536) / (perPortLimit || 1)));
                const procEntry = { id: p.id, model: p.model, perPortLimit, ethernetPorts, ports: new Array(ethernetPorts).fill(0) };
                for (let i=0;i<ethernetPorts;i++) portPool.push({ procEntry, portIndex: i });
            });

            if (portPool.length === 0) return [];

            let remaining = totalPixels;
            // allocate in blocks to reduce iterations
            const blocks = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(remaining / blockSize));
            let blockIdx = 0;
            while (remaining > 0 && blockIdx < blocks) {
                const slot = portPool[blockIdx % portPool.length];
                const alloc = Math.min(blockSize, remaining);
                slot.procEntry.ports[slot.portIndex] += alloc;
                remaining -= alloc;
                blockIdx++;
            }

            // aggregate
            const resultMap = new Map();
            portPool.forEach(p => {
                const id = p.procEntry.id;
                if (!resultMap.has(id)) resultMap.set(id, { id, model: p.procEntry.model, perPortLimit: p.procEntry.perPortLimit, ports: [...p.procEntry.ports] });
            });
            return Array.from(resultMap.values());
    };

            // Add processor
            if (addBtn && selectEl) {
                addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const model = selectEl.value;
                    if (!model) { showNotification('Select a processor model first'); return; }
                    const id = `proc-${Date.now()}`;
                    const info = processorsDB[model] || {};
                    const pixels = info.totalPixels || 65536;
                    state.hardware.processors.push({ id, model, pixels });
                    showNotification(`Added ${model}`);
                    renderLedPatching();
                });
            }

            if (reviewBtn) reviewBtn.addEventListener('click', () => renderProcessorsDbReview());
            const pixelsPerCableInput = document.getElementById('pixels-per-cable');
            const exportOverlayBtn = document.getElementById('export-overlay-png');
            const exportSummaryBtn = document.getElementById('export-summary-png');
            const autoCalcBtn = document.getElementById('auto-calc-processors');
            const autoPatchBtn = document.getElementById('auto-patch-arrows');
            const exportAllocCsvBtn = document.getElementById('export-alloc-csv');

            if (exportOverlayBtn) exportOverlayBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportOverlayAsPng());
            if (exportSummaryBtn) exportSummaryBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportPatchSummaryAsPng());
            if (autoCalcBtn) autoCalcBtn.addEventListener('click', () => runAutoCalcProcessors());
            if (autoPatchBtn) autoPatchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => runAutoArrowPatching());
            if (exportAllocCsvBtn) exportAllocCsvBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportPerPortCsv());
            if (pixelsPerCableInput) pixelsPerCableInput.addEventListener('change', () => { try { state.pdfExport.pixelsPerCable = Number(pixelsPerCableInput.value) || 65536; } catch(e){} });

            // Rendering arrows as SVG over the overlay
            const renderArrows = () => {
                if (!overlay || !previewCanvas) return;
                // Use the visible/displayed size (bounding rect) so SVG coords map directly to screen pixels
                const rect = previewCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                const w = rect.width || previewCanvas.width || 1;
                const h = rect.height || previewCanvas.height || 1;
                // ensure overlay sits on top visually
                try { overlay.style.zIndex = 50; } catch (e) {}

                const patches = state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches || [];
                // SVG set to fill the overlay div; use viewBox in the same pixel space as the rect
                const svgParts = [`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" preserveAspectRatio="none" width="${w}" height="${h}" style="display:block; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none;">`,
                    `<defs><marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto"><polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#f59e0b" /></marker></defs>`];

                patches.filter(p => p.mapId == (activeMap && activeMap.id)).forEach((p, idx) => {
                    // Use explicit null/undefined checks so valid 0 coords are preserved
                    const nx1 = (p.x1 != null) ? p.x1 : p.x;
                    const ny1 = (p.y1 != null) ? p.y1 : p.y;
                    const nx2 = (p.x2 != null) ? p.x2 : p.x;
                    const ny2 = (p.y2 != null) ? p.y2 : p.y;
                    const x1 = (Number(nx1) || 0) * w;
                    const y1 = (Number(ny1) || 0) * h;
                    const x2 = (Number(nx2) || 0) * w;
                    const y2 = (Number(ny2) || 0) * h;
                    // determine color: overloaded if flagged
                    const overloaded = !!p.overloaded;
                    const stroke = overloaded ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b';
                    svgParts.push(`<line x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>`);
                    // label with port and count near mid point
                    const label = p.processorId ? `P:${p.processorModel || ''} Port:${p.portIndex != null ? p.portIndex+1 : ''} (${p.count || 1})` : `${p.count || 1}`;
                    const labelColor = overloaded ? '#ffdddd' : '#f59e0b';
                    const midX = (x1 + x2) / 2;
                    const midY = (y1 + y2) / 2 - 8;
                    svgParts.push(`<text x="${midX}" y="${midY}" fill="${labelColor}" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">${label}</text>`);
                });
                // Render tile markers (if panel details exist on patches)
                try {
                    const calcs = (activeMap && calculateLayout(activeMap)) || null;
                    if (calcs && calcs.totalResWidth && activeMap && activeMap.panelResWidth) {
                        // tile display size in SVG pixel space
                        const tileW = (activeMap.panelResWidth / calcs.totalResWidth) * w;
                        const tileH = (activeMap.panelResHeight / calcs.totalResHeight) * h;
                        const maxMarker = Math.min(Math.max(6, Math.min(tileW, tileH) * 0.25), 18);
                        patches.filter(p => p.mapId == (activeMap && activeMap.id)).forEach((p) => {
                            if (p.panelIndex == null) return;
                            const cx = (Number(p.x2 || p.x) || 0) * w;
                            const cy = (Number(p.y2 || p.y) || 0) * h;
                            let fill = '#10b981'; // green = assigned
                            if (p.portStatus === 'portFull') fill = '#f59e0b';
                            if (p.portStatus === 'unassigned' || p.overloaded) fill = '#ef4444';
                            const strokeCol = '#111827';
                            const title = `Tile ${p.panelX},${p.panelY} - ${p.portStatus || (p.overloaded ? 'overloaded' : 'assigned')}${p.processorModel ? ' (' + p.processorModel + ' p' + (p.portIndex!=null? (p.portIndex+1):'') + ')': ''}`;
                            svgParts.push(`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${maxMarker}" fill="${fill}" stroke="${strokeCol}" stroke-width="1.5"><title>${title}</title></circle>`);
                        });
                        // Legend (small) in the top-left corner
                        const legendX = 8;
                        const legendY = 12;
                        svgParts.push(`<rect x="${legendX-6}" y="${legendY-10}" width="120" height="36" rx="4" fill="rgba(17,24,39,0.6)" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.04)"/>`);
                        svgParts.push(`<circle cx="${legendX+6}" cy="${legendY+4}" r="6" fill="#10b981" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1"/>`);
                        svgParts.push(`<text x="${legendX+20}" y="${legendY+7}" fill="#d1fae5" font-size="10">Assigned</text>`);
                        svgParts.push(`<circle cx="${legendX+6}" cy="${legendY+20}" r="6" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1"/>`);
                        svgParts.push(`<text x="${legendX+20}" y="${legendY+23}" fill="#fff7ed" font-size="10">Port Full</text>`);
                        svgParts.push(`<circle cx="${legendX+80}" cy="${legendY+20}" r="6" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1"/>`);
                        svgParts.push(`<text x="${legendX+94}" y="${legendY+23}" fill="#ffebee" font-size="10">Unassigned</text>`);
                    }
                } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }
                svgParts.push('</svg>');
                overlay.innerHTML = svgParts.join('');
            };

            // Arrow creation mode
            let arrowMode = false;
            let tempStart = null;
            if (toggleArrowBtn) {
                toggleArrowBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    arrowMode = !arrowMode;
                    toggleArrowBtn.textContent = arrowMode ? 'Exit Arrow Mode' : 'Add Arrow';
                    tempStart = null;
                });
            }

            if (previewCanvas && overlay) {
                overlay.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                    if (!arrowMode) return;
                    const rect = previewCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const scaleX = previewCanvas.width / rect.width;
                    const scaleY = previewCanvas.height / rect.height;
                    const x = (ev.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
                    const y = (ev.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
                    const nx = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x / (previewCanvas.width || rect.width)));
                    const ny = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y / (previewCanvas.height || rect.height)));
                    if (!tempStart) {
                        tempStart = { x: nx, y: ny };
                        showNotification('Start point set — click end point to finish the arrow.');
                    } else {
                        const patch = { id: 'patch-' + Date.now(), mapId: activeMap ? activeMap.id : null, x1: tempStart.x, y1: tempStart.y, x2: nx, y2: ny, count: 1 };
                        state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches.push(patch);
                        tempStart = null;
                        renderArrows();
                        showNotification('Arrow added');
                    }
                });
            }

            if (clearBtn) {
                clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches = [];
                    renderArrows();
                    showNotification('Patches cleared');
                });
            }

            renderProcessorsList();
            renderArrows();
        };

                // Create arrow patches automatically by assigning tiles (panels) to processor ports.
                // This does a tile-by-tile assignment: each panel (tile) is either assigned to a port that has
                // enough per-port capacity (in pixels) or marked overloaded/unassigned. When a port reaches
                // its limit, subsequent tiles will be assigned elsewhere and tiles assigned at the moment a port
                // becomes full will be flagged so the UI can draw a different color/symbol.
                const runAutoArrowPatching = () => {
                    const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
                    if (!activeMap) { showNotification('No active pixel map selected'); return; }
                    const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap) || {};
                    if (!calcs.totalResWidth) { showNotification('Active map has no pixel calculation'); return; }

                    // Clear existing patches for this map
                    state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches = state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches.filter(p => p.mapId != activeMap.id);

                    const panelPixels = (activeMap.panelResWidth || 0) * (activeMap.panelResHeight || 0);
                    if (!panelPixels) { showNotification('Panel resolution missing (cannot assign tiles)'); return; }

                    // Build a flat list of ports with their remaining capacity
                    const ports = [];
                    state.hardware.processors = state.hardware.processors || [];
                    state.hardware.processors.forEach((proc, procIdx) => {
                        const info = processorsDB[proc.model] || {};
                        const perPortEstimate = info.perPortEstimate || Math.floor((proc.pixels || info.totalPixels || 65536) / (info.ethernetPorts || 1));
                        const ethernetPorts = info.ethernetPorts || Math.max(1, Math.floor((proc.pixels || info.totalPixels || 65536) / (perPortEstimate || 1)));
                        for (let pi = 0; pi < ethernetPorts; pi++) {
                            ports.push({ procId: proc.id, procModel: proc.model, procIdx, portIndex: pi, capacity: perPortEstimate, remaining: perPortEstimate, assignedPanels: [], full: false });
                        }
                    });

                    // Helper: find first port with enough remaining capacity for one full panel
                    const findPortForPanel = () => {
                        for (let i = 0; i < ports.length; i++) {
                            if (!ports[i].full && ports[i].remaining >= panelPixels) return ports[i];
                        }
                        return null;
                    };

                    // Iterate through tiles (panels) left-to-right, top-to-bottom and assign each tile to a port
                    let tileIndex = 0;
                    for (let y = 0; y < calcs.panelsVertically; y++) {
                        for (let x = 0; x < calcs.panelsHorizontally; x++) {
                            const posX = x * activeMap.panelResWidth;
                            const posY = y * activeMap.panelResHeight;
                            const centerX = posX + activeMap.panelResWidth / 2;
                            const centerY = posY + activeMap.panelResHeight / 2;
                            const nx = centerX / calcs.totalResWidth;
                            const ny = centerY / calcs.totalResHeight;

                            const port = findPortForPanel();
                            if (port) {
                                // Assign tile to this port
                                port.assignedPanels.push(tileIndex);
                                port.remaining -= panelPixels;
                                if (port.remaining < panelPixels) port.full = true; // becomes full (no more whole tiles)
                                const startX = 0.03; // near left edge where processors are visually located
                                // stagger startY by processor/port index so arrows don't overlap exactly
                                const totalPorts = ports.length || 1;
                                const globalPortIndex = port.procIdx * (processorsDB[port.procModel]?.ethernetPorts || 1) + port.portIndex;
                                const startY = 0.08 + 0.8 * (globalPortIndex / Math.max(1, totalPorts - 1));
                                const status = port.full ? 'portFull' : 'assigned';
                                const patch = {
                                    id: `auto-patch-${Date.now()}-${tileIndex}`,
                                    mapId: activeMap.id,
                                    x1: startX,
                                    y1: startY,
                                    x2: nx,
                                    y2: ny,
                                    count: 1,
                                    processorId: port.procId,
                                    processorModel: port.procModel,
                                    portIndex: port.portIndex,
                                    portStatus: status,
                                    panelIndex: tileIndex,
                                    panelX: x,
                                    panelY: y,
                                    panelPixels: panelPixels,
                                    overloaded: false
                                };
                                state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches.push(patch);
                            } else {
                                // No port available for this tile -> mark overloaded/unassigned
                                const startX = 0.03;
                                const startY = 0.5; // default
                                const patch = {
                                    id: `auto-patch-unassigned-${Date.now()}-${tileIndex}`,
                                    mapId: activeMap.id,
                                    x1: startX,
                                    y1: startY,
                                    x2: nx,
                                    y2: ny,
                                    count: 1,
                                    processorId: null,
                                    processorModel: null,
                                    portIndex: null,
                                    portStatus: 'unassigned',
                                    panelIndex: tileIndex,
                                    panelX: x,
                                    panelY: y,
                                    panelPixels: panelPixels,
                                    overloaded: true
                                };
                                state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches.push(patch);
                            }
                            tileIndex++;
                        }
                    }

                    renderLedPatching();
                    showNotification('Auto patching complete (tile-by-tile assignment)');
                };

        // Export per-port allocation as CSV
        const exportPerPortCsv = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap) || {};
            const totalPixels = calcs.totalPixels || 0;
            const sim = simulatePerPortAllocation(state.hardware.processors || [], totalPixels || 0);
            const rows = [['processorId','model','portIndex','portUsage','perPortLimit','overloaded']];
            sim.forEach(proc => {
                proc.ports.forEach((usage, idx) => {
                    rows.push([proc.id, proc.model, idx+1, usage, proc.perPortLimit || '', (proc.perPortLimit && usage > proc.perPortLimit) ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE']);
                });
            });
            const csv = rows.map(r => r.map(c => typeof c === 'string' && c.includes(',') ? `"${c}"` : c).join(',')).join('\n');
            const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'per-port-allocation.csv'; a.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            showNotification('Per-port allocation CSV exported');
        };

        // Export overlay (canvas + SVG overlay) as a PNG for video techs
        const exportOverlayAsPng = async () => {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('led-patching-canvas');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('led-patch-overlay');
            if (!canvas) { showNotification('No preview canvas available'); return; }

            // Render canvas to an offscreen canvas and draw SVG overlay on top
            try {
                const w = canvas.width;
                const h = canvas.height;
                const out = document.createElement('canvas');
                out.width = w; out.height = h;
                const ctx = out.getContext('2d');
                // draw the preview canvas
                ctx.drawImage(canvas, 0, 0, w, h);
                // draw SVG overlay by serializing and drawing as image
                if (overlay && overlay.innerHTML.trim()) {
                    const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${w}" height="${h}">` + overlay.innerHTML + `</svg>`;
                    const img = new Image();
                    const svgBlob = new Blob([svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
                    await new Promise((res, rej) => {
                        img.onload = () => { ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); res(); };
                        img.onerror = (e) => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); rej(e); };
                        img.src = url;
                    });
                }
                // download
                const dataUrl = out.toDataURL('image/png');
                const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = dataUrl; a.download = 'led-patch-overlay.png'; a.click();
                showNotification('Overlay exported as PNG');
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('exportOverlayAsPng error', e);
                showNotification('Failed to export overlay');
            }
        };

        // Export a summary image (text summary of patches + counts)
        const exportPatchSummaryAsPng = () => {
            const patches = state.pdfExport.ledPatching.patches || [];
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            const lines = [`Patch Summary - ${activeMap ? activeMap.name : 'No Map'}`, ''];
            patches.filter(p => p.mapId == (activeMap && activeMap.id)).forEach((p, i) => {

            ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc'; ctx.font = '16px Inter, Arial';

        // Auto-calc a processors recommendation: greedy fill by model choices in processorsDB
        const runAutoCalcProcessors = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap) || {};
            const need = calcs.totalPixels || 0;
            if (!need) { showNotification('Active map has no pixel calculation'); return; }

            // Build candidate list from processorsDB, sorted by totalPixels desc
            const candidates = Object.keys(processorsDB).map(k => ({ model: k, info: processorsDB[k] })).filter(c => c.info && c.info.totalPixels).sort((a,b) => (b.info.totalPixels || 0) - (a.info.totalPixels || 0));
            if (candidates.length === 0) { showNotification('No processors with totalPixels in DB'); return; }

            let remaining = need;
            const result = [];
            for (const c of candidates) {
                const cap = c.info.totalPixels;
                // how many units of this model would we need at most
                const neededUnits = Math.floor(remaining / cap);
                if (neededUnits > 0) {
                    result.push({ model: c.model, count: neededUnits, perUnit: cap });
                    remaining -= neededUnits * cap;
                }
            }
            // if still remaining, pick smallest candidate that can accept the remainder
            if (remaining > 0) {
                const fit = candidates.find(c => c.info.totalPixels >= remaining);
                if (fit) result.push({ model: fit.model, count: 1, perUnit: fit.info.totalPixels });
                else {
                    // otherwise add one smallest unit available
                    const smallest = candidates[candidates.length-1];
                    result.push({ model: smallest.model, count: 1, perUnit: smallest.info.totalPixels });
                }
            }

            // present result in UI (if present)
            const outEl = document.getElementById('auto-calc-result');
            if (outEl) {
                outEl.innerHTML = `<div class="bg-gray-800 p-2 rounded text-sm">Recommendation: ${result.map(r => `${r.count}× ${r.model}`).join(', ')} <button id="apply-auto-calc" class="ml-3 px-2 py-1 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Apply</button></div>`;
                const applyBtn = document.getElementById('apply-auto-calc');
                if (applyBtn) applyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    // append recommended processors
                    result.forEach(r => {
                        for (let i=0;i<r.count;i++) {
                            const id = `proc-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2,8)}`;
                            const info = processorsDB[r.model] || {};
                            state.hardware.processors.push({ id, model: r.model, pixels: info.totalPixels || 65536 });
                        }
                    });
                    showNotification('Auto-calculated processors applied');
                    renderLedPatching();
                });
            }
        };

        // Merge saved processorsDB from localStorage if present (allow user edits to persist)
        try {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('processorsDB');
            if (saved) {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
                if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
                    // shallow-merge: prefer saved values when present
                    Object.keys(parsed).forEach(k => { processorsDB[k] = Object.assign({}, processorsDB[k] || {}, parsed[k]); });
                }
            }
        } catch (e) { console.warn('Could not load processorsDB from localStorage', e); }

        // Render a simple modal to review/edit processorsDB entries
        const renderProcessorsDbReview = () => {
            const rows = Object.keys(processorsDB).map(key => {

                return `
                    <tr data-key="${key}" class="border-b border-gray-700">
                        <td class="px-2 py-1 text-sm text-gray-200">${p.model || key}</td>
                        <td class="px-2 py-1"><input data-field="totalPixels" type="number" value="${p.totalPixels || ''}" class="w-32 bg-gray-800 text-sm text-gray-200 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1"/></td>
                        <td class="px-2 py-1"><input data-field="ethernetPorts" type="number" value="${p.ethernetPorts || ''}" class="w-24 bg-gray-800 text-sm text-gray-200 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1"/></td>
                        <td class="px-2 py-1"><input data-field="optPorts" type="number" value="${p.optPorts || ''}" class="w-24 bg-gray-800 text-sm text-gray-200 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1"/></td>
                        <td class="px-2 py-1"><input data-field="perPortEstimate" type="number" value="${p.perPortEstimate || ''}" class="w-32 bg-gray-800 text-sm text-gray-200 border border-gray-700 rounded px-2 py-1"/></td>
                        <td class="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-gray-400">${p.source ? `<a href="${p.source}" target="_blank" class="underline">spec</a>` : ''}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            }).join('');

            const modalHtml = `
                <div id="processors-db-modal" class="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-50">
                    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60"></div>
                    <div class="bg-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 max-w-4xl w-full z-60">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold">Review processors DB</h3>
                            <div class="flex gap-2">
                                <button id="processors-db-cancel" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 text-sm">Cancel</button>
                                <button id="processors-db-save" class="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-accent text-black text-sm">Save</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-2">Edit values and click "Auto-calc" to compute per-port estimate from totalPixels and ethernetPorts.</div>
                        <div class="overflow-auto max-h-80">
                            <table class="w-full text-left text-sm">
                                <thead class="text-xs text-gray-400 border-b border-gray-700">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Model</th>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Total Pixels</th>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Ethernet Ports</th>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Optical Ports</th>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Per-Port Est.</th>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Actions</th>
                                        <th class="px-2 py-1">Source</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody class="text-gray-200">${rows}</tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            // append modal to body
            const container = document.createElement('div');
            container.innerHTML = modalHtml;
            document.body.appendChild(container);

            const modal = document.getElementById('processors-db-modal');
            const saveBtn = document.getElementById('processors-db-save');
            const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('processors-db-cancel');

            cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.remove(); });

            // Inline action handlers: Auto-calc per-row and validation
            modal.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(r => {
                const key = r.getAttribute('data-key');
                const autoBtn = document.createElement('button');
                autoBtn.textContent = 'Auto-calc';
                autoBtn.className = 'px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-700 text-xs text-white';
                const actionsCell = r.querySelector('td:last-child').previousElementSibling;
                if (actionsCell) actionsCell.appendChild(autoBtn);

                autoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const totalInput = r.querySelector('input[data-field="totalPixels"]');
                    const ethInput = r.querySelector('input[data-field="ethernetPorts"]');
                    const perPortInput = r.querySelector('input[data-field="perPortEstimate"]');
                    const total = Number(totalInput.value) || 0;
                    const eth = Number(ethInput.value) || 0;
                    if (total > 0 && eth > 0) {
                        perPortInput.value = Math.floor(total / eth);
                        perPortInput.classList.remove('border-red-500');
                    } else {
                        showNotification('Provide totalPixels and ethernetPorts to auto-calc');
                    }
                });

                // simple inline validation on change
                r.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(inp => {
                    inp.addEventListener('input', () => {
                        const val = inp.value;
                        if (val !== '' && (!/^-?\d+$/.test(val) || Number(val) < 0)) {
                            inp.classList.add('border-red-500');
                        } else {
                            inp.classList.remove('border-red-500');
                        }
                    });
                });
            });

            saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Validate before saving
                let valid = true;
                const rows = modal.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
                rows.forEach(r => {
                    const key = r.getAttribute('data-key');
                    if (!key) return;
                    const obj = processorsDB[key] || {};
                    ['totalPixels','ethernetPorts','optPorts','perPortEstimate'].forEach(field => {
                        const input = r.querySelector(`input[data-field="${field}"]`);
                        let val = input ? input.value.trim() : '';
                        if (val === '') { obj[field] = null; return; }
                        if (!/^-?\d+$/.test(val) || Number(val) < 0) { valid = false; input.classList.add('border-red-500'); }
                        else { obj[field] = Number(val); input.classList.remove('border-red-500'); }
                    });
                    processorsDB[key] = obj;
                });
                if (!valid) { showNotification('Fix validation errors before saving'); return; }
                // persist
                try { localStorage.setItem('processorsDB', JSON.stringify(processorsDB)); showNotification('processorsDB saved'); } catch (e) { console.warn('Could not save processorsDB', e); showNotification('Could not save processorsDB'); }
                modal.remove();
            });
        };

        };

        const saveProject = () => {

        // Delete a project by id with confirmation and safe active selection fallback
        const deleteProjectById = (id) => {
            try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush(`deleteProjectById(${id}) called`); } catch(_) {}
            const idx = (state.projects || []).findIndex(p => p.id === id);
            if (idx === -1) { showNotification('Project not found'); return false; }

            }
            if (!state.projects.some(p => p.id === state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId)) {

            }

            try { persistProjects(); } catch(e) { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush(`persistProjects error: ${e.message}`); }
            showNotification(`Project "${proj.name}" deleted`);
            try { if (window.__debugPush) window.__debugPush(`after delete: projects=${(state.projects||[]).length}, active=${state.activeProjectId}`); } catch(_) {}

        };

        // Helper: open the dedicated Rename Project modal reliably
        const openRenameProjectModal = (proj) => {
            if (!proj) return;
            const modal = document.getElementById('rename-project-modal');
            const input = document.getElementById('rename-project-input');
            const saveBtn = document.getElementById('rename-project-save');
            const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('rename-project-cancel');
            if (!modal || !input || !saveBtn || !cancelBtn) { console.warn('Rename modal elements missing'); return; }

            // Show modal
            try { modal.classList.add('flex'); } catch (e) {}
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
            input.value = proj.name || '';
            setTimeout(() => { try { input.focus(); input.select(); } catch(e){} }, 0);

            let onKeyDownHandler = null;
            const cleanup = () => {
                modal.style.display = 'none';
                // Remove one-off listeners by replacing nodes
                const s2 = saveBtn.cloneNode(true);
                const c2 = cancelBtn.cloneNode(true);
                saveBtn.replaceWith(s2);
                cancelBtn.replaceWith(c2);
                // Detach keydown handler from input if attached
                if (onKeyDownHandler) {
                    try { input.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDownHandler); } catch (_) {}
                    onKeyDownHandler = null;
                }
            };

            const onSave = () => {
                const val = (input.value || '').trim();
                if (!val) { showNotification('Project name cannot be empty'); return; }
                proj.name = val;
                persistProjects();
                try {
                    if (state.activeTab === 'shows') renderShows();
                    else if (state.activeTab === 'saved') renderSaved();
                } catch(e) {}
                cleanup();
                showNotification('Project renamed');
            };
            const onCancel = () => cleanup();

            // Re-acquire new references after clone to attach fresh listeners
            const newSave = document.getElementById('rename-project-save');
            const newCancel = document.getElementById('rename-project-cancel');
            if (newSave) newSave.addEventListener('click', onSave, { once: true });
            if (newCancel) newCancel.addEventListener('click', onCancel, { once: true });
            // Keep Enter-to-save active for the entire modal session
            onKeyDownHandler = (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); onSave(); }
            };
            try { input.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDownHandler); } catch (_) {}
        };

        const fitDesignerPreviewToScreen = (isOneToOne = false, forceRecalc = false) => {
            const container = document.getElementById('designer-preview-viewport');
            const canvas = document.getElementById('designer-preview-canvas');
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();

            if (!container || !canvas || !activeMap) return;
            if (canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) return;
            if (state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview === false && !forceRecalc) return;

            const cs = getComputedStyle(container);
            const padX = (parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) || 0);
            const padY = (parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom) || 0);
            const containerWidth = Math.max(0, container.clientWidth - padX);
            const containerHeight = Math.max(0, container.clientHeight - padY);

            const scaleX = containerWidth / canvas.width;
            const scaleY = containerHeight / canvas.height;
            let newZoom = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY) * 0.98; // slight padding
            if (isOneToOne) newZoom = 1.0;

            activeMap.zoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, newZoom));
            // Apply CSS sizing; scrollbars handle navigation
            const z = activeMap.zoom || 1;
            canvas.style.width = `${Math.round(canvas.width * z)}px`;
            canvas.style.height = `${Math.round(canvas.height * z)}px`;
            state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview = false; // Reset after fitting
        };

        const handleDesignerZoom = (factor, absoluteZoom = null) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            if (absoluteZoom !== null) {
                activeMap.zoom = absoluteZoom;
            } else {
                activeMap.zoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, (activeMap.zoom || 1) * factor));
            }

            const canvas = document.getElementById('designer-preview-canvas');
            if (canvas && canvas.width && canvas.height) {
                const z = activeMap.zoom || 1;
                canvas.style.width = `${Math.round(canvas.width * z)}px`;
                canvas.style.height = `${Math.round(canvas.height * z)}px`;
            }
            state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview = false; // User is manually zooming
        };

        const handleInputChange = (e) => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) return;
            const activeMap = project.pixelMaps.find(m => m.id === project.activePixelMapId);
            if (!activeMap) return;
