            const field = e.target.dataset.field;
            let value = e.target.value;

            // Handle math expressions on change (e.g., when user blurs input)
            if (e.type === 'change' && typeof value === 'string' && (value.includes('*') || value.includes('/'))) {
                try {
                    const evaluate = (str) => {
                        // Basic security: only allow numbers, operators, and whitespace.
                        if (!/^[0-9\s\.\*\/\-]+$/.test(str)) return NaN;
                        return new Function(`return ${str}`)();
                    };
                    const result = evaluate(value);
                    if (!isNaN(result)) {
                        value = result;
                        e.target.value = value;
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                     console.error("Invalid expression:", value);
                     value = parseFloat(value) || 0;
                }
            }
            
            if (!field) { return; }
            if (field === 'screenDimensionsUnit') {
                const oldUnit = activeMap.screenDimensionsUnit;
                const newUnit = value;
                const toMeters = { m: 1, cm: 0.01, mm: 0.001, ft: 0.3048, in: 0.0254 };
                const fromMeters = { m: 1, cm: 100, mm: 1000, ft: 3.28084, in: 39.3701 };
                
                const widthInMeters = (parseFloat(activeMap.screenWidthValue) || 0) * toMeters[oldUnit];
                const heightInMeters = (parseFloat(activeMap.screenHeightValue) || 0) * toMeters[oldUnit];
                
                activeMap.screenWidthValue = parseFloat((widthInMeters * fromMeters[newUnit]).toFixed(2));
                activeMap.screenHeightValue = parseFloat((heightInMeters * fromMeters[newUnit]).toFixed(2));
                activeMap.screenDimensionsUnit = newUnit;
                // Re-render the whole designer to update input values correctly
                renderPixelMapDesigner(); 
            } else if (field === 'panelDimensionsUnit') {
                activeMap.panelDimensionsUnit = value;
                renderPixelMapDesigner();
            } else {
                // Support nested fields in future (placeholder)
                const setNested = (obj, path, v) => {
                    const parts = path.split('.');
                    const last = parts.pop();
                    let cur = obj;
                    parts.forEach(p => { if (!cur[p] || typeof cur[p] !== 'object') cur[p] = {}; cur = cur[p]; });
                    cur[last] = v;
                };
                let v;
                if (e.target.type === 'checkbox') v = !!e.target.checked;
                else if (e.target.type === 'text') {
                    // Allow math expressions for numeric text fields
                    if (typeof value === 'string' && (value.includes('*') || value.includes('/'))) {
                        try {
                            if (/^[0-9\s\.+\-*\/]+$/.test(value)) {
                                // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
                                const calc = new Function(`return (${value})`);
                                const r = calc();
                                if (!isNaN(r)) { value = r; e.target.value = r; }
                            }
                        } catch(_) {}
                    }
                    // parseFloat if numeric-ish, else keep string (for now all relevant are numeric)
                    const num = parseFloat(value);
                    v = isNaN(num) ? value : num;
                } else v = parseFloat(value) || value;

                if (field === 'panelWidthMm' || field === 'panelHeightMm') {
                    const unit = activeMap.panelDimensionsUnit || 'mm';
                    const numericValue = parseFloat(value);
                    v = isNaN(numericValue) ? 0 : convertPanelUnitValueToMm(numericValue, unit);
                }

                if (field.includes('.')) setNested(activeMap, field, v);
                else activeMap[field] = v;
            }
            
            const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap);
            if (field.startsWith('screen') || field.startsWith('panel')) { 
                activeMap.panels = Array(calcs.totalPanels || 0).fill(true);
            }
            updateCalculationCards(calcs);
            state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview = true; // Force a refit on next draw
            
            redrawAffectedVisuals();
        };
        
        const handleVisualStyleChange = (e) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;
            activeMap.visualStyle = e.target.value;
            renderPixelMapDesigner(); // Re-render to show/hide controls
            redrawAffectedVisuals();
        };

        const handleStyleChange = (e) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            const { gradientField, checkerField, numberingField, borderField } = e.target.dataset;
            const value = e.target.value;

            if (gradientField) {
                if(gradientField === 'type') {
                    activeMap.gradient.type = value;
                    document.getElementById('gradient-angle-control').style.display = value === 'linear' ? 'block' : 'none';
                }
                else if (gradientField === 'color1') activeMap.gradient.colors[0] = value;
                else if (gradientField === 'color2') activeMap.gradient.colors[1] = value;
                else if (gradientField === 'angle') {
                    activeMap.gradient.angle = value;
                    const angleLabel = document.getElementById('gradient-angle-label');
                    if(angleLabel) angleLabel.textContent = `Angle (${value}°)`;
                }
                if(gradientField.startsWith('color')) {
                    activeMap.gradient.palette = 'Custom';
                    document.getElementById('gradient-palette').value = 'Custom';
                }
            }
            if (checkerField) {
                if (checkerField === 'color1') activeMap.checkerColors[0] = value;
                else if (checkerField === 'color2') activeMap.checkerColors[1] = value;
                activeMap.checkerPalette = 'Custom';
                document.getElementById('checker-palette').value = 'Custom';
            }
            if (numberingField) {
                activeMap.numbering[numberingField] = value;
                if (numberingField === 'fontSize') {
                    const label = document.getElementById('font-size-label');
                    if(label) label.textContent = `Font Size (${value}%)`;
                }
            }
            if (borderField) {
                activeMap.border[borderField] = value;
                if (borderField === 'thickness') {
                    const label = document.getElementById('border-thickness-label');
                    if(label) label.textContent = `Thickness (${value}px)`;
                }
            }
            
            redrawAffectedVisuals();
        };

        const handlePaletteChange = (e) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;
            const paletteName = e.target.value;
            activeMap.gradient.palette = paletteName;
            const saved = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-gradient-palettes')) || []; } catch(_) { return []; } })();
            const builtInGrad = [
                { name: 'Sunrise', colors: ['#ff9a9e', '#fad0c4'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Ocean', colors: ['#a1c4fd', '#c2e9fb'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Passion', colors: ['#fa709a', '#fee140'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Forest', colors: ['#43e97b', '#38f9d7'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
                { name: 'Amethyst', colors: ['#9d50bb', '#6e48aa'], type: 'linear', angle: 90 },
            ];
            const gradientPalettes = [ { name: 'Custom', colors: activeMap.gradient.colors, type: activeMap.gradient.type, angle: activeMap.gradient.angle }, ...builtInGrad, ...saved ];
            const selectedPalette = gradientPalettes.find(p => p.name === paletteName);
            if (selectedPalette && paletteName !== 'Custom') {
                activeMap.gradient.colors = [...(selectedPalette.colors || ['#ffffff','#000000'])];
                if (selectedPalette.type) activeMap.gradient.type = selectedPalette.type;
                if (typeof selectedPalette.angle === 'number') activeMap.gradient.angle = selectedPalette.angle;
                renderPixelMapDesigner();
            }
            redrawAffectedVisuals();
        };
        
        const handleCheckerPaletteChange = (e) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;
            const paletteName = e.target.value;
            activeMap.checkerPalette = paletteName;
            const saved = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-checker-palettes')) || []; } catch(_) { return []; } })();
            const builtInChecker = [
                { name: 'Classic', colors: ['#4b5563', '#1f2937'] },
                { name: 'Monochrome', colors: ['#ffffff', '#000000'] },
                { name: 'Earth', colors: ['#a16207', '#422006'] },
                { name: 'Oceanic', colors: ['#0c4a6e', '#082f49'] },
            ];
            const checkerPalettes = [ { name: 'Custom', colors: activeMap.checkerColors }, ...builtInChecker, ...saved ];
            const selectedPalette = checkerPalettes.find(p => p.name === paletteName);
            if (selectedPalette && paletteName !== 'Custom') {
                activeMap.checkerColors = [...(selectedPalette.colors || ['#ffffff','#000000'])];
                renderPixelMapDesigner();
            }
            redrawAffectedVisuals();
        };

        const populatePanelResPresets = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            const getCustomPresets = () => {
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-custom-panel-res')) || [];
                } catch (e) {
                    return [];
                }
            };

            const presets = [
                { text: 'Custom', value: 'custom' },
                { text: '128 x 128', value: '128x128' },
                { text: '192 x 192', value: '192x192' },
                { text: '256 x 256', value: '256x256' },
                ...getCustomPresets(),
                { text: '168 x 168', value: '168x168' },
                { text: '128 x 256 (Vertical)', value: '128x256' },
            ];

            const selectEl = document.getElementById('panel-res-preset');
            selectEl.innerHTML = presets.map(p => `<option value="${p.value}">${p.text}</option>`).join('');

            const currentRes = `${activeMap.panelResWidth}x${activeMap.panelResHeight}`;
            const matchingPreset = presets.find(p => p.value === currentRes);

            if (matchingPreset) {
                selectEl.value = matchingPreset.value;
            } else {
                selectEl.value = 'custom';
            }
            if (selectEl.value === 'custom') {
                document.getElementById('save-custom-res-btn').classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        };

        const handlePanelResPresetChange = (e) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            const value = e.target.value;
            if (value === 'custom') {
                document.getElementById('save-custom-res-btn').classList.remove('hidden');
                return;
            }

            document.getElementById('save-custom-res-btn').classList.add('hidden');

            const [width, height] = value.split('x').map(Number);
            activeMap.panelResWidth = width;
            activeMap.panelResHeight = height;
            renderPixelMapDesigner(); // Re-render to update the input fields
        };

        const saveCustomPanelResolution = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            const width = parseInt(activeMap.panelResWidth, 10);
            const height = parseInt(activeMap.panelResHeight, 10);

            if (!width || !height || width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
                showNotification("Invalid custom resolution to save.");
                return;
            }

            const getCustomPresets = () => {
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-custom-panel-res')) || [];
                } catch (e) {
                    return [];
                }
            };

            const customPresets = getCustomPresets();
            const newValue = `${width}x${height}`;
            if (customPresets.some(p => p.value === newValue)) {
                showNotification("This resolution is already saved.");
                return;
            }

            customPresets.push({ text: `${width} x ${height} (Custom)`, value: newValue });
            localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-custom-panel-res', JSON.stringify(customPresets));
            showNotification(`Saved ${newValue} to presets.`);
            renderPixelMapDesigner(); // Re-render to update the dropdown
        };

        const handleDetailsChange = (e) => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            const field = e.target.dataset.detailsField;
            if (!field) return; 
            const [category, property] = field.split('.');

            if (e.target.type === 'file') {
                const file = e.target.files[0];
                if (file) {
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = (event) => {
                        const imageUrl = event.target.result;
                        const image = new Image();
                        image.onload = () => {
                            activeMap.details.logo.imageObject = image;
                            activeMap.details.logo.src = imageUrl; 
                            redrawAffectedVisuals();
                        };
                        image.onerror = () => {
                            showNotification("Error loading logo image.");
                            activeMap.details.logo.imageObject = null;
                            activeMap.details.logo.src = null;
                            redrawAffectedVisuals();
                        };
                        image.src = imageUrl;
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                }
                return;
            }

            let value;
            if (e.target.type === 'checkbox') {
                value = e.target.checked;
            } else if (e.target.type === 'range' || e.target.type === 'number') {
                value = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            } else {
                value = e.target.value;
            }
            
            if(!activeMap.details[category]) {
                activeMap.details[category] = {};
            }
            activeMap.details[category][property] = value;
            // Keep displayMode and badgeEnabled in sync for backward compatibility
            if (field === 'info.displayMode') {
                if (!activeMap.details.info) activeMap.details.info = {};
                activeMap.details.info.badgeEnabled = (value === 'badge');
            }

            // Direct DOM update for slider labels to avoid re-rendering
            if (e.target.type === 'range') {
                switch(field) {
                    case 'info.fontSize':
                        document.getElementById('info-font-size-label').textContent = `Font Size (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'info.lineSpacing':
                        const ils = document.getElementById('info-line-spacing-label'); if (ils) ils.textContent = `Line Spacing (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'info.badgeTextScale':
                        const bts = document.getElementById('center-badge-textsize-label'); if (bts) bts.textContent = `Text Size (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'info.badgeLineSpacing':
                        const bls = document.getElementById('center-badge-linespacing-label'); if (bls) bls.textContent = `Line Spacing (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'coords.fontSize':
                        const cfs = document.getElementById('coords-font-size-label'); if (cfs) cfs.textContent = `Font Size (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'logo.size':
                        document.getElementById('logo-size-label').textContent = `Size (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'logo.opacity':
                        document.getElementById('logo-opacity-label').textContent = `Opacity (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'shared.thickness':
                        document.getElementById('shared-thickness-label').textContent = `Circle / Cross Thickness (${value}px)`;
                        break;
                    case 'circle.radius':
                        document.getElementById('circle-radius-label').textContent = `Circle Radius (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'cornerCircles.radius':
                        const cc = document.getElementById('corner-circles-radius-label'); if (cc) cc.textContent = `Radius (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'info.badgeSize':
                        const cblBadge = document.getElementById('center-badge-size-label'); if (cblBadge) cblBadge.textContent = `Size (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'info.badgeOpacity':
                        const cbo2 = document.getElementById('center-badge-opacity-label'); if (cbo2) cbo2.textContent = `Opacity (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'colorBars.heightPercent':
                        const cbh = document.getElementById('color-bars-height-label'); if (cbh) cbh.textContent = `Bar Thickness (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'colorBars.lengthPercent':
                        const cblBars = document.getElementById('color-bars-length-label'); if (cblBars) cblBars.textContent = `Bar Length (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'colorBars.opacity':
                        const cbo = document.getElementById('color-bars-opacity-label'); if (cbo) cbo.textContent = `Opacity (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'colorBars.offsetXPercent':
                        const cbx = document.getElementById('color-bars-offset-x-label'); if (cbx) cbx.textContent = `Offset X (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                    case 'colorBars.offsetYPercent':
                        const cby = document.getElementById('color-bars-offset-y-label'); if (cby) cby.textContent = `Offset Y (${value}%)`;
                        break;
                }
            }

            if (e.target.type === 'checkbox') {
                renderEffectsDetails();
            }
            redrawAffectedVisuals();
        };

        const redrawAffectedVisuals = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if(!activeMap) return;
            // Update the designer preview
            const previewCanvas = document.getElementById('designer-preview-canvas');
            if(previewCanvas) {
                drawVisualizerCanvas(previewCanvas, activeMap); // Redraw the canvas first
                fitDesignerPreviewToScreen(); // Then, fit the preview to its container
            }
            // Update the Effects live preview if visible
            const effectsCanvas = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
            if (effectsCanvas) {
                try { drawVisualizerCanvas(effectsCanvas, activeMap); } catch (e) { console.warn('effects preview redraw failed', e); }
            }
            // If the main visualizer is open, update it too
            if(state.activeTab === 'visualizer') {
                renderVisualizer();
            }

             // If the canvas tab is open, redraw it to reflect changes in any source maps
            if(state.activeTab === 'canvas') {
                drawMainCanvas();
            }
        };

    const calculateLayout = (map) => {
             if(!map) return {};

             let widthInMeters = parseFloat(map.screenWidthValue) || 0;
             let heightInMeters = parseFloat(map.screenHeightValue) || 0;
             const unit = map.screenDimensionsUnit || 'm';

             const toMeters = { m: 1, cm: 0.01, mm: 0.001, ft: 0.3048, in: 0.0254 };
             
             widthInMeters *= toMeters[unit];
             heightInMeters *= toMeters[unit];

                 // Base area (uniform panels)
                 const { panelWidthMm, panelHeightMm, panelResWidth, panelResHeight } = map;
                 if (!(widthInMeters > 0 && heightInMeters > 0 && panelWidthMm > 0 && panelHeightMm > 0)) return {};
                 const screenWidthMm = widthInMeters * 1000;
                 const screenHeightMm = heightInMeters * 1000;

                 // Uniform-only calculation
                 const panelsHorizontally = Math.ceil(screenWidthMm / panelWidthMm);
                 const panelsVertically = Math.ceil(screenHeightMm / panelHeightMm);
                 const totalPanels = panelsHorizontally * panelsVertically;
                 const totalResWidth = panelsHorizontally * panelResWidth;
                 const totalResHeight = panelsVertically * panelResHeight;
                 const totalPixels = totalResWidth * totalResHeight;
                 return { panelsHorizontally, panelsVertically, totalPanels, totalResWidth, totalResHeight, totalPixels, screenWidthMm, screenHeightMm };
        };
        
        const updateCalculationCards = (calcs) => {
            const container = document.getElementById('info-cards-container');
            if (!container) return;

            container.innerHTML = `
               <div class="info-card bg-gray-800 p-4 rounded-lg text-center shadow-lg"><p class="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium">Panels Wide</p><p class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">${calcs.panelsHorizontally || 0} <span class="text-lg text-gray-300">pcs</span></p></div>
               <div class="info-card bg-gray-800 p-4 rounded-lg text-center shadow-lg"><p class="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium">Panels High</p><p class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">${calcs.panelsVertically || 0} <span class="text-lg text-gray-300">pcs</span></p></div>
               <div class="info-card bg-gray-800 p-4 rounded-lg text-center shadow-lg"><p class="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium">Total Panels</p><p class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">${calcs.totalPanels || 0} <span class="text-lg text-gray-300">pcs</span></p></div>
               <div class="info-card bg-gray-800 p-4 rounded-lg text-center shadow-lg"><p class="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium">Total Resolution Width</p><p class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">${calcs.totalResWidth || 0} <span class="text-lg text-gray-300">px</span></p></div>
               <div class="info-card bg-gray-800 p-4 rounded-lg text-center shadow-lg"><p class="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium">Total Resolution Height</p><p class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">${calcs.totalResHeight || 0} <span class="text-lg text-gray-300">px</span></p></div>
               <div class="info-card bg-gray-800 p-4 rounded-lg text-center shadow-lg"><p class="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium">Total Pixels</p><p class="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">${calcs.totalPixels ? (calcs.totalPixels / 1000000).toFixed(2) : 0} <span class="text-lg text-gray-300">MP</span></p></div>
            `;
        };
        
        const showNotification = (message) => {
            notificationEl.textContent = message;
            notificationEl.style.display = 'block';
            setTimeout(() => {
                notificationEl.style.display = 'none';
            }, 4000);
        };
        
        const parsePdfText = (text) => {
            const data = {};
            // More flexible regex patterns to catch common variations
            const patterns = {
                model: /Model\s*[:\s]\s*([A-Z0-9.-]+)/i,
                pitch: /Pixel Pitch\s*[:\s]\s*([\d.]+)/i,
                brightness: /Brightness\s*[:\s]\s*(\d+)/i,
                refreshRate: /Refresh Rate\s*[:\s]\s*(\d+)/i,
                // Look for "Panel Size" or just "Size" followed by dimensions in mm
                panelSize: /(?:Panel\s*)?Size\s*(?:\(mm\))?\s*[:\s]\s*(\d+)\s*[x*]\s*([\d.]+)/im,
                // Look for "Panel Resolution", "Resolution", or just pixel dimensions
                panelRes: /(?:Panel\s*)?Resolution\s*(?:\(px\))?\s*[:\s]\s*(\d+)\s*[x*]\s*(\d+)/im,
            };

            data.model = text.match(patterns.model)?.[1] || `PDF-Panel-${Date.now() % 1000}`;
            data.pitch = parseFloat(text.match(patterns.pitch)?.[1]);
            data.brightness = parseInt(text.match(patterns.brightness)?.[1], 10);
            data.refreshRate = parseInt(text.match(patterns.refreshRate)?.[1], 10);

            const panelSizeMatch = text.match(patterns.panelSize);
            if (panelSizeMatch) {
                data.panelWidth = parseFloat(panelSizeMatch[1].trim());
                data.panelHeight = parseFloat(panelSizeMatch[2].trim());
            }
            
            const panelResMatch = text.match(patterns.panelRes);
            if (panelResMatch) {
                data.resWidth = parseInt(panelResMatch[1].trim(), 10);
                data.resHeight = parseInt(panelResMatch[2].trim(), 10);
            }

            if (!data.pitch || !data.panelWidth || !data.resWidth) return null;
            return data;
        };

        const addPixelMap = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) return;
            const newMap = createNewPixelMapObject(project.pixelMaps.length + 1);
            // Ensure panels are initialized (in case layout wasn't available during object creation)
            try {
                const calcs = calculateLayout(newMap) || {};
                if (!newMap.panels || newMap.panels.length === 0) newMap.panels = Array(calcs.totalPanels || 0).fill(true);
            } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
            project.pixelMaps.push(newMap);
            project.activePixelMapId = newMap.id;
            renderPixelMapDesigner();
        };

        const deletePixelMap = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project || project.pixelMaps.length <= 1) {
                showNotification("Cannot delete the last pixel map in a project.");
                return;
            }
            // Confirm before deleting the active pixel map
            const activeMap = project.pixelMaps.find(m => m.id === project.activePixelMapId);
            const mapName = activeMap && activeMap.name ? activeMap.name : 'this map';
            const confirmed = window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete "${mapName}"? This action cannot be undone.`);
            if (!confirmed) return;
            const mapIndex = project.pixelMaps.findIndex(m => m.id === project.activePixelMapId);
            if (mapIndex > -1) {
                project.pixelMaps.splice(mapIndex, 1);
                project.activePixelMapId = project.pixelMaps[0].id;
                renderPixelMapDesigner();
                showNotification("Pixel map deleted.");
            }
        };

        const duplicatePixelMap = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project) return;
            const original = project.pixelMaps.find(m => String(m.id) === String(project.activePixelMapId));
            if (!original) { showNotification('No active pixel map to duplicate.'); return; }

            // Deep clone via JSON; sanitize non-serializable fields afterwards
            let clone;
            try { clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original)); }
            catch (_) { clone = Object.assign({}, original); }

            // Assign a new unique id
            clone.id = Date.now() + Math.random();

            // Name it as a copy, ensuring uniqueness within the project
            const base = original.name || 'Pixel Map';
            let proposed = base.endsWith(' Copy') ? base : `${base} Copy`;
            const existingNames = new Set((project.pixelMaps || []).map(m => m && m.name).filter(Boolean));
            if (existingNames.has(proposed)) {
                let i = 2;
                while (existingNames.has(`${base} Copy ${i}`)) i++;
                proposed = `${base} Copy ${i}`;
            }
            clone.name = proposed;

            // Ensure transient fields are reset
            try { if (clone.details && clone.details.logo) clone.details.logo.imageObject = null; } catch (_) {}

            // Insert right after the original
            const at = project.pixelMaps.findIndex(m => String(m.id) === String(original.id));
            if (at >= 0) project.pixelMaps.splice(at + 1, 0, clone); else project.pixelMaps.push(clone);
            project.activePixelMapId = clone.id;

            renderPixelMapDesigner();
            showNotification('Pixel map duplicated.');
        };

        const renameItem = (type) => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if(!project) return;

            let item, promptText, renderFunc;

            if(type === 'pixelMap') {
                // Use helper to ensure we always get the latest active map reference
                item = getActivePixelMap();
                if (!item) { showNotification('No active pixel map to rename.'); return; }
                promptText = "Enter new name for Pixel Map:";
                renderFunc = renderPixelMapDesigner;
            } else if (type === 'canvas') {
                item = getActiveCanvas();
                promptText = "Enter new name for Output Canvas:";
                renderFunc = renderCanvas;
            }
            else if (type === 'project') {
                item = project; // The project is the item
                promptText = "Edit Project Details";
                renderFunc = () => { /* dashboard removed */ };
                showInputModal(promptText, item, (newValues) => {
                    if (newValues) {
                        item.name = newValues.name || item.name;
                        item.location = newValues.location || item.location;
                        item.salesperson = newValues.salesperson || item.salesperson;
                        item.venue = (typeof newValues.venue === 'string') ? newValues.venue : (item.venue || '');
                        // No dashboard to re-render; optionally refresh current tab
                        if (state.activeTab === 'designer') renderPixelMapDesigner();
                    }
                });
                return; // Use the multi-field modal and exit
            }
            
            if(!item) return;

            showInputModal(promptText, item.name, (newName) => {
                if (newName && newName.trim() !== '') {
                    item.name = newName.trim();
                    renderFunc();
                }
            });
        };

        const getActivePixelMap = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => String(p.id) === String(state.activeProjectId));
            if (!project || !Array.isArray(project.pixelMaps) || project.pixelMaps.length === 0) return null;
            const match = project.pixelMaps.find(m => String(m.id) === String(project.activePixelMapId));
            return match || project.pixelMaps[0];
        };
        
        const drawVisualizerCanvas = (targetCanvas, styleSource, options) => {
            // The styleSource object is the single source of truth.
            // It contains all necessary data, even for maps on the main canvas (as a snapshot).
            // This avoids looking up a source project that may have been deleted.
            // Non-destructive active preset overlay for Effects preview only
            let sourceForRender = styleSource;
            try {
                const isEffectsPreview = !!(targetCanvas && typeof targetCanvas.id === 'string' && (targetCanvas.id === 'effects-preview-canvas' || targetCanvas.id.startsWith('effects-thumb-canvas-')));
                const activePresetId = state?.ui?.activeEffectsPresetId;
                if (isEffectsPreview && activePresetId && Array.isArray(state.effectsPresets)) {
                    const preset = state.effectsPresets.find(p => String(p.id) === String(activePresetId));
                    if (preset && preset.data) {
                        const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(styleSource));
                        ['visualStyle','gradient','checkerColors','checkerPalette','numbering','border','details'].forEach(k=>{
                            if (typeof preset.data[k] !== 'undefined') clone[k] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(preset.data[k]));
                        });
                        sourceForRender = clone;
                    }
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            const calcs = calculateLayout(sourceForRender);
            const canvas = targetCanvas;
            if (!canvas) return;

            if (!calcs || !calcs.totalResWidth) {
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                // Clear and show a message if there's nothing to draw
                const parentWidth = canvas.parentElement ? canvas.parentElement.clientWidth : 300;
                const parentHeight = canvas.parentElement ? canvas.parentElement.clientHeight : 150;
                canvas.width = parentWidth > 0 ? parentWidth : 300;
                canvas.height = parentHeight > 0 ? parentHeight : 150;
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                if (canvas.id === 'designer-preview-canvas') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    ctx.font = '14px Inter';
                    ctx.fillText('Enter valid dimensions to see preview', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
                }
                return;
            }
            
            const panelResWidth = sourceForRender.panelResWidth;
            const panelResHeight = sourceForRender.panelResHeight;
            // Scale the preview rendering to keep things fast for large maps
            const fullW = calcs.totalResWidth;
            const fullH = calcs.totalResHeight;
            const fullPixels = Math.max(1, fullW * fullH);
            const forceFullRes = !!(options && options.forceFullRes);
            const userScale = forceFullRes ? 1 : Math.max(0.05, Math.min(1, (state.visualizerState?.previewScale ?? 1)));
            const savedCapMp = (() => { try { return parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-preview-cap-mp')); } catch(_) { return NaN; } })();
            const capMp = Number.isFinite(savedCapMp) && savedCapMp > 0.25 ? savedCapMp : (state?.performance?.previewCapMP ?? 4);
            const MAX_PREVIEW_PIXELS = Math.max(500000, Math.round(capMp * 1000000));
            const capScale = forceFullRes ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(MAX_PREVIEW_PIXELS / fullPixels));
            const previewScale = forceFullRes ? 1 : Math.max(0.05, Math.min(userScale, capScale));
            canvas.width = forceFullRes ? fullW : Math.max(1, Math.round(fullW * previewScale));
            canvas.height = forceFullRes ? fullH : Math.max(1, Math.round(fullH * previewScale));
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            // Apply parent-fit sizing only for thumbnails and non-zoomed mini-previews; main previews manage CSS size elsewhere
            try {
                const id = String(canvas.id || '');
                const isThumb = id.startsWith('thumb-canvas-') || id.startsWith('effects-thumb-canvas-') || id.startsWith('pdf-thumb-canvas-');
                const managedByZoom = (id === 'visualizer-canvas') || (id === 'designer-preview-canvas') || (id === 'effects-preview-canvas');
                if (!managedByZoom && isThumb) {
                    const parent = canvas.parentElement;
                    if (parent) {
                        const parentW = parent.clientWidth || canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth;
                        const parentH = parent.clientHeight || canvas.parentElement.offsetHeight || window.innerHeight * 0.6;
                        if (parentW > 0 && parentH > 0 && canvas.width > 0 && canvas.height > 0) {
                            const scale = Math.min(parentW / canvas.width, parentH / canvas.height);
                            canvas.style.width = Math.round(canvas.width * scale) + 'px';
                            canvas.style.height = Math.round(canvas.height * scale) + 'px';
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }
            
            // Base background (kept neutral); panels draw their own styles
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111827';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            // Ensure panels array matches current layout
            try {
                if (!Array.isArray(sourceForRender.panels) || sourceForRender.panels.length !== (calcs.totalPanels || 0)) {
                    sourceForRender.panels = Array(calcs.totalPanels || 0).fill(true);
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            const fontSize = (Math.min(panelResWidth, panelResHeight) * previewScale / 100) * (sourceForRender.numbering.fontSize || 25);
            ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px Inter`;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

            let panelCounter = 1;
            const drawCell = (gridX, gridY, cellResW, cellResH, sectionYOffsetPx, sectionPanelsHForIndex, indexOffset = 0) => {
                const x = gridX;
                const y = gridY;
                const index = indexOffset + (y * sectionPanelsHForIndex) + x;
                const posX = Math.round(x * cellResW * previewScale);
                const posY = Math.round((y * cellResH + sectionYOffsetPx) * previewScale);
                let label;
                const style = styleSource.numbering.style;
                const currentPanelNumber = panelCounter;
                if (style === 'sequential') label = currentPanelNumber; else {
                    switch (style) {
                        case 'rowLetter': label = `${String.fromCharCode(65 + y)}${x + 1}`; break;
                        case 'colLetter': label = `${String.fromCharCode(65 + x)}${y + 1}`; break;
                        case 'rowColNum': label = `${y + 1}-${x + 1}`; break;
                        case 'colRowNum': label = `${x + 1}-${y + 1}`; break;
                        default: label = currentPanelNumber;
                    }
                }
                if (styleSource.panels && !styleSource.panels[index]) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                    ctx.fillRect(posX, posY, Math.round(cellResW * previewScale), Math.round(cellResH * previewScale));
                } else {
                    if (styleSource.visualStyle === 'checker') {
                        ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 === 0 ? styleSource.checkerColors[0] : styleSource.checkerColors[1];
                        ctx.fillRect(posX, posY, Math.round(cellResW * previewScale), Math.round(cellResH * previewScale));
                    } else if (styleSource.visualStyle === 'gradient') {
                        const { type, colors, angle } = styleSource.gradient;
                        let grad;
                        if (type === 'linear') {
                            const angleRad = (angle - 90) * (Math.PI / 180);
                            const cellW = Math.round(cellResW * previewScale);
                            const cellH = Math.round(cellResH * previewScale);
                            const cx = posX + cellW / 2;
                            const cy = posY + cellH / 2;
                            const dx = Math.cos(angleRad) * (cellW / 2);
                            const dy = Math.sin(angleRad) * (cellH / 2);
                            const x1 = cx - dx; const y1 = cy - dy; const x2 = cx + dx; const y2 = cy + dy;
                            grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x1, y1, x2, y2);
                        } else {
                            const cellW = Math.round(cellResW * previewScale);
                            const cellH = Math.round(cellResH * previewScale);
                            const cx = posX + cellW / 2; const cy = posY + cellH / 2;
                            const radius = Math.sqrt((cellW/2) * (cellW/2) + (cellH/2) * (cellH/2));
                            grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius);
                        }
                        grad.addColorStop(0, colors[0]); grad.addColorStop(1, colors[1]);
                        ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(posX, posY, Math.round(cellResW * previewScale), Math.round(cellResH * previewScale));
                    }
                    ctx.lineWidth = styleSource.border.thickness; ctx.strokeStyle = styleSource.border.color;
                    if (styleSource.border.style === 'dashed') ctx.setLineDash([ctx.lineWidth * 3, ctx.lineWidth * 2]);
                    else if (styleSource.border.style === 'dotted') ctx.setLineDash([ctx.lineWidth, ctx.lineWidth * 2]);
                    else ctx.setLineDash([]);
                    ctx.strokeRect(posX, posY, Math.round(cellResW * previewScale), Math.round(cellResH * previewScale));
                    ctx.setLineDash([]);
                    ctx.fillStyle = styleSource.numbering.color;
                    ctx.fillText(label, posX + Math.round(cellResW * previewScale) / 2, posY + Math.round(cellResH * previewScale) / 2);
                    if (style === 'sequential') panelCounter++;
                }
            };

            const basePanelsH = calcs.panelsHorizontally;
            const basePanelsV = calcs.panelsVertically;
            for (let y = 0; y < basePanelsV; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < basePanelsH; x++) {
                    drawCell(x, y, panelResWidth, panelResHeight, 0, basePanelsH, 0);
                }
            }

            // Draw the details overlays if enabled
            const details = styleSource.details;
            if (!details) return; 

            const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
            const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

            // Color Bars overlay
            if (details.colorBars && details.colorBars.enabled) {
                const preset = details.colorBars.preset || 'smpte';
                const orientation = details.colorBars.orientation || 'horizontal';
                const position = details.colorBars.position || 'full';
                const alpha = (details.colorBars.opacity ?? 100) / 100;
                const pct = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, details.colorBars.heightPercent ?? 30));
                const lenPct = Math.max(10, Math.min(100, details.colorBars.lengthPercent ?? 60));
                let colors;
                if (preset === 'rgbw') {
                    colors = ['#ff0000', '#00ff00', '#0000ff', '#ffffff'];
                } else if (preset === 'rgb') {
                    colors = ['#ff0000', '#00ff00', '#0000ff'];
                } else { // smpte default set
                    colors = ['#c0c0c0', '#ffff00', '#00ffff', '#00ff00', '#ff00ff', '#ff0000', '#0000ff'];
                }
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                let x = 0, y = 0, w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
                if (position !== 'full') {
                    if (orientation === 'horizontal') {
                        h = Math.round(canvas.height * (pct / 100));
                        const desiredW = Math.round(canvas.width * (lenPct / 100));
                        if (position === 'top') { y = 0; w = canvas.width; }
                        else if (position === 'bottom') { y = canvas.height - h; w = canvas.width; }
                        else if (position === 'center' || position === 'near-info') {
                            y = Math.round((canvas.height - h) / 2);
                            w = desiredW; x = Math.round((canvas.width - w) / 2);
                        }
                    } else { // vertical
                        w = Math.round(canvas.width * (pct / 100));
                        const desiredH = Math.round(canvas.height * (lenPct / 100));
                        if (position === 'left') { x = 0; h = canvas.height; }
                        else if (position === 'right') { x = canvas.width - w; h = canvas.height; }
                        else if (position === 'center' || position === 'near-info') {
                            x = Math.round((canvas.width - w) / 2);
                            h = desiredH; y = Math.round((canvas.height - h) / 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
                // If near-info, nudge bars near the info box if visible
                if (position === 'near-info' && details.info && details.info.enabled) {
                    const infoPadding = canvas.height / 30; // reuse scale from info block
                    // heuristic: place bars adjacent to the info overlay based on its position
                    switch (details.info.position) {
                        case 'top-left':
                        case 'top-right':
                            if (orientation === 'horizontal') { y = infoPadding + Math.round((canvas.height * 0.12)); }
                            else { y = infoPadding; x = (details.info.position === 'top-left') ? (infoPadding + Math.round(canvas.width * 0.12)) : (canvas.width - w - infoPadding - Math.round(canvas.width * 0.12)); }
                            break;
                        case 'bottom-left':
                        case 'bottom-right':
                            if (orientation === 'horizontal') { y = canvas.height - h - infoPadding - Math.round((canvas.height * 0.12)); }
                            else { y = canvas.height - h - infoPadding; x = (details.info.position === 'bottom-left') ? (infoPadding + Math.round(canvas.width * 0.12)) : (canvas.width - w - infoPadding - Math.round(canvas.width * 0.12)); }
                            break;
                        case 'center':
                            // leave centered
                            break;
                    }
                }
                // apply offsets
                const offX = Math.round((details.colorBars.offsetXPercent ?? 0) / 100 * canvas.width);
                const offY = Math.round((details.colorBars.offsetYPercent ?? 0) / 100 * canvas.height);
                x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - w, x + offX));
                y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - h, y + offY));

                const n = colors.length;
                if (orientation === 'horizontal') {
                    const barW = w / n;
                    colors.forEach((c, i) => {
                        ctx.fillStyle = c;
                        ctx.fillRect(x + i * barW, y, Math.ceil(barW), h);
                    });
                } else {
                    const barH = h / n;
                    colors.forEach((c, i) => {
                        ctx.fillStyle = c;
                        ctx.fillRect(x, y + i * barH, w, Math.ceil(barH));
                    });
                }
                ctx.restore();
            }

            if(details.circle.enabled) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = details.shared.color;
                ctx.lineWidth = details.shared.thickness;
                // Style handling
                const cStyle = details.circle?.style || 'solid';
                if (cStyle === 'dashed') {
                    ctx.setLineDash([ctx.lineWidth * 4, ctx.lineWidth * 3]);
                    ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
                } else if (cStyle === 'dotted') {
                    ctx.setLineDash([Math.max(1, Math.round(ctx.lineWidth)), ctx.lineWidth * 2.5]);
                    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                } else {
                    ctx.setLineDash([]);
                }
                ctx.beginPath();
                const radius = (Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2) * (details.circle.radius / 100);
                ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.restore();
            }

            if(details.cross.enabled) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = details.shared.color;
                ctx.lineWidth = details.shared.thickness;
                // Style handling
                const xStyle = details.cross?.style || 'solid';
                if (xStyle === 'dashed') {
                    ctx.setLineDash([ctx.lineWidth * 4, ctx.lineWidth * 3]);
                    ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
                } else if (xStyle === 'dotted') {
                    ctx.setLineDash([Math.max(1, Math.round(ctx.lineWidth)), ctx.lineWidth * 2.5]);
                    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                } else {
                    ctx.setLineDash([]);
                }
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
                ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.moveTo(canvas.width, 0);
                ctx.lineTo(0, canvas.height);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.restore();
            }

            

            if(details.corners.enabled) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = details.shared.color;
                ctx.lineWidth = details.shared.thickness;
                const cornerLength = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.1;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(0, cornerLength); ctx.lineTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(cornerLength, 0);
                ctx.moveTo(canvas.width - cornerLength, 0); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, 0); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, cornerLength);
                ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height - cornerLength); ctx.lineTo(0, canvas.height); ctx.lineTo(cornerLength, canvas.height);
                ctx.moveTo(canvas.width - cornerLength, canvas.height); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height - cornerLength);
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            // Corner Circles overlay
            if (details.cornerCircles && details.cornerCircles.enabled) {
                const rPct = details.cornerCircles.radius ?? 2; // percent of min dimension
                const r = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * (rPct / 100)));
                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = details.shared.color;
                ctx.lineWidth = details.shared.thickness;
                const style = details.cornerCircles?.style || 'solid';
                if (style === 'dashed') {
                    ctx.setLineDash([ctx.lineWidth * 3, ctx.lineWidth * 2]);
                    ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
                } else if (style === 'dotted') {
                    ctx.setLineDash([Math.max(1, Math.round(ctx.lineWidth)), ctx.lineWidth * 2]);
                    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                } else {
                    ctx.setLineDash([]);
                }
                const positions = [
                    { x: 0 + r, y: 0 + r },
                    { x: canvas.width - r, y: 0 + r },
                    { x: 0 + r, y: canvas.height - r },
                    { x: canvas.width - r, y: canvas.height - r }
                ];
                positions.forEach(p => {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                });
                ctx.restore();
            }

            if (details.info.enabled && (details.info.displayMode !== 'badge')) {
                const info = details.info;
                const baseFontSize = canvas.height / 30;
                const detailsFontSize = Math.max(1, baseFontSize * (info.fontSize / 100));
                const fontFamily = info.fontFamily || 'Inter';
                ctx.font = `bold ${detailsFontSize}px ${fontFamily}`;
                const padding = detailsFontSize;
                const lineHeight = 1.8 * ((info.lineSpacing ?? 100) / 100);

                const derivedName = (styleSource && typeof styleSource.name === 'string') ? styleSource.name.trim() : '';
                const fallbackName = (info && typeof info.name === 'string') ? info.name.trim() : '';
                const overlayTitle = derivedName || fallbackName;
                const nameLines = overlayTitle
                    ? overlayTitle.split(/\r?\n/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
                    : [];
                const lines = [
                    ...nameLines,
                    `Screen Size: ${(calcs.screenWidthMm / 1000).toFixed(2)}m x ${(calcs.screenHeightMm / 1000).toFixed(2)}m`,
                    `Pixel Map: ${calcs.totalResWidth}px x ${calcs.totalResHeight}px`
                ].filter(Boolean);

                let textWidth = 0;
                lines.forEach(line => {
                    const metrics = ctx.measureText(line);
                    if (metrics.width > textWidth) textWidth = metrics.width;
                });

                const boxWidth = textWidth + padding * 2;
                const totalTextHeight = (lines.length - 1) * detailsFontSize * lineHeight + detailsFontSize;
                const boxHeight = totalTextHeight + padding * 2;

                let x, y;
                ctx.textAlign = 'left';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'top';

                switch (info.position) {
                    case 'top-right': x = canvas.width - boxWidth - padding; y = padding; ctx.textAlign = 'right'; break;
                    case 'bottom-left': x = padding; y = canvas.height - boxHeight - padding; break;
                    case 'bottom-right': x = canvas.width - boxWidth - padding; y = canvas.height - boxHeight - padding; ctx.textAlign = 'right'; break;
                    case 'center': x = (canvas.width - boxWidth) / 2; y = (canvas.height - boxHeight) / 2; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; break;
                    default: x = padding; y = padding; break;
                }

                if (!info.bgTransparent) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)`;
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, boxWidth, boxHeight);
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = details.shared.color;
                let textX = (ctx.textAlign === 'left') ? x + padding : (ctx.textAlign === 'right') ? x + boxWidth - padding : x + boxWidth / 2;
                lines.forEach((line, index) => {
                    ctx.fillText(line, textX, y + padding + (index * detailsFontSize * lineHeight));
                });
            }

            // Center Badge (hexagon style with text) - controlled under Information Overlay
            const legacyBadge = details.centerBadge && details.centerBadge.enabled;
            const infoBadge = details.info && ((details.info.displayMode === 'badge') || details.info.badgeEnabled === true);
            if (legacyBadge || infoBadge) {
                const sizePct = Math.max(10, Math.min(60, (details.info?.badgeSize ?? details.centerBadge?.size ?? 30)));
                const r = (Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * (sizePct / 100)) / 2; // radius of hexagon
                // Hexagon points (flat-top)
                const points = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                    const angle = (Math.PI / 3) * i - Math.PI / 6; // rotate so a flat side is top
                    points.push({ x: centerX + r * Math.cos(angle), y: centerY + r * Math.sin(angle) });
                }
                const fillAlpha = ((details.info?.badgeOpacity ?? details.centerBadge?.opacity ?? 80)) / 100;
                ctx.save();
                const performanceLite = (() => { try { const v = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-preview-cap-mp')); return Number.isFinite(v) && v <= 1.25; } catch(_) { return false; } })();
                if ((details.info?.badgeShadow ?? details.centerBadge?.shadow ?? true) && !performanceLite) {
                    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
                    ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(6, r * 0.08);
                    ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
                }
                // Fill
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
                for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(points[i].x, points[i].y);
                ctx.closePath();
                // Convert hex color to rgba with alpha
                const hex = (details.info?.badgeFillColor ?? '#000000');
                const parseHex = (h) => {
                    let c = h.replace('#','');
                    if (c.length === 3) c = c.split('').map(x=>x+x).join('');
                    const r = parseInt(c.substr(0,2),16) || 0;
                    const g = parseInt(c.substr(2,2),16) || 0;
                    const b = parseInt(c.substr(4,2),16) || 0;
                    return {r,g,b};
                };
                const {r:fr,g:fg,b:fb} = parseHex(hex);
                // Fill hexagon with opacity
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${fr}, ${fg}, ${fb}, ${fillAlpha})`;
                ctx.fill();
                // Optional stroke
                const badgeStroke = Math.max(0, (details.info?.badgeStroke ?? details.shared?.thickness ?? 0));
                if (badgeStroke > 0) {
                    ctx.lineWidth = badgeStroke;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = details.info?.badgeStrokeColor ?? details.shared?.color ?? '#ffffff';
                    ctx.stroke();
                }

                // Text inside badge (multi-line support)
                const textColor = details.info?.badgeTextColor ?? details.shared?.color ?? '#ffffff';
                const badgeBaseName = (styleSource && typeof styleSource.name === 'string') ? styleSource.name.trim() : '';
                const legacyBadgeName = (typeof details.info?.name === 'string') ? details.info.name.trim() : '';
                const rawBadgeText = (typeof details.info?.badgeText === 'string') ? details.info.badgeText : '';
                const resolvedBadgeText = rawBadgeText.trim() !== ''
                    ? rawBadgeText
                    : (badgeBaseName || legacyBadgeName);
                const lines = (resolvedBadgeText || '')
                    .split(/\r?\n/)
                    .map(l => l.trim())
                    .filter(l => l.length > 0);
                // Optionally append metrics (physical size + pixel resolution)
                try {
                    if ((details.info?.badgeIncludeMetrics ?? true) && calcs && calcs.totalResWidth && calcs.totalResHeight) {
                        const sizeLine = `Size: ${(calcs.screenWidthMm/1000).toFixed(2)}m x ${(calcs.screenHeightMm/1000).toFixed(2)}m`;
                        const pixelsLine = `Pixels: ${calcs.totalResWidth}px x ${calcs.totalResHeight}px`;
                        const lower = lines.map(l=>l.toLowerCase());
                        if (!lower.some(l=>l.includes('size:'))) lines.push(sizeLine);
                        if (!lower.some(l=>l.includes('pixels:'))) lines.push(pixelsLine);
                    }
                } catch(_) {}
                // Font sizing driven by badgeTextScale (0-100%) relative to radius, then auto-fit
                const textScalePct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, details.info?.badgeTextScale ?? 50));
                let badgeFontSize = Math.max(6, Math.round(r * (textScalePct / 100)));
                const badgeFontFamily = details.info?.fontFamily || 'Inter';
                ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                const lineSpacingPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(300, details.info?.badgeLineSpacing ?? 50));
                const lineSpacingFactor = lineSpacingPct / 50; // 50% => 1.0 (normal), 100% => 2.0
                let lineHeight = badgeFontSize * lineSpacingFactor;
                ctx.font = `bold ${badgeFontSize}px ${badgeFontFamily}`;
                // Approximate inner safe box inside flat-top hexagon
                const innerW = Math.max(1, Math.sqrt(3) * r * 0.88); // ~0.88 margin
                const innerH = Math.max(1, 2 * r * 0.80); // vertical margin
                // Measure longest line width
                let maxLineW = 0;
                lines.forEach(l => { const m = ctx.measureText(l); if (m.width > maxLineW) maxLineW = m.width; });
                let totalHeight = lines.length === 0 ? badgeFontSize : (lines.length * lineHeight);
                // Scale down if needed to fit inner box
                if (maxLineW > innerW || totalHeight > innerH) {
                    const scaleW = innerW / Math.max(1, maxLineW);
                    const scaleH = innerH / Math.max(1, totalHeight);
                    const scale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1, Math.min(scaleW, scaleH)));
                    const newSize = Math.max(6, Math.floor(badgeFontSize * scale));
                    if (newSize !== badgeFontSize) {
                        badgeFontSize = newSize;
                        lineHeight = badgeFontSize * lineSpacingFactor;
                        ctx.font = `bold ${badgeFontSize}px ${badgeFontFamily}`;
                        maxLineW = 0;
                        lines.forEach(l => { const m = ctx.measureText(l); if (m.width > maxLineW) maxLineW = m.width; });
                        totalHeight = lines.length === 0 ? badgeFontSize : (lines.length * lineHeight);
                    }
                }
                let startY = centerY - totalHeight / 2 + lineHeight / 2;
                lines.forEach((line, i) => {
                    ctx.fillText(line, centerX, startY + i * lineHeight);
                });
                ctx.restore();
            }
        }
            // end drawVisualizerCanvas

        // Uniform-only click toggle for Visualizer and Effects preview
        const onVisualizerCanvasClick = (e) => {
            try {
                const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
                if (!activeMap) return;
                const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap);
                const canvas = e.currentTarget;
                if (!canvas || !calcs || !(calcs.totalResWidth > 0 && calcs.totalResHeight > 0)) return;

                const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
                const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
                const mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
                const mouseY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;

                // Match previewScale used in drawVisualizerCanvas
                const userScale = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(1, (state.visualizerState?.previewScale ?? 1)));
                const fullW = calcs.totalResWidth;
                const fullH = calcs.totalResHeight;
                const fullPixels = Math.max(1, fullW * fullH);
                const MAX_PREVIEW_PIXELS = 4000000;
                const capScale = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(MAX_PREVIEW_PIXELS / fullPixels));
                const previewScale = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(userScale, capScale));

                // Derive hit-testing directly from rendered canvas size to avoid scale mismatches
                const cols = Math.max(1, Math.round(calcs.panelsHorizontally));
                const rows = Math.max(1, Math.round(calcs.panelsVertically));
                const cellWpx = canvas.width / cols;
                const cellHpx = canvas.height / rows;

                const col = Math.floor(mouseX / cellWpx);
                const row = Math.floor(mouseY / cellHpx);
                if (row < 0 || row >= rows || col < 0 || col >= cols) return;
                const index = row * cols + col;
                const expectedPanels = Number.isFinite(calcs.totalPanels) && calcs.totalPanels > 0 ? calcs.totalPanels : (rows * cols);
                if (!Array.isArray(activeMap.panels) || activeMap.panels.length !== expectedPanels) {
                    activeMap.panels = Array(expectedPanels).fill(true);
                }
                activeMap.panels[index] = !activeMap.panels[index];
                drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, activeMap);
            } catch(_) { /* ignore */ }
        };

        const fitVisualizerToScreen = (forceRecalc = false) => {
            const container = document.getElementById('visualizer-scroll-container');
            const canvas = document.getElementById('visualizer-canvas');
            const wrapper = document.getElementById('visualizer-wrapper');

            if (!container || !canvas || !wrapper) return;
            if (state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview === false && !forceRecalc) return;
            
            const containerStyle = getComputedStyle(container);
            const paddingX = parseFloat(containerStyle.paddingLeft) + parseFloat(containerStyle.paddingRight);
            const paddingY = parseFloat(containerStyle.paddingTop) + parseFloat(containerStyle.paddingBottom);
            const containerWidth = container.clientWidth - paddingX;
            const containerHeight = container.clientHeight - paddingY;

            if (canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) return;

            const scaleX = containerWidth / canvas.width;
            const scaleY = containerHeight / canvas.height;
            const newZoom = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY) * 0.98;

            state.visualizerState.zoom = newZoom;
            // Update canvas CSS size to reflect zoom, scrollbars handle navigation
            canvas.style.width = `${Math.round(canvas.width * newZoom)}px`;
            canvas.style.height = `${Math.round(canvas.height * newZoom)}px`;
            state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview = false; // Reset after fitting
        };

        const handleVisualizerZoom = (factor, absoluteZoom = null) => {
            if (absoluteZoom !== null) {
                state.visualizerState.zoom = absoluteZoom;
            } else {
                state.visualizerState.zoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, state.visualizerState.zoom * factor));
            }

            const wrapper = document.getElementById('visualizer-wrapper');
            const canvas = document.getElementById('visualizer-canvas');
            if (canvas) {
                const z = state.visualizerState.zoom || 1;
                canvas.style.width = `${Math.round(canvas.width * z)}px`;
                canvas.style.height = `${Math.round(canvas.height * z)}px`;
            }
            state.visualizerState.autoFitPreview = false; // User is manually zooming
        };

        // --- CANVAS TAB LOGIC ---
         const getActiveCanvas = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if (!project || !project.canvases || !project.activeCanvasId) return null;
            return project.canvases.find(c => c.id === project.activeCanvasId);
        };

        const addCanvas = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            if(!project) return;
            const newCanvasName = `Canvas ${project.canvases.length + 1}`;
            const newCanvas = {id: Date.now(), name: newCanvasName, width: 1920, height: 1080, maps: []};
            project.canvases.push(newCanvas);
            project.activeCanvasId = newCanvas.id;
            renderCanvas();
        };

        const deleteCanvas = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if(!project || !activeCanvas || project.canvases.length <= 1) {
                showNotification("Cannot delete the last output canvas.");
                return;
            }
            
            project.canvases = project.canvases.filter(c => c.id !== project.activeCanvasId);
            project.activeCanvasId = project.canvases[0].id;
            showNotification(`Canvas "${activeCanvas.name}" deleted.`);
            renderCanvas();
        };

        const duplicateCanvas = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const original = getActiveCanvas();
            if (!project || !original) { showNotification('No active canvas to duplicate.'); return; }

            // Deep clone canvas, including maps and drawings
            let clone;
            try { clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original)); }
            catch (_) { clone = Object.assign({}, original); }

            // Restore transient references for logos (if any) in maps
            try {
                if (Array.isArray(original.maps) && Array.isArray(clone.maps)) {
                    clone.maps.forEach((m, i) => {
                        const src = original.maps[i];
                        if (src && src.details && src.details.logo && src.details.logo.imageObject) {
                            m.details = m.details || {};
                            m.details.logo = m.details.logo || {};
                            m.details.logo.imageObject = src.details.logo.imageObject;
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (_) {}

            // New unique integer id and name (avoid decimals to keep tab selection working)
            clone.id = Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000);
            const base = original.name || 'Canvas';
            let proposed = base.endsWith(' Copy') ? base : `${base} Copy`;
            const existingNames = new Set((project.canvases || []).map(c => c && c.name).filter(Boolean));
            if (existingNames.has(proposed)) {
                let i = 2;
                while (existingNames.has(`${base} Copy ${i}`)) i++;
                proposed = `${base} Copy ${i}`;
            }
            clone.name = proposed;

            // Insert after original and activate
            const idx = project.canvases.findIndex(c => String(c.id) === String(original.id));
            if (idx >= 0) project.canvases.splice(idx + 1, 0, clone); else project.canvases.push(clone);
            project.activeCanvasId = clone.id;

            renderCanvas();
            showNotification('Output canvas duplicated.');
        };

        const sendVisualizerToCanvas = () => {
            const activeMap = getActivePixelMap();
            if (!activeMap) return;

            const calcs = calculateLayout(activeMap);
            if (!calcs.totalResWidth) {
                showNotification("Current map has no valid dimensions to send.");
                return;
            }
            // Create a deep copy for the canvas
            const mapCopy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeMap));
            // Manually copy non-serializable properties (guard nested objects)
            try {
                if (activeMap.details && activeMap.details.logo && activeMap.details.logo.imageObject) {
                    mapCopy.details = mapCopy.details || {};
                    mapCopy.details.logo = mapCopy.details.logo || {};
                    mapCopy.details.logo.imageObject = activeMap.details.logo.imageObject;
                }
            } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

            // Create a canvas-instance map with its own unique id so multiple copies of
            // the same pixel map can coexist and be selected/moved independently.
            // Place the spread first so our explicit fields override copied ones (id, x/y, size).
            const newCanvasMap = {
                ...mapCopy,
                id: (typeof uid === 'function' ? uid() : (Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6))),
                sourceMapId: activeMap.id, // Reference to original
                sourceProjectId: state.activeProjectId,
                x: 0,
                y: 0,
                width: calcs.totalResWidth,
                height: calcs.totalResHeight,
                calcs: calcs
            };

            let activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            // If there is no active canvas, create one automatically
            if (!activeCanvas) {
                console.info('No active output canvas found — creating one automatically.');
                const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
                if (!project) {
                    showNotification('No active project to create output canvas in.');
                    return;
                }
                const newCanvas = { id: Date.now(), name: 'Canvas 1', width: calcs.totalResWidth || 1920, height: calcs.totalResHeight || 1080, maps: [] };
                project.canvases = project.canvases || [];
                project.canvases.push(newCanvas);
                project.activeCanvasId = newCanvas.id;
                activeCanvas = newCanvas;
            }

            activeCanvas.maps = activeCanvas.maps || [];
            activeCanvas.maps.push(newCanvasMap);
            showNotification(`'${activeMap.name}' sent to Output Canvas.`);
            // re-render canvases so user can see it immediately
            try { renderCanvas(); } catch (e) { console.warn('renderCanvas error after send', e); }
            switchTab('canvas');
        };
        
        const drawMainCanvas = () => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const canvas = document.getElementById('main-canvas');
            const container = document.getElementById('main-canvas-container');
            const drawOverlay = document.getElementById('draw-overlay');
            if(!project || !canvas || !container) return;
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if(!activeCanvas) return;
            
            const { zoom, panX, panY } = state.canvasState;
            const rulerSize = state.canvasState.rulers ? 30 : 0;

            container.style.width = `${activeCanvas.width}px`;
            container.style.height = `${activeCanvas.height}px`;
            // First translate in screen pixels (including ruler offset), then scale.
            // This yields: screen = world * zoom + (pan + ruler),
            // and the inverse used in mouse handlers: world = (screen - (pan + ruler)) / zoom.
            container.style.transform = `translate(${panX + rulerSize}px, ${panY + rulerSize}px) scale(${zoom})`;
            container.style.transformOrigin = 'top left';

            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            if (canvas.width !== activeCanvas.width || canvas.height !== activeCanvas.height) {
                 canvas.width = activeCanvas.width;
                 canvas.height = activeCanvas.height;
            }
            if (drawOverlay) {
                // Keep overlay same size as main canvas so world coords line up
                if (drawOverlay.width !== activeCanvas.width || drawOverlay.height !== activeCanvas.height) {
                    drawOverlay.width = activeCanvas.width;
                    drawOverlay.height = activeCanvas.height;
                }
            }
            
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            activeCanvas.maps.forEach(map => {
                const tempCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                // Force full resolution (ignore preview quality scale)
                drawVisualizerCanvas(tempCanvas, map, { forceFullRes: true });
                if (tempCanvas.width > 0 && tempCanvas.height > 0) {
                    const sw0 = tempCanvas.width;
                    const sh0 = tempCanvas.height;
                    const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropLeft ?? map.sliceLeft ?? 0)));
                    const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropRight ?? map.sliceRight ?? 0)));
                    const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropTop ?? 0)));
                    const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropBottom ?? 0)));
                    // Allow full crop to zero, clamp totals to source dimensions
                    const totalCropW = Math.min(sw0, sL + sR);
                    const totalCropH = Math.min(sh0, sT + sB);
                    const srcX = Math.min(sL, sw0);
                    const srcY = Math.min(sT, sh0);
                    const srcW = Math.max(0, sw0 - totalCropW);
                    const srcH = Math.max(0, sh0 - totalCropH);
                    if (srcW === 0 || srcH === 0) return; // nothing visible after crop
                    // Cropping: keep same placement scale; reduce destination rect accordingly
                    const scaleX = map.width / sw0;
                    const scaleY = map.height / sh0;
                    const destX = map.x + scaleX * srcX;
                    const destW = scaleX * srcW;
                    const destY = map.y + scaleY * srcY;
                    const destH = scaleY * srcH;
                    ctx.drawImage(tempCanvas, srcX, srcY, srcW, srcH, destX, destY, destW, destH);

                    // Processor patch overlay on Output Canvas (if enabled)
                    try {
                        const pp = activeCanvas.processorPatch || {};
                        const cfg = activeCanvas.processorConfig || {};
                        if (pp.showOverlay) {
                            const style = Object.assign({ color: '#ff0000', width: 5, lineStyle: 'solid', wiringPattern: 'H-TL' }, pp.overlayStyle || {});
                            const calcs = (typeof calculateLayout === 'function') ? calculateLayout(map) : null;
                            if (calcs && calcs.panelResWidth && calcs.panelResHeight && calcs.panelsHorizontally && calcs.panelsVertically) {
                                // Visible panel counts after crop
                                const pW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelResWidth));
                                const pH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelResHeight));
                                const panelsX = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelsHorizontally));
                                const panelsY = Math.max(1, Math.floor(calcs.panelsVertically));
                                const offColsLeft = Math.min(panelsX, Math.ceil(sL / pW));
                                const offColsRight = Math.min(panelsX - offColsLeft, Math.ceil(sR / pW));
                                const offRowsTop = Math.min(panelsY, Math.ceil(sT / pH));
                                const offRowsBottom = Math.min(panelsY - offRowsTop, Math.ceil(sB / pH));
