                                const visCols = Math.max(0, panelsX - offColsLeft - offColsRight);
                                const visRows = Math.max(0, panelsY - offRowsTop - offRowsBottom);
                                if (visCols > 0 && visRows > 0) {
                                    // Destination per-panel size
                                    const dPW = destW / visCols;
                                    const dPH = destH / visRows;
                                    // Stroke style
                                    ctx.save();
                                    ctx.strokeStyle = style.color;
                                    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, style.width);
                                    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
                                    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                                    if (style.lineStyle === 'dashed') ctx.setLineDash([Math.max(8, style.width*2), Math.max(6, style.width*1.5)]);
                                    else if (style.lineStyle === 'dotted') ctx.setLineDash([style.width, Math.max(6, style.width*2)]);
                                    // Arrow helper
                                    const drawHead = (x1,y1,x2,y2) => {
                                        const headLen = Math.max(6, Math.round(style.width * 2));
                                        const ang = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
                                        ctx.beginPath();
                                        ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
                                        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(ang - Math.PI/6), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(ang - Math.PI/6));
                                        ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
                                        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLen * Math.cos(ang + Math.PI/6), y2 - headLen * Math.sin(ang + Math.PI/6));
                                        ctx.stroke();
                                    };
                                    const isH = String(style.wiringPattern||'H-TL').startsWith('H-');
                                    const startCorner = String(style.wiringPattern||'H-TL').slice(2);
                                    if (isH) {
                                        const topFirst = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'TR');
                                        const leftStart = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'BL');
                                        const rowOrder = [...Array(visRows).keys()];
                                        if (!topFirst) rowOrder.reverse();
                                        rowOrder.forEach((rowAbsIdx, relIdx) => {
                                            const y = destY + rowAbsIdx * dPH + dPH/2;
                                            const ltr = (relIdx % 2 === 0) ? leftStart : !leftStart;
                                            const xStart = ltr ? (destX + dPW/2) : (destX + destW - dPW/2);
                                            const xEnd = ltr ? (destX + destW - dPW/2) : (destX + dPW/2);
                                            ctx.beginPath();
                                            ctx.moveTo(xStart, y);
                                            ctx.lineTo(xEnd, y);
                                            ctx.stroke();
                                            drawHead(xStart, y, xEnd, y);
                                            // connector down to next row
                                            const nextRowAbs = rowOrder[relIdx + 1];
                                            if (nextRowAbs != null) {
                                                const y2 = destY + nextRowAbs * dPH + dPH/2;
                                                const xConn = xEnd;
                                                ctx.beginPath();
                                                ctx.moveTo(xConn, y);
                                                ctx.lineTo(xConn, y2);
                                                ctx.stroke();
                                            }
                                        });
                                    } else {
                                        // vertical
                                        const leftFirst = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'BL');
                                        const topStart = (startCorner === 'TL' || startCorner === 'TR');
                                        const colOrder = [...Array(visCols).keys()];
                                        if (!leftFirst) colOrder.reverse();
                                        colOrder.forEach((colAbsIdx, relIdx) => {
                                            const x = destX + colAbsIdx * dPW + dPW/2;
                                            const ttb = (relIdx % 2 === 0) ? topStart : !topStart;
                                            const yStart = ttb ? (destY + dPH/2) : (destY + destH - dPH/2);
                                            const yEnd = ttb ? (destY + destH - dPH/2) : (destY + dPH/2);
                                            ctx.beginPath();
                                            ctx.moveTo(x, yStart);
                                            ctx.lineTo(x, yEnd);
                                            ctx.stroke();
                                            drawHead(x, yStart, x, yEnd);
                                            const nextColAbs = colOrder[relIdx + 1];
                                            if (nextColAbs != null) {
                                                const x2 = destX + nextColAbs * dPW + dPW/2;
                                                const yConn = yEnd;
                                                ctx.beginPath();
                                                ctx.moveTo(x, yConn);
                                                ctx.lineTo(x2, yConn);
                                                ctx.stroke();
                                            }
                                        });
                                    }

                                    // Per-port bounding boxes/labels for this map
                                    try {
                                        const assigns = Array.isArray(pp.assignments) ? pp.assignments : [];
                                        const mine = assigns.filter(a => String(a.mapId) === String(map.id));
                                        if (mine.length) {
                                            ctx.setLineDash([]);
                                            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                                            const sX = scaleX; // map.width / sw0
                                            const sY = scaleY; // map.height / sh0
                                            mine.forEach(a => {
                                                const dx = destX + sX * (a.relX + sL);
                                                const dy = destY + sY * (a.relY + sT);
                                                const dw = sX * a.w;
                                                const dh = sY * a.h;
                                                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
                                                ctx.strokeRect(dx + 0.5, dy + 0.5, Math.max(0, dw - 1), Math.max(0, dh - 1));
                                                const text = `U${a.unit}-P${a.port}`;
                                                const fs = Math.max(8, Math.round(Math.min(dPW, dPH) * 0.35));
                                                ctx.font = `${fs}px Inter`;
                                                const pad = 2;
                                                const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + pad*2;
                                                const th = fs + pad*2;
                                                const cx = dx + dw/2 - tw/2;
                                                const cy = dy + dh/2 - th/2;
                                                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
                                                ctx.fillRect(cx, cy, tw, th);
                                                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                                                ctx.fillText(text, cx + pad, cy + th - pad - 2);
                                            });
                                        }
                                    } catch(_) {}

                                    ctx.restore();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch(_) {}
                    // Selection outline reflects visible bounds
                    if (map.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId) {
                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.9)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 4 / zoom;
                        ctx.strokeRect(destX, destY, destW, destH);
                    }
                    // Coordinates label with nearest gap info, placed just outside the visible rect
                    try {
                        const baseFs = state.canvasState.coordFontSize || 12;
                        const fs = Math.max(8, Math.round(baseFs / zoom));
                        ctx.font = `${fs}px Inter, Arial`;
                        const gaps = computeNearestGapsForMap(activeCanvas, map);
                        const parts = [`X: ${Math.round(map.x)}`, `Y: ${Math.round(map.y)}`];
                        if (gaps && gaps.hGap != null && gaps.hGap > 0) parts.push(`H: ${Math.round(gaps.hGap)} px`);
                        if (gaps && gaps.vGap != null && gaps.vGap > 0) parts.push(`V: ${Math.round(gaps.vGap)} px`);
                        const label = parts.join('  ');
                        const pad = 4 / zoom;
                        const tw = ctx.measureText(label).width + pad * 2;
                        const th = fs + pad * 2;
                        // Try to place above; if not enough room, try below; then left; then right
                        const visLeft = destX, visTop = destY, visRight = destX + destW, visBottom = destY + destH;
                        let lx = visLeft;
                        let ly = visTop - th - 2/zoom; // above
                        if (ly < 0) {
                            ly = visBottom + 2/zoom; // below
                            if (ly + th > canvas.height) {
                                // left of rect
                                lx = visLeft - tw - 2/zoom;
                                ly = Math.max(0, visTop);
                                if (lx < 0) {
                                    // right of rect
                                    lx = visRight + 2/zoom;
                                    ly = Math.max(0, visTop);
                                    // Clamp if exceeds canvas width
                                    if (lx + tw > canvas.width) {
                                        lx = Math.max(0, canvas.width - tw - 2/zoom);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        // Final clamps
                        lx = Math.max(0, Math.min(lx, canvas.width - tw));
                        ly = Math.max(0, Math.min(ly, canvas.height - th));
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
                        ctx.fillRect(lx, ly, tw, th);
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(label, lx + pad, ly + fs + (pad - 2/zoom));
                    } catch(_) {}
                }
            });

            // Draw crop selection rectangle overlay (if any)
            if (state.canvasState.cropSelecting && state.canvasState.cropRect) {
                const r = state.canvasState.cropRect;
                const x = Math.min(r.x1, r.x2);
                const y = Math.min(r.y1, r.y2);
                const w = Math.abs(r.x2 - r.x1);
                const h = Math.abs(r.y2 - r.y1);
                if (isFinite(w) && isFinite(h) && w >= 0 && h >= 0) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.setLineDash([6 / zoom, 4 / zoom]);
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2 / zoom;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.9)';
                    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.15)';
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            }

            if (state.canvasState.snapLines.length > 0) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.9)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2 / zoom;
                ctx.beginPath();
                state.canvasState.snapLines.forEach(line => {
                    ctx.moveTo(line.x1, line.y1);
                    ctx.lineTo(line.x2, line.y2);
                });
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            if (state.canvasState.grid) {
                drawCanvasGrid();
            } else {
                const gridCanvas = document.getElementById('grid-canvas');
                if(gridCanvas) gridCanvas.style.display = 'none';
            }

            if (state.canvasState.rulers) {
                drawRulers();
            } else {
                const rulerTop = document.getElementById('ruler-top');
                const rulerLeft = document.getElementById('ruler-left');
                if(rulerTop) rulerTop.style.display = 'none';
                if(rulerLeft) rulerLeft.style.display = 'none';
            }

            // Draw gap measurement guides if any (live), otherwise the last persistent guides.
            // If none present, draw transient guides for the selected map so users can see gap text between maps.
            try {
                const guides = state.canvasState.gapGuides;
                const persistent = state.canvasState.persistentGuides;
                let gsrc = guides || persistent;
                // If no guides present, compute transient guides for selected map
                if (!gsrc && state.canvasState.selectedMapId) {
                    const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
                    const sel = activeCanvas?.maps?.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                    if (sel) gsrc = computeGapGuidesForTarget(activeCanvas, sel);
                }
                if (gsrc) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.setLineDash([6/zoom, 6/zoom]);
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2/zoom;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.9)';
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(17,24,39,0.8)';
                    const drawGuide = (g) => {
                        if (!g) return;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(g.x1, g.y1);
                        ctx.lineTo(g.x2, g.y2);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        const fs = Math.max(10, Math.round(12/zoom));
                        ctx.font = `${fs}px Inter, Arial`;
                        const pad = 4/zoom;
                        const tw = ctx.measureText(g.text).width + pad*2;
                        const th = fs + pad*2;
                        const bx = g.tx - tw/2;
                        const by = g.ty - th/2;
                        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, tw, th);
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(g.text, bx + pad, by + fs + (pad - 2/zoom));
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(17,24,39,0.8)';
                    };
                    drawGuide(gsrc.h);
                    drawGuide(gsrc.v);
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // After base render, draw manual overlay strokes and preview
            try { renderDrawOverlay(); } catch(_) {}
        };

        // Compute the visible rectangle of a map accounting for cropping
        const getVisibleRectForMap = (m) => {
            if (!m) return null;
            const sw0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m?.calcs?.totalResWidth || m.width || 1));
            const sh0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m?.calcs?.totalResHeight || m.height || 1));
            const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropLeft ?? m.sliceLeft ?? 0));
            const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropRight ?? m.sliceRight ?? 0));
            const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropTop ?? 0));
            const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropBottom ?? 0));
            const totalCropW = Math.min(sw0, sL + sR);
            const totalCropH = Math.min(sh0, sT + sB);
            const srcW = Math.max(0, sw0 - totalCropW);
            const srcH = Math.max(0, sh0 - totalCropH);
            if (srcW === 0 || srcH === 0) return { left: m.x, top: m.y, right: m.x, bottom: m.y, width: 0, height: 0 };
            const scaleX = m.width / sw0;
            const scaleY = m.height / sh0;
            const left = m.x + scaleX * sL;
            const top = m.y + scaleY * sT;
            const right = left + scaleX * srcW;
            const bottom = top + scaleY * srcH;
            return { left, top, right, bottom, width: right - left, height: bottom - top };
        };

        // For a given map, compute nearest horizontal and vertical gap (in pixels) to any other map that overlaps on the perpendicular axis.
        const computeNearestGapsForMap = (canvasObj, target) => {
            if (!canvasObj || !target || !Array.isArray(canvasObj.maps)) return { hGap: null, vGap: null };
            const self = getVisibleRectForMap(target);
            let hGap = null, vGap = null;
            canvasObj.maps.forEach(other => {
                if (!other || other.id === target.id) return;
                const r = getVisibleRectForMap(other);
                // Horizontal gap if vertical overlap exists
                const vOverlap = Math.min(self.bottom, r.bottom) - Math.max(self.top, r.top);
                if (vOverlap > 0) {
                    if (self.right <= r.left) {
                        const d = r.left - self.right; hGap = (hGap == null) ? d : Math.min(hGap, d);
                    } else if (r.right <= self.left) {
                        const d = self.left - r.right; hGap = (hGap == null) ? d : Math.min(hGap, d);
                    }
                }
                // Vertical gap if horizontal overlap exists
                const hOverlap = Math.min(self.right, r.right) - Math.max(self.left, r.left);
                if (hOverlap > 0) {
                    if (self.bottom <= r.top) {
                        const d = r.top - self.bottom; vGap = (vGap == null) ? d : Math.min(vGap, d);
                    } else if (r.bottom <= self.top) {
                        const d = self.top - r.bottom; vGap = (vGap == null) ? d : Math.min(vGap, d);
                    }
                }
            });
            return { hGap, vGap };
        };

        // Compute full gap guide geometry for a target map relative to others
        // Returns { h?: {x1,y1,x2,y2,text,tx,ty}, v?: {...} }
        const computeGapGuidesForTarget = (canvasObj, target) => {
            if (!canvasObj || !target || !Array.isArray(canvasObj.maps)) return null;
            const self = getVisibleRectForMap(target);
            let bestH = null, bestV = null;
            canvasObj.maps.forEach(other => {
                if (!other || other.id === target.id) return;
                const r = getVisibleRectForMap(other);
                // Horizontal (requires vertical overlap)
                const vOverlap = Math.min(self.bottom, r.bottom) - Math.max(self.top, r.top);
                if (vOverlap > 0) {
                    let dist = null, x1, x2, y;
                    if (self.right <= r.left) { dist = r.left - self.right; x1 = self.right; x2 = r.left; }
                    else if (r.right <= self.left) { dist = self.left - r.right; x1 = r.right; x2 = self.left; }
                    if (dist != null) {
                        y = Math.max(self.top, r.top) + vOverlap/2;
                        if (!bestH || dist < bestH.dist) bestH = { dist, x1, x2, y };
                    }
                }
                // Vertical (requires horizontal overlap)
                const hOverlap = Math.min(self.right, r.right) - Math.max(self.left, r.left);
                if (hOverlap > 0) {
                    let dist = null, y1, y2, x;
                    if (self.bottom <= r.top) { dist = r.top - self.bottom; y1 = self.bottom; y2 = r.top; }
                    else if (r.bottom <= self.top) { dist = self.top - r.bottom; y1 = r.bottom; y2 = self.top; }
                    if (dist != null) {
                        x = Math.max(self.left, r.left) + hOverlap/2;
                        if (!bestV || dist < bestV.dist) bestV = { dist, y1, y2, x };
                    }
                }
            });
            const out = {};
            if (bestH) out.h = { x1: bestH.x1, y1: bestH.y, x2: bestH.x2, y2: bestH.y, text: `${Math.round(bestH.dist)} px`, tx: (bestH.x1+bestH.x2)/2, ty: bestH.y };
            if (bestV) out.v = { x1: bestV.x, y1: bestV.y1, x2: bestV.x, y2: bestV.y2, text: `${Math.round(bestV.dist)} px`, tx: bestV.x, ty: (bestV.y1+bestV.y2)/2 };
            return (out.h || out.v) ? out : null;
        };

    // Draw a line with optional arrowheads on the given context
        const drawLineWithArrows = (ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, options = {}) => {
            const color = options.color || '#ff0000';
            const width = Math.max(1, options.width || 2);
            const arrowStart = !!options.arrowStart;
            const arrowEnd = !!options.arrowEnd;
            const lineStyle = options.lineStyle || 'solid'; // solid|dashed|dotted|zigzag
            const zzAmp = Math.max(0, options.zzAmp != null ? +options.zzAmp : Math.max(2, width * 2));
            const zzStep = Math.max(1, options.zzStep != null ? +options.zzStep : Math.max(6, width * 4));
            const arrowSize = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(5, options.arrowSize || 1));
            ctx.save();
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = width;
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';
            // Apply line style
            if (lineStyle === 'dashed') {
                ctx.setLineDash([width * 4, width * 2]);
            } else if (lineStyle === 'dotted') {
                ctx.setLineDash([0, width * 2.2]); // sequence of round-capped dots
            } else {
                ctx.setLineDash([]);
            }
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
            if (lineStyle === 'zigzag') {
                // Draw a triangular zigzag from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2)
                const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
                const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
                const ux = dx / len, uy = dy / len;           // unit vector along line
                const nx = -uy, ny = ux;                       // normal vector
                let d = zzStep;
                let sign = 1;
                while (d < len) {
                    const px = x1 + ux * d + nx * zzAmp * sign;
                    const py = y1 + uy * d + ny * zzAmp * sign;
                    ctx.lineTo(px, py);
                    d += zzStep;
                    sign *= -1;
                }
                ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
                ctx.stroke();
            } else {
                ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            // Arrowheads
            const drawArrowHead = (toX, toY, angle) => {
                const len = Math.max(6, width * 3) * arrowSize;
                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(toX, toY);
                ctx.lineTo(toX - len * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), toY - len * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
                ctx.lineTo(toX - len * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), toY - len * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fill();
            };
            const arrowAngle = typeof options.arrowAngle === 'number' ? options.arrowAngle : Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
            if (arrowStart) drawArrowHead(x1, y1, arrowAngle + Math.PI); // start arrow
            if (arrowEnd) drawArrowHead(x2, y2, arrowAngle); // end arrow
            ctx.restore();
        };

        // Draw a freehand pencil polyline and arrowheads at crossings
        const drawPencilPolyline = (ctx, points, arrowPoints, options = {}) => {
            if (!points || points.length < 2) return;
            const color = options.color || '#ff0000';
            const width = Math.max(1, options.width || 2);
            const arrowScale = options.arrowSize || 1;
            const nearPoint = (a, b) => a && b && Math.abs(a.x - b.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(a.y - b.y) < 0.5;
            const startPt = points[0];
            const endPt = points[points.length - 1];
            const hasLegacyStartArrow = Array.isArray(arrowPoints) && startPt && arrowPoints.some(ap => nearPoint(ap, startPt));
            const hasLegacyEndArrow = Array.isArray(arrowPoints) && endPt && arrowPoints.some(ap => nearPoint(ap, endPt));
            let arrowStart = (typeof options.arrowStart === 'boolean') ? options.arrowStart : hasLegacyStartArrow;
            let arrowEnd = (typeof options.arrowEnd === 'boolean') ? options.arrowEnd : hasLegacyEndArrow;
            arrowStart = !!arrowStart;
            arrowEnd = !!arrowEnd;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = width;
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(startPt.x, startPt.y);
            for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
                ctx.lineTo(points[i].x, points[i].y);
            }
            ctx.stroke();

            const drawArrowHead = (x, y, angle) => {
                const len = Math.max(6, width * 3) * arrowScale;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                ctx.lineTo(x - len * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y - len * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
                ctx.lineTo(x - len * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y - len * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
            };

            const filteredArrowPoints = Array.isArray(arrowPoints)
                ? arrowPoints.filter(ap => {
                    if (startPt && nearPoint(ap, startPt)) return false;
                    if (endPt && nearPoint(ap, endPt)) return false;
                    return true;
                })
                : [];

            filteredArrowPoints.forEach(ap => drawArrowHead(ap.x, ap.y, ap.angle));

            if (arrowStart && points.length > 1) {
                const next = points[1];
                const angle = Math.atan2(startPt.y - next.y, startPt.x - next.x);
                drawArrowHead(startPt.x, startPt.y, angle);
            }
            if (arrowEnd && points.length > 1) {
                const prev = points[points.length - 2];
                const angle = Math.atan2(endPt.y - prev.y, endPt.x - prev.x);
                drawArrowHead(endPt.x, endPt.y, angle);
            }

            ctx.restore();
        };

        // Render all saved strokes and current preview on overlay canvas
        const renderDrawOverlay = () => {
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            const overlay = document.getElementById('draw-overlay');
            if (!activeCanvas || !overlay) return;
            // Keep overlay dimensions in sync with world space so clearing is exact and previews don't smear when zoom/pan change.
            if (overlay.width !== activeCanvas.width || overlay.height !== activeCanvas.height) {
                overlay.width = activeCanvas.width;
                overlay.height = activeCanvas.height;
            }
            const ctx = overlay.getContext('2d');
            // Reset any transform/dash state before clearing to avoid leaving trails.
            ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, overlay.width, overlay.height);
            const showLines = state.canvasState.drawing?.showLines !== false;
            const strokes = Array.isArray(activeCanvas.drawings) ? activeCanvas.drawings : [];
            if (showLines) {
                strokes.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.lineStyle === 'pencil' && Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 1) {
                        drawPencilPolyline(ctx, s.points, s.arrowPoints, s);
                    } else {
                        drawLineWithArrows(ctx, s.x1, s.y1, s.x2, s.y2, s);
                    }
                });
                // Highlight selected stroke if any
                const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                const toHighlight = new Set();
                if (typeof selIdx === 'number' && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < strokes.length) toHighlight.add(selIdx);
                selMany.forEach(i => { if (i >= 0 && i < strokes.length) toHighlight.add(i); });
                if (toHighlight.size > 0) {
                    ctx.save();
                    toHighlight.forEach(i => {
                        const s = strokes[i];
                        if (!s) return;
                        if (s.lineStyle === 'pencil' && Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 1) {
                            drawPencilPolyline(ctx, s.points, s.arrowPoints, {
                                color: '#00ffff',
                                width: Math.max(2, (s.width||2) + 3),
                                arrowSize: (s.arrowSize||1),
                                arrowStart: s.arrowStart,
                                arrowEnd: s.arrowEnd
                            });
                        } else {
                            drawLineWithArrows(ctx, s.x1, s.y1, s.x2, s.y2, { color: '#00ffff', width: Math.max(2, (s.width||2) + 3), lineStyle: s.lineStyle, arrowStart: s.arrowStart, arrowEnd: s.arrowEnd, arrowSize: s.arrowSize, arrowAngle: s.arrowAngle });
                        }
                    });
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            }
            // Preview (supports straight preview or pencil freehand path)
            const p = state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.preview;
            const pPath = state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath;
            if (pPath && state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle === 'pencil') {
                drawPencilPolyline(ctx, pPath, state.canvasState.drawing.arrowPoints, {
                    color: state.canvasState.drawing.color,
                    width: state.canvasState.drawing.width,
                    arrowSize: state.canvasState.drawing.arrowSize,
                    arrowStart: state.canvasState.drawing.arrowStart,
                    arrowEnd: state.canvasState.drawing.arrowEnd
                });
            } else if (p) {
                // If snapping, show a different color for the preview
                let previewColor = state.canvasState.drawing.color;
                if (p.snapped) previewColor = '#00ff00'; // bright green for snap effect
                drawLineWithArrows(ctx, p.x1, p.y1, p.x2, p.y2, {
                    color: previewColor,
                    width: state.canvasState.drawing.width,
                    lineStyle: state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle,
                    arrowSize: state.canvasState.drawing.arrowSize,
                    arrowStart: state.canvasState.drawing.arrowStart,
                    arrowEnd: state.canvasState.drawing.arrowEnd
                });
                // Draw a green snap dot at the snapped endpoint for clear feedback
                try {
                    const sp = state.canvasState.drawing.snapPoint;
                    if (sp && p.snapped) {
                        const zoom = state.canvasState.zoom || 1;
                        const r = Math.max(3, 6 / zoom);
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(sp.x, sp.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 2 / zoom);
                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#0a0a0a';
                        ctx.stroke();
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                } catch(_) {}
            }

            // Draw marquee selection rectangle if any (select mode)
            try {
                const drawCfg = state.canvasState.drawing || {};
                const mr = drawCfg.marqueeRect;
                if (drawCfg.selectEnabled && drawCfg.marqueeSelecting && mr) {
                    const x = Math.min(mr.x1, mr.x2);
                    const y = Math.min(mr.y1, mr.y2);
                    const w = Math.abs(mr.x2 - mr.x1);
                    const h = Math.abs(mr.y2 - mr.y1);
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.9)';
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15)';
                    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Update Undo/Redo buttons states
            try {
                const undoBtn = document.getElementById('draw-undo');
                const redoBtn = document.getElementById('draw-redo');
                if (undoBtn) undoBtn.disabled = !(activeCanvas && Array.isArray(activeCanvas.drawings) && activeCanvas.drawings.length > 0);
                if (redoBtn) redoBtn.disabled = !(activeCanvas && Array.isArray(activeCanvas.drawingsRedo) && activeCanvas.drawingsRedo.length > 0);
            } catch(_) {}
        };

        // Sync selection UI and control values based on selected stroke or defaults
        function syncSelectionUIFromStroke() {
            try {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                const drawCfg = state.canvasState.drawing || {};
                const selIdx = state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndex;
                const selMany = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing?.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                const lbl = document.getElementById('selected-stroke-label');
                const delBtn = document.getElementById('draw-delete-selected');
                const colorEl = document.getElementById('draw-color');
                const widthEl = document.getElementById('draw-width');
                const styleEl = document.getElementById('draw-style');
                const aStartEl = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-start');
                const aEndEl = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-end');
                const arrowSizeEl = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-size');
                const arrowSizeVal = document.getElementById('draw-arrow-size-val');
                const hasSingle = (typeof selIdx === 'number' && ac && ac.drawings && selIdx >= 0 && selIdx < ac.drawings.length && (!selMany || selMany.length <= 1));
                if (hasSingle) {
                    const s = ac.drawings[selIdx] || {};
                    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `Selected: #${selIdx + 1}`;
                    if (delBtn) delBtn.disabled = false;
                    if (colorEl && s.color) colorEl.value = s.color;
                    if (widthEl && s.width) widthEl.value = s.width;
                    if (styleEl && s.lineStyle) styleEl.value = s.lineStyle;
                    if (aStartEl) aStartEl.checked = !!s.arrowStart;
                    if (aEndEl) aEndEl.checked = !!s.arrowEnd;
                    if (arrowSizeEl) arrowSizeEl.value = s.arrowSize || (drawCfg.arrowSize || 1.2);
                    if (arrowSizeVal) arrowSizeVal.textContent = `x${arrowSizeEl ? arrowSizeEl.value : (s.arrowSize || drawCfg.arrowSize || 1.2)}`;
                } else if (Array.isArray(selMany) && selMany.length > 0) {
                    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `Selected: ${selMany.length}`;
                    if (delBtn) delBtn.disabled = false;
                    // Leave control values as-is for batch editing; they will apply to all selected on change
                } else {
                    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'Selected: None';
                    if (delBtn) delBtn.disabled = true;
                    if (colorEl) colorEl.value = drawCfg.color || '#ff0000';
                    if (widthEl) widthEl.value = drawCfg.width || 5;
                    if (styleEl) styleEl.value = drawCfg.lineStyle || 'solid';
                    if (aStartEl) aStartEl.checked = !!drawCfg.arrowStart;
                    if (aEndEl) aEndEl.checked = !!drawCfg.arrowEnd;
                    if (arrowSizeEl) arrowSizeEl.value = drawCfg.arrowSize || 1.2;
                    if (arrowSizeVal) arrowSizeVal.textContent = `x${drawCfg.arrowSize || 1.2}`;
                }
            } catch(_) {}
        }

        // Helper: paint this canvas object's saved drawings onto a 2D context
        const drawCanvasDrawingsToContext = (ctx, canvasObj) => {
            if (!canvasObj || !Array.isArray(canvasObj.drawings)) return;
            canvasObj.drawings.forEach(s => {
                if (s.lineStyle === 'pencil' && Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 1) {
                    drawPencilPolyline(ctx, s.points, s.arrowPoints, s);
                } else {
                    drawLineWithArrows(ctx, s.x1, s.y1, s.x2, s.y2, s);
                }
            });
        };
        
        const drawCanvasGrid = () => {
            const gridCanvas = document.getElementById('grid-canvas');
            const container = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            if(!gridCanvas || !container) return;
            
            gridCanvas.style.display = 'block';
            const { zoom, panX, panY } = state.canvasState;
            const rulerSize = state.canvasState.rulers ? 30 : 0;
            
            gridCanvas.width = container.clientWidth;
            gridCanvas.height = container.clientHeight;
            gridCanvas.style.transform = `translate(0, 0)`;

            const ctx = gridCanvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, gridCanvas.width, gridCanvas.height);
            
            let interval = 100;
            if (zoom < 0.25) interval = 500;
            else if (zoom < 0.5) interval = 200;
            
            const scaledInterval = interval * zoom;
            
            const startX = rulerSize + (panX % scaledInterval);
            const startY = rulerSize + (panY % scaledInterval);
            
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)";
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            
            for(let x = startX; x < gridCanvas.width; x += scaledInterval) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, rulerSize);
                ctx.lineTo(x, gridCanvas.height);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            for(let y = startY; y < gridCanvas.height; y += scaledInterval) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(rulerSize, y);
                ctx.lineTo(gridCanvas.width, y);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        };

        const exportCanvas = (format) => {
            const project = state.projects.find(p => p.id === state.activeProjectId);
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if (!project || !activeCanvas || !activeCanvas.width || !activeCanvas.height) {
                showNotification("Canvas has no valid dimensions to export.");
                return;
            }

            showNotification(`Generating ${format.toUpperCase()} image...`);

            const exportCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            exportCanvas.width = activeCanvas.width;
            exportCanvas.height = activeCanvas.height;
            const ctx = exportCanvas.getContext('2d');

            // Draw background
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111827';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, exportCanvas.width, exportCanvas.height);

            // Draw each map and collect coordinate labels to draw on top
            const coordLabels = [];
            activeCanvas.maps.forEach(map => {
                const tempMapCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                drawVisualizerCanvas(tempMapCanvas, map);
                if (tempMapCanvas.width > 0 && tempMapCanvas.height > 0) {
                    const sw0 = tempMapCanvas.width;
                    const sh0 = tempMapCanvas.height;
                    const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropLeft ?? map.sliceLeft ?? 0)));
                    const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropRight ?? map.sliceRight ?? 0)));
                    const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropTop ?? 0)));
                    const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor((map.cropBottom ?? 0)));
                    const totalCropW = Math.min(sw0, sL + sR);
                    const totalCropH = Math.min(sh0, sT + sB);
                    const srcX = Math.min(sL, sw0);
                    const srcY = Math.min(sT, sh0);
                    const srcW = Math.max(0, sw0 - totalCropW);
                    const srcH = Math.max(0, sh0 - totalCropH);
                    if (srcW === 0 || srcH === 0) return;
                    const scaleX = map.width / sw0;
                    const scaleY = map.height / sh0;
                    const destX = map.x + scaleX * srcX;
                    const destW = scaleX * srcW;
                    const destY = map.y + scaleY * srcY;
                    const destH = scaleY * srcH;
                    ctx.drawImage(tempMapCanvas, srcX, srcY, srcW, srcH, destX, destY, destW, destH);

                    // Prepare coordinates label placed outside the visible rect (draw later on top)
                    try {
                        const fs = Math.max(8, state.canvasState.coordFontSize || 12);
                        const pad = Math.max(4, Math.round(fs * 0.3));
                        const gaps = computeNearestGapsForMap(activeCanvas, map);
                        const parts = [`X: ${Math.round(map.x)}`, `Y: ${Math.round(map.y)}`];
                        if (gaps && gaps.hGap != null && gaps.hGap > 0) parts.push(`H: ${Math.round(gaps.hGap)} px`);
                        if (gaps && gaps.vGap != null && gaps.vGap > 0) parts.push(`V: ${Math.round(gaps.vGap)} px`);
                        const text = parts.join('  ');
                        // Placement outside visible rect
                        const visLeft = destX, visTop = destY, visRight = destX + destW, visBottom = destY + destH;
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.font = `${fs}px Inter, Arial`;
                        const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + pad * 2;
                        const th = fs + pad * 2;
                        let lx = visLeft;
                        let ly = visTop - th - 2; // above
                        if (ly < 0) {
                            ly = visBottom + 2; // below
                            if (ly + th > exportCanvas.height) {
                                lx = visLeft - tw - 2; // left of rect
                                ly = Math.max(0, visTop);
                                if (lx < 0) {
                                    lx = visRight + 2; // right of rect
                                    ly = Math.max(0, visTop);
                                    if (lx + tw > exportCanvas.width) {
                                        lx = Math.max(0, exportCanvas.width - tw - 2);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        lx = Math.max(0, Math.min(lx, exportCanvas.width - tw));
                        ly = Math.max(0, Math.min(ly, exportCanvas.height - th));
                        ctx.restore();
                        coordLabels.push({ text, fs, pad, x: lx, y: ly });
                    } catch(_) {}
                }
            });

            // Draw gap guides (live or persistent). If neither, compute for selected map to mirror canvas behavior.
            try {
                let gsrc = state.canvasState.gapGuides || state.canvasState.persistentGuides;
                if (!gsrc && state.canvasState.selectedMapId) {
                    const sel = activeCanvas.maps?.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                    if (sel) gsrc = computeGapGuidesForTarget(activeCanvas, sel);
                }
                if (gsrc) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.9)';
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(17,24,39,0.8)';
                    const drawGuide = (g) => {
                        if (!g) return;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(g.x1, g.y1);
                        ctx.lineTo(g.x2, g.y2);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        const fs = Math.max(8, state.canvasState.coordFontSize || 12);
                        ctx.font = `${fs}px Inter, Arial`;
                        const pad = Math.max(4, Math.round(fs * 0.3));
                        const tw = ctx.measureText(g.text).width + pad*2;
                        const th = fs + pad*2;
                        const bx = g.tx - tw/2;
                        const by = g.ty - th/2;
                        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, tw, th);
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillText(g.text, bx + pad, by + fs + (pad - 2));
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(17,24,39,0.8)';
                    };
                    drawGuide(gsrc.h);
                    drawGuide(gsrc.v);
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            } catch(_) {}

            // Draw labels after all maps so they are not covered
            try {
                coordLabels.forEach(l => {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.font = `${l.fs}px Inter, Arial`;
                    const tw = ctx.measureText(l.text).width + l.pad * 2;
                    const th = l.fs + l.pad * 2;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
                    ctx.fillRect(l.x, l.y, tw, th);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.fillText(l.text, l.x + l.pad, l.y + l.fs + (l.pad - 2));
                    ctx.restore();
                });
            } catch(_) {}

            // Draw saved manual drawings on top
            try { drawCanvasDrawingsToContext(ctx, activeCanvas); } catch(_) {}

            // Add stats overlay for canvas and actual pixel usage
            try {
                const usedBounds = (() => {
                    let left = Infinity, top = Infinity, right = -Infinity, bottom = -Infinity;
                    activeCanvas.maps.forEach(map => {
                        const rect = getVisibleRectForMap(map);
                        if (!rect || rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;
                        left = Math.min(left, rect.left);
                        top = Math.min(top, rect.top);
                        right = Math.max(right, rect.right);
                        bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom);
                    });
                    if (!Number.isFinite(left) || !Number.isFinite(top) || !Number.isFinite(right) || !Number.isFinite(bottom)) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    return {
                        width: Math.max(0, Math.round(right - left)),
                        height: Math.max(0, Math.round(bottom - top))
                    };
                })();

                const stats = [
                    { title: 'Canvas Size', value: `${exportCanvas.width} x ${exportCanvas.height} px` },
                    { title: 'Actual Pixels', value: usedBounds ? `${usedBounds.width} x ${usedBounds.height} px` : '0 x 0 px' }
                ];

                const margin = 12;
                const padX = 12;
                const padY = 10;
                const baseFs = Math.max(12, Math.round(Math.min(exportCanvas.width, exportCanvas.height) * 0.018));
                const titleFs = Math.max(10, Math.round(baseFs * 0.6));
                const valueFs = Math.max(titleFs + 2, Math.round(baseFs * 1.05));
                const lineGap = Math.max(4, Math.round(valueFs * 0.2));
                const boxSpacing = Math.max(8, Math.round(margin * 0.4));

                ctx.save();
                ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
                let maxWidth = 0;
                stats.forEach(stat => {
                    ctx.font = `${titleFs}px Inter, Arial`;
                    const titleWidth = ctx.measureText(stat.title).width;
                    ctx.font = `${valueFs}px Inter, Arial`;
                    const valueWidth = ctx.measureText(stat.value).width;
                    stat.boxWidth = Math.ceil(Math.max(titleWidth, valueWidth) + padX * 2);
                    stat.boxHeight = Math.ceil(padY * 2 + titleFs + lineGap + valueFs);
                    if (stat.boxWidth > maxWidth) maxWidth = stat.boxWidth;
                });

                let yCursor = exportCanvas.height - margin;
                for (let i = stats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    const stat = stats[i];
                    yCursor -= stat.boxHeight;
                    const x = exportCanvas.width - margin - maxWidth;
                    const y = Math.max(margin, yCursor);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.78)';
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, maxWidth, stat.boxHeight);
                    ctx.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, maxWidth - 1, stat.boxHeight - 1);
                    ctx.font = `${titleFs}px Inter, Arial`;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.95)';
                    ctx.fillText(stat.title, x + padX, y + padY);
                    ctx.font = `${valueFs}px Inter, Arial`;
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.fillText(stat.value, x + padX, y + padY + titleFs + lineGap);
                    yCursor -= boxSpacing;
                }
                ctx.restore();
            } catch(_) {}

            // Trigger download
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.download = `${project.name.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_${activeCanvas.name.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}.${format}`;
            link.href = exportCanvas.toDataURL(`image/${format}`, 0.9);
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
        };

        // --- Single Visualizer Export (PNG/JPG) ---
        const sanitizeFilename = (name) => {
            try { return String(name || '').trim().replace(/[\\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_'); } catch(_) { return 'pixel_map'; }
        };

        const exportVisualizer = (format = 'png', canvasId, nameHint) => {
            try {
                const project = state.projects.find(p => String(p.id) === String(state.activeProjectId));
                const map = getActivePixelMap();
                if (!project || !map) { showNotification('No active pixel map to export'); return; }
                const temp = document.createElement('canvas');
                drawVisualizerCanvas(temp, map, { forceFullRes: true });
                if (!temp.width || !temp.height) { showNotification('Pixel map has no valid resolution'); return; }
                const w = temp.width, h = temp.height;
                const mime = format === 'jpeg' ? 'image/jpeg' : 'image/png';
                const ext = format === 'jpeg' ? 'jpg' : 'png';
                const pname = sanitizeFilename(project.name);
                const mname = sanitizeFilename(nameHint || map.name || 'pixel_map');
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.download = `${pname}_${mname}_${w}x${h}.${ext}`;
                a.href = temp.toDataURL(mime, 0.92);
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('exportVisualizer failed', e);
                showNotification('Failed to export image');
            }
        };

        // --- Batch Export: Save All Pixel Maps as PNG ---
        const exportAllPixelMapsAsPNGs = async () => {
            try {
                const project = state.projects.find(p => String(p.id) === String(state.activeProjectId));
                const maps = project?.pixelMaps || [];
                if (!project || maps.length === 0) { showNotification('No pixel maps to export'); return; }
                showNotification(`Saving ${maps.length} PNG${maps.length>1?'s':''}...`);
                const pname = sanitizeFilename(project.name);
                for (let i = 0; i < maps.length; i++) {
                    const map = maps[i];
                    const temp = document.createElement('canvas');
                    drawVisualizerCanvas(temp, map, { forceFullRes: true });
                    if (!temp.width || !temp.height) continue;
                    const w = temp.width, h = temp.height;
                    const mname = sanitizeFilename(map.name || `pixel_map_${i+1}`);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.download = `${pname}_${mname}_${w}x${h}.png`;
                    a.href = temp.toDataURL('image/png');
                    document.body.appendChild(a);
                    a.click();
                    document.body.removeChild(a);
                    // small delay between downloads to keep things smooth
                    await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 80));
                }
                showNotification('All PNGs saved');
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('exportAllPixelMapsAsPNGs failed', e);
                showNotification('Failed to save all PNGs');
            }
        };


        const handleCanvasPresetChange = (e) => {
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if(!activeCanvas) return;
            const customControls = document.getElementById('canvas-custom-size');
            if (e.target.value === 'custom') {
                customControls.style.display = 'flex';
            } else {
                const [width, height] = e.target.value.split('x').map(Number);
                activeCanvas.width = width;
                activeCanvas.height = height;
                document.getElementById('canvas-custom-width').value = width;
                document.getElementById('canvas-custom-height').value = height;
                drawMainCanvas();
            }
        };

        const handleCanvasCustomSizeChange = () => {
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if(!activeCanvas) return;
            const width = parseInt(document.getElementById('canvas-custom-width').value, 10) || 0;
            const height = parseInt(document.getElementById('canvas-custom-height').value, 10) || 0;
            activeCanvas.width = width;
            activeCanvas.height = height;
            drawMainCanvas();
        };

        const deleteSelectedMapFromCanvas = () => {
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if (!activeCanvas || state.canvasState.selectedMapId === null) {
                showNotification("No map selected to delete.");
                return;
            };

            activeCanvas.maps = activeCanvas.maps.filter(map => map.id !== state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
            state.canvasState.selectedMapId = null;
            drawMainCanvas();
            showNotification('Map deleted from canvas.');
            // Reset cropping controls when no selection
            const leftEl = document.getElementById('crop-left-input');
            const rightEl = document.getElementById('crop-right-input');
            const topEl = document.getElementById('crop-top-input');
            const bottomEl = document.getElementById('crop-bottom-input');
            const pLeftEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-left-input');
            const pRightEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-right-input');
            const pTopEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-top-input');
            const pBottomEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-bottom-input');
            if (leftEl && rightEl && topEl && bottomEl) { 
                leftEl.disabled = true; rightEl.disabled = true; topEl.disabled = true; bottomEl.disabled = true; 
                leftEl.value = 0; rightEl.value = 0; topEl.value = 0; bottomEl.value = 0; 
            }
            if (pLeftEl && pRightEl && pTopEl && pBottomEl) {
                pLeftEl.disabled = true; pRightEl.disabled = true; pTopEl.disabled = true; pBottomEl.disabled = true;
                pLeftEl.value = 0; pRightEl.value = 0; pTopEl.value = 0; pBottomEl.value = 0;
            }
            try { updateMapUndoRedoButtons(); } catch(_) {}
        };

        // Undo last deleted map on the active canvas
        function undoCanvasMapDelete() {
            try {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                if (!ac) return;
                if (!Array.isArray(state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory) || state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory.length === 0) return;
                // Find the most recent deletion for this canvas
                let entryIdx = -1;
                for (let i = state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory[i].canvasId === ac.id) { entryIdx = i; break; }
                }
                if (entryIdx < 0) return;
                const entry = state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory.splice(entryIdx, 1)[0];
                const mapSnap = entry.map;
                const insertIndex = Math.min(Math.max(0, entry.index), ac.maps.length);
                ac.maps.splice(insertIndex, 0, mapSnap);
                // Select restored map
                state.canvasState.selectedMapId = mapSnap.id;
                // Push to redo stack so we can reapply deletion
                state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo = state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo || [];
                state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo.push({ map: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mapSnap)), index: insertIndex, canvasId: ac.id });
                drawMainCanvas();
                showNotification('Restored deleted map.');
            } catch(_) {}
            try { updateMapUndoRedoButtons(); } catch(_) {}
        }

        // Redo the last undone deletion on the active canvas
        function redoCanvasMapDelete() {
            try {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                if (!ac) return;
                if (!Array.isArray(state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo) || state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo.length === 0) return;
                // Find the most recent redo for this canvas
                let entryIdx = -1;
                for (let i = state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo[i].canvasId === ac.id) { entryIdx = i; break; }
                }
                if (entryIdx < 0) return;
                const entry = state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo.splice(entryIdx, 1)[0];
                const targetId = entry.map && entry.map.id;
                // Find the map by id (prefer id match), fallback to index bounds
                let idx = ac.maps.findIndex(m => m.id === targetId);
                if (idx < 0) {
                    idx = Math.min(Math.max(0, entry.index), ac.maps.length - 1);
                }
                if (idx >= 0 && idx < ac.maps.length) {
                    const removed = ac.maps.splice(idx, 1)[0];
                    // Push back to history so it can be undone again
                    state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory = state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory || [];
                    const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(removed));
                    try {
                        if (removed?.details?.logo?.imageObject) {
                            copy.details = copy.details || {}; copy.details.logo = copy.details.logo || {};
                            copy.details.logo.imageObject = removed.details.logo.imageObject;
                        }
                    } catch(_) {}
                    state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory.push({ map: copy, index: idx, canvasId: ac.id });
                    // Clear selection if the deleted map was selected
                    if (state.canvasState.selectedMapId === (removed && removed.id)) {
                        state.canvasState.selectedMapId = null;
                    }
                    drawMainCanvas();
                    showNotification('Reapplied deletion.');
                }
            } catch(_) {}
            try { updateMapUndoRedoButtons(); } catch(_) {}
        }

        // Enable/disable Undo/Redo buttons for map deletions
        function updateMapUndoRedoButtons() {
            try {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                const undoBtn = document.getElementById('undo-map-delete-btn');
                const redoBtn = document.getElementById('redo-map-delete-btn');
                if (undoBtn) {
                    const has = !!(Array.isArray(state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory) && state.canvasState.mapDeleteHistory.some(e => e.canvasId === (ac && ac.id)));
                    undoBtn.disabled = !has;
                }
                if (redoBtn) {
                    const has = !!(Array.isArray(state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo) && state.canvasState.mapDeleteRedo.some(e => e.canvasId === (ac && ac.id)));
                    redoBtn.disabled = !has;
                }
            } catch(_) {}
        }

        const getPanelAt = (worldX, worldY, activeCanvas) => {
            if (!activeCanvas || !Array.isArray(activeCanvas.maps)) return null;
            for (let i = activeCanvas.maps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const m = activeCanvas.maps[i];
                const vr = getVisibleRectForMap(m);
                if (!vr) continue;
                if (worldX >= vr.left && worldX <= vr.right && worldY >= vr.top && worldY <= vr.bottom) {
                    return m.id;
                }
            }
            return null;
        };

        // --- Draw Mode helpers (v2) ---
        // Goal: make endpoint snapping reliable even near/over panel boundaries.
        const getAllowedRectForPanelId = (panelId, activeCanvas) => {
            if (panelId == null || !activeCanvas || !Array.isArray(activeCanvas.maps)) return null;
            const m = activeCanvas.maps.find(mm => mm && mm.id === panelId);
            return m ? getVisibleRectForMap(m) : null;
        };

        const getDrawSnapThresholdWorld = (zoom) => {
            const z = (zoom || 1);
            return (state.canvasState.drawSnapThreshold || 50) / z;
        };

        const findDrawSnapPoint = (x, y, activeCanvas, zoom, allowedRect, allowedPanelId, wantSnap) => {
            if (!wantSnap) return { x, y, snapped: false };
            const thresholdWorld = getDrawSnapThresholdWorld(zoom);
            // Prefer snapping within current panel scope, but fall back to global snapping
            // so users can connect across panel boundaries.
            let r = findSnapPoint(x, y, activeCanvas, thresholdWorld, allowedRect, allowedPanelId);
            if (!r.snapped) {
                r = findSnapPoint(x, y, activeCanvas, thresholdWorld, null, null);
            }
            return r;
        };

        const computeDrawStartContext = (worldX, worldY, activeCanvas, zoom, wantSnap) => {
            let panelId = getPanelAt(worldX, worldY, activeCanvas);
            let allowedRect = getAllowedRectForPanelId(panelId, activeCanvas);
            const snap = findDrawSnapPoint(worldX, worldY, activeCanvas, zoom, allowedRect, panelId, wantSnap);
            // If snapping moved the start point into a different panel, track that panel.
            const snappedPanelId = getPanelAt(snap.x, snap.y, activeCanvas);
            if (snappedPanelId != null) {
                panelId = snappedPanelId;
                allowedRect = getAllowedRectForPanelId(panelId, activeCanvas);
            }
            return { x: snap.x, y: snap.y, snapped: snap.snapped, panelId, allowedRect };
        };

        const findSnapPoint = (x, y, canvas, threshold, allowedRect, allowedPanelId) => {
            if (!canvas || !Array.isArray(canvas.drawings)) return { x, y, snapped: false };

            let bestSnap = { dist: Infinity, x, y };

            canvas.drawings.forEach(stroke => {
                if (allowedPanelId != null && typeof stroke.panelId !== 'undefined' && stroke.panelId !== allowedPanelId) {
                    return; // restrict snapping to strokes started in same panel
                }
                if (stroke.lineStyle === 'pencil' && stroke.points) {
                    // Snap to start/end of pencil strokes
                    const first = stroke.points[0];
                    const last = stroke.points[stroke.points.length - 1];
                    [first, last].forEach(p => {
                        if (allowedRect) {
                            if (p.x < allowedRect.left || p.x > allowedRect.right || p.y < allowedRect.top || p.y > allowedRect.bottom) return;
                        }
                        const d = Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y);
                        if (d < threshold && d < bestSnap.dist) {
                            bestSnap = { dist: d, x: p.x, y: p.y };
                        }
                    });
                } else if (stroke.x1 != null) {
                    // Snap to start/end of straight lines
                    [{x: stroke.x1, y: stroke.y1}, {x: stroke.x2, y: stroke.y2}].forEach(p => {
                        if (allowedRect) {
                            if (p.x < allowedRect.left || p.x > allowedRect.right || p.y < allowedRect.top || p.y > allowedRect.bottom) return;
                        }
                        const d = Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y);
                        if (d < threshold && d < bestSnap.dist) {
                            bestSnap = { dist: d, x: p.x, y: p.y };
                        }
                    });
                }
            });

            if (bestSnap.dist < threshold) {
                return { x: bestSnap.x, y: bestSnap.y, snapped: true };
            }
            return { x, y, snapped: false };
        };

        // Hit-test to find a stroke near a point (world coords). Returns { index } or null
        const findStrokeAtPoint = (canvasObj, x, y, threshold) => {
            if (!canvasObj || !Array.isArray(canvasObj.drawings)) return null;
            const distPointToSeg = (px, py, x1, y1, x2, y2) => {
                const vx = x2 - x1, vy = y2 - y1;
                const wx = px - x1, wy = py - y1;
                const c1 = vx*wx + vy*wy;
                if (c1 <= 0) return Math.hypot(px - x1, py - y1);
                const c2 = vx*vx + vy*vy;
                if (c2 <= 0) return Math.hypot(px - x1, py - y1);
                const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, c1 / c2));
                const projx = x1 + t * vx, projy = y1 + t * vy;
                return Math.hypot(px - projx, py - projy);
            };
            for (let i = canvasObj.drawings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const s = canvasObj.drawings[i];
                if (s && s.lineStyle === 'pencil' && Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 1) {
                    for (let j = 0; j < s.points.length - 1; j++) {
                        const a = s.points[j], b = s.points[j+1];
                        const d = distPointToSeg(x, y, a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y);
                        if (d <= Math.max(threshold, (s.width||2)/2)) return { index: i };
                    }
                } else if (s && typeof s.x1 === 'number' && typeof s.y1 === 'number' && typeof s.x2 === 'number' && typeof s.y2 === 'number') {
                    const d = distPointToSeg(x, y, s.x1, s.y1, s.x2, s.y2);
                    const tol = Math.max(threshold, (s.width||2)/2);
                    if (d <= tol) return { index: i };
                    // Additional axis-aligned fallback for near-vertical or near-horizontal segments
                    const dx = s.x2 - s.x1;
                    const dy = s.y2 - s.y1;
                    const minX = Math.min(s.x1, s.x2) - tol;
                    const maxX = Math.max(s.x1, s.x2) + tol;
                    const minY = Math.min(s.y1, s.y2) - tol;
                    const maxY = Math.max(s.y1, s.y2) + tol;
                    // If segment is effectively vertical, check x proximity and y range
                    if (Math.abs(dx) < 1e-6) {
                        if (Math.abs(x - s.x1) <= tol && y >= minY && y <= maxY) return { index: i };
                    }
                    // If segment is effectively horizontal, check y proximity and x range
                    if (Math.abs(dy) < 1e-6) {
                        if (Math.abs(y - s.y1) <= tol && x >= minX && x <= maxX) return { index: i };
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        };

        // Compute a stroke's bounding box in world coordinates
        const getStrokeBounds = (s) => {
            if (!s) return null;
            if (s.lineStyle === 'pencil' && Array.isArray(s.points) && s.points.length > 0) {
                let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
                s.points.forEach(p => { if (!p) return; if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x; if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x; if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y; if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y; });
                if (!isFinite(minX) || !isFinite(minY) || !isFinite(maxX) || !isFinite(maxY)) return null;
                return { x1: minX, y1: minY, x2: maxX, y2: maxY };
            } else if (typeof s.x1 === 'number' && typeof s.y1 === 'number' && typeof s.x2 === 'number' && typeof s.y2 === 'number') {
                const x1 = Math.min(s.x1, s.x2), x2 = Math.max(s.x1, s.x2);
                const y1 = Math.min(s.y1, s.y2), y2 = Math.max(s.y1, s.y2);
                return { x1, y1, x2, y2 };
            }
            return null;
        };

        // Convert pointer coordinates into wrapper "layout pixels".
        // This compensates for UI scaling via `document.body.style.zoom` where
        // `getBoundingClientRect()` reflects visual pixels but `clientWidth/Height`
        // reflect layout pixels.
        const getPointerInWrapper = (e, wrapper) => {
            const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
            const safeRectW = Math.max(1, rect.width || 0);
            const safeRectH = Math.max(1, rect.height || 0);
            const scaleX = (wrapper.clientWidth || safeRectW) / safeRectW;
            const scaleY = (wrapper.clientHeight || safeRectH) / safeRectH;
            const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
            const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
            // UI scale is uniform; use average to be robust.
            const uiScale = (scaleX + scaleY) / 2;
            return { x, y, uiScale };
        };

        const handleCanvasMouseDown = (e) => {
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if (!activeCanvas) return;
            const wrapper = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            if (!wrapper) return;
            const { zoom, panX, panY } = state.canvasState;
            const rulerSize = state.canvasState.rulers ? 30 : 0;

            const ptr = getPointerInWrapper(e, wrapper);
            const mouseXInWrapper = ptr.x;
            const mouseYInWrapper = ptr.y;
            const zoomForScreen = (zoom || 1) / (ptr.uiScale || 1);

            // With transform: scale(zoom) translate(panX + rulerSize, panY + rulerSize)
            // screen = world * zoom + (pan + ruler)  =>  world = (screen - (pan + ruler)) / zoom
            const worldX = (mouseXInWrapper - (panX + rulerSize)) / (zoom || 1);
            const worldY = (mouseYInWrapper - (panY + rulerSize)) / (zoom || 1);

            // Manual line drawing mode takes precedence over other interactions (unless Select mode is on)
            const drawCfg = state.canvasState.drawing || {};
            if (drawCfg.selectEnabled && mouseXInWrapper > rulerSize && mouseYInWrapper > rulerSize) {
                // Try selecting a stroke or begin marquee
                const thresholdScreen = 8; // px
                const thresholdWorld = thresholdScreen / (zoomForScreen || 1);
                const hit = findStrokeAtPoint(activeCanvas, worldX, worldY, thresholdWorld);
                const multi = !!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey);
                if (hit && hit.index != null) {
                    const arr = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices) ? state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices : [];
                    if (multi) {
                        const i = arr.indexOf(hit.index);
                        if (i >= 0) arr.splice(i, 1); else arr.push(hit.index);
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices = arr;
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndex = (arr.length === 1) ? arr[0] : null;
                    } else {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices = [hit.index];
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndex = hit.index;
                    }
                    // reset marquee
                    state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting = false;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect = null;
                    syncSelectionUIFromStroke();
                    renderDrawOverlay();
                    return;
                } else {
                    // Clear selection (unless multi append attempted) and start marquee selection
                    if (!multi) {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndex = null;
                        state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices = [];
                        syncSelectionUIFromStroke();
                    }
                    state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting = true;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect = { x1: worldX, y1: worldY, x2: worldX, y2: worldY };
                    renderDrawOverlay();
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (drawCfg.enabled && mouseXInWrapper > rulerSize && mouseYInWrapper > rulerSize) {
                // Color palette for alternating lines
                if (!window._pixiLogicLinePalette) {
                    window._pixiLogicLinePalette = ['#ff0000', '#00bfff', '#00c853', '#ffab00', '#d500f9', '#ff4081', '#00e5ff', '#ffd600'];
                }
                if (typeof state.canvasState.drawing.nextColorIdx !== 'number') state.canvasState.drawing.nextColorIdx = 0;

                const wantSnap = !!(state.canvasState.drawing?.snapEnabled) || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey;
                const startCtx = computeDrawStartContext(worldX, worldY, activeCanvas, zoomForScreen, wantSnap);
                const startX = startCtx.x;
                const startY = startCtx.y;
                state.canvasState.drawing.startPanelId = startCtx.panelId;
                state.canvasState.drawing.allowedRect = startCtx.allowedRect;

                // Pencil mode: start a new freehand path
                if ((drawCfg.lineStyle || 'solid') === 'pencil') {
                    state.canvasState.drawing.preview = null;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath = [{ x: startX, y: startY }];
                    state.canvasState.drawing.arrowPoints = [];
                    state.canvasState.drawing.lastPanel = startCtx.panelId;
                    if (state.canvasState.drawing.multiColor) {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.color = window._pixiLogicLinePalette[state.canvasState.drawing.nextColorIdx % window._pixiLogicLinePalette.length];
                        state.canvasState.drawing.nextColorIdx++;
                    } else {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.color = state.canvasState.drawing.color || '#ff0000';
                    }
                } else {
                    state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath = null;
                    state.canvasState.drawing.preview = { x1: startX, y1: startY, x2: startX, y2: startY, snapped: startCtx.snapped };
                    state.canvasState.drawing.snapPoint = startCtx.snapped ? { x: startX, y: startY } : null;
                    if (state.canvasState.drawing.multiColor) {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.color = window._pixiLogicLinePalette[state.canvasState.drawing.nextColorIdx % window._pixiLogicLinePalette.length];
                        state.canvasState.drawing.nextColorIdx++;
                    } else {
                        state.canvasState.drawing.color = state.canvasState.drawing.color || '#ff0000';
                    }
                }
                renderDrawOverlay();
                return;
            }

            // If crop-by-panel mode is active and a map is selected, start a crop selection drag
            if (state.canvasState.cropMode && state.canvasState.selectedMapId != null && mouseXInWrapper > rulerSize && mouseYInWrapper > rulerSize) {
                const map = activeCanvas.maps.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                if (map) {
                    const clamp = (v, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
                    const sx = clamp(worldX, map.x, map.x + map.width);
                    const sy = clamp(worldY, map.y, map.y + map.height);
                    state.canvasState.cropSelecting = true;
                    state.canvasState.cropStart = { x: sx, y: sy };
                    state.canvasState.cropRect = { x1: sx, y1: sy, x2: sx, y2: sy };
                    // Prevent map dragging in crop mode
                    state.canvasState.draggingMapId = null;
                    drawMainCanvas();
                    return;
                }
            }

            let clickedMapId = null;
            for (let i = activeCanvas.maps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const map = activeCanvas.maps[i];
                if (worldX >= map.x && worldX <= map.x + map.width && worldY >= map.y && worldY <= map.y + map.height) {
                    state.canvasState.draggingMapId = map.id;
                    state.canvasState.dragOffsetX = worldX - map.x;
                    state.canvasState.dragOffsetY = worldY - map.y;
                    clickedMapId = map.id;
                    break; 
                }
            }
            
            state.canvasState.selectedMapId = clickedMapId;
