            // Update cropping controls to reflect the current selection
            try {
                const ac = getActiveCanvas();
                const sel = ac?.maps?.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                const leftEl = document.getElementById('crop-left-input');
                const rightEl = document.getElementById('crop-right-input');
                const topEl = document.getElementById('crop-top-input');
                const bottomEl = document.getElementById('crop-bottom-input');
                const pLeftEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-left-input');
                const pRightEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-right-input');
                const pTopEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-top-input');
                const pBottomEl = document.getElementById('crop-panels-bottom-input');
                if (leftEl && rightEl && topEl && bottomEl) {
                    if (sel) {
                        leftEl.disabled = false; rightEl.disabled = false; topEl.disabled = false; bottomEl.disabled = false;
                        leftEl.value = (sel.cropLeft ?? sel.sliceLeft ?? 0);
                        rightEl.value = (sel.cropRight ?? sel.sliceRight ?? 0);
                        topEl.value = (sel.cropTop ?? 0);
                        bottomEl.value = (sel.cropBottom ?? 0);
                    } else {
                        leftEl.disabled = true; rightEl.disabled = true; topEl.disabled = true; bottomEl.disabled = true;
                        leftEl.value = 0; rightEl.value = 0; topEl.value = 0; bottomEl.value = 0;
                    }
                }
                if (pLeftEl && pRightEl && pTopEl && pBottomEl) {
                    if (sel) {
                        const pW = Math.max(1, sel.panelResWidth || 128);
                        const pH = Math.max(1, sel.panelResHeight || 128);
                        pLeftEl.disabled = false; pRightEl.disabled = false; pTopEl.disabled = false; pBottomEl.disabled = false;
                        pLeftEl.value = Math.floor((sel.cropLeft ?? sel.sliceLeft ?? 0) / pW);
                        pRightEl.value = Math.floor((sel.cropRight ?? sel.sliceRight ?? 0) / pW);
                        pTopEl.value = Math.floor((sel.cropTop ?? 0) / pH);
                        pBottomEl.value = Math.floor((sel.cropBottom ?? 0) / pH);
                    } else {
                        pLeftEl.disabled = true; pRightEl.disabled = true; pTopEl.disabled = true; pBottomEl.disabled = true;
                        pLeftEl.value = 0; pRightEl.value = 0; pTopEl.value = 0; pBottomEl.value = 0;
                    }
                }
                // Update name input for selected map
                try {
                    const nameEl = document.getElementById('selected-map-name-input');
                    if (nameEl) {
                        if (sel) {
                            nameEl.disabled = false;
                            nameEl.value = sel.name || '';
                        } else {
                            nameEl.disabled = true;
                            nameEl.value = '';
                        }
                    }
                } catch(_){}
            } catch(_){}

            if (!clickedMapId && mouseXInWrapper > rulerSize && mouseYInWrapper > rulerSize) {
                state.canvasState.isPanning = true;
                state.canvasState.lastPanX = mouseXInWrapper;
                state.canvasState.lastPanY = mouseYInWrapper;
                wrapper.classList.add('grabbing');
            }
            drawMainCanvas();
        };

        const handleCanvasMouseMove = (e) => {
            const { isPanning, draggingMapId, zoom, panX, panY, snapping, snapThreshold } = state.canvasState;
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if (!activeCanvas) return;
            const wrapper = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            if(!wrapper) return;
            const rulerSize = state.canvasState.rulers ? 30 : 0;

            const ptr = getPointerInWrapper(e, wrapper);
            const mouseXInWrapper = ptr.x;
            const mouseYInWrapper = ptr.y;
            const zoomForScreen = (zoom || 1) / (ptr.uiScale || 1);
            // Inverse of transform: scale(zoom) translate(panX + rulerSize, panY + rulerSize)
            const worldX = (mouseXInWrapper - (panX + rulerSize)) / (zoom || 1);
            const worldY = (mouseYInWrapper - (panY + rulerSize)) / (zoom || 1);

            // Update marquee selection rectangle if selecting
            if (state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled && state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting) {
                const mr = state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect || { x1: worldX, y1: worldY, x2: worldX, y2: worldY };
                mr.x2 = worldX; mr.y2 = worldY;
                state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect = mr;
                // Live update selection set to intersecting strokes
                const ax = Math.min(mr.x1, mr.x2), ay = Math.min(mr.y1, mr.y2);
                const aw = Math.abs(mr.x2 - mr.x1), ah = Math.abs(mr.y2 - mr.y1);
                const bx = ax + aw, by = ay + ah;
                const sel = [];
                const strokes = Array.isArray(activeCanvas.drawings) ? activeCanvas.drawings : [];
                for (let i = 0; i < strokes.length; i++) {
                    const b = getStrokeBounds(strokes[i]);
                    if (!b) continue;
                    const sx1 = Math.min(b.x1, b.x2), sy1 = Math.min(b.y1, b.y2);
                    const sx2 = Math.max(b.x1, b.x2), sy2 = Math.max(b.y1, b.y2);
                    const overlap = (sx1 <= bx && sx2 >= ax && sy1 <= by && sy2 >= ay);
                    if (overlap) sel.push(i);
                }
                state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndices = sel;
                state.canvasState.drawing.selectedStrokeIndex = (sel.length === 1) ? sel[0] : null;
                renderDrawOverlay();
                return;
            }

            // Update preview while drawing (not in select-only mode)
            if (state.canvasState.drawing && !state.canvasState.drawing.selectEnabled) {
                if (state.canvasState.drawing.preview) {
                    const p = state.canvasState.drawing.preview;
                    let endX = worldX;
                    let endY = worldY;

                    if (e.shiftKey) {
                        const dx = Math.abs(endX - p.x1);
                        const dy = Math.abs(endY - p.y1);
                        if (dx > dy) {
                            endY = p.y1; // Lock to horizontal
                        } else {
                            endX = p.x1; // Lock to vertical
                        }
                    }
                    
                    const wantSnap = !!(state.canvasState.drawing?.snapEnabled) || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey;
                    if (wantSnap) {
                        const allowedRect = state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.allowedRect;
                        const startPanelId = state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.startPanelId;
                        const snapResult = findDrawSnapPoint(endX, endY, activeCanvas, zoomForScreen, allowedRect, startPanelId, true);
                        p.x2 = snapResult.x;
                        p.y2 = snapResult.y;
                        p.snapped = snapResult.snapped;
                        // Record snap point for visual indicator
                        state.canvasState.drawing.snapPoint = snapResult.snapped ? { x: snapResult.x, y: snapResult.y } : null;
                    } else {
                        p.x2 = endX;
                        p.y2 = endY;
                        p.snapped = false;
                        state.canvasState.drawing.snapPoint = null;
                    }

                    renderDrawOverlay();
                    return;
                } else if (state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath && (state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle === 'pencil')) {
                    const pts = state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath;
                    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
                    const dx = worldX - last.x, dy = worldY - last.y;
                    // add point when moved at least 2px to keep it light
                    if (dx*dx + dy*dy > 4) {
                        pts.push({ x: worldX, y: worldY });
                        // Panel crossing detection
                        const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
                        const prevPanel = state.canvasState.drawing.lastPanel;
                        const newPanel = getPanelAt(worldX, worldY, activeCanvas);
                        if (prevPanel !== null && newPanel !== null && prevPanel !== newPanel) {
                            // Compute direction angle
                            const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                            state.canvasState.drawing.arrowPoints.push({ x: worldX, y: worldY, angle });
                        }
                        state.canvasState.drawing.lastPanel = newPanel;
                        renderDrawOverlay();
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }

            // Update crop rectangle while dragging in crop mode
            if (state.canvasState.cropSelecting) {
                const map = activeCanvas.maps.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                if (map) {
                    const clamp = (v, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
                    const cx = clamp(worldX, map.x, map.x + map.width);
                    const cy = clamp(worldY, map.y, map.y + map.height);
                    const s = state.canvasState.cropStart || { x: cx, y: cy };
                    state.canvasState.cropRect = { x1: s.x, y1: s.y, x2: cx, y2: cy };
                    drawMainCanvas();
                }
                return;
            }
            
            if (isPanning) {
                const dx = mouseXInWrapper - state.canvasState.lastPanX;
                const dy = mouseYInWrapper - state.canvasState.lastPanY;
                state.canvasState.panX += dx;
                state.canvasState.panY += dy;
                state.canvasState.lastPanX = mouseXInWrapper;
                state.canvasState.lastPanY = mouseYInWrapper;
                drawMainCanvas();
            } else if (draggingMapId) {
                // Use the same inverse transform as for drawing so map drag follows the cursor under zoom/pan.
                const worldX = (mouseXInWrapper - (panX + rulerSize)) / (zoom || 1);
                const worldY = (mouseYInWrapper - (panY + rulerSize)) / (zoom || 1);
                const map = activeCanvas.maps.find(m => m.id === draggingMapId);

                // Calculate delta before updating map.x/map.y
                const oldX = map.x;
                const oldY = map.y;
                let newX = worldX - state.canvasState.dragOffsetX;
                let newY = worldY - state.canvasState.dragOffsetY;

                state.canvasState.snapLines = [];
                state.canvasState.gapGuides = null;

                if (snapping) {
                    const snapPointsX = [0, activeCanvas.width / 2, activeCanvas.width];
                    const snapPointsY = [0, activeCanvas.height / 2, activeCanvas.height];

                    // Helper to compute visible rect taking cropping into account
                    const getVisibleRect = (m, x, y) => {
                        const sw0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m?.calcs?.totalResWidth || m.width || 1));
                        const sh0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m?.calcs?.totalResHeight || m.height || 1));
                        const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropLeft ?? m.sliceLeft ?? 0));
                        const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropRight ?? m.sliceRight ?? 0));
                        const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropTop ?? 0));
                        const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropBottom ?? 0));
                        const totalCropW = Math.min(sw0, sL + sR);
                        const totalCropH = Math.min(sh0, sT + sB);
                        const srcX = Math.min(sL, sw0);
                        const srcY = Math.min(sT, sh0);
                        const srcW = Math.max(0, sw0 - totalCropW);
                        const srcH = Math.max(0, sh0 - totalCropH);
                        const scaleX = sw0 > 0 ? (m.width / sw0) : 1;
                        const scaleY = sh0 > 0 ? (m.height / sh0) : 1;
                        // If fully cropped, visible rect collapses to 0 size at the corresponding edge
                        const visLeft = x + scaleX * srcX;
                        const visTop = y + scaleY * srcY;
                        const visW = scaleX * srcW;
                        const visH = scaleY * srcH;
                        return { left: visLeft, top: visTop, right: visLeft + visW, bottom: visTop + visH, width: visW, height: visH };
                    };

                    // Add other maps' bounding and visible edges as snap targets
                    activeCanvas.maps.forEach(otherMap => {
                        if (otherMap.id === draggingMapId) return;
                        // Original bounding edges
                        snapPointsX.push(otherMap.x, otherMap.x + otherMap.width, otherMap.x + otherMap.width / 2);
                        snapPointsY.push(otherMap.y, otherMap.y + otherMap.height, otherMap.y + otherMap.height / 2);
                        // Visible edges if cropped
                        const vr = getVisibleRect(otherMap, otherMap.x, otherMap.y);
                        if (isFinite(vr.left) && isFinite(vr.right)) {
                            snapPointsX.push(vr.left, (vr.left + vr.right) / 2, vr.right);
                        }
                        if (isFinite(vr.top) && isFinite(vr.bottom)) {
                            snapPointsY.push(vr.top, (vr.top + vr.bottom) / 2, vr.bottom);
                        }
                    });

                    // Use the dragged map's visible rect, not just its bounding box
                    const selfVR = getVisibleRect(map, newX, newY);
                    const mapPointsX = [
                        { type: 'x', val: selfVR.left },
                        { type: 'cx', val: (selfVR.left + selfVR.right) / 2 },
                        { type: 'x2', val: selfVR.right }
                    ];
                    const mapPointsY = [
                        { type: 'y', val: selfVR.top },
                        { type: 'cy', val: (selfVR.top + selfVR.bottom) / 2 },
                        { type: 'y2', val: selfVR.bottom }
                    ];
                    
                    let bestSnapDeltaX = { dist: Infinity, delta: 0, snapLine: null };
                    let bestSnapDeltaY = { dist: Infinity, delta: 0, snapLine: null };

                    for(const mapPoint of mapPointsX) {
                        for(const snapPoint of snapPointsX) {
                            const dist = Math.abs(mapPoint.val - snapPoint);
                            if (dist < bestSnapDeltaX.dist) bestSnapDeltaX = { dist, delta: snapPoint - mapPoint.val, snapLine: snapPoint };
                        }
                    }
                    for(const mapPoint of mapPointsY) {
                        for(const snapPoint of snapPointsY) {
                            const dist = Math.abs(mapPoint.val - snapPoint);
                            if (dist < bestSnapDeltaY.dist) bestSnapDeltaY = { dist, delta: snapPoint - mapPoint.val, snapLine: snapPoint };
                        }
                    }

                    if (bestSnapDeltaX.dist * zoomForScreen < snapThreshold) {
                         newX += bestSnapDeltaX.delta;
                         state.canvasState.snapLines.push({x1: bestSnapDeltaX.snapLine, y1: -10000, x2: bestSnapDeltaX.snapLine, y2: 10000});
                    }
                    if (bestSnapDeltaY.dist * zoomForScreen < snapThreshold) {
                        newY += bestSnapDeltaY.delta;
                        state.canvasState.snapLines.push({x1: -10000, y1: bestSnapDeltaY.snapLine, x2: 10000, y2: bestSnapDeltaY.snapLine});
                    }
                }

                // Allow maps to move into negative space so users can position content left/up as needed
                // If you want to enforce bounds later, clamp against canvas extents instead of zero.

                map.x = Math.round(newX);
                map.y = Math.round(newY);

                // Move all lines whose endpoints are within the old map bounds by the same delta
                const dx = map.x - oldX;
                const dy = map.y - oldY;
                if (Math.abs(dx) > 0 || Math.abs(dy) > 0) {
                    const within = (x, y) => x >= oldX && x <= oldX + map.width && y >= oldY && y <= oldY + map.height;
                    (activeCanvas.drawings || []).forEach(s => {
                        if (s.lineStyle === 'pencil' && Array.isArray(s.points)) {
                            // Move all points if any are within the map
                            if (s.points.some(pt => within(pt.x, pt.y))) {
                                s.points.forEach(pt => { pt.x += dx; pt.y += dy; });
                                if (Array.isArray(s.arrowPoints)) s.arrowPoints.forEach(ap => { ap.x += dx; ap.y += dy; });
                            }
                        } else if (typeof s.x1 === 'number' && typeof s.y1 === 'number' && typeof s.x2 === 'number' && typeof s.y2 === 'number') {
                            // Move line if either endpoint is within the map
                            if (within(s.x1, s.y1) || within(s.x2, s.y2)) {
                                s.x1 += dx; s.y1 += dy; s.x2 += dx; s.y2 += dy;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Compute gap guides against nearest other map (visible rect)
                try {
                    const getVisibleRect = (m, x, y) => {
                        const sw0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m?.calcs?.totalResWidth || m.width || 1));
                        const sh0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(m?.calcs?.totalResHeight || m.height || 1));
                        const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropLeft ?? m.sliceLeft ?? 0));
                        const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropRight ?? m.sliceRight ?? 0));
                        const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropTop ?? 0));
                        const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor(m.cropBottom ?? 0));
                        const totalCropW = Math.min(sw0, sL + sR);
                        const totalCropH = Math.min(sh0, sT + sB);
                        const srcX = Math.min(sL, sw0);
                        const srcY = Math.min(sT, sh0);
                        const srcW = Math.max(0, sw0 - totalCropW);
                        const srcH = Math.max(0, sh0 - totalCropH);
                        const scaleX = sw0 > 0 ? (m.width / sw0) : 1;
                        const scaleY = sh0 > 0 ? (m.height / sh0) : 1;
                        const left = x + scaleX * srcX;
                        const top = y + scaleY * srcY;
                        const right = left + scaleX * srcW;
                        const bottom = top + scaleY * srcH;
                        return { left, top, right, bottom, width: right-left, height: bottom-top };
                    };
                    const self = getVisibleRect(map, map.x, map.y);
                    let bestH = null, bestV = null; // {dist, line}
                    activeCanvas.maps.forEach(other => {
                        if (other.id === draggingMapId) return;
                        const r = getVisibleRect(other, other.x, other.y);
                        // Horizontal gap: if vertical overlap exists, measure edge distance
                        const vOverlap = Math.min(self.bottom, r.bottom) - Math.max(self.top, r.top);
                        if (vOverlap > 0) {
                            let dist = null, x1, x2, y;
                            if (self.right <= r.left) { dist = r.left - self.right; x1 = self.right; x2 = r.left; }
                            else if (r.right <= self.left) { dist = self.left - r.right; x1 = r.right; x2 = self.left; }
                            if (dist != null) {
                                y = Math.max(self.top, r.top) + vOverlap/2;
                                if (!bestH || dist < bestH.dist) bestH = { dist, x1, x2, y };
                            }
                        }
                        // Vertical gap: if horizontal overlap exists, measure edge distance
                        const hOverlap = Math.min(self.right, r.right) - Math.max(self.left, r.left);
                        if (hOverlap > 0) {
                            let dist = null, y1, y2, x;
                            if (self.bottom <= r.top) { dist = r.top - self.bottom; y1 = self.bottom; y2 = r.top; }
                            else if (r.bottom <= self.top) { dist = self.top - r.bottom; y1 = r.bottom; y2 = self.top; }
                            if (dist != null) {
                                x = Math.max(self.left, r.left) + hOverlap/2;
                                if (!bestV || dist < bestV.dist) bestV = { dist, y1, y2, x };
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    if (bestH || bestV) {
                        state.canvasState.gapGuides = {};
                        if (bestH) {
                            state.canvasState.gapGuides.h = { x1: bestH.x1, y1: bestH.y, x2: bestH.x2, y2: bestH.y, text: `${Math.round(bestH.dist)} px`, tx: (bestH.x1+bestH.x2)/2, ty: bestH.y };
                        }
                        if (bestV) {
                            state.canvasState.gapGuides.v = { x1: bestV.x, y1: bestV.y1, x2: bestV.x, y2: bestV.y2, text: `${Math.round(bestV.dist)} px`, tx: bestV.x, ty: (bestV.y1+bestV.y2)/2 };
                        }
                    }
                } catch(_) { /* ignore */ }

                drawMainCanvas();
            }

            if (state.canvasState.rulers) {
                 drawRulers(mouseXInWrapper, mouseYInWrapper);
            }
        };

        const handleCanvasMouseUp = () => {
            // Finish marquee selection if active
            if (state.canvasState.drawing && state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting) {
                state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeSelecting = false;
                // keep marqueeRect for a momentary draw; then clear on next render
                syncSelectionUIFromStroke();
                renderDrawOverlay();
                // Clear marquee rect after showing selection update
                state.canvasState.drawing.marqueeRect = null;
                return;
            }
            // Persist the last computed guides when interaction ends so the user can still see the gaps
            if (state.canvasState.gapGuides) {
                state.canvasState.persistentGuides = state.canvasState.gapGuides;
            }
            state.canvasState.gapGuides = null;
            // Commit preview stroke if present
            if (state.canvasState.drawing && (state.canvasState.drawing.preview || (Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath) && state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath.length > 1))) {
                const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
                if (activeCanvas) {
                    activeCanvas.drawings = activeCanvas.drawings || [];
                    // New stroke invalidates redo history
                    activeCanvas.drawingsRedo = [];
                    const drawCfg = state.canvasState.drawing || {};
                    const strokeColor = drawCfg.color || '#ff0000';
                    const strokeWidth = Math.max(1, drawCfg.width || 5);
                    const arrowSize = drawCfg.arrowSize || 1.2;
                    // Respect the UI toggles for arrowheads
                    const arrowStartFlag = !!drawCfg.arrowStart;
                    const arrowEndFlag = !!drawCfg.arrowEnd;
                    if (state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath && state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle === 'pencil') {
                        const pts = state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath.slice();
                        const arrows = Array.isArray(state.canvasState.drawing.arrowPoints)
                            ? state.canvasState.drawing.arrowPoints.map(ap => ({ x: ap.x, y: ap.y, angle: ap.angle }))
                            : [];
                        if (pts.length > 1) {
                            activeCanvas.drawings.push({
                                points: pts,
                                arrowPoints: arrows,
                                color: strokeColor,
                                width: strokeWidth,
                                lineStyle: 'pencil',
                                arrowSize,
                                arrowStart: arrowStartFlag,
                                arrowEnd: arrowEndFlag,
                                panelId: state.canvasState.drawing.startPanelId
                            });
                        }
                    } else if (state.canvasState.drawing.preview) {
                        const p = state.canvasState.drawing.preview;
                        const dx = p.x2 - p.x1, dy = p.y2 - p.y1;
                        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                        activeCanvas.drawings.push({
                            x1: p.x1, y1: p.y1, x2: p.x2, y2: p.y2,
                            color: strokeColor,
                            width: strokeWidth,
                            lineStyle: state.canvasState.drawing.lineStyle,
                            arrowSize,
                            arrowStart: arrowStartFlag,
                            arrowEnd: arrowEndFlag,
                            arrowAngle: angle,
                            panelId: state.canvasState.drawing.startPanelId
                        });
                    }
                }
                state.canvasState.drawing.preview = null;
                state.canvasState.drawing.previewPath = null;
                state.canvasState.drawing.arrowPoints = [];
                state.canvasState.drawing.lastPanel = null;
                state.canvasState.drawing.snapPoint = null;
                renderDrawOverlay();
                return;
            }
            // If finishing a crop selection, convert selection to crop values
            if (state.canvasState.cropSelecting) {
                const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
                if (activeCanvas) {
                    const map = activeCanvas.maps.find(m => m.id === state.canvasState.selectedMapId);
                    const r = state.canvasState.cropRect;
                    if (map && r) {
                        const rx = Math.min(r.x1, r.x2);
                        const ry = Math.min(r.y1, r.y2);
                        const rw = Math.abs(r.x2 - r.x1);
                        const rh = Math.abs(r.y2 - r.y1);
                        if (rw > 0 && rh > 0) {
                            const temp = document.createElement('canvas');
                            try { drawVisualizerCanvas(temp, map); } catch(_){ }
                            const sw0 = temp.width || 0;
                            const sh0 = temp.height || 0;
                            if (sw0 > 0 && sh0 > 0) {
                                const scaleX = map.width / sw0;
                                const scaleY = map.height / sh0;
                                const clamp = (v, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
                                const srcXf = (rx - map.x) / scaleX;
                                const srcYf = (ry - map.y) / scaleY;
                                const srcWf = rw / scaleX;
                                const srcHf = rh / scaleY;
                                let srcX = Math.round(clamp(srcXf, 0, sw0));
                                let srcY = Math.round(clamp(srcYf, 0, sh0));
                                let srcW = Math.round(clamp(srcWf, 0, sw0 - srcX));
                                let srcH = Math.round(clamp(srcHf, 0, sh0 - srcY));
                                // Compute crop values from source rect
                                const left = srcX;
                                const top = srcY;
                                const right = Math.max(0, sw0 - (srcX + srcW));
                                const bottom = Math.max(0, sh0 - (srcY + srcH));
                                map.cropLeft = left; map.cropRight = right; map.cropTop = top; map.cropBottom = bottom;
                                map.sliceLeft = left; map.sliceRight = right; // back-compat
                                // Update inputs
                                const lEl = document.getElementById('crop-left-input'); if (lEl) lEl.value = left;
                                const rEl = document.getElementById('crop-right-input'); if (rEl) rEl.value = right;
                                const tEl = document.getElementById('crop-top-input'); if (tEl) tEl.value = top;
                                const bEl = document.getElementById('crop-bottom-input'); if (bEl) bEl.value = bottom;
                                showNotification('Crop applied from panel selection.');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                state.canvasState.cropSelecting = false;
                state.canvasState.cropRect = null;
            }

            state.canvasState.isPanning = false;
            state.canvasState.draggingMapId = null;
            state.canvasState.snapLines = [];
            const container = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            if(container) container.classList.remove('grabbing');
            drawMainCanvas();
        };
        
        const handleCanvasWheel = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleCanvasZoom(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 1 / 1.1);
        };
        
        const handleCanvasZoom = (factor) => {
            state.canvasState.zoom = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(10, state.canvasState.zoom * factor));
            drawMainCanvas();
        }
        
        const fitCanvasToScreen = () => {
            const container = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            const activeCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
            if(!container || !activeCanvas) return;
            
            const rulerSize = state.canvasState.rulers ? 30 : 0;
            const containerWidth = container.clientWidth - rulerSize;
            const containerHeight = container.clientHeight - rulerSize;
            const canvasWidth = activeCanvas.width;
            const canvasHeight = activeCanvas.height;
            
            if(canvasWidth === 0 || canvasHeight === 0) return;
            
            const scaleX = containerWidth / canvasWidth;
            const scaleY = containerHeight / canvasHeight;
            state.canvasState.zoom = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY) * 0.95;
            state.canvasState.panX = (containerWidth - canvasWidth * state.canvasState.zoom) / 2;
            state.canvasState.panY = (containerHeight - canvasHeight * state.canvasState.zoom) / 2;
            
            drawMainCanvas();
        };

        const drawRulers = (mouseX, mouseY) => {
            const rulerTop = document.getElementById('ruler-top');
            const rulerLeft = document.getElementById('ruler-left');
            const container = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
            if(!rulerTop || !rulerLeft || !container) return;
            
            rulerTop.style.display = 'block';
            rulerLeft.style.display = 'block';

            const { zoom, panX, panY } = state.canvasState;
            const rulerSize = 30;
            
            rulerTop.width = container.clientWidth;
            rulerTop.height = rulerSize;
            rulerLeft.width = rulerSize;
            rulerLeft.height = container.clientHeight;
            
            const ctxTop = rulerTop.getContext('2d');
            const ctxLeft = rulerLeft.getContext('2d');
            
            ctxTop.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; // bg-gray-800
            ctxTop.fillRect(0, 0, rulerTop.width, rulerTop.height);
            ctxLeft.fillStyle = '#1f2937';
            ctxLeft.fillRect(0, 0, rulerLeft.width, rulerLeft.height);
            
            ctxTop.fillStyle = '#9ca3af'; // text-gray-400
            ctxTop.font = '10px Inter';
            ctxLeft.fillStyle = '#9ca3af';
            ctxLeft.font = '10px Inter';

            let interval = 100;
            if (zoom < 0.25) interval = 500;
            else if (zoom < 0.5) interval = 200;

            // Top Ruler (fixed origin: labels start at 0 and increase; pan does not shift label numbers)
            // Compute visible maximum world X based on displayed width and zoom
            const maxWorldX = Math.ceil((rulerTop.width - rulerSize) / zoom);
            for (let wx = 0; wx <= maxWorldX; wx += interval/10) {
                const screenX = wx * zoom + rulerSize; // ignore pan for label anchoring
                if (screenX < rulerSize || screenX > rulerTop.width) continue;
                const markHeight = (wx % interval === 0) ? 10 : (wx % (interval/2) === 0 ? 5 : 3);
                ctxTop.strokeStyle = (wx === 0) ? 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7)' : '#9ca3af';
                ctxTop.beginPath();
                ctxTop.moveTo(screenX, rulerSize - markHeight);
                ctxTop.lineTo(screenX, rulerSize);
                ctxTop.stroke();
                if (wx % interval === 0) ctxTop.fillText(wx, screenX + 2, rulerSize - 12);
            }

            // Left Ruler (fixed origin: labels start at 0 and increase downward; pan does not shift label numbers)
            const maxWorldY = Math.ceil((rulerLeft.height - rulerSize) / zoom);
            for (let wy = 0; wy <= maxWorldY; wy += interval/10) {
                const screenY = wy * zoom + rulerSize; // ignore pan for label anchoring
                if (screenY < rulerSize || screenY > rulerLeft.height) continue;
                const markWidth = (wy % interval === 0) ? 10 : (wy % (interval/2) === 0 ? 5 : 3);
                ctxLeft.strokeStyle = (wy === 0) ? 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7)' : '#9ca3af';
                ctxLeft.beginPath();
                ctxLeft.moveTo(rulerSize - markWidth, screenY);
                ctxLeft.lineTo(rulerSize, screenY);
                ctxLeft.stroke();
                if (wy % interval === 0) {
                    ctxLeft.save();
                    ctxLeft.translate(rulerSize - 12, screenY + 2);
                    ctxLeft.rotate(-Math.PI/2);
                    ctxLeft.fillText(wy, 0, 0);
                    ctxLeft.restore();
                }
            }

            // Mouse Indicators
            if (mouseX !== undefined && mouseY !== undefined) {
                if(mouseX >= rulerSize) {
                    ctxTop.fillStyle = 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7)';
                    ctxTop.fillRect(mouseX, 0, 1, rulerSize);
                }
                if(mouseY >= rulerSize) {
                    ctxLeft.fillStyle = 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7)';
                    ctxLeft.fillRect(0, mouseY, rulerSize, 1);
                }
            }
        };

        // --- PDF EXPORT LOGIC ---
        const handlePdfProjectChange = (e) => {
            state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId = parseInt(e.target.value);
            state.pdfExport.mapNames = {}; // Reset custom names when project changes
            state.pdfExport.pdfTitle = ''; // Reset title as well
            renderPdfExport();
        };
        
        const handlePdfMapNameChange = (e) => {
            const mapId = e.target.dataset.mapId;
            const newName = e.target.value;
            state.pdfExport.mapNames[mapId] = newName;
        };


        const handleTemplateUpload = (e) => {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (file) {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = (event) => {
                    const imageUrl = event.target.result;
                    const image = new Image();
                    image.onload = () => {
                        state.pdfExport.templateImage = image;
                        state.pdfExport.templateSrc = imageUrl;
                        state.pdfExport.templateOptOut = false;
                        try { localStorage.setItem('pdfTemplateOptOut', 'false'); } catch(_) {}
                        try { localStorage.setItem('pdfTemplateSrc', imageUrl); } catch (err) { console.warn('Could not persist template to localStorage', err); }
                        renderPdfExport(); // Re-render to show preview
                    };
                    image.src = imageUrl;
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            }
        };

        // Build a standalone canvas representing an output-canvas-like object (high-res) for PDF inclusion
        // Accepts an object with { name, width, height, maps: [...] }
        const captureProjectCanvasToCanvas = (canvasObj) => {
            if (!canvasObj || !canvasObj.width || !canvasObj.height) return null;
            const exportCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            exportCanvas.width = canvasObj.width;
            exportCanvas.height = canvasObj.height;
            const ctx = exportCanvas.getContext('2d');
            // Background
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111827';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, exportCanvas.width, exportCanvas.height);

            // Draw each map snapshot
            if (Array.isArray(canvasObj.maps)) {
                canvasObj.maps.forEach(m => {
                    const temp = document.createElement('canvas');
                    // Full-resolution draw for PDF export
                    drawVisualizerCanvas(temp, m, { forceFullRes: true });
                    if (temp.width > 0 && temp.height > 0) {
                        const sw0 = temp.width;
                        const sh0 = temp.height;
                        const sL = Math.max(0, Math.floor((m.cropLeft ?? m.sliceLeft ?? 0)));
                        const sR = Math.max(0, Math.floor((m.cropRight ?? m.sliceRight ?? 0)));
                        const sT = Math.max(0, Math.floor((m.cropTop ?? 0)));
                        const sB = Math.max(0, Math.floor((m.cropBottom ?? 0)));
                        const maxCropW = Math.max(0, sw0 - 1);
                        const totalW = Math.min(sL + sR, maxCropW);
                        const maxCropH = Math.max(0, sh0 - 1);
                        const totalH = Math.min(sT + sB, maxCropH);
                        const srcX = Math.min(sL, sw0 - 1);
                        const srcW = Math.max(1, sw0 - totalW);
                        const srcY = Math.min(sT, sh0 - 1);
                        const srcH = Math.max(1, sh0 - totalH);
                        const scaleX = m.width / sw0;
                        const scaleY = m.height / sh0;
                        const destX = m.x + scaleX * sL;
                        const destW = scaleX * srcW;
                        const destY = m.y + scaleY * sT;
                        const destH = scaleY * srcH;
                        ctx.drawImage(temp, srcX, srcY, srcW, srcH, destX, destY, destW, destH);
                    }
                });
            }

            // Draw any manual drawing strokes stored on the canvas
            try { drawCanvasDrawingsToContext(ctx, canvasObj); } catch(_) {}

            // Mark some metadata for the PDF helper
            exportCanvas.__isCanvas = true;
            exportCanvas.name = canvasObj.name || 'Output Canvas';
            exportCanvas.mapsCount = canvasObj.maps ? canvasObj.maps.length : 0;
            return exportCanvas;
        };

        const handlePdfSettingsChange = (e) => {
            const setting = e.target.dataset.pdfSetting;
            const value = e.target.value;
            state.pdfExport.placement[setting] = parseFloat(value);

            const labelEl = document.getElementById(`pdf-${setting}-label`);
            if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = `${setting.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + setting.slice(1)} (${value}%)`;
            updatePdfPreviewOverlay();
            // persist placement so user doesn't need to re-adjust each session
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('pdfPlacement', JSON.stringify(state.pdfExport.placement));
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Could not persist PDF placement to localStorage', err);
            }
        };

        const updatePdfPreviewOverlay = () => {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('pdf-placement-preview');
            const label = document.getElementById('pdf-template-area-label');
            const labelTitle = document.getElementById('pdf-title-area-label');
            const labelDetails = document.getElementById('pdf-details-area-label');
            const labelTB = document.getElementById('pdf-title-block-area-label');
            const labelRef = document.getElementById('pdf-ref-area-label');
            const mapOutline = document.getElementById('pdf-map-area-outline');
            const titleBox = document.getElementById('pdf-title-area-preview');
            const detailsBox = document.getElementById('pdf-details-area-preview');
            const tbBox = document.getElementById('pdf-title-block-area-preview');
            const refBox = document.getElementById('pdf-ref-area-preview');
            const container = document.getElementById('template-preview-container');
            const imgEl = document.getElementById('template-preview');
            if (!overlay || !container) return;
            // Calculate displayed image rect within container (object-contain)
            const containerW = container ? container.clientWidth : 0;
            const containerH = container ? container.clientHeight : 0;
            const imgNaturalW = (imgEl && imgEl.naturalWidth) ? imgEl.naturalWidth : containerW;
            const imgNaturalH = (imgEl && imgEl.naturalHeight) ? imgEl.naturalHeight : containerH;
            const scaleToFit = Math.min(
                imgNaturalW ? containerW / imgNaturalW : 1,
                imgNaturalH ? containerH / imgNaturalH : 1
            );
            const dispW = imgNaturalW * scaleToFit;
            const dispH = imgNaturalH * scaleToFit;
            const offsetX = (containerW - dispW) / 2;
            const offsetY = (containerH - dispH) / 2;
            // Helper to place a rect and optional label
            const placeRect = (rect, boxEl, lblEl) => {
                if (!rect || !boxEl) return;
                // Clamp rect to 0..100 and ensure it doesn't exceed image bounds
                const rx = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(rect.x || 0)));
                const ry = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(rect.y || 0)));
                const rw = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(rect.width || 0), 100 - rx));
                const rh = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(rect.height || 0), 100 - ry));
                const x = offsetX + dispW * (rx / 100);
                const y = offsetY + dispH * (ry / 100);
                const w = dispW * (rw / 100);
                const h = dispH * (rh / 100);
                boxEl.style.left = `${x}px`;
                boxEl.style.top = `${y}px`;
                boxEl.style.width = `${w}px`;
                boxEl.style.height = `${h}px`;
                if (lblEl) {
                    lblEl.style.display = 'block';
                    lblEl.style.left = `${x + 2}px`;
                    lblEl.style.top = `${y + 2}px`;
                }
            };
            // Draw base areas
            if (mapOutline) placeRect(state.pdfExport.templateArea, mapOutline, label);
            if (titleBox) placeRect(state.pdfExport.titleArea, titleBox, labelTitle);
            if (detailsBox) placeRect(state.pdfExport.detailsArea, detailsBox, labelDetails);
            if (tbBox) placeRect(state.pdfExport.titleBlockArea, tbBox, labelTB);
            if (refBox) placeRect(state.pdfExport.refImageArea, refBox, labelRef);

            // When auto-fit, center a scaled overlay within Template Area; when manual, show placement box — all relative to displayed image rect
            const src = state.pdfExport.autoFitPlacement ? state.pdfExport.templateArea : state.pdfExport.placement;
            overlay.style.display = 'block';
            if (state.pdfExport.autoFitPlacement) {
                const s = Math.max(10, Math.min(200, state.pdfExport.mapScale || 100)) / 100;
                // Base template area within displayed image
                const areaX = offsetX + dispW * (src.x / 100);
                const areaY = offsetY + dispH * (src.y / 100);
                const areaW = dispW * (src.width / 100);
                const areaH = dispH * (src.height / 100);
                // Reduce available Y if title area overlaps
                const t = state.pdfExport.titleArea;
                if (t) {
                    const tX = offsetX + dispW * (t.x / 100);
                    const tY = offsetY + dispH * (t.y / 100);
                    const tW = dispW * (t.width / 100);
                    const tH = dispH * (t.height / 100);
                    const interLeft = Math.max(areaX, tX), interTop = Math.max(areaY, tY);
                    const interRight = Math.min(areaX + areaW, tX + tW), interBottom = Math.min(areaY + areaH, tY + tH);
                    if (interRight > interLeft && interBottom > interTop) {
                        const delta = (tY + tH) - areaY + 6; // 6px gap
                        // adjust areaY/H only visually for overlay
                        const adjY = areaY + Math.max(0, delta);
                        const adjH = Math.max(1, (areaY + areaH) - adjY);
                        // Overwrite locals
                        // eslint-disable-next-line no-var
                        var areaYLocal = adjY, areaHLocal = adjH;
                    }
                }
                // Determine target image aspect from selected project's first pixel map
                let aspect = 16 / 9;
                try {
                    const proj = state.projects.find(p => p.id == state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId) || state.projects[0];
                    const map = proj && Array.isArray(proj.pixelMaps) ? proj.pixelMaps[0] : null;
                    if (map) {
                        const calcs = calculateLayout(map);
                        if (calcs && calcs.totalResWidth > 0 && calcs.totalResHeight > 0) {
                            aspect = calcs.totalResWidth / calcs.totalResHeight;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) { /* fallback keeps default aspect */ }
                // Compute base fit box (aspect-fit) inside area
                const aY = (typeof areaYLocal === 'number') ? areaYLocal : areaY;
                const aH = (typeof areaHLocal === 'number') ? areaHLocal : areaH;
                let fitW = areaW;
                let fitH = fitW / aspect;
                if (fitH > aH) {
                    fitH = aH;
                    fitW = fitH * aspect;
                }
                // Apply user scale while preserving aspect
                let ovW = fitW * s;
                let ovH = fitH * s;
                // Ensure overlay does not exceed area by clamping with aspect preservation
                const ratio = ovW / ovH;
                if (ovW > areaW) { ovW = areaW; ovH = ovW / ratio; }
                if (ovH > aH) { ovH = aH; ovW = ovH * ratio; }
                const off = state.pdfExport.mapOffset || { x: 0, y: 0 };
                const remX = Math.max(0, areaW - ovW);
                const remY = Math.max(0, aH - ovH);
                let left = areaX + (areaW - ovW) / 2 + (remX * (off.x / 100));
                let top = aY + (aH - ovH) / 2 + (remY * (off.y / 100));
                // Clamp within area
                left = Math.max(areaX, Math.min(areaX + areaW - ovW, left));
                top = Math.max(aY, Math.min(aY + aH - ovH, top));
                overlay.style.width = `${ovW}px`;
                overlay.style.height = `${ovH}px`;
                overlay.style.left = `${left}px`;
                overlay.style.top = `${top}px`;
                if (label) { label.style.display = 'block'; label.style.left = `${areaX + 2}px`; label.style.top = `${aY + 2}px`; }
            } else {
                // Manual placement mode: clamp box to displayed image rect
                let left = offsetX + dispW * (src.x / 100);
                let top = offsetY + dispH * (src.y / 100);
                let width = dispW * (src.width / 100);
                let height = dispH * (src.height / 100);
                // Ensure size doesn't exceed image rect
                if (width > dispW) width = dispW;
                if (height > dispH) height = dispH;
                // Clamp position so box remains inside
                left = Math.max(offsetX, Math.min(offsetX + dispW - width, left));
                top = Math.max(offsetY, Math.min(offsetY + dispH - height, top));
                overlay.style.left = `${left}px`;
                overlay.style.top = `${top}px`;
                overlay.style.width = `${width}px`;
                overlay.style.height = `${height}px`;
                if (label) label.style.display = 'none';
            }
        };

    const ensurePdfRefImagesLoaded = async (projectForPdf) => {
        const promises = [];
        try {
            (projectForPdf?.pixelMaps || []).forEach(map => {
                const src = map && map.pdfRefImageSrc;
                if (src && (!map.__pdfRefImage || !map.__pdfRefImage.complete)) {
                    promises.push(new Promise((resolve) => {
                        const img = new Image();
                        img.onload = () => { map.__pdfRefImage = img; resolve(); };
                        img.onerror = () => resolve();
                        img.src = src;
                    }));
                }
            });
        } catch(_) {}
        if (promises.length) {
            try { await Promise.all(promises); } catch(_) {}
        }
    };

    const generatePdf = async (mode = 'save') => {
            try {
            const jspdfUmd = window.jspdf;
            if (!jspdfUmd || !jspdfUmd.jsPDF) {
                showNotification('PDF engine not loaded. Please check your internet connection and reload the page.');
                return;
            }
            const { jsPDF } = jspdfUmd;
            const projectForPdf = state.projects.find(p => p.id == state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId);
            
            if (!projectForPdf || projectForPdf.pixelMaps.length === 0) {
                showNotification('Please select a project with at least one pixel map to export.');
                return;
            }

            showNotification('Generating PDF... This may take a moment.');

            const doc = new jsPDF({
                orientation: 'landscape',
                unit: 'px',
                format: 'a4'
            });

            // Ensure any per-map reference images are loaded before drawing pages
            try { await ensurePdfRefImagesLoaded(projectForPdf); } catch(_) {}

            // Determine typography with Microsoft font name mapping to jsPDF core fonts
            const ts = (state.pdfExport && state.pdfExport.textStyle) || {};
            const msMap = { arial: 'helvetica', timesnewroman: 'times', couriernew: 'courier' };
            const selectedFamily = ts.fontFamily || 'helvetica';
            const mappedFamily = msMap[selectedFamily] || selectedFamily;
            const effectiveFamily = mappedFamily || 'helvetica';
            try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'normal'); } catch (_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal'); } catch(__) {} }

            // Helper: draw Title Block values inside Title Block Area with labels, two columns, and page number
            const drawTitleBlock = (doc, pageNumber, totalPages) => {
                try {
                    if (!state.pdfExport.showTitleBlock) return;
                    const area = state.pdfExport.titleBlockArea || { x: 79, y: 18, width: 18, height: 76 };
                    const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                    const x0 = pageWidth * (area.x / 100);
                    const y0 = pageHeight * (area.y / 100);
                    const w = pageWidth * (area.width / 100);
                    const h = pageHeight * (area.height / 100);
                    const padX = Math.max(6, Math.round(w * 0.08));
                    const padY = Math.max(6, Math.round(h * 0.04));

                    const s = state.pdfExport.titleBlock || {};
                    const proj = projectForPdf;
                    const entries = [
                        { label: 'Project Name', value: (s.projectName || proj?.name || '').toString() },
                        { label: 'Project Date', value: (s.projectDate || '').toString() },
                        { label: 'Venue', value: (s.venue || proj?.venue || '').toString() },
                        { label: 'Sales', value: (s.sales || proj?.salesperson || '').toString() },
                        { label: 'Client', value: (s.client || proj?.client || '').toString() },
                        { label: 'Page no', value: `Page ${pageNumber}${totalPages ? ` of ${totalPages}` : ''}` },
                        { label: 'Drawn By', value: (s.drawnBy || '').toString() },
                        { label: 'Version', value: (s.version || '').toString() },
                    ];

                    // Single-column layout: one field per line (Label: Value), wrapping values as needed
                    const innerX = x0 + padX;
                    const innerY = y0 + padY;
                    const innerW = w - padX * 2;
                    const innerH = h - padY * 2;

                    // Typography settings and fallbacks
                    const tbs = (state.pdfExport && state.pdfExport.titleBlockStyle) || {};
                    let labelFS = Math.round(Number.isFinite(tbs.labelBaseFS) ? tbs.labelBaseFS : 8);
                    let valueFS = Math.round(Number.isFinite(tbs.valueBaseFS) ? tbs.valueBaseFS : 9);
                    const minLabelFS = Math.max(5, Math.min(labelFS, Math.round(Number.isFinite(tbs.minLabelFS) ? tbs.minLabelFS : 6)));
                    const minValueFS = Math.max(5, Math.min(valueFS, Math.round(Number.isFinite(tbs.minValueFS) ? tbs.minValueFS : 7)));
                    let entryGap = Number.isFinite(tbs.entryGap) ? tbs.entryGap : 4;

                    // Layout tuning: tighter label-to-value spacing using per-row label width
                    let lhScale = 1.2; // start with comfortable line height
                    const cellPadX = 2; // horizontal padding inside each outlined row
                    const rowPadY = 1; // vertical padding inside each outlined row
                    const valueGapX = 2; // gap between label and value text
                    const minWrap = 20; // minimal wrap width for value text
                    const measureHeight = () => {
                        const lhLabel = Math.round(labelFS * lhScale);
                        const lhValue = Math.round(valueFS * lhScale);
                        let total = 0;
                        // measure label widths (bold) including colon
                        try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'bold'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); } catch(__) {} }
                        doc.setFontSize(labelFS);
                        const labelWidths = entries.map(e => doc.getTextWidth(String((e.label || '') + ' :')));
                        // wrap values (normal)
                        try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'normal'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal'); } catch(__) {} }
                        doc.setFontSize(valueFS);
                        for (let idx = 0; idx < entries.length; idx++) {
                            const e = entries[idx];
                            const available = innerW - cellPadX * 2 - labelWidths[idx] - valueGapX;
                            const valueWrapW = Math.max(minWrap, available);
                            const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(String(e.value || ''), valueWrapW);
                            const lines = Math.max(1, wrapped.length);
                            total += (rowPadY * 2) + Math.max(lhLabel, lines * lhValue);
                            if (idx !== entries.length - 1) total += entryGap; // no extra gap after last
                        }
                        return { total, lhLabel, lhValue };
                    };

                    

                    // Shrink fonts if needed to fit height
                    let metrics = measureHeight();
                    while (metrics.total > innerH) {
                        if (valueFS > minValueFS) {
                            valueFS -= 1;
                        } else if (labelFS > minLabelFS) {
                            labelFS -= 1;
                        } else if (entryGap > 1) {
                            entryGap -= 1;
                        } else if (lhScale > 1.05) {
                            lhScale = Math.max(1.05, +(lhScale - 0.05).toFixed(2));
                        } else {
                            break; // can't shrink further
                        }
                        // Recompute metrics as font sizes/spacing change
                        metrics = measureHeight();
                    }

                    // Draw single-column rows
                    doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                    let y = innerY;
                    const lhLabel = metrics.lhLabel;
                    const lhValue = metrics.lhValue;
                    // Set line style for outlining details
                    try { doc.setDrawColor(0, 0, 0); } catch(_) {}
                    if (typeof doc.setLineWidth === 'function') { doc.setLineWidth(0.2); }
                    for (let idx = 0; idx < entries.length; idx++) {
                        const e = entries[idx];
                        // Measure wrapped value and row height first
                        // label width in bold
                        try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'bold'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); } catch(__) {} }
                        doc.setFontSize(labelFS);
                        const labelWidth = doc.getTextWidth(String((e.label || '') + ' :'));
                        // wrap value with available width
                        try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'normal'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal'); } catch(__) {} }
                        doc.setFontSize(valueFS);
                        const available = innerW - cellPadX * 2 - labelWidth - valueGapX;
                        const valueWrapW = Math.max(minWrap, available);
                        const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(String(e.value || ''), valueWrapW);
                        const lines = Math.max(1, wrapped.length);
                        const consumed = Math.max(lhLabel, lines * lhValue);

                        // Draw outline rectangle for this detail row (exclude gap area)
                        const rowY = y;
                        const rowH = consumed + rowPadY * 2;
                        if (rowY + rowH <= innerY + innerH) {
                            try { doc.rect(innerX, rowY, innerW, rowH, 'S'); } catch(_) {}
                        }

                        // Label (bold)
                        try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'bold'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); } catch(__) {} }
                        doc.setFontSize(labelFS);
                        const labelBaselineY = y + rowPadY + lhLabel; // baseline with top padding
                        doc.text(String(e.label || '') + ' :', innerX + cellPadX, labelBaselineY); // small left padding inside row box

                        // Value (normal), aligned to label column right edge
                        const valueX = innerX + cellPadX + labelWidth + valueGapX; // small padding from label end
                        try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'normal'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal'); } catch(__) {} }
                        doc.setFontSize(valueFS);
                        let vy = labelBaselineY;
                        for (let i = 0; i < lines; i++) {
                            if (i === 0) {
                                doc.text(wrapped[i] || '', valueX, vy);
                            } else {
                                vy += lhValue;
                                if (vy > innerY + innerH - rowPadY) break;
                                doc.text(wrapped[i], valueX, vy);
                            }
                        }

                        // Advance y by row height plus gap (no gap after last)
                        y += rowH + (idx !== entries.length - 1 ? entryGap : 0);
                        if (y > innerY + innerH) break;
                    }
                } catch (e) { /* graceful no-op if something off */ }
            };

            const addImageToPage = (doc, title, imageCanvas, detailsSourceMap, pageNumber, totalPages) => {
                const templateImg = state.pdfExport.templateImage;
                const placement = state.pdfExport.placement;
                const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                const rasterDpi = Number(state.pdfExport?.rasterizeDpi) || 0;

                // If rasterizeDpi > 0, draw the entire page to an offscreen canvas and place it as a single image
                if (rasterDpi > 0) {
                    const scale = Math.max(1, Math.round(rasterDpi / 96)); // base jsPDF px ~96 DPI
                    const off = document.createElement('canvas');
                    off.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(pageWidth * scale));
                    off.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(pageHeight * scale));
                    const ctx = off.getContext('2d');
                    if (!ctx) return;
                    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
                    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

                    // Helpers to convert page percent areas to pixel coords in offscreen canvas
                    const px = (p) => Math.round(p * scale);
                    const areaToRect = (area) => ({
                        x: px(pageWidth * (area.x / 100)),
                        y: px(pageHeight * (area.y / 100)),
                        w: px(pageWidth * (area.width / 100)),
                        h: px(pageHeight * (area.height / 100)),
                    });

                    // Background (template image) if present
                    if (templateImg) {
                        try { ctx.drawImage(templateImg, 0, 0, templateImg.naturalWidth || templateImg.width, templateImg.naturalHeight || templateImg.height, 0, 0, off.width, off.height); } catch(_) {}
                    } else {
                        // white background
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, off.width, off.height);
                    }

                    // Title banner
                    const tA = state.pdfExport.titleArea || { x: 20, y: 5, width: 50, height: 8 };
                    const tb = areaToRect(tA);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(235,235,235)';
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgb(180,180,180)';
                    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(scale * 0.8));
                    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(tb.x, tb.y, tb.w, tb.h); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                    // Compose banner text
                    const ts = (state.pdfExport && state.pdfExport.textStyle) || {};
                    const baseTitle = (state.pdfExport.pdfTitle || state.projects.find(p => p.id == state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId)?.name || 'NAME OF THE SHOW');
                    let subTitle = '';
                    if (ts.includeMapNameInBanner) {
                        if (detailsSourceMap && detailsSourceMap.__isCanvas) subTitle = detailsSourceMap.name || '';
                        else if (detailsSourceMap) subTitle = (state.pdfExport.mapNames?.[detailsSourceMap.id] || detailsSourceMap.name || '');
                    }
                    const bannerText = (subTitle ? `${baseTitle} - ${subTitle}` : baseTitle).toUpperCase();
                    // Fit text into tb.w
                    const fontBase = Math.min(px(22), Math.max(px(12), tb.h - px(6)));
                    let fontSize = fontBase; ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
                    let textWidth = ctx.measureText(bannerText).width;
                    if (ts.bannerFitToWidth) {
                        const avail = Math.max(px(12), tb.w - px(12));
                        if (textWidth > avail && fontSize > px(6)) {
                            const scaleF = avail / textWidth;
                            fontSize = Math.max(px(6), Math.floor(fontSize * scaleF));
                            ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
                            textWidth = ctx.measureText(bannerText).width;
                        }
                    }
                    const align = (ts.bannerAlignH || 'center');
                    const baseline = (ts.bannerAlignV || 'middle');
                    const ax = align === 'left' ? (tb.x + px(6)) : align === 'right' ? (tb.x + tb.w - px(6)) : (tb.x + tb.w / 2);
                    const ay = baseline === 'top' ? (tb.y + px(6)) : baseline === 'bottom' ? (tb.y + tb.h - px(6)) : (tb.y + tb.h / 2);
                    ctx.textAlign = align === 'left' ? 'left' : align === 'right' ? 'right' : 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = baseline === 'top' ? 'top' : baseline === 'bottom' ? 'bottom' : 'middle';
                    ctx.fillText(bannerText, ax, ay);

                    // Place map image inside template area with scaling and offsets
                    const area = state.pdfExport.templateArea || { x: 6, y: 6, width: 44, height: 80 };
                    const imgRect = areaToRect(area);
                    const aspect = imageCanvas.width / imageCanvas.height;
                    let imgW = imgRect.w, imgH = Math.round(imgW / aspect);
                    if (imgH > imgRect.h) { imgH = imgRect.h; imgW = Math.round(imgH * aspect); }
                    const scaleImg = (state.pdfExport.mapScale || 100) / 100;
                    imgW = Math.round(imgW * scaleImg); imgH = Math.round(imgH * scaleImg);
                    const baseX = imgRect.x + Math.round((imgRect.w - imgW) / 2);
                    const baseY = imgRect.y + Math.round((imgRect.h - imgH) / 2);
                    const offPct = state.pdfExport.mapOffset || { x: 0, y: 0 };
                    const remX = Math.max(0, imgRect.w - imgW), remY = Math.max(0, imgRect.h - imgH);
                    let imgX = baseX + Math.round(remX * (offPct.x / 100));
                    let imgY = baseY + Math.round(remY * (offPct.y / 100));
                    imgX = Math.max(imgRect.x, Math.min(imgRect.x + imgRect.w - imgW, imgX));
                    imgY = Math.max(imgRect.y, Math.min(imgRect.y + imgRect.h - imgH, imgY));
                    // Draw
                    ctx.drawImage(imageCanvas, 0, 0, imageCanvas.width, imageCanvas.height, imgX, imgY, imgW, imgH);

                    // Details block
                    const dA = state.pdfExport.detailsArea || { x: 4, y: 80, width: 52, height: 16 };
                    const dr = areaToRect(dA);
                    const calcs = calculateLayout(detailsSourceMap);
                    let lines = [];
                    if (detailsSourceMap && detailsSourceMap.__isCanvas) {
                        const canvasName = detailsSourceMap.name || 'Output Canvas';
                        lines = [
                            `Screen Name: ${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ` : ''}${canvasName}`,
                            `Canvas Size (px): ${detailsSourceMap.width} x ${detailsSourceMap.height}`,
                            `Maps on Canvas: ${detailsSourceMap.mapsCount || 0}`
                        ];
                    } else {
                        const mapName = detailsSourceMap ? (state.pdfExport.mapNames[detailsSourceMap.id] || detailsSourceMap.name) : '';
                        const screenSizeText = (calcs && calcs.screenWidthMm) ? `${(calcs.screenWidthMm / 1000).toFixed(2)}m x ${(calcs.screenHeightMm / 1000).toFixed(2)}m` : 'N/A';
                        const computedPitch = (() => {
                            const pw = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelWidthMm);
                            const ph = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelHeightMm);
                            const rw = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelResWidth);
                            const rh = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelResHeight);
                            const candidates = [];
                            if (isFinite(pw) && isFinite(rw) && rw > 0) candidates.push(pw / rw);
                            if (isFinite(ph) && isFinite(rh) && rh > 0) candidates.push(ph / rh);
                            if (candidates.length) { const avg = candidates.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / candidates.length; return Math.round(avg * 100) / 100; }
                            return null;
                        })();
                        lines = [
                            `Screen Name: ${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ` : ''}${mapName}`,
                            `Screen Size (m): ${screenSizeText}`,
                            `Pixels per Tile: ${detailsSourceMap.panelResWidth || 'N/A'}px x ${detailsSourceMap.panelResHeight || 'N/A'}px`,
                            ...(state.pdfExport.includePitchInDetails ? [
                                `Pixel Pitch: ${
                                    Number.isFinite(detailsSourceMap.panelPitchMm) ? (detailsSourceMap.panelPitchMm + ' mm') :
                                    Number.isFinite(detailsSourceMap.pitchMm) ? (detailsSourceMap.pitchMm + ' mm') :
                                    (computedPitch!=null ? (computedPitch + ' mm') : 'N/A')
                                }`
                            ] : []),
                            `Total Tiles: ${calcs.panelsHorizontally || 'N/A'} (W) x ${calcs.panelsVertically || 'N/A'} (H)`,
                            `Panel Size (mm): ${detailsSourceMap.panelWidthMm || 'N/A'}mm x ${detailsSourceMap.panelHeightMm || 'N/A'}mm`,
                            `Total Pixel Size: ${calcs.totalResWidth || 'N/A'}px x ${calcs.totalResHeight || 'N/A'}px`
                        ];
                    }
                    const pad = px(6);
                    let fontSizeD = Math.max(px(6), Math.min(px(16), Math.round(((state.pdfExport?.textStyle?.detailsFS) ?? 14) * scale)));
                    const lh = Math.round(fontSizeD * 1.2);
                    const neededH = pad * 2 + (lines.length * lh);
                    const useAutoFit = !!(state.pdfExport?.textStyle?.detailsFitToText);
                    const boxH = Math.min(dr.h, useAutoFit ? neededH : dr.h);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(230,230,230)'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#000'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(scale * 0.8));
                    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(dr.x, dr.y, dr.w, boxH); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.font = `${fontSizeD}px sans-serif`; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
                    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                        const ty = dr.y + pad + (i + 1) * lh;
                        if (ty > dr.y + boxH - pad) break;
                        ctx.fillText(lines[i], dr.x + pad, ty);
                    }

                    // Optional per-map reference image (e.g., room photo) inside refImageArea
                    try {
                        const refImg = detailsSourceMap && detailsSourceMap.__pdfRefImage;
                        if (refImg && refImg.naturalWidth && refImg.naturalHeight && state.pdfExport && state.pdfExport.refImageArea) {
                            const rA = state.pdfExport.refImageArea;
                            const rr = areaToRect(rA);
                            const rAspect = refImg.naturalWidth / refImg.naturalHeight;
                            let rw = rr.w;
                            let rh = Math.round(rw / rAspect);
                            if (rh > rr.h) { rh = rr.h; rw = Math.round(rh * rAspect); }
                            const rx = rr.x + Math.round((rr.w - rw) / 2);
                            const ry = rr.y + Math.round((rr.h - rh) / 2);
                            ctx.drawImage(refImg, 0, 0, refImg.naturalWidth, refImg.naturalHeight, rx, ry, rw, rh);
                        }
                    } catch(_) {}

                    // Title Block rows (simple text-only rendering using existing drawTitleBlock data via jsPDF would be redundant here; keep compact)
                    // Finally add the offscreen image to PDF page
                    // Export as compressed JPEG to drastically reduce PDF size
                    const q = Math.min(0.9, Math.max(0.3, Number(state.pdfExport?.rasterizeJpegQuality) || 0.6));
                    const url = off.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q);
                    doc.addImage(url, 'JPEG', 0, 0, pageWidth, pageHeight);
                    return;
                }

                
                if (templateImg) {
                    doc.addImage(templateImg, 'JPEG', 0, 0, pageWidth, pageHeight);
                }
                // Draw page title banner inside titleArea
                const tA = state.pdfExport.titleArea || { x: 20, y: 5, width: 50, height: 8 };
                const tX = pageWidth * (tA.x / 100);
                const tY = pageHeight * (tA.y / 100);
                const tW = pageWidth * (tA.width / 100);
                const tH = pageHeight * (tA.height / 100);
                doc.setFillColor(235, 235, 235);
                doc.setDrawColor(180, 180, 180);
                doc.rect(tX, tY, tW, tH, 'FD');
                doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'bold'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); } catch(__) {} }
                let fsB = (Number.isFinite(+ts.bannerFS) && +ts.bannerFS > 0) ? +ts.bannerFS : Math.min(22, Math.max(12, tH - 6));
                doc.setFontSize(fsB);
                // Compose banner text with optional pixel map/output name
                const baseTitle = (state.pdfExport.pdfTitle || state.projects.find(p => p.id == state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId)?.name || 'NAME OF THE SHOW');
                let subTitle = '';
                if (ts.includeMapNameInBanner) {
                    if (detailsSourceMap && detailsSourceMap.__isCanvas) {
                        subTitle = detailsSourceMap.name || '';
                    } else if (detailsSourceMap) {
                        const mapped = state.pdfExport.mapNames?.[detailsSourceMap.id];
                        subTitle = (mapped || detailsSourceMap.name || '');
                    }
                }
                const bannerText = (subTitle ? `${baseTitle} - ${subTitle}` : baseTitle).toUpperCase();
                // Optionally fit text to title width by shrinking font size
                if (ts.bannerFitToWidth) {
                    const avail = Math.max(12, tW - 12); // 6px padding on each side
                    const w = doc.getTextWidth(bannerText);
                    if (w > avail && fsB > 6) {
                        const scale = avail / w;
                        fsB = Math.max(6, Math.floor(fsB * scale));
                        doc.setFontSize(fsB);
                    }
                }
                const alignMap = { left: 'left', center: 'center', right: 'right' };
                const baselineMap = { top: 'top', middle: 'middle', bottom: 'bottom' };
                const align = alignMap[(ts.bannerAlignH || 'center')] || 'center';
                const baseline = baselineMap[(ts.bannerAlignV || 'middle')] || 'middle';
                // Compute anchor X and Y per alignment
                const ax = align === 'left' ? (tX + 6) : align === 'right' ? (tX + tW - 6) : (tX + tW / 2);
                const ay = baseline === 'top' ? (tY + 6) : baseline === 'bottom' ? (tY + tH - 6) : (tY + tH / 2);
                doc.text(bannerText, ax, ay, { align, baseline });
                
                doc.setFontSize(18);
                doc.setTextColor("#000000");
                if (!templateImg) {
                    doc.text(title, pageWidth / 2, 30, { align: 'center' });
                }

                // Simplified: always embed PNG without optimization
                const dataUrl = imageCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                const aspect = imageCanvas.width / imageCanvas.height;
                let imgWidth, imgHeight, x, y;
                if (state.pdfExport.autoFitPlacement) {
                    // Fit the image into the defined templateArea while preserving aspect ratio
                    const area = state.pdfExport.templateArea || { x: 6, y: 6, width: 44, height: 80 };
                    let areaX = pageWidth * (area.x / 100);
                    let areaY = pageHeight * (area.y / 100);
                    const areaW = pageWidth * (area.width / 100);
                    let areaH = pageHeight * (area.height / 100);
                    // If title area overlaps this area at the top, push image area down
                    const t = state.pdfExport.titleArea;
                    if (t) {
                        const tX = pageWidth * (t.x / 100);
                        const tY = pageHeight * (t.y / 100);
                        const tW = pageWidth * (t.width / 100);
                        const tH = pageHeight * (t.height / 100);
                        const interLeft = Math.max(areaX, tX), interTop = Math.max(areaY, tY);
                        const interRight = Math.min(areaX + areaW, tX + tW), interBottom = Math.min(areaY + areaH, tY + tH);
                        if (interRight > interLeft && interBottom > interTop) {
                            const delta = (tY + tH) - areaY + 12; // 12px gap under title banner
                            areaY = areaY + Math.max(0, delta);
                            areaH = Math.max(1, (pageHeight * (area.y / 100) + pageHeight * (area.height / 100)) - areaY);
                        }
                    }
                    // Base aspect-fit inside area
                    imgWidth = areaW;
                    imgHeight = imgWidth / aspect;
                    if (imgHeight > areaH) {
                        imgHeight = areaH;
                        imgWidth = imgHeight * aspect;
                    }
                    // Apply user scale (10% - 200%)
