                    const scale = (state.pdfExport.mapScale || 100) / 100;
                    imgWidth *= scale;
                    imgHeight *= scale;
                    // Centered base position
                    let baseX = areaX + (areaW - imgWidth) / 2;
                    let baseY = areaY + (areaH - imgHeight) / 2;
                    // Apply offset: interpret [-50,50]% as movement across remaining space
                    const off = state.pdfExport.mapOffset || { x: 0, y: 0 };
                    const remX = Math.max(0, areaW - imgWidth);
                    const remY = Math.max(0, areaH - imgHeight);
                    x = baseX + (remX * (off.x / 100));
                    y = baseY + (remY * (off.y / 100));
                    // Clamp within template area
                    x = Math.max(areaX, Math.min(areaX + areaW - imgWidth, x));
                    y = Math.max(areaY, Math.min(areaY + areaH - imgHeight, y));
                    // Avoid overlapping the details block area, if defined
                    const d = state.pdfExport.detailsArea;
                    if (d) {
                        const dX = pageWidth * (d.x / 100);
                        const dY = pageHeight * (d.y / 100);
                        const dW = pageWidth * (d.width / 100);
                        const dH = pageHeight * (d.height / 100);
                        const limitBottom = dY - 8; // 8px gap above details
                        const maxY = Math.min(areaY + areaH - imgHeight, limitBottom - imgHeight);
                        const minY = areaY;
                        if (y > maxY) y = Math.max(minY, maxY);
                    }
                } else {
                    const placementAreaX = pageWidth * (placement.x / 100);
                    const placementAreaY = pageHeight * (placement.y / 100);
                    const placementAreaWidth = pageWidth * (placement.width / 100);
                    const placementAreaHeight = pageHeight * (placement.height / 100);
                    imgWidth = placementAreaWidth;
                    imgHeight = imgWidth / aspect;
                    if (imgHeight > placementAreaHeight) {
                        imgHeight = placementAreaHeight;
                        imgWidth = imgHeight * aspect;
                    }
                    x = placementAreaX + (placementAreaWidth - imgWidth) / 2;
                    y = placementAreaY + (placementAreaHeight - imgHeight) / 2;
                    // Avoid overlapping the details block area (manual mode)
                    const d = state.pdfExport.detailsArea;
                    if (d) {
                        const dY = pageHeight * (d.y / 100);
                        const maxY = dY - 8 - imgHeight;
                        if (y > maxY) y = Math.max(0, maxY);
                    }
                }
                doc.addImage(dataUrl, 'PNG', x, y, imgWidth, imgHeight);

                // Optional per-map reference image (non-raster path)
                try {
                    const refImg = detailsSourceMap && detailsSourceMap.__pdfRefImage;
                    if (refImg && refImg.naturalWidth && refImg.naturalHeight && state.pdfExport && state.pdfExport.refImageArea) {
                        const rA = state.pdfExport.refImageArea;
                        const rX = pageWidth * (rA.x / 100);
                        const rY = pageHeight * (rA.y / 100);
                        const rW = pageWidth * (rA.width / 100);
                        const rH = pageHeight * (rA.height / 100);
                        const aspectR = refImg.naturalWidth / refImg.naturalHeight;
                        let rw = rW;
                        let rh = rw / aspectR;
                        if (rh > rH) { rh = rH; rw = rh * aspectR; }
                        const rx = rX + (rW - rw) / 2;
                        const ry = rY + (rH - rh) / 2;
                        // Use the image element directly; jsPDF will handle encoding
                        doc.addImage(refImg, 'PNG', rx, ry, rw, rh);
                    }
                } catch(_) {}

                // Add Details Block inside detailsArea with grey background and black outline
                const calcs = calculateLayout(detailsSourceMap);
                let lines = [];
                if (detailsSourceMap && detailsSourceMap.__isCanvas) {
                    const canvasName = detailsSourceMap.name || 'Output Canvas';
                    lines = [
                        `Screen Name: ${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ` : ''}${canvasName}`,
                        `Canvas Size (px): ${detailsSourceMap.width} x ${detailsSourceMap.height}`,
                        `Maps on Canvas: ${detailsSourceMap.mapsCount || 0}`
                    ];
                } else {
                    const mapName = detailsSourceMap ? (state.pdfExport.mapNames[detailsSourceMap.id] || detailsSourceMap.name) : '';
                    const screenSizeText = (calcs && calcs.screenWidthMm) ? `${(calcs.screenWidthMm / 1000).toFixed(2)}m x ${(calcs.screenHeightMm / 1000).toFixed(2)}m` : 'N/A';
                    const computedPitch = (() => {
                        const pw = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelWidthMm);
                        const ph = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelHeightMm);
                        const rw = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelResWidth);
                        const rh = Number(detailsSourceMap.panelResHeight);
                        const candidates = [];
                        if (isFinite(pw) && isFinite(rw) && rw > 0) candidates.push(pw / rw);
                        if (isFinite(ph) && isFinite(rh) && rh > 0) candidates.push(ph / rh);
                        if (candidates.length) {
                            const avg = candidates.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / candidates.length;
                            return Math.round(avg * 100) / 100;
                        }
                        return null;
                    })();
                    lines = [
                        `Screen Name: ${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ` : ''}${mapName}`,
                        `Screen Size (m): ${screenSizeText}`,
                        `Pixels per Tile: ${detailsSourceMap.panelResWidth || 'N/A'}px x ${detailsSourceMap.panelResHeight || 'N/A'}px`,
                        ...(state.pdfExport.includePitchInDetails ? [
                            `Pixel Pitch: ${
                                Number.isFinite(detailsSourceMap.panelPitchMm) ? (detailsSourceMap.panelPitchMm + ' mm') :
                                Number.isFinite(detailsSourceMap.pitchMm) ? (detailsSourceMap.pitchMm + ' mm') :
                                (computedPitch!=null ? (computedPitch + ' mm') : 'N/A')
                            }`
                        ] : []),
                        `Total Tiles: ${calcs.panelsHorizontally || 'N/A'} (W) x ${calcs.panelsVertically || 'N/A'} (H)`,
                        `Panel Size (mm): ${detailsSourceMap.panelWidthMm || 'N/A'}mm x ${detailsSourceMap.panelHeightMm || 'N/A'}mm`,
                        `Total Pixel Size: ${calcs.totalResWidth || 'N/A'}px x ${calcs.totalResHeight || 'N/A'}px`
                    ];
                }
                let fontSize = Math.max(6, Math.min(16, Number.isFinite(+ts.detailsFS) ? +ts.detailsFS : 14));
                let lineHeight = 12;
                const pad = 6;
                const d = state.pdfExport.detailsArea || { x: 4, y: 80, width: 52, height: 16 };
                const dX = pageWidth * (d.x / 100);
                const dY = pageHeight * (d.y / 100);
                const dW = pageWidth * (d.width / 100);
                const dH = pageHeight * (d.height / 100);
                // Fit text within details box by reducing font if needed
                const fits = (fs) => {
                    doc.setFontSize(fs);
                    const lh = Math.round(fs * 1.2);
                    const maxLines = Math.floor((dH - pad * 2) / lh);
                    return maxLines >= lines.length;
                };
                while (!fits(fontSize) && fontSize > 8) { fontSize -= 1; }
                lineHeight = Math.round(fontSize * 1.2);
                doc.setFontSize(fontSize);
                doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                // Grey fill with black outline
                doc.setFillColor(230, 230, 230);
                doc.setDrawColor(0, 0, 0);
                // Optionally auto-fit the box height to content
                const neededH = pad * 2 + (lines.length * lineHeight);
                const useAutoFit = !!(ts && ts.detailsFitToText);
                const boxH = Math.min(dH, useAutoFit ? neededH : dH);
                doc.rect(dX, dY, dW, boxH, 'FD');
                // Draw text in details block
                let ty = dY + pad + lineHeight;
                const tx = dX + pad;
                lines.forEach((line, index) => {
                    if (ty > dY + boxH - pad) return; // stop if overflow
                    doc.text(line, tx, dY + pad + (index + 1) * lineHeight);
                });

                // Draw Title Block values on right panel for this page
                drawTitleBlock(doc, pageNumber, totalPages);
            };
            
            
            // Pre-calculate total pages for "Page X of N"
            const countPlannedCanvasPages = () => {
                if (!state.pdfExport.includeCanvas || state.pdfExport.includeCanvas === 'none') return 0;
                if (state.pdfExport.includeCanvas === 'active') {
                    const projectCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
                    try { return (projectCanvas && projectCanvas.width > 0) ? 1 : 0; } catch { return 0; }
                }
                if (state.pdfExport.includeCanvas === 'all') {
                    const list = projectForPdf.canvases || [];
                    return list.filter(c => c && c.width > 0).length;
                }
                return 0;
            };
            const totalPages = (state.pdfExport.includeTitlePage ? 1 : 0) + (projectForPdf.pixelMaps?.length || 0) + countPlannedCanvasPages() + 1; // +1 Delivery page
            let pageIndex = 0;

            // Optional Title Page (cover)
            if (state.pdfExport.includeTitlePage) {
                const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                const templateImg = state.pdfExport.templateImage;
                if (templateImg) { try { doc.addImage(templateImg, 'JPEG', 0, 0, pageWidth, pageHeight); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }

                // Use configured areas
                const area = state.pdfExport.templateArea || { x: 3, y: 3, width: 77, height: 92 };
                const titleArea = state.pdfExport.titleArea || { x: 20, y: 5, width: 50, height: 8 };
                const areaX = pageWidth * (area.x / 100);
                const areaY = pageHeight * (area.y / 100);
                const areaW = pageWidth * (area.width / 100);
                const areaH = pageHeight * (area.height / 100);
                const tX = pageWidth * (titleArea.x / 100);
                const tY = pageHeight * (titleArea.y / 100);
                const tW = pageWidth * (titleArea.width / 100);
                const tH = pageHeight * (titleArea.height / 100);

                // Title banner (aligned inside area)
                const titleText = (state.pdfExport.pdfTitle || projectForPdf.name || '').toUpperCase() || 'NAME OF THE SHOW';
                try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'bold'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); } catch(__) {} }
                let coverFS = (Number.isFinite(+ts.bannerFS) && +ts.bannerFS > 0) ? Math.max(10, +ts.bannerFS) : Math.min(32, Math.max(16, tH - 6));
                doc.setFontSize(coverFS);
                const padX = 12, padY = 6;
                const bX = tX;
                const bY = tY;
                const bW = tW;
                const bH = tH;
                doc.setFillColor(235, 235, 235);
                doc.setDrawColor(180, 180, 180);
                doc.rect(bX, bY, bW, bH, 'FD');
                doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                {
                    const alignMap2 = { left: 'left', center: 'center', right: 'right' };
                    const baselineMap2 = { top: 'top', middle: 'middle', bottom: 'bottom' };
                    const align2 = alignMap2[(ts.bannerAlignH || 'center')] || 'center';
                    const baseline2 = baselineMap2[(ts.bannerAlignV || 'middle')] || 'middle';
                    if (ts.bannerFitToWidth) {
                        const avail = Math.max(12, bW - 12);
                        const w = doc.getTextWidth(titleText);
                        if (w > avail && coverFS > 6) {
                            const scale = avail / w;
                            coverFS = Math.max(6, Math.floor(coverFS * scale));
                            doc.setFontSize(coverFS);
                        }
                    }
                    const ax2 = align2 === 'left' ? (bX + 6) : align2 === 'right' ? (bX + bW - 6) : (bX + bW / 2);
                    const ay2 = baseline2 === 'top' ? (bY + 6) : baseline2 === 'bottom' ? (bY + bH - 6) : (bY + bH / 2);
                    doc.text(titleText, ax2, ay2, { align: align2, baseline: baseline2 });
                }

                // Optional cover image (fits below banner inside area)
                if (state.pdfExport.coverImage) {
                    const img = state.pdfExport.coverImage;
                    const imgAspect = img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight;
                    const padTop = Math.max(8, (tY + tH) - areaY + 12);
                    const imgX = areaX + 10;
                    const imgY = areaY + padTop;
                    const imgW = areaW - 20;
                    let drawW = imgW;
                    let drawH = drawW / imgAspect;
                    const maxH = areaH - padTop - 14;
                    if (drawH > maxH) { drawH = maxH; drawW = drawH * imgAspect; }
                    const dx = areaX + (areaW - drawW) / 2;
                    const dy = imgY + (maxH - drawH) / 2; // vertically center within remaining area
                    try { doc.addImage(img, 'JPEG', dx, dy, drawW, drawH); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
                }

                // Place Title Block on the title page as well (Page 1)
                drawTitleBlock(doc, 1, totalPages);
                pageIndex = 1;
                // Do not add a page here; the loop will add a page before the first map page when needed
            }

            // Pixel map pages
            for (let i = 0; i < projectForPdf.pixelMaps.length; i++) {
                const map = projectForPdf.pixelMaps[i];
                if (!(i === 0 && !state.pdfExport.includeTitlePage)) { doc.addPage(); }
                pageIndex += 1;

                const tempCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                drawVisualizerCanvas(tempCanvas, map);
                
                if (tempCanvas.width > 0) {
                    const mapName = state.pdfExport.mapNames[map.id] || map.name;
                    const title = state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ${mapName}` : `Pixel Map: ${mapName}`;
                    addImageToPage(doc, title, tempCanvas, map, pageIndex, totalPages);
                }
            }
            // Optionally include canvases per selection: 'active' -> active canvas, 'specific' -> one selected, 'all' -> all canvases in project
            if (state.pdfExport.includeCanvas && state.pdfExport.includeCanvas !== 'none') {
                if (state.pdfExport.includeCanvas === 'active') {
                    const projectCanvas = getActiveCanvas();
                        const canvasToInclude = captureProjectCanvasToCanvas(projectCanvas);
                    if (canvasToInclude) {
                        doc.addPage();
                        pageIndex += 1;
                        const title = state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ${canvasToInclude.name}` : canvasToInclude.name;
                        const detailsSourceMap = { __isCanvas: true, name: canvasToInclude.name, width: canvasToInclude.width, height: canvasToInclude.height, mapsCount: canvasToInclude.mapsCount };
                        addImageToPage(doc, title, canvasToInclude, detailsSourceMap, pageIndex, totalPages);
                    } else {
                        showNotification('No valid active output canvas available to include.');
                    }
                } else if (state.pdfExport.includeCanvas === 'specific') {
                    const ids = (state.pdfExport.selectedCanvasIds || []).map(String);
                    const all = projectForPdf.canvases || [];
                    if (!ids.length) {
                        showNotification('Select at least one output map in the Specific Output list.');
                    }
                    ids.forEach(id => {
                        const target = all.find(c => String(c.id) === id);
                        const canvasToInclude = captureProjectCanvasToCanvas(target);
                        if (canvasToInclude) {
                            doc.addPage();
                            pageIndex += 1;
                            const title = state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ${canvasToInclude.name}` : canvasToInclude.name;
                            const detailsSourceMap = { __isCanvas: true, name: canvasToInclude.name, width: canvasToInclude.width, height: canvasToInclude.height, mapsCount: canvasToInclude.mapsCount };
                            addImageToPage(doc, title, canvasToInclude, detailsSourceMap, pageIndex, totalPages);
                        }
                    });
                } else if (state.pdfExport.includeCanvas === 'all') {
                    const projectCanvases = projectForPdf.canvases || [];
                    for (let ci = 0; ci < projectCanvases.length; ci++) {
                        const canvasObj = projectCanvases[ci];
                        const canvasToInclude = captureProjectCanvasToCanvas(canvasObj);
                        if (canvasToInclude) {
                            doc.addPage();
                            pageIndex += 1;
                            const title = state.pdfExport.pdfTitle ? `${state.pdfExport.pdfTitle} - ${canvasToInclude.name}` : canvasToInclude.name;
                            const detailsSourceMap = { __isCanvas: true, name: canvasToInclude.name, width: canvasToInclude.width, height: canvasToInclude.height, mapsCount: canvasToInclude.mapsCount };
                            addImageToPage(doc, title, canvasToInclude, detailsSourceMap, pageIndex, totalPages);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Add final page: Delivery Specification (inside template area with grey bg, black outline, justified)
            const addDeliverySpecPage = (doc, pageNumber) => {
                const spec = state.pdfExport.deliverySpec || {};
                // start a new page and draw template background if present
                doc.addPage();
                const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
                const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
                const margin = 36;

                const templateImg = state.pdfExport.templateImage;
                if (templateImg) {
                    try {
                        doc.addImage(templateImg, 'JPEG', 0, 0, pageWidth, pageHeight);
                    } catch (e) {
                        // fallback: ignore image drawing errors
                        console.warn('Failed to draw template on delivery page', e);
                    }
                }

                // Compute the template area and the title banner area
                const area = state.pdfExport.templateArea || { x: 6, y: 6, width: 44, height: 80 };
                const titleArea = state.pdfExport.titleArea || { x: 20, y: 5, width: 50, height: 8 };
                const areaX = pageWidth * (area.x / 100);
                const areaY = pageHeight * (area.y / 100);
                const areaW = pageWidth * (area.width / 100);
                const areaH = pageHeight * (area.height / 100);
                const tX = pageWidth * (titleArea.x / 100);
                const tY = pageHeight * (titleArea.y / 100);
                const tW = pageWidth * (titleArea.width / 100);
                const tH = pageHeight * (titleArea.height / 100);

                // Draw centered title banner with two lines
                const showTitle = (state.pdfExport.pdfTitle || state.projects.find(p => p.id == state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId)?.name || 'NAME OF THE SHOW').toUpperCase();
                const mediaName = (spec.mediaServer === 'Custom' && spec.mediaServerCustom) ? spec.mediaServerCustom : spec.mediaServer;
                const specLine = `*${(mediaName || 'FILE DELIVERY').toUpperCase()} - FILE DELIVERY SPECIFICATIONS*`;
                doc.setFillColor(235, 235, 235);
                doc.setDrawColor(180, 180, 180);
                doc.rect(tX, tY, tW, tH, 'FD');
                doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                try { doc.setFont(effectiveFamily, 'bold'); } catch(_) { try { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); } catch(__) {} }
                let line1Size = (Number.isFinite(+ts.bannerFS) && +ts.bannerFS > 0) ? Math.max(10, Math.min(24, +ts.bannerFS)) : Math.min(20, Math.max(12, tH * 0.45));
                let line2Size = Math.max(8, Math.min(24, Math.round(line1Size * 0.8)));
                // Fit each line to the available width if enabled
                if (ts.bannerFitToWidth) {
                    const avail = Math.max(12, tW - 12); // 6px padding on each side
                    doc.setFontSize(line1Size);
                    const w1 = doc.getTextWidth(showTitle);
                    if (w1 > avail) {
                        const s1 = avail / Math.max(1, w1);
                        line1Size = Math.max(8, Math.floor(line1Size * s1));
                    }
                    doc.setFontSize(line2Size);
                    const w2 = doc.getTextWidth(specLine);
                    if (w2 > avail) {
                        const s2 = avail / Math.max(1, w2);
                        line2Size = Math.max(8, Math.floor(line2Size * s2));
                    }
                }
                doc.setFontSize(line1Size);
                doc.text(showTitle, tX + tW / 2, tY + (tH * 0.45), { align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' });
                doc.setFontSize(line2Size);
                doc.text(specLine, tX + tW / 2, tY + (tH * 0.8), { align: 'center', baseline: 'middle' });

                // Inner grey panel for the fields (below banner, inside template area)
                const panelPad = 12;
                const panelY = Math.max(areaY + panelPad, tY + tH + 8);
                const panelX = areaX + panelPad;
                const panelW = areaW - panelPad * 2;
                const panelH = areaY + areaH - panelPad - panelY;
                doc.setDrawColor(0, 0, 0);
                if (spec.showPanelBackground) {
                    doc.setFillColor(230, 230, 230);
                    doc.rect(panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 'FD');
                }

                // Three-column text layout: Label | : | Value
                const rowGap = 6;
                const labelX = panelX + 10;
                const colonX = labelX + 130;
                const valueX = colonX + 10;
                const valueW = panelW - (valueX - panelX) - 10;

                const codecsList = Array.isArray(spec.codecs) ? spec.codecs.filter(c => c !== 'Other') : (spec.codecs ? [spec.codecs] : []);
                const codecsText = (codecsList.length ? codecsList.join(' / ') : (spec.codecsCustom || '')) || 'N/A';
                const mediaServerValue = (spec.mediaServer === 'Custom' && spec.mediaServerCustom) ? spec.mediaServerCustom : spec.mediaServer;
                const linesDLBase = [];
                if (spec.codecsLink) linesDLBase.push('HAP CODEC: ' + spec.codecsLink);
                if (spec.codecsLink2) linesDLBase.push('NOTCH LC CODEC: ' + spec.codecsLink2);

                // Build rows (unwrapped yet; wrapping depends on font size)
                const rows = [
                    { label: 'Media Server', value: mediaServerValue || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Format', value: spec.format || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Codec', value: codecsText },
                    { label: 'Download Link', dl: linesDLBase },
                    { label: 'Quality', value: spec.quality || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Pixel Aspect Ratio', value: spec.pixelAspectRatio || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'FPS', value: spec.fps || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Embedded Audio Settings', value: spec.embeddedAudio ? (spec.embeddedAudioDetails || 'Yes') : 'No' },
                    { label: 'Sample Rate', value: spec.sampleRate || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Unembedded Audio Format', value: spec.unembeddedAudioFormat || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Still Frame Format', value: spec.stillFrameFormat || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Naming Structure', value: spec.namingStructure || 'N/A' },
                    { label: 'Example', value: spec.example || '' },
                    { label: 'Comments', value: spec.comments || '' },
                ];

                // Add Content Validation Email row (from dedicated field or detected inside note)
                const emailFromNote = (spec.contentValidationNote || '').match(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/i)?.[0] || '';
                const validationEmail = (spec.contentValidationEmail || emailFromNote || '').trim();
                if (validationEmail) {
                    const commentsIdx = rows.findIndex(r => r.label === 'Comments');
                    const emailRow = { label: 'Content Validation Email', email: validationEmail };
                    if (commentsIdx >= 0) rows.splice(commentsIdx, 0, emailRow); else rows.push(emailRow);
                }

                const startY = panelY + 18;
                const minRowsFS = 9;
                let rowsFS = Math.max(8, Math.min(72, Number.isFinite(+ts.deliveryFS) ? +ts.deliveryFS : 12));
                let noteFS = 10; // will be adjusted relative to rowsFS
                const padBottom = 10;

                const measureWithFont = (fsRows) => {
                    // Measure rows
                    doc.setFontSize(fsRows);
                    const lhRows = Math.round(fsRows * 1.2);
                    let totalRowsH = 0;
                    for (const r of rows) {
                        if (r.dl && r.dl.length) {
                            totalRowsH += (r.dl.length * lhRows) + rowGap;
                        } else if (r.email) {
                            const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(String(r.email || ''), valueW);
                            totalRowsH += (Math.max(1, wrapped.length) * lhRows) + rowGap;
                        } else {
                            const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(String(r.value || ''), valueW);
                            totalRowsH += (Math.max(1, wrapped.length) * lhRows) + rowGap;
                        }
                    }
                    totalRowsH -= rowGap; // remove last gap
                    // Measure note with slightly smaller font
                    const fsNote = Math.max(8, fsRows - 1);
                    doc.setFontSize(fsNote);
                    const lhNote = Math.round(fsNote * 1.2);
                    const noteLines = spec.contentValidationNote ? doc.splitTextToSize(spec.contentValidationNote, panelW - 20) : [];
                    const noteH = noteLines.length ? (noteLines.length * lhNote) : 0;
                    const total = (startY - panelY) + totalRowsH + padBottom + noteH;
                    return { total, lhRows, fsNote, lhNote, noteLines };
                };

                // Fit loop
                let measure = measureWithFont(rowsFS);
                while (rowsFS > minRowsFS && measure.total > panelH) {
                    rowsFS -= 1;
                    measure = measureWithFont(rowsFS);
                }
                noteFS = measure.fsNote;

                // Render
                let y = startY;
                doc.setFont(undefined, 'normal');
                doc.setFontSize(rowsFS);
                for (let rIndex = 0; rIndex < rows.length; rIndex++) {
                    const r = rows[rIndex];
                    doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                    const lh = measure.lhRows;
                    doc.text(String(r.label || ''), labelX, y);
                    doc.text(':', colonX, y);
                    if (r.dl && r.dl.length) {
                        r.dl.forEach((full, idx) => {
                            const [prefix, url] = full.split(': ');
                            const yLine = y + (idx * lh);
                            doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                            doc.text(prefix + ':', valueX, yLine);
                            const pxW = doc.getTextWidth(prefix + ': ');
                            doc.setTextColor(200, 0, 0);
                            doc.text(url, valueX + pxW, yLine);
                            try { doc.link(valueX + pxW, yLine - (lh - rowsFS), doc.getTextWidth(url), lh, { url }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
                        });
                        doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                        y += (r.dl.length * lh);
                        if (rIndex < rows.length - 1) y += rowGap;
                    } else if (r.email) {
                        // Render email as clickable mailto link
                        const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(String(r.email || ''), valueW);
                        let first = true;
                        wrapped.forEach(line => {
                            if (!first) y += lh;
                            doc.setTextColor(200, 0, 0);
                            doc.text(line, valueX, y);
                            try { doc.link(valueX, y - (lh - rowsFS), doc.getTextWidth(line), lh, { url: `mailto:${line}` }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
                            first = false;
                        });
                        doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                        y += lh;
                        if (rIndex < rows.length - 1) y += rowGap;
                    } else {
                        const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(String(r.value || ''), valueW);
                        let first = true;
                        wrapped.forEach(line => {
                            if (!first) y += lh;
                            doc.text(line, valueX, y);
                            first = false;
                        });
                        y += lh;
                        if (rIndex < rows.length - 1) y += rowGap;
                    }
                }

                // Bottom red validation note inside the grey panel (anchored near bottom)
                if (spec.showValidationNote && spec.contentValidationNote) {
                    doc.setTextColor(200, 0, 0);
                    doc.setFontSize(noteFS);
                    const lhNote = Math.round(noteFS * 1.2);
                    const noteLines = doc.splitTextToSize(spec.contentValidationNote, panelW - 20);
                    const totalH = noteLines.length * lhNote;
                    const noteY = Math.max(panelY + panelH - 10 - totalH, y + 6);
                    doc.text(noteLines, panelX + 10, noteY);
                    doc.setTextColor('#000000');
                }

                // Draw Title Block on this Delivery page as well
                drawTitleBlock(doc, pageNumber, totalPages);
            };

            // Delivery page is the last page
            pageIndex += 1;
            addDeliverySpecPage(doc, pageIndex);

            if (mode === 'preview') {
                try {
                    const pdfBlob = doc.output('blob');
                    const arrayBuffer = await pdfBlob.arrayBuffer();
                    const typedArray = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);
                    const pdfjsLib = window['pdfjsLib'] || window['pdfjs-dist/build/pdf'] || window['pdfjs-dist'];
                    if (!pdfjsLib || !pdfjsLib.getDocument) {
                        const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(pdfBlob);
                        window.open(blobUrl, '_blank');
                        showNotification('Preview opened in a new tab');
                        return;
                    }
                    const loadingTask = pdfjsLib.getDocument({ data: typedArray });
                    const pdf = await loadingTask.promise;
                    const panel = document.getElementById('pdf-preview-panel');
                    const pagesEl = document.getElementById('pdf-preview-pages');
                    if (!panel || !pagesEl) return;
                    pagesEl.innerHTML = '';
                    for (let pageNum = 1; pageNum <= pdf.numPages; pageNum++) {
                        const page = await pdf.getPage(pageNum);
                        const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1.25 });
                        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                        const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
                        canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
                        canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
                        canvas.style.width = '100%';
                        const renderContext = { canvasContext: context, viewport };
                        await page.render(renderContext).promise;
                        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        wrapper.className = 'bg-white rounded shadow overflow-hidden';
                        wrapper.appendChild(canvas);
                        const caption = document.createElement('div');
                        caption.className = 'text-xs text-gray-300 mt-1';
                        caption.textContent = `Page ${pageNum} of ${pdf.numPages}`;
                        pagesEl.appendChild(wrapper);
                        pagesEl.appendChild(caption);
                    }
                    panel.classList.remove('hidden');
                    state.pdfExport.previewPanelOpen = true;
                    state.pdfExport.previewDirty = false;
                    const badge = document.getElementById('pdf-preview-dirty');
                    if (badge) badge.classList.add('hidden');
                    showNotification('Preview ready');
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('PDF preview error', e);
                    try {
                        const blobUrl = doc.output('bloburl');
                        window.open(blobUrl, '_blank');
                        showNotification('Preview opened in a new tab');
                    } catch (_) {
                        showNotification('Failed to render preview');
                    }
                }
            } else {
                const safeOut = (state.pdfExport.outputFileName || `${projectForPdf.name}_PixelMaps_Export`).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_\-]/g, '_');
                doc.save(`${safeOut}.pdf`);
                showNotification('PDF generated successfully!');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('PDF generation error', err);
            showNotification('Failed to generate/preview PDF: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
        }
        };


        const applyTheme = (accentColor, textColor) => {
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--color-accent', accentColor);
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--color-text-base', textColor);
        };

        const clampUiScale = (value) => {
            const numeric = Number(value);
            if (Number.isNaN(numeric)) return 1;
            return Math.min(1.25, Math.max(0.8, numeric));
        };

        const applyUiScale = (value) => {
            const scale = clampUiScale(value || state.uiScale || 1);
            state.uiScale = scale;
            if (document && document.body) {
                document.body.style.zoom = scale;
            }
            const slider = document.getElementById('app-scale-slider');
            if (slider) slider.value = Math.round(scale * 100);
            const label = document.getElementById('app-scale-value');
            if (label) label.textContent = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
            try { localStorage.setItem('pixellogic-ui-scale', String(scale)); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        };

        const loadGoogleFont = (family) => {
            try {
                const href = `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=${family}:wght@400;600;700;900&display=swap`;
                if (!document.querySelector(`link[href="${href}"]`)) {
                    const link = document.createElement('link');
                    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
                    link.href = href;
                    document.head.appendChild(link);
                }
            } catch (e) { /* best-effort */ }
        };

        const showInputModal = (title, currentValue, callback, isNewProject = false) => {
            const fieldsContainer = document.getElementById('input-modal-fields');
            fieldsContainer.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous fields

            if (typeof currentValue === 'object' && currentValue !== null) {
                inputModalIsObject = true;
                // Multi-field for project details (now includes client and venue)
                fieldsContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div><label class="text-sm text-gray-400">Project Name</label>
                        <input type="text" id="input-modal-field-name" value="${currentValue.name}" placeholder="e.g., Summer Festival 2025" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mt-1">
                    </div>
                    <div><label class="text-sm text-gray-400">Location (Optional)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="input-modal-field-location" value="${currentValue.location || ''}" placeholder="e.g., New York, NY" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mt-1">
                    </div>
                    <div><label class="text-sm text-gray-400">Salesperson (Optional)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="input-modal-field-salesperson" value="${currentValue.salesperson || ''}" placeholder="e.g., Jane Doe" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mt-1">
                    </div>
                    <div><label class="text-sm text-gray-400">Client (Optional)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="input-modal-field-client" value="${currentValue.client || ''}" placeholder="e.g., Client Name" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mt-1">
                    </div>
                    <div><label class="text-sm text-gray-400">Venue (Optional)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="input-modal-field-venue" value="${currentValue.venue || ''}" placeholder="e.g., Madison Square Garden" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mt-1">
                    </div>
                `;
            } else {
                inputModalIsObject = false;
                // Single field for map/canvas name
                fieldsContainer.innerHTML = `<input type="text" id="input-modal-field" value="${currentValue}" class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-600 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">`;
            }

            const modal = document.getElementById('input-modal');
            document.getElementById('input-modal-title').textContent = title;
            const saveButton = document.getElementById('input-modal-save');
            saveButton.textContent = isNewProject ? 'Create Project' : 'Save';

            inputModalCallback = callback;
            modal.style.display = 'flex';

            const firstInput = fieldsContainer.querySelector('input');
            if (firstInput) {
                firstInput.focus();
                firstInput.select();
                firstInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const btn = document.getElementById('input-modal-save');
                        if (btn) btn.click();
                    }
                }, { once: true });
            }
        };

        const hideInputModal = () => {
            document.getElementById('input-modal').style.display = 'none';
        };

        
        // --- INITIALIZATION ---
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            if(window.pdfjsLib) {
                window.pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/2.11.338/pdf.worker.min.js`;
            }

            hydrateSystemFonts();

            // Load and apply theme
            const savedAccent = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-accent-color') || '#6366f1';
            const savedText = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-text-color') || '#ffffff';
            // applyTheme controls accent and text color; interface background is controlled by --interface-bg
            applyTheme(savedAccent, savedText);
            // initialize background from savedAccent for backward compatibility (layout color picker used to map to accent)
            const savedBg = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-interface-bg') || savedAccent || '#0a0a1a';
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--interface-bg', savedBg);
            document.getElementById('layout-color-picker').value = savedBg;
            document.getElementById('font-color-picker').value = savedText;
            const savedFont = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-font') || "Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial";
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--interface-font', savedFont);
            const fontSelect = document.getElementById('interface-font-select'); if (fontSelect) fontSelect.value = savedFont;
            // Load a Google font where appropriate
            if (savedFont.includes('Roboto')) loadGoogleFont('Roboto');
            else if (savedFont.includes('Montserrat')) loadGoogleFont('Montserrat');
            else if (savedFont.includes('IBM Plex Sans')) loadGoogleFont('IBM+Plex+Sans');
            else if (savedFont.includes('Source Sans Pro')) loadGoogleFont('Source+Sans+Pro');
            else if (savedFont.includes('Fira Sans')) loadGoogleFont('Fira+Sans');

            // Restore previously selected active Effects preset (non-destructive preview selection)
            try {
                const savedActivePreset = localStorage.getItem('pixellogic-active-effects-preset');
                if (savedActivePreset) {
                    if (!state.ui) state.ui = {};
                    state.ui.activeEffectsPresetId = savedActivePreset;
                }
            } catch(_) {}
            const firstPixelMap = createNewPixelMapObject(1);
            Object.assign(firstPixelMap, {
                id: Date.now(), name: 'Main Backdrop',
                screenWidthValue: 8, screenHeightValue: 4.5, screenDimensionsUnit: 'm',
                panelWidthMm: 500, panelHeightMm: 500, panelResWidth: 128, panelResHeight: 128,
                details: {
                    ...firstPixelMap.details,
                    info: { ...firstPixelMap.details.info, enabled: true, name: 'Main Stage Center', position: 'top-left', fontSize: 50 },
                }
            });
            const calcs = calculateLayout(firstPixelMap);
            firstPixelMap.panels = Array(calcs.totalPanels || 0).fill(true);

            const firstCanvas = {id: Date.now() + 1, name: 'Main Output', width: 3840, height: 2160, maps: []};

            // Load Devices DB (v2) from localStorage; ignore other versions to avoid cross-impact
            try { loadDevicesFromStorage(); } catch(_) {}

            // Try to load from localStorage; if not present, seed a sample project
            let loaded = loadProjectsFromStorage();
            if (!loaded) {
                const now = new Date().toISOString();
                const sampleProject = {
                    id: 1,
                    name: 'Project - 01',
                    createdAt: now,
                    savedAt: now,
                    status: 'draft',
                    eventDate: '',
                    eventTime: '',
                    location: 'New York, NY',
                    salesperson: 'Jane Doe',
                    client: 'ACME Corp',
                    venue: '',
                    pixelMaps: [firstPixelMap],
                    activePixelMapId: firstPixelMap.id,
                    canvases: [firstCanvas], 
                    activeCanvasId: firstCanvas.id
                };
                state.projects.push(sampleProject);
                state.activeProjectId = sampleProject.id;
                persistProjects();
            }
            // Normalize legacy default name if loaded from older sessions
            try {
                let renamed = false;
                state.projects.forEach(p => {
                    if (p && typeof p.name === 'string' && p.name === 'Sample Show Project') {
                        p.name = 'Project - 01';
                        renamed = true;
                    }
                });
                if (renamed) persistProjects();
            } catch(_) {}
            // Sync PDF Export selection with active project
            state.pdfExport.selectedProjectId = state.activeProjectId || (state.projects[0]?.id ?? null);

            switchTab('designer');

            // --- Global Event Listeners ---
            navTabs.forEach(tab => tab.addEventListener('click', (e) => switchTab(e.currentTarget.dataset.tab)));
            if (modeSwitch) {
                modeSwitch.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    applyAppMode(modeSwitch.checked ? APP_MODES.projection : APP_MODES.pixel);
                });
            }
            initAppMode();

            // Keydown listener for canvas delete
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (state.activeTab === 'canvas' && (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && state.canvasState.selectedMapId) {
                    deleteSelectedMapFromCanvas();
                }
            });

            // About Modal Listeners
            const aboutBtn = document.getElementById('about-btn');
            const aboutModal = document.getElementById('about-modal');
            const closeModalBtn = document.getElementById('close-about-modal');
            // Help Modal Listeners
            const helpBtn = document.getElementById('help-btn');
            const helpModal = document.getElementById('help-modal');
            const closeHelpBtn = document.getElementById('close-help-modal');
            const layoutColorPicker = document.getElementById('layout-color-picker');
            const fontColorPicker = document.getElementById('font-color-picker');
            const interfaceFontSelect = document.getElementById('interface-font-select');
            const appScaleSlider = document.getElementById('app-scale-slider');
            const appScaleResetButton = document.getElementById('app-scale-reset');

            applyUiScale(state.uiScale);

            if (appScaleSlider) {
                appScaleSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                    const normalized = Number(e.target.value || 100) / 100;
                    applyUiScale(normalized);
                });
            }
            if (appScaleResetButton) {
                appScaleResetButton.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    applyUiScale(1);
                    if (appScaleSlider) appScaleSlider.focus();
                });
            }

                // Focus management for modal
                let lastFocusedElement = null;
                const focusableSelectors = 'a[href], area[href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), button:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

                const trapFocus = (container) => {
                    const focusable = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors)).filter(el => el.offsetParent !== null);
                    if (focusable.length === 0) return null;
                    const first = focusable[0];
                    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
                    const handler = (e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                            if (e.shiftKey) {
                                if (document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
                            } else {
                                if (document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
                            }
                        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                            closeAboutModal();
                        }
                    };
                    document.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
                    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
                };

                let releaseFocusTrap = null;
                const openAboutModal = () => {
                    lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
                    aboutModal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    aboutModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
                    aboutBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    // delay focus to first focusable element inside the dialog
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        const dialog = aboutModal.querySelector('[role="dialog"]');
                        if (dialog) {
                            const firstFocusable = dialog.querySelector(focusableSelectors);
                            if (firstFocusable) firstFocusable.focus();
                        }
                        releaseFocusTrap = trapFocus(aboutModal);
                    }, 10);
                };

                const closeAboutModal = () => {
                    aboutModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    aboutModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                    aboutBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    if (typeof releaseFocusTrap === 'function') { releaseFocusTrap(); releaseFocusTrap = null; }
                    if (lastFocusedElement && lastFocusedElement.focus) lastFocusedElement.focus();
                };

                // Help modal open/close using same focus trap utilities
                const openHelpModal = () => {
                    if (!helpModal) return;
                    lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
                    helpModal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    helpModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
                    if (helpBtn) helpBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        const dialog = helpModal.querySelector('[role="dialog"]');
                        if (dialog) {
                            const firstFocusable = dialog.querySelector(focusableSelectors);
                            if (firstFocusable) firstFocusable.focus();
                        }
                        releaseFocusTrap = trapFocus(helpModal);
                    }, 10);
                };
                const closeHelpModal = () => {
                    if (!helpModal) return;
                    helpModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    helpModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                    if (helpBtn) helpBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    if (typeof releaseFocusTrap === 'function') { releaseFocusTrap(); releaseFocusTrap = null; }
                    if (lastFocusedElement && lastFocusedElement.focus) lastFocusedElement.focus();
                };

                aboutBtn.addEventListener('click', openAboutModal);
                closeModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeAboutModal);
                // clicking backdrop closes
                const aboutBackdrop = document.querySelector('[data-about-backdrop]');
                if (aboutBackdrop) aboutBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeAboutModal);

                if (helpBtn) helpBtn.addEventListener('click', openHelpModal);
                if (closeHelpBtn) closeHelpBtn.addEventListener('click', closeHelpModal);
                const helpBackdrop = document.querySelector('[data-help-backdrop]');
                if (helpBackdrop) helpBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeHelpModal);

                // ensure Escape key closes when focus not trapped
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                        if (aboutModal && !aboutModal.classList.contains('hidden')) closeAboutModal();
                        if (helpModal && !helpModal.classList.contains('hidden')) closeHelpModal();
                    }
                });

                aboutModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    // close only when clicking outside the dialog box (backdrop area)
                    const dialog = aboutModal.querySelector('[role="dialog"]');
                    if (dialog && !dialog.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('[role="dialog"]')) closeAboutModal();
                });
                if (helpModal) helpModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const dialog = helpModal.querySelector('[role="dialog"]');
                    if (dialog && !dialog.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('[role="dialog"]')) closeHelpModal();
                });

                // About modal Help button removed

                layoutColorPicker.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                    // Use layout color picker to set interface background (not font color)
                    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--interface-bg', e.target.value);
                    // persist to dedicated interface bg key
                    localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-interface-bg', e.target.value);
                });
             fontColorPicker.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                applyTheme(localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-accent-color') || '#6366f1', e.target.value);
                localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-text-color', e.target.value);
            });
            interfaceFontSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                const val = e.target.value;
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--interface-font', val);
                localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-font', val);
                // Try to load matching Google font families where applicable (best-effort)
                if (val.includes('Roboto')) loadGoogleFont('Roboto');
                else if (val.includes('Montserrat')) loadGoogleFont('Montserrat');
                else if (val.includes('IBM Plex Sans')) loadGoogleFont('IBM+Plex+Sans');
                else if (val.includes('Source Sans Pro')) loadGoogleFont('Source+Sans+Pro');
                else if (val.includes('Fira Sans')) loadGoogleFont('Fira+Sans');
            });
            // Theme mode handlers
            const applyThemeMode = (mode) => {
                const root = document.documentElement;
                root.classList.remove('theme-dark','theme-light','theme-invert');
                const savedAccent = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-accent-color') || '#6366f1';
                const savedText = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-text-color') || '#ffffff';
                if (mode === 'dark') {
                    root.classList.add('theme-dark');
                    root.style.setProperty('--color-accent', savedAccent);
                    root.style.setProperty('--color-text-base', savedText);
                    const savedBg = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-interface-bg') || '#0a0a1a';
                    root.style.setProperty('--interface-bg', savedBg);
                } else if (mode === 'light') {
                    root.classList.add('theme-light');
                    root.style.setProperty('--color-accent', savedAccent);
                    root.style.setProperty('--color-text-base', '#0b1220');
                    root.style.setProperty('--interface-bg', '#f8fafc');
                } else if (mode === 'invert') {
                    root.classList.add('theme-invert');
                    root.style.setProperty('--color-accent', '#ffffff');
                    root.style.setProperty('--color-text-base', '#000000');
                    root.style.setProperty('--interface-bg', '#ffffff');
                }
                localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-theme-mode', mode);
            };

            const renderHeaderSocialLinks = () => {
                const container = document.getElementById('header-social-links');
                if (!container) return;
                container.innerHTML = '';
                // Instagram
                const a1 = document.createElement('a'); a1.href = AUTHOR_INSTAGRAM; a1.target = '_blank'; a1.rel = 'noreferrer noopener'; a1.title = 'Instagram';
                a1.innerHTML = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-5 h-5 text-pink-500" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="5"/><path d="M16 11.37A4 4 0 1 1 12.63 8 4 4 0 0 1 16 11.37z"/><line x1="17.5" y1="6.5" x2="17.51" y2="6.5"/></svg>`;
                container.appendChild(a1);
                // LinkedIn
                const a2 = document.createElement('a'); a2.href = AUTHOR_LINKEDIN; a2.target = '_blank'; a2.rel = 'noreferrer noopener'; a2.title = 'LinkedIn';
                a2.innerHTML = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M16 8a6 6 0 0 1 6 6v6h-4v-6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2c-1.657 0-3 1.343-3 3v5h-4v-11h4v2.2c.9-1.6 2.7-2.7 4.6-2.7z"/></svg>`;
                container.appendChild(a2);
            };
            

            document.getElementById('theme-dark').addEventListener('click', () => applyThemeMode('dark'));
            document.getElementById('theme-light').addEventListener('click', () => applyThemeMode('light'));
            document.getElementById('theme-invert').addEventListener('click', () => applyThemeMode('invert'));

            // Social links are fixed; no save handler required

            // Backup & Restore now lives in Shows tab (renderShows binds listeners per render)

            // Render fixed social links in header
            renderHeaderSocialLinks();
            // Bind quick theme swatches in header
            try {
                const container = document.getElementById('header-theme-swatches');
                if (container) {
                    const updatePerformanceBadge = () => {
                        const el = document.getElementById('header-performance-status');
                        if (!el) return;
                        const mode = (localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-performance-mode') || '').toLowerCase();
                        if (mode === 'lite') {
                            el.textContent = 'Lite';
                            el.classList.remove('hidden');
                        } else {
                            el.classList.add('hidden');
                        }
                    };
                    container.querySelectorAll('button[data-accent]').forEach(btn => {
                        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            const accent = btn.getAttribute('data-accent') || '#6366f1';
                            const bg = btn.getAttribute('data-bg') || '#0a0a1a';
                            applyTheme(accent, localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-text-color') || '#ffffff');
                            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--interface-bg', bg);
                            try {
                                localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-accent-color', accent);
                                localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-interface-bg', bg);
                                const lp = document.getElementById('layout-color-picker'); if (lp) lp.value = bg;
                            } catch(_) {}
                        });
                    });
                    const darkBtn = document.getElementById('header-theme-dark');
                    const lightBtn = document.getElementById('header-theme-light');
                    if (darkBtn) darkBtn.addEventListener('click', () => applyThemeMode('dark'));
                    if (lightBtn) lightBtn.addEventListener('click', () => applyThemeMode('light'));
                    const perfLite = document.getElementById('header-performance-lite');
                    const perfFull = document.getElementById('header-performance-full');
                    if (perfLite) perfLite.addEventListener('click', () => { try { localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-preview-cap-mp', '1'); localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-performance-mode', 'lite'); showNotification('Lite mode: preview capped at 1MP'); } catch(_) {} updatePerformanceBadge(); redrawAffectedVisuals && redrawAffectedVisuals(); });
                    if (perfFull) perfFull.addEventListener('click', () => { try { localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-preview-cap-mp', '4'); localStorage.setItem('pixi-logic-performance-mode', 'full'); showNotification('Full mode: preview capped at 4MP'); } catch(_) {} updatePerformanceBadge(); redrawAffectedVisuals && redrawAffectedVisuals(); });
                    // Initialize badge state on start
                    updatePerformanceBadge();
                }
            } catch(_) {}
            const savedMode = localStorage.getItem('pixi-logic-theme-mode') || 'dark'; applyThemeMode(savedMode);
            
            // Input modal buttons wiring
            const modalSaveBtn = document.getElementById('input-modal-save');
            const modalCancelBtn = document.getElementById('input-modal-cancel');
            if (modalCancelBtn) modalCancelBtn.addEventListener('click', hideInputModal);
            if (modalSaveBtn) modalSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                try {
                    if (typeof inputModalCallback !== 'function') { hideInputModal(); return; }
                    if (inputModalIsObject) {
                        const values = {
                            name: (document.getElementById('input-modal-field-name')?.value || '').trim(),
                            location: (document.getElementById('input-modal-field-location')?.value || '').trim(),
                            salesperson: (document.getElementById('input-modal-field-salesperson')?.value || '').trim(),
                            client: (document.getElementById('input-modal-field-client')?.value || '').trim(),
                            venue: (document.getElementById('input-modal-field-venue')?.value || '').trim(),
                        };
                        inputModalCallback(values);
                    } else {
                        const value = (document.getElementById('input-modal-field')?.value || '').trim();
                        inputModalCallback(value);
                    }
                } finally {
                    hideInputModal();
                    inputModalCallback = null;
                }
            });

            // Global delegated handler as a safety net for Rename buttons (Shows only)
            document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const showsBtn = e.target.closest('.shows-rename');
                if (showsBtn) {
                    const id = parseInt(showsBtn.getAttribute('data-id'));
                    const proj = (state.projects || []).find(p => p.id === id);
                    if (proj) openRenameProjectModal(proj);
                    return;
                }
            });

            // Close rename modal on Escape or click outside
            const renameModal = document.getElementById('rename-project-modal');
            if (renameModal) {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape' && renameModal.style.display === 'flex') {
                        renameModal.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
                renameModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const content = renameModal.querySelector('.bg-gray-800.rounded-xl');
                    if (content && !content.contains(e.target)) {
                        renameModal.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
            }

            // Global responsive fitting: keep all previews visible on window resize
            let _resizeTimer = null;
            const doGlobalFit = () => {
                try {
                    // Designer preview
                    const designerWrapper = document.getElementById('designer-preview-wrapper');
                    if (designerWrapper) {
                        try { fitDesignerPreviewToScreen(false, true); } catch (_) {}
                    }
                    // Visualizer
                    const visualWrapper = document.getElementById('visualizer-wrapper');
                    if (visualWrapper) {
                        try { fitVisualizerToScreen(true); } catch (_) {}
                    }
                    // Effects live preview
                    const effectsViewport = document.getElementById('effects-preview-viewport');
                    const effectsCanvas = document.getElementById('effects-preview-canvas');
                    const effectsWrapper = document.getElementById('effects-preview-wrapper');
                    const effectsLabel = document.getElementById('effects-zoom-label');
                    if (effectsViewport && effectsCanvas && effectsWrapper) {
                        const vw = effectsViewport.clientWidth;
                        const vh = effectsViewport.clientHeight;
                        const cw = effectsCanvas.clientWidth || effectsCanvas.width || 1;
                        const ch = effectsCanvas.clientHeight || effectsCanvas.height || 1;
                        const fitScale = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(8, Math.min(vw / cw, vh / ch)));
                        try { state.ui = state.ui || {}; state.ui.effectsPreviewScale = fitScale; saveState(); } catch(_) {}
                        effectsWrapper.style.transform = `scale(${fitScale})`;
                        if (effectsLabel) effectsLabel.textContent = `${Math.round(fitScale * 100)}%`;
                    }
                    // Output Canvas
                    const mainCanvasWrap = document.getElementById('main-canvas-wrapper');
                    if (mainCanvasWrap) {
                        try { fitCanvasToScreen(); } catch (_) {}
                    }
                } catch(_) {}
            };
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                if (_resizeTimer) clearTimeout(_resizeTimer);
                _resizeTimer = setTimeout(doGlobalFit, 150);
            });
            // When app regains focus, ensure Shows tab is unlocked (addresses freeze that clears after tab switch)
            window.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                try {
                    if (state && state.activeTab === 'shows' && typeof unlockShowsUi === 'function') {
                        unlockShowsUi();
                        setTimeout(unlockShowsUi, 50);
                    }
                } catch(_) {}
            });
            // Also on visibility change
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
                try {
                    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && state && state.activeTab === 'shows' && typeof unlockShowsUi === 'function') {
                        unlockShowsUi();
                        setTimeout(unlockShowsUi, 50);
                    }
                } catch(_) {}
            });
            
        });
    </script>
        <script>
            // Lightweight anti-inspect and anti-copy deterrents (not bulletproof)
            (function () {
                const ENABLE_PROTECTION = false; // disabled
                if (!ENABLE_PROTECTION) return;

                // Disable right-click context menu
                document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                }, { capture: true });

                // Block common shortcut combos (View Source, DevTools, Save, Print)
                // Allow normal browser shortcuts; do not block DevTools or printing
                // (previously prevented F12/Ctrl+Shift+I/C/etc. which could interfere in Chrome)

                // Heuristic DevTools detection: if opened, blur UI temporarily
                let devtoolsOpen = false;
                const overlay = document.createElement('div');
                overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:99999;display:none;color:#fff;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:600 16px Inter,system-ui;';
                overlay.textContent = 'Protected Mode: Developer Tools detected';
                document.body.appendChild(overlay);

                const checkDevtools = () => {
                    // Disable heuristic overlay to prevent accidental UI blackout
                    const threshold = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
                    const widthDiff = Math.abs(window.outerWidth - window.innerWidth);
                    const heightDiff = Math.abs(window.outerHeight - window.innerHeight);
                    const suspected = widthDiff > threshold || heightDiff > threshold;
                    if (suspected !== devtoolsOpen) {
                        devtoolsOpen = false;
                        overlay.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                };
                setInterval(checkDevtools, 1000);
            })();
        </script>
</div>
